The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.
Surfaces include ceramic tile"bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72"occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.
Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.
Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Carrying

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Shift Leader - 6071
jobs.description:
Summary: Assists in the daily oversight, coordination and execution of stated objectives in sales, costs, employee retention, customer service and satisfaction, food quality, cleanliness and sanitation.

Summary: Delivers excellent service, product and image standards to maintain high customer satisfaction.

Essential Job Functions:

1. Provides leadership support to the Manager on Duty (MOD).

2. Maintains high standards of customer service during high-volume, fast-paced operations.

3. Communicates clearly and positively with management and team members.

4. Greets customers in person or via phone and takes order professionally and promptly.

5. Provides excellent customer service to encourage repeat customers, providing information regarding menu and specials.

6. Helps support shift management.

7. Communicates daily job assignments on each shift.

8. Oversees pre-close functions while ensuring service and food quality standards are maintained.

9. Front of the House (FOH): Oversees cash management duties. Counts down registers, tracks cash and coupons for accountability. Processes daily report(s).

10. Back of the House (BOH): Adheres to all waste tracking procedures and adheres to all food and labor cost best practices.

11. Avails chances to “up-sell” additional products

12. Masters Point of Sale (POS) computer systems for automated order taking.

13. Handles currency and credit transactions quickly and accurately.

14. Follows procedures for safe food preparation, assembly and presentation.

15. Assists management with inventory control and stock ordering.

16. Builds loyal customers through friendly interactions and consistent appreciation.

17. Resolves complaints promptly and professionally.

18. Cross-trains and coordinates scheduling with team members to ensure seamless service.

19. Takes initiative to find extra tasks when scheduled duties are complete.

20. Assemble and fold boxes. Affix labels and promotional materials as needed.

21. Prepares a variety of pizzas and other menu items.

22. Measures ingredients required for specific items being prepared.

23. Reads order slips or receives verbal instructions to prepare order according to specifications, often making several different orders simultaneously.

24. Cleans, stocks and restocks work stations and display cases.

25. Transfers supplies and tools between storage and work areas.

26. Packs, weighs, and labels products as required.

27. Ensures supervisor is aware of food shortages.

28. Adhere with all quality standards, principles, guidelines and policies

29. Perform other duties as assigned.

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.
Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
Prepare product.
Receive and process telephone orders.
Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.
Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
Must be able to make correct monetary change.
Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
Fumes from food odors.
Exposure to cornmeal dust.
Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.
Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
Depth perception.
Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.
Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending
Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.
Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.
Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.

Responsibilities

• Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data.

• Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering.

• Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant.

• Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way.

• Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response.

• Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.

Skills and Qualifications

• 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.

• A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish.

• Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration.

• Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).

• Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.

• Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.

• Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.

Bonus Skills and Qualifications

• Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala.

• Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores).

• Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.

• Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.

• Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).

• Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.

• Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration.

Benefits:

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

• Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

• 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

• Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

• Medical and dependent care FSA options.

• Flexible PTO policy.

• Parental leave.

• Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $170,000

Bonus Target: 10%

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT DAVID AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.



David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.



Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for exceptional people across every function to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to build and lead our marketing function. You will own how we position David AI, bring our work to market, and create demand among the teams building audio AI. You will connect our datasets, evaluations, and research into a clear company story, supported by evidence that earns the trust of customers, researchers, and future teammates.



You will work closely with our founders and leadership team across functions to drive tangible results for David AI. This is a hands-on leadership role: you should be as comfortable interviewing a customer or writing a launch announcement as setting strategy, allocating budget for different marketing initiatives, and hiring your team.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work directly with Tomer on the company's most important priorities. Turn broad goals and open questions into clear plans, decisions, owners, and next steps.

 - Own strategic and operating projects that cut across functions or do not yet have a clear owner, from initial problem definition through execution.

 - Help run the company's operating rhythm. Track the most important priorities, surface issues early, and make sure decisions and commitments turn into action.

 - Dig into parts of the business that need additional attention. Get to the underlying facts, identify what is working or not working, and build a plan with the team to address it.

 - Support company planning and help translate company-level goals into priorities across the organization.

 - Lead analysis on important company decisions. Pull together the right data and context, pressure-test the options, and develop a clear recommendation.

 - Partner closely with leaders across research, engineering, product, data operations, go-to-market, finance, and people to move cross-functional work forward.

 - Support CEO-level work including board preparation, fundraising, executive hiring, organizational planning, and other priorities as they arise.

 - Help Tomer allocate his time against the areas where he can have the most impact, and take ownership of work that does not need to stay with him.

 - Step into new initiatives or areas that need temporary ownership, build structure around them, and stay close to execution until there is a clear long-term owner.




YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 8+ years in marketing, communications, or a related storytelling role, including experience leading a team at a growing startup.

 - Exceptional writing and storytelling, demonstrated through work you personally created and published. 

 - Experience working with technical experts. You can ask questions that get beyond the obvious, understand the substance, and explain it accurately without relying on jargon.

 - Experience hiring and developing people, managing creative work, and giving specific, useful feedback that makes the work better.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

BENEFITS

VISAS

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer II
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

MANUFACTURING

Manufacturing Engineering powers Rocket Lab’s factories from concept to full-scale production. We turn early ideas into manufacturable designs, build and optimize the systems that make them real, and constantly push for faster, better, smarter ways to build. We engineer the factories that build the rockets, boosting quality, cutting cost, and accelerating build rate.

SENIOR MANUFACTURING ENGINEER II - AVIONICS & TEST

This role centers on testing and avionics, involving hands-on debugging of electro-mechanical and avionics systems, optimizing manufacturing processes, and supporting product design for manufacturability. It also includes troubleshooting production issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and driving process improvements.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A SENIOR MANUFACTURING ENGINEER II - AVIONICS & TEST

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or similar

• 8 + years of technical experience in a Manufacturing, Production, or Process Engineering environment

• Hands-on experience solving problems in complex manufacturing systems

• Ability to effectively deliver on complex assignments with autonomy

• Foundational knowledge in complex manufacturing processes

• Hands-on technical experience debugging electro-mechanical systems

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

• Working experience with environmental acceptance/production acceptance testing, such as vibration, shock, thermal, and vacuum

• Understanding of instrumentation, interfaces, and sensors including power supplies, oscilloscopes, serial devices, switch topologies, accelerometers, thermocouples, RTDs, and 4-20mA sensors

• Experience with designing, implementing, and supporting a production line and/or build area

• Experience transitioning products from design to production as a part of cross-functional team in a fast-paced, iterative design environment

• Demonstrated experience with DFMEA, PFMEA methodologies, Fault Tree Analysis, Pareto analysis, root cause and corrective action

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)

$164,500—$233,275 USD

Base Salary

$132,000—$176,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.title: Director of Account Management
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.



About the role

Rillet is the AI-native ERP for modern finance teams, trusted by 750+ customers from fast-growing startups to public companies. As our customer base scales, expansion and retention will become increasingly important drivers of growth.

We're looking for our first Director of Account Management to build and own the commercial strategy for our existing customers. You'll establish our renewals and expansion motions, build and lead the AM team, and help drive Rillet's evolution into a multi-product platform. You'll also serve as a key voice of the customer, influencing pricing, packaging, and product strategy. This is a hands-on builder role for a commercial leader who has owned a number, built scalable processes, and thrives in high-growth environments.



What You'll Do

 - Build and lead Account Management: Own NRR and expansion ARR targets, hire and develop the AM team, establish coverage models and compensation plans, and define clear ownership across AM, CS, and Sales.

 - Own renewals and expansion: Build predictable renewal forecasting, risk management, and escalation processes while driving strategic account planning, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities.

 - Drive multi-product growth: Partner with Product and Product Marketing to launch new modules into the customer base, develop cross-sell strategies, and turn early adopters into advocates.

 - Shape pricing and monetization: Work closely with the CEO, Product, and Finance to refine pricing and packaging using customer insights, expansion data, and willingness-to-pay analysis.

 - Influence product strategy: Establish a structured customer feedback loop, quantify opportunities by ARR impact, and help prioritize the roadmap based on customer needs.

 - Build executive relationships: Lead strategic customer engagement, including Executive Briefings and a Customer Advisory Board of CFOs and Controllers.



What You Bring

 - 10+ years in B2B SaaS, including 5+ years leading Account Management, renewals, or expansion teams.

 - Proven success owning and exceeding NRR and expansion revenue targets.

 - Experience building and scaling renewals or expansion motions from the ground up.

 - Hands-on experience influencing pricing, packaging, and multi-product growth strategies.

 - Experience selling to finance leaders; ERP, accounting, FP&A, or fintech experience strongly preferred.

 - Strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and experience leading complex negotiations.


AI FLUENCY (REQUIRED)

AI is central to how Rillet builds and operates. We're looking for leaders who actively leverage AI to improve efficiency, decision-making, and team performance.

 - Use LLMs and AI agents for account research, meeting preparation, and strategic account planning.

 - Build or implement AI-powered workflows for renewal risk, call analysis, and forecasting.

 - Drive AI adoption across the team and measure its impact on productivity.

Be prepared to demonstrate how you're using AI in your work today.

The expected base salary range for this role is $320,000 - $340,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.


LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR THE BEST




ABOUT US

42dot is a mobility AI company committed to solving mobility challenges with software and AI. As the Global Software Center of Hyundai Motor Group, 42dot pioneers the future of mobility by advancing the development of software-defined vehicles. 

We develop safety-first, user-centric software-defined vehicle technologies that deliver the latest performance through continuous updates like smartphones. By advancing software and AI technology, 42dot envisions a world where everything is connected and moves autonomously through a self-managing urban transportation operating system.





ABOUT THE ROLE

Great models are only as good as the system they run on. This role sits at the boundary between the ML autonomy team's models and the on-board system, taking what the research and ML teams build and turning it into something that runs reliably, in real time, on real vehicle hardware. 42dot is looking for builders who want to own the last and hardest mile between a model that works in an offline eval and a model that works in a vehicle.




FOUNDING TEAM OPPORTUNITY

The on-board integration architecture is being defined right now, with no legacy deployment stack to retrofit. An early hire here will help shape:

 - The model deployment pipeline, from training-time artifact to vehicle-ready binary

 - Inference optimization strategy and tooling for the whole autonomy stack

 - The interface contract standard between ML models and on-board software

Responsibilities

 - Integrate ML models (end-to-end driving, VLA, world models) onto the on-board compute and runtime stack

 - Optimize model inference for latency, throughput, memory, and power on embedded automotive hardware

 - Build and maintain the model deployment pipeline, including conversion, validation, and rollout

 - Stabilize on-vehicle ML execution by diagnosing runtime failures, timing violations, and resource contention

 - Define interface contracts between ML models and the rest of the on-board software stack

 - Work closely with the ML autonomy team to close the loop between deployment constraints and model design



Qualifications

 -  A track record of grit and ownership, with a demonstrated ability to work through ambiguous technical problems to a working solution

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, EE, Robotics, or related field

 - 2-4 years of experience in systems or software engineering, with some exposure to ML inference, embedded systems, or real-time software

 - Experience contributing to deploying or optimizing ML models in production.

 - Solid C++ and Python skills, with interest in working across the ML and systems boundary



Preferred Qualifications

 - Background in autonomous driving or robotics on-board software

 - Exposure to inference optimization frameworks such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, and automotive SoCs

 - Exposure to real-time operating systems and safety-critical software practices

 - Experience contributing to CI/CD and automated validation pipelines

jobs.title: Communications Associate
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Communications Associate, reporting to the Director of Communications, to support external communications and marketing across Vast’s programs including space stations, satellites, and lunar infrastructure.

This will be a fixed-term position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

The work is hands-on and includes responsibilities like project managing company announcements, pitching reporters, tracking news, and shepherding speaker submissions and award nominations. You will work with the rest of the Marketing team to ensure Vast’s external communications is cohesive, accurate and on brand.

Responsibilities:

• Draft and send media pitches for company news

• Build and maintain media lists and reporter relationships across space, technology, and business beats

• Monitor daily coverage of Vast, competitors, customers, and partners; flag items needing a same-day response

• Draft speaker abstracts, executive bios, and award nominations; gather supporting data from engineering, program, and business development teams

• Manage timelines and status for communications projects and keep stakeholders informed of deliverables

• 3+ years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, journalism, or an agency setting

• Demonstrated media relations experience, including pitches that resulted in earned coverage

• Bachelor’s degree

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Experience in communications within the aerospace, technology, or hardware industries

• Familiarity with the space industry press, conference circuit, and major industry awards

• Experience drafting speaker abstracts or award nominations that were accepted

jobs.title: Calibration, Mapping & Localization Engineer
jobs.description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR THE BEST




ABOUT US

42dot is a mobility AI company committed to solving mobility challenges with software and AI. As the Global Software Center of Hyundai Motor Group, 42dot pioneers the future of mobility by advancing the development of software-defined vehicles. 

We develop safety-first, user-centric software-defined vehicle technologies that deliver the latest performance through continuous updates like smartphones. By advancing software and AI technology, 42dot envisions a world where everything is connected and moves autonomously through a self-managing urban transportation operating system.





ABOUT THE ROLE

ML-first does not mean ML-only: every model this team ships depends on a vehicle that knows precisely where its sensors are, where it is in the world, and how confident it can be in both. This role owns that foundation, building the calibration, mapping, and localization stack that every perception and planning model is built on top of, across a multi-vehicle-class fleet spanning passenger vehicles, robotaxis, buses, and trucks.




FOUNDING TEAM OPPORTUNITY

Most autonomy programs set their calibration and localization architecture years ago and are now stuck maintaining it. This team is establishing its framework now, and an early hire will help shape:

 - Sensor calibration methodology and tooling, both online and offline

 - Mapping strategy, representation, and drift-detection pipelines

 - Localization architecture and the technical roadmap as the fleet scales

Responsibilities

 - Design and implement sensor calibration systems (camera, LiDAR, radar, IMU) for factory and in-field use

 - Build and maintain mapping pipelines, including map creation, versioning, and drift detection

 - Develop and improve localization algorithms, including sensor fusion, odometry, and SLAM

 - Define accuracy, latency, and reliability requirements for outputs consumed by downstream teams

 - Build tooling to validate calibration and localization quality at fleet scale

 - Diagnose and resolve calibration and localization failures from on-road and simulation testing

Qualifications

 - A demonstrated ability to work through difficult technical problems methodically, with growing independence

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, EE, Mathematics, or related field

 - 2-4 years of experience in sensor calibration, SLAM, mapping, localization, or multi-sensor fusion

 - Working knowledge of estimation theory, including Kalman filters, factor graphs, or optimization-based fusion

 - Solid software engineering skills in C++ and/or Python, with experience contributing to production-grade robotics systems



Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to autonomous driving or robotics across multiple vehicle classes

 - Exposure to HD map creation and maintenance pipelines

 - Experience with LiDAR, camera, or radar extrinsic calibration

 - Familiarity with functional safety requirements such as ISO 26262

Interview Process

 - Application Review - Coding Test - 1st interview - 2nd interview - Offer Negotiation - Hiring

 - The screening procedures may vary depending on the position, schedule, or other circumstances.
   
   You will be individually notified of the screening schedule and results via the email address provided in your application.



Compensation

 - $150,000 - $205,000



Additional Information

WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

As a Legal Engineer Associate, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our law firm and in-house customer users are set up for success. jobs.title: IAM Engineer
jobs.location: Austin, TX; Palo Alto, CA; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

IAM ENGINEER

We are looking for an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maturing our enterprise IAM ecosystem. As a Senior IAM Engineer, you will serve as a key subject matter expert (SME) within the broader Information Security organization, driving secure, scalable, and user-friendly identity solutions in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will own complex IAM initiatives end-to-end — from strategy and architecture to implementation and optimization — while collaborating closely with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Engineering teams. This is a high-impact, hands-on role suited for someone who thrives in ambiguity and takes extreme ownership of outcomes.

This high-visibility role requires the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates extreme ownership, a collaborative no-ego mindset, and is comfortable taking the lead. This is a significant opportunity to shape the future of identity and security at the company.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design and implement enterprise-grade IAM solutions across on-prem, cloud, and SaaS environments

• Architect and deliver end-to-end federation strategies using modern protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM)

• Lead integration and optimization of key IAM platforms including SailPoint, Okta, PingOne, Microsoft Entra ID, and other tools

• Drive Identity Lifecycle Management (LCM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Just-In-Time access initiatives

• Develop automation scripts and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to improve provisioning, governance, and operational efficiency

• Serve as the primary IAM SME, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting complex issues, and mentoring other team members

• Work closely with InfoSec, Compliance, and Engineering teams to meet audit, regulatory, and security requirements

• Continuously improve IAM architecture, processes, and capabilities in a dynamic, fast-moving organization

• Support cloud IAM strategies across AWS, GCP, and other platforms

• Participate in on-call rotation and incident response related to identity systems

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Thorough understanding of IAM principles and modern security concepts, including Zero Trust, Least Privilege, Adaptive/Risk-Based Authentication, Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), Continuous Access Evaluation, and Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR)

• Strong expertise in IAM protocols and standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and other federation protocols

• Strong expertise in IAM and federation protocols, with proven experience in architecting and implementing end-to-end federation solutions

• Hands-on experience with major IAM platforms, particularly SailPoint, Okta, PingOne, and Microsoft identity solutions

• Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), Cloud IAM services, Terraform, and CI/CD practices

• Strong scripting and programming skills in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with extensive experience developing IAM workflows, automation, and integrations

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and drive projects from design through implementation

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$100,000 - $198,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Channel Accounts, Comfort
jobs.description:
Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Location

This position will be based in Charlotte, NC.

Reporting

This position will report to the GM, Comfort.

Summary of Role

The Channel Accounts Director, Comfort is a senior management level role within Palmetto, and reports directly to the GM, Comfort. This is a key role responsible for identifying, assessing, negotiating and finalizing new business opportunities that are in line with the overall business and strategic growth objectives for Palmetto, and managing channel sales for the business.. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in the HVAC industry, along with a robust network of contracts in this space to drive partnerships and new product channel development. The Channel Accounts Director will work collaboratively with other internal functions to assess market potential, financial viability, technical relevance and proprietary and legal implications of all potential new business opportunities. In addition the Channel Accounts Director will lead day to day activities across the Channel Accounts Management team, including implementation of best practices, KPI development, and tooling and process which supports a high performing sales team. The successful candidate will be resourceful, a leader, proactive, organized, motivated to enhance the company's reputation, and relentless in developing high performance sales teams.

Strategic & Tactical

Strategic:

• Use established network within HVAC and Home Services industry to develop commercial partnerships

• Initiate prospecting and lead generation activities for both channel partners and corporate clients

• Help in developing educational and sales materials that clearly articulate Palmetto product offerings

• Work as a key stakeholder in the development of new products, services and channels including:

• Conducting market research and know Total Addressable Market for each state in region

• Development of business plans, sales positioning, presentations, reference material, and other documents as required

• Relay customer needs and requirements back to internal Palmetto teams including Product and Capital Markets leadership with a focus on both periodic innovation of existing products and development of new products or revenue opportunities

• Keeps informed on industry trends, regulations, technological advancements, and conducts market research and intelligence to identify opportunities for growth

• Collaborate with internal teams, including Technology, Finance, Revenue, and Operations, to ensure successful implementation and delivery of solutions to external customers

• Assist in regular reporting and strategy calibration with executive leadership

Tactical:

• Define, measure, and optimize the partner lifecycle stages (Lead → Onboarded → Trained → Activated → Producing → Repeat Producing) for HVAC and home electrification partners.

• Ensure forecast reliability and overall pipeline health for the channel.

• In collaboration with leadership - architect, operationalize and optimize revenue engine to drive predicable, scalable growth through well planned KPIs

• Sequence and manage rollouts for major national accounts to ensure structural success.

• Leverage data analytics to gain insights into partner behavior, sales trends, and market opportunities.

• Use data to inform strategic decisions regarding sales processes, marketing efforts, and partner relationships.

• Manage Salesforce platform governance, reporting integrity, and clean data architecture, as well as additional technology stack supporting Comfort Plan sales teams.

• In partnership with GM, Comfort, own team planning process, OKR structure, and design and evolve team management structures including reporting cadences.

• Own performance management, Compensation modeling and quota management for the Comfort Account Management team.

Qualifications

• 8+ years B2B enterprise business development, sales and/or account management experience

• Mandatory experience in HVAC/Heat Pump and Home Electrification industry with experience in consumer finance and the energy industry

• Athletes wanted - Broad commercial awareness developed in a fast-moving environment

• Superior communication skills – both oral and written

• Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills

• Proven analytical skills and ability to influence people both internally and externally

• Proven Ability to ideate, develop and execute strategic plans, in close collaboration with internal and external partners and stakeholders

• Decisive and ability to move with speed to implement ideas

• Ability to travel up to 30% of the time

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Palmetto embraces diversity and is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Director of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.




WHO WE ARE

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.



About the role

Rillet sells an AI-native ERP to finance teams, where operational rigor is everything. Our GTM engine should operate at the same standard.

As VP of Revenue Operations, you'll own the systems, data, planning, and processes behind every dollar of ARR, from first touch through renewal. You'll build a predictable, scalable revenue engine and give leadership one trusted view of the business.



What You’ll Do

 - Own GTM planning and forecasting: Lead annual and quarterly planning, bookings targets, capacity models, hiring plans, quota setting, and forecasting across new business, expansion, and renewals in partnership with Finance.

 - Drive revenue strategy and performance: Own executive and board reporting across ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, win rates, CAC payback, and sales efficiency, translating data into actionable business decisions.

 - Design scalable GTM infrastructure: Build territories, segmentation, account assignments, compensation plans, and rules of engagement across Sales, AM, CS, and Partnerships.

 - Own systems and data integrity: Lead the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, Gong, CPQ, etc.), ensuring clean CRM data, accurate commissions, a trusted source of truth for revenue, and measurable ROI on tools.

 - Optimize revenue processes: Establish pipeline standards, stage definitions, and deal desk operations that accelerate complex deals while protecting pricing, margins, and contract integrity. Partner with Finance on quote-to-cash and AM leadership on renewals.

 - Turn insights into action: Analyze funnel conversion, rep productivity, ramp time, and segment performance while leading weekly forecasts and QBRs that drive accountability.

 - Build and lead the RevOps function: Develop a high-performing team spanning sales operations, systems, analytics, and deal desk to support Rillet's next stage of growth.



Who We’re Looking For

 - 10+ years in Revenue, Sales, or Business Operations within high-growth B2B SaaS, including 4+ years leading teams.

 - Proven experience scaling GTM organizations through significant ARR and headcount growth.

 - Deep Salesforce expertise and hands-on experience with CPQ, forecasting, and conversation intelligence tools.

 - Strong financial modeling skills, including building and defending capacity plans with executive leadership.

 - Experience designing compensation plans, territories, and deal desk processes.

 - Strong communicator who builds credibility with sales teams and executives.

 - Experience selling to finance buyers or working in fintech/ERP is a plus.

The expected base salary range for this role is $220,000-$250,000 in New York City and San Francisco. Final compensation within this range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com http://rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.


LIFE AT RILLET

 - Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

 - Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

 - Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

 - Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Link Snacks is looking for a seasoned Human Resources Manager to serve as a strategic and hands-on HR business partner to manufacturing leadership, providing guidance and support to personnel and daily operations of the human resources department. Partnering with the leadership team to develop strategies that will enable the company to attract, recruit, and retain the best team members to meet its business objectives. This role is a great combination of both thought leadership and execution. We are looking for an innovative Human Resources leader, a self-starter who wants a hands-on role in building structure, systems, programs, and processes to achieve business success. This role will have responsibility for managing the workplace culture and environment through high performing programs within compensation, performance management, organization development, benefits and team member engagement.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as a strategic HR business partner to plant leadership, providing guidance on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, talent management, and people-related business decisions.
• Lead, coach, and develop the onsite HR team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and consistent execution of HR processes and initiatives.
• Foster a positive workplace culture by promoting team member engagement, open communication, recognition, retention, and strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
• Manage team member relations, including workplace investigations, conflict resolution, corrective actions, performance concerns, and employment separations, ensuring fair, timely, and consistent resolution.
• Coach and support supervisors and managers on effective leadership, performance management, accountability, communication, and team member development.
• Partner with plant leadership and Talent Acquisition to support staffing strategies, workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, internal promotions, and retention initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws, company policies, and established HR procedures.
• Oversee daily HR operations, including attendance management, personnel transactions, HR systems, recordkeeping, reporting, and accurate maintenance of team member information.
• Collaborate with corporate HR, Benefits, Payroll, Safety, Legal, and other functional partners to resolve issues, implement initiatives, and ensure consistent HR practices.
• Analyze key workforce metrics, including turnover, absenteeism, headcount, staffing, and retention, to identify trends, recommend solutions, and drive measurable improvements.
• Support organizational changes, leadership development, succession planning, and continuous improvement initiatives that align the people strategies with manufacturing business objectives.
• Drive standardization and continuous improvement of HR policies, processes, and programs across manufacturing facilities while ensuring effective execution at the site level.
• Maintain a visible and approachable HR presence across all shifts, ensuring team members and leaders have access to timely, professional, and consistent HR support.
• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• 5+ years of progressive manufacturing human resources experience, including significant experience in employee relations, HR operations, and leadership consultation.
• 2+ years of progressive HR leadership experience with direct responsibility for managing, mentoring, and developing HR team members while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Experience supporting complex distribution center operations, including employee relations, workforce planning, and HR programs for a multi-shift hourly employee population.
• Extensive working knowledge of employment law and regulatory compliance, with experience guiding leaders on complex employee relations matters and mitigating legal and organizational risk.
• Strong communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
• Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to build effective relationships with team members and leaders at all organizational levels.
• Highly proficient in HR information systems (HRIS) and Microsoft Office Suite, with the ability to leverage technology, workforce analytics, and process improvements to support organizational effectiveness and drive successful change initiatives.
• Ability to travel up to 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

• Masters degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• PHR/SPHR and/or SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP certification preferred.
• Previous experience working in a distribution or manufacturing environment preferred.
• Experience with SAP, UKG, Power BI, or similar HR systems.
• Experience working within a centralized HR structure.
• Experience supporting compensation, job architecture, and organizational effectiveness initiatives across multiple business functions.

Additional Information

This role will be in Underwood, IA and required to travel once monthly to Laurens, IA.

The salary range for this role is $80,000.00 - $100,000.00 (Annually).  Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant/office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet/slippery floors. However, the vast amount of work is conducted in a climate-controlled office. Travel may be required.

While performing the duties of this job the Team Member is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The Team Member is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The Team Member must occasionally lift and/or more up to twenty-five pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: Link Snacks provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

E-VERIFY: Link Snacks is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees.  For information about the E-Verify program, please visit:  http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

jobs.title: Vice President, Procurement
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

ROLE: Vice President, Procurement

REPORTS TO: Corporate Treasurer

THE ROLE

The VP, Procurement will serve as Sotheby's procurement subject matter expert, responsible for building and leading a scalable global procurement function. This role will establish procurement policies, governance, workflows, and best practices while driving commercial value through strategic sourcing, contract negotiations, and vendor management. Partnering closely with Finance, Legal, Information Security, Technology, Operations, and business leaders across the organization, the successful candidate will bring greater structure, efficiency, and compliance to procurement activities. This is an exceptional opportunity for a hands-on leader to elevate a global procurement function and create lasting value, drive strategic initiatives, and influence decision-making at the highest levels.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and lead Sotheby's global procurement strategy, operating model, governance framework, and best practices.

• Build and implement scalable procurement policies, approval workflows, contract management processes, and supplier governance standards.

• Create and manage a centralized intake process for procurement requests and contract reviews.

• Lead strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier evaluations, RFPs, and bid processes across multiple spend categories.

• Negotiate complex commercial agreements and supplier contracts to maximize value and mitigate risk.

• Partner with Legal, Finance, Technology, Information Security, Operations, and business leaders to streamline procurement activities and drive compliance.

• Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance procurement visibility across the organization.

• Monitor supplier performance, contract obligations, spend data, and procurement metrics, providing insights to senior leadership.

• Stay informed on market trends, pricing conditions, and supplier developments to support sourcing decisions and cost optimization.

• Drive adoption of procurement best practices through stakeholder engagement, education, and change management.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Business Management, or similar field. MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, or related commercial experience.

• Demonstrated success building, transforming, or enhancing procurement functions, processes, and governance frameworks.

• Deep expertise in contract negotiations, supplier management, and strategic sourcing methodologies.

• Proven ability to operate independently, establish priorities, and drive results with minimal oversight.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build credibility across all levels of an organization.

• Experience partnering with Legal, Finance, Technology, Information Security, and Operations teams on procurement initiatives.

• Process-oriented mindset with a track record of creating scalable workflows and operational efficiencies.

• Strong commercial, financial, and analytical acumen, with the ability to assess business risk and identify value creation opportunities.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

• Experience in luxury, technology, financial services, professional services, or other complex global organizations is a plus.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $190,000 - $220,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.
