jobs.title: Vedúci/Vedúca oddelenia / Department Manager, Liptovský Mikuláš
jobs.location: Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia (Slovak Republic)
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Vedúci/a oddelenia budete lídrom, ktorý podporuje a motivuje celý tím. Vytváraním inkluzívnej kultúry, ktorá podporuje spoluprácu a podnikateľského ducha, vytvoríte prostredie, v ktorom sa každý môže rozvíjať. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Povediete svoj tím k poskytovaniu výnimočného zákazníckeho zážitku zabezpečením vynikajúcich operačných a vizuálnych štandardov a aktívnou podporou predaja našich produktov.
• Prevezmete zodpovednosť za silné stránky predajne a vášho oddelenia, budete analyzovať predajné výsledky, identifikovať obchodné príležitosti, stanovovať ciele a vytvárať plány na optimalizáciu výsledkov, zisku a úrovne zásob.
• Riadiť plánovanie a rozvrh tímu a zabezpečovať hladké procesy otvárania a zatvárania predajne.
• Nábor, onboarding a rozvoj tímu, pričom budete podporovať inkluzívnu a spolupracujúcu kultúru, ktorá podnecuje rast a inovácie.
• Budete sledovať módne trendy, preferencie zákazníkov a konkurenciu s cieľom udržať si konkurenčnú výhodu.
• Pozitívne reprezentovať seba aj značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.
• Zabezpečovať celkový OMNI zákaznícky zážitok aktívnym propagovaním nášho zákazníckeho vernostného programu.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti s vedením a prevádzkou v retailovom prostredí.
• Expertízu v plánovaní predaja, analýze a následnom vyhodnocovaní s využitím zákaznícky orientovaných nástrojov a reportingu.

A ľudí ktorí sú…​

• Silní a sebavedomí lídri, ktorí inšpirujú, koučujú a rozvíjajú svoje tímy, a zároveň stelesňujú hodnoty a kultúru spoločnosti.
• Schopní pracovať v dynamickom a spolupracujúcom prostredí so zameraním na riešenia.
• Motivovaní vytvárať výnimočné zákaznícke zážitky a aktívne podporovať predaj produktov.
• Zapálení pre módne trendy, obchodný potenciál a analýzu konkurencie, aby podporovali predaj.
• Komunikačne zdatní, kreatívni a zvedaví.
• Flexibilní, analytickí a orientovaní na výsledky s dobrými schopnosťami pracovať so štatistikami a číslami.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• 25% zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v obchodoch aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP
• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Športová karta Multisport,
• Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
• Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
• Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
• Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
• 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).
• Možná mesačná obratová prémia

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Táto pozícia je na plný úväzok, so sídlom v Liptovskom Mikuláši.

Platové ohodnotenie tvorí základná mzda od 1490 € brutto/mesačne. Súčasťou odmeňovania je aj možnosť mesačnej obratovej prémie a nadštandardné príplatky za prácu počas víkendov. Konečná výška mzdy bude stanovená na základe skúseností kandidáta.

Prihláste sa zaslaním svojho životopisu čo najskôr, najneskôr do 29.11.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov prijímame žiadosti výlučne prostredníctvom kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.

*Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: CNC Lathe Machinist I and II, Prototype Shop
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

El Segundo, California, United States

Varda Space Industries is scaling the commercial space and microgravity frontier, building the world's first commercial orbital material production and reentry infrastructure. By designing and manufacturing. Orbital platforms end-to-end in-house, we can iterate faster, fly more often, tackle physical problems that terrestrial - based facilities cannot touch. Then reliably bring these complex manufacturing processes back to Earth.

Position

Seeking an experienced CNC Machinist to anchor our prototyping capabilities. In this role, you will leverage extensive Mastercam expertise and advanced CNC Lathe experience to program, set up, and execute complex, one-off aerospace components. Beyond machining mastery, you will serve as a vital cross-functional partner, collaborating digitally and interpersonally with all teams to drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) in an environment where speed and flexibility are paramount.

As a part of the captive prototype machine shop embedded directly within this high-cadence aerospace environment, you’re a critical moving part of this internal engine that addresses the complex, high-urgency work that most job shops simply cannot. Priorities can change quickly here, and we thrive on the momentum of real hardware coming back from flight. The requirement is not just machine parts. As a team we are looking forward to work together. Building an efficient prototype environment where we lean into each other's strengths and cross-train as opportunities arise.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Machining & Lathe Programming

• use Mastercam to program, set up, and operate CNC equipment, with a heavy emphasis on CNC Lathe and complex geometries.

• Fabricate challenging prototype and flight-support components from diverse aerospace materials under tight, rapidly evolving deadlines.

• Own the manufacturing process from CAM programming through fixturing, tool selection, optimization, on-machine probing, and final inspection/verification.

Captive Shop Agility & Rapid-Response Prototyping

• Mindset: A hands-on builder's mentality who embraces continuous improvement and loves seeing physical hardware come to life, test, and fly.

• Handle high-priority, complex work that commercial vendors cannot turn around or execute, acting as the critical link between design concept and physical hardware.

• Adapt seamlessly when priorities change, managing shifting project scopes without sacrificing part integrity or precision.

• Maintain rigorous quality standards through in-process inspection and close collaboration with quality assurance.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM) & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Strong knowledge of GD&T, blueprint interpretation and inspection allowing you to partner with any team to offer proactive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) feedback, optimizing part designs for efficiency, strength, and manufacturability.

• Work collaboratively and digitally with engineers and peers of all backgrounds and personalities, ensuring transparent communication through digital work orders, CAD/CAM notes, and direct dialogue.

Team Contribution & Cross-Training Culture

• Actively contributes to building a cohesive, high-performing shop floor by sharing your expertise, mentoring peers, and troubleshooting setups collaboratively.

• Embrace a cross-training mindset—sharing your specialized CNC Lathe and Mastercam knowledge while stepping outside your comfort zone to learn other machines and processes as shop needs evolve.

Qualifications & Skills

• Experience: Level 1 -1-4 years of experience. Level 2 - 5+ years of hands-on Manual and CNC machining experience within a fast-paced prototype, aerospace, R&D, or advanced manufacturing environment.

• Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Mastercam programming for complex CNC Lathe.

• Hardware Expertise: Deep, hands-on operational and programming background with CNC Lathe.

• Adaptability & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively and digitally with all personalities. Comfortable thriving in an environment where priorities change quickly.

• U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency to comply with ITAR regulations.

Pay Range

• Pay Range: Level 1: $29 - $40 hourly Level 2: $40 - $55 hourly

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Senior Demand Marketing Manager, Velocity
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.



Learn more at envoy.com http://envoy.com




ABOUT THE ROLE

Envoy is hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own pipeline growth for our velocity business: SMB (under 250 employees) and Mid-Market (250–2,500 employees) companies. You will be measured on one thing above all else: velocity marketing-sourced pipeline, delivered at an efficient CAC.

Today, this segment runs on direct and paid ads programs. Your job is to scale what works, fix what leaks, and build the full-funnel engine around it, from the first ad click through website conversion, trial and product signups, nurture, and handoff to our BDR and AE teams.

You operate like an owner: hypothesis-led, fast to ship, and accountable to pipeline, not just leads. You will partner closely with Marketing Operations, RevOps, PMM, Design, Content, and Velocity Sales leadership, and work day-to-day with our paid search agency.


This is an onsite position that requires at least 4 days a week (Monday - Thursday) in our San Francisco HQ.



YOU WILL

 - Paid Acquisition (Google, Bing, LinkedIn, Meta)
   
   - Own the velocity paid ads strategy and budget across search and social, managing to pipeline, CAC, and ROAS targets.
   
   - Work hands-on in the platforms: campaign structure, keyword and audience strategy, bidding, budget pacing, and creative testing.
   
   - Direct our paid search agency day-to-day: set priorities, review their work, and hold them to pipeline outcomes.
   
   - Shift spend weekly based on what turns into qualified pipeline, not just what turns into leads.
   
   Website Conversion & Experimentation
   
   - Own conversion on the pages velocity buyers use most: pricing, product, comparison, demo, and trial pages.
   
   - Run the experimentation backlog: write hypotheses, prioritize them, launch tests, read results, and ship the winners.
   
   - Improve visit-to-lead and lead-to-SQL conversion rates, with paid landing pages built to match the ads that drive traffic to them.
   
   Trial & Product Signup Funnel
   
   - Grow the volume and quality of free trial and product demo signups for SMB and Mid-Market buyers.
   
   - Partner with Product, Marketing Ops, and Sales to turn trial activity into qualified handoffs to BDRs and AEs, with clear signals for who is ready to talk.
   
   - Find and fix drop-off between signup, activation, and sales conversation.
   
   Lifecycle Email & Nurture
   
   - Build and run nurture programs in Marketo for velocity leads and trial users who are not yet ready for sales.
   
   - Segment by company size, persona, use case, and behavior, and trigger programs from intent and product activity.
   
   - Bring stalled and closed-lost velocity opportunities back into the funnel.
   
   Funnel Analytics & Sales Partnership
   
   - Build and maintain velocity funnel dashboards with Marketing Ops and RevOps, from spend to Closed-Won.
   
   - Run a weekly velocity pipeline review with Sales leadership and make the calls on where to invest next.
   
   - Keep a tight feedback loop with BDRs and AEs on lead quality, routing, speed to lead, and messaging.

 


YOU HAVE  

 - 5+ years in B2B SaaS growth or demand marketing, with direct accountability for pipeline in a high-velocity, sales-led motion selling to SMB and Mid-Market buyers.

 - Deep, hands-on paid expertise: You have run SEM and paid social campaigns yourself, not just overseen them. You know how to structure accounts, manage bids and budgets, write creative briefs, and optimize to pipeline instead of cost per lead.

 - Proven at conversion: You have designed A/B tests that produced measurable conversion wins, and you understand sample size, statistical significance, and when a test is worth running.

 - Full-funnel thinker: You have connected paid, website, trial, and email into one system, and you know where velocity funnels usually leak.

 - Analytically rigorous: CAC, CAC payback, ROAS, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity are how you think. You are comfortable building dashboards in Salesforce or a BI tool and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.

 - Hypothesis-led and fast to ship: You form a clear thesis, move quickly from idea to live, and do not over-engineer.

 - Strong cross-functional partner: You work naturally with Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and agencies, and you lead with influence rather than authority.

 - AI-forward: You use AI to build agents, automate reporting and campaign work, and ship faster. Marketing engineering experience is a plus.

 - Tools: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, Salesforce, and Marketo. Experience with Outreach, ZoomInfo, G2, and website testing tools is a plus.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

GITAI is a vertically integrated space and defense company building the next generation of hardware for low-Earth-orbit missions.

At our core is the space robotics technology that has defined GITAI from the beginning. A small, highly capable engineering team applies that foundation across satellite buses, in-orbit servicing robotics, and mission hardware for applications such as Earth observation. Today, a major focus of our work is supporting U.S. national security missions, particularly through proliferated LEO satellite constellations and other next-generation space systems.

We design, build, integrate, and test much of our hardware in-house. Electrical, mechanical, software, manufacturing, integration, and test teams work closely together, allowing a small team to own complete systems rather than isolated components. This vertical integration helps us move quickly, learn directly from hardware, and shorten the path from architecture to a working system.

We are still early. The systems, the company, and the market are all being built at the same time. Requirements change, technical problems are often ambiguous, and many answers do not yet exist. We are looking for exceptional engineers and operators who want broad ownership, can work across disciplines, and are willing to stay close to the hardware until the mission succeeds.

Your Mission

Build and improve GITAI’s accounting operations in a fast-moving startup environment where many systems and processes are still being developed. Your mission is not just to ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance with U.S. GAAP, but to create practical, scalable accounting processes that allow our engineering and manufacturing teams to move as fast as possible. Work closely with these teams to understand their needs, solve problems, and build an accounting infrastructure that supports rapid execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Reporting

• Own and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Oversee general ledger accounting, journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Ensure accurate accounting for accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, and other balance sheet accounts.

• Prepare and review financial statements and supporting schedules.

• Support revenue recognition and contract accounting in accordance with U.S. GAAP, including ASC 606.

• Manage intercompany accounting and support the consolidation of U.S. and Japanese entities, including intercompany reconciliations and consolidated financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Serve as the primary accounting point of contact for external financial statement audits.

• Coordinate with external tax advisors on U.S. federal and state corporate income tax filings, including the preparation of supporting schedules and documentation.

Manufacturing & Project Cost Accounting

• Oversee accounting for inventory, work-in-progress (WIP), manufacturing costs, and cost of goods sold (COGS).

• Establish and maintain accurate project cost accounting processes, including the allocation of labor, materials, and overhead costs.

• Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Program Management teams to ensure accurate project cost tracking and financial reporting.

• Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for R&D expenditures, fixed assets, capital expenditures, and manufacturing-related costs.

• Improve the accuracy, consistency, and visibility of project costs and inventory balances.

Accounting Systems & Process Improvement

• Drive accounting process improvements and collaborate with internal teams and external vendors on system implementation, integration, and automation initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to streamline accounting operations, automate workflows, and reduce manual processes.

• Develop scalable accounting processes that improve data accuracy, operational efficiency, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data flows, transaction reconciliation, and accounting system controls.

Internal Controls & Audit Readiness

• Develop, document, and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls in collaboration with the Director of Finance.

• Ensure accurate and complete accounting records and supporting documentation.

• Lead the preparation of audit schedules and coordinate responses to external auditor requests.

• Identify accounting risks, resolve control deficiencies, and implement process improvements.

• Support the development of scalable accounting and reporting processes to meet increasing audit and compliance requirements.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Manage day-to-day accounting operations and support the development of the accounting team as the organization grows.

• Partner with the Director of Finance on complex accounting matters, financial reporting requirements, and the development of accounting policies and internal controls.

• Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Operations teams to ensure accurate and timely accounting information.

• Take ownership of accounting-related initiatives and contribute to building a strong, scalable finance and accounting organization.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience independently managing accounting operations.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and hands-on experience managing month-end close, general ledger accounting, and financial reporting.

• Hands-on experience with manufacturing or project-based cost accounting, including inventory, work-in-progress (WIP), cost allocation, and fixed assets.

• Demonstrated experience improving accounting processes, strengthening internal controls, and leveraging accounting systems to enhance operational efficiency.

• Experience coordinating external financial statement audits and maintaining audit-ready accounting records.

• Strong Excel skills and hands-on experience with accounting or ERP systems.

• Ability to independently manage accounting operations, resolve complex accounting issues, and work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a hands-on, detail-oriented, and ownership-driven mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA certification.

• Experience in aerospace, defense technology, or U.S. government contracting.

• Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, CAS, or DCAA accounting requirements.

• Experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 842 lease accounting, and manufacturing cost accounting.

• Experience with international subsidiaries, intercompany transactions, and consolidated financial reporting.

• Experience supervising or mentoring accounting staff.

• Experience implementing or integrating accounting, procurement, expense management, or inventory systems.

• Experience in a venture-backed startup or high-growth environment.

• Experience supporting IPO readiness, SOX compliance, or the development of public-company-level internal controls.

Location and Position Type

• Torrance, CA/ Full-time, Exempt

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $105,000–$145,000 per year. Final title, compensation, and equity will depend on the candidate’s experience and ability to build practical accounting processes that support our engineering and manufacturing teams as we scale.

Benefits

• Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, with 90% coverage for dependents, plus life insurance

• Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a company match

• Equity Opportunities: Stock options in a rapidly growing startup, giving you a stake in our success

• Relocation Support: Financial assistance for relocation is available for candidates residing outside the Los Angeles area

• Holidays: 12 days of paid time off (PTO) and 12 company holidays annually

• Dynamic Work Environment: Collaborate and innovate with a passionate team

• Office Perks: Enjoy free snacks and drinks, plus regular social events to foster team spirit

• Cutting Edge Experience: Work alongside state-of-the-art robots, driving the future of space technology

GITAI does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing or recruiting agencies. We work only with recruiting partners that have been specifically engaged by GITAI. No fees will be paid for resumes submitted without a prior agreement.

Compensation may include base salary or hourly pay and, depending on the position, equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skillset, and other job-related factors.

Important Notice

jobs.title: Shipping Specialist (Logistics HT) - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SHIPPING SPECIALIST (LOGISTICS HT) - 1ST SHIFT

As a shipping specialist, you will be responsible for the expedient movement of designated items needed to support production, test, and launch operations. Primary functions of the Shipping Specialist include the packaging, manifesting, and tracking of materials as requested by internal and external customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Process Hazmat shipments, including classification, appropriate CFR/IATA packaging, manifesting, and shipping declarations.

• Possess thorough knowledge of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and criteria therein necessary to offer hazardous goods for shipment to third party logistics providers.

• Properly package and manifest parcel, LTL, and large freight as required to ensure product integrity throughout the transportation cycle to intended destination.

• Manifest consignments with information provided by requestor and schedule movements accordingly based on delivery demand (FedEx, UPS, 3PL vendors, expedite courier services, etc.), ensuring that each package has the correct information and configuration to guarantee intended delivery conditions.

• Create shipping documents, packing slips, shipping labels, BOL's ,Hazmat declaration (if required) meeting SpaceX processing requirements.

• Create/print identifying labels for all material/packages being shipped for traceability.

• File and maintain records of shipping documents per departmental guidelines.

• Perform cycle counts to assure proper inventory is allocated in Shipping-owned Incoming/Outgoing areas.

• Track critical shipments, and update delivery status to requestors.

• Be responsible for system integrity for all shipments including coordination with requestor and distribution center(s) to ensure timely product delivery.

• Maintain strict material handling practices in accordance with best business practices

• Accurately update required tracking systems (spreadsheets, modules, external data sources)

• Operate forklifts and material handling equipment per safety procedures to load carriers as required in order to load material onto delivery trucks competently and without incident.

• Coordinate with internal delivery system drivers/material handlers to pick up and expedite material to the shipping department to avoid cutoffs and evade flight delays.

• Maintain good customer relationships, and provide timely updates on shipments as needed to both origin and destination

• Process outbound material through ERP system, partnering with appropriate departments to ensure quality and quantity of material is delivered to vendors.

• Maintain good housekeeping in area.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

• 5+ years in a shipping role.

• Experience in freight and expedited shipping.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Hazmat certified highly preferably (49/CFR, IATA, IMDG, Explosive, Battery, etc.).

• Able to understand the difference between limited quantities and excepted quantities when shipping dangerous goods ensure proper mode per 49/CFR, IATA is selected.

• Experience in international shipping.

• Experience in filing EEI’s in manifesting software systems.

• Experience in a high volume manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, or commercial aircraft environment.

• Experience with ERP system(s).

• Strong computer skills, including familiarity with the Microsoft, Excel and Power Point.

• Certification operating a forklift or other material handling motorized vehicles and equipment.

• Comprehension of shipping International goods to Asia, UK and South America.

• Comprehension of shipping temperature sensitive items within the US.

• Knowledge of Indicia and Pitney Bowes software (USPS requests).

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to lift 30 lbs. unassisted, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required to perform the functions of this position.

• Must be open to working all required shift hours, including overtime, and weekends as needed.

• Able to travel domestically to obtain relevant certifications and to assist in development of skill sets at other SpaceX sites as needed.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $22.00 - $25.00
Level 2: $24.50 - $29.00
Level 3: $28.00 - $35.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. jobs.title: Staff Global Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who’s fired up by our mission and ready to build. You’ll thrive here if you adapt quickly, take ownership, and care about the details.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Los Angeles headquarters. You’ll report to the Director of Supply Chain Operations  and work closely with a lean, high-trust team where everyone’s work matters.

This role is on-site at our Los Angeles headquarters.

What You'll Do

As a Global Supply Manager, you’ll own the supply base for your assigned commodities from sourcing through ramp and into steady-state production. You’ll make the calls on who we buy from, at what price and terms, and how we protect the build schedule.

• Owning commodity strategy. Develop and execute sourcing strategy for your assigned categories [e.g., powertrain, composite structures, electrical, cable and harness], including make vs. buy, dual-sourcing, and long-term capacity planning.

• Running supplier selection. Lead RFQs end to end: build should-cost models, compare quotes on total landed cost (not just piece price), and recommend suppliers to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Negotiating and managing contracts. Secure pricing, payment terms, tooling ownership, IP protection, and capacity commitments that support cost, quality, and delivery targets.

• Partnering on new product launches. Work with Engineering, Quality, and Production from early design through ramp: give DFM and cost feedback, plan tooling and first-article builds, and make sure supply is ready before each program milestone.

• Managing supply risk. Identify and mitigate disruption risk across geopolitical, tariff, capacity, and single-source exposure, and maintain contingency plans for critical parts.

• Driving supplier performance. Own supplier scorecards and KPIs (on-time delivery, lead time, quality, total landed cost, inventory turns) and run corrective action and supplier development where needed.

• Building the function. Help establish the processes, tools, and data standards (commodity strategies, parts data, supplier records, PO and replenishment workflows) that let us scale without adding chaos.

• Owning cost and reporting out. Hold commodity-level cost targets and forecasts, and report cost, risk, and savings to leadership.

• Senior Staff only: Own multiple commodities or a major program’s full supply base, set standards for the broader GSM team, mentor or manage other GSMs, and lead executive-level supplier negotiations and strategic partnerships.

• Travel: Up to 25%, including domestic and international supplier visits.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Staff: 7+ years / Senior Staff: 10+ years in global sourcing, procurement, or supply management

• Experience sourcing complex electromechanical or discrete manufactured products in a hardware company, including at least one new product introduction through production ramp

• Track record negotiating supplier contracts and delivering measurable cost, quality, or delivery results

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and BOMs, and to hold technical conversations with engineers and suppliers

• Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and comfort working with data to drive decisions (advanced Excel at minimum)

• Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience in EV, battery, marine, automotive, aerospace, or other regulated or high-performance hardware industries

• Sourcing experience in Asia and/or Europe, plus familiarity with tariffs, customs, and trade compliance

• Experience with supplier quality processes such as PPAP/FAI, on-site audits, and supplier development

• Data skills beyond Excel (SQL, Python, BI tools)

• Prior experience at a startup or scale-up, especially building supply chain processes from scratch

• Relevant certifications (CPSM, APICS CSCP/CPIM)

• Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving environment where priorities shift

• Genuine enthusiasm for boating and clean energy

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base salary for this role is  P4: $160,000 / P5: $190,000 annually.

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Healthcare benefits — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision

• Parental leave — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents

• Generous time off — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure

• Income protection — Life and disability insurance for all employees

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Water fund — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose

• Professional development — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend

• Safety support — Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Captain training — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

• Relocation assistance — Available depending on role eligibility

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Director of IT
jobs.location: Austin, Texas, United States; San Jose, California, United States
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

About the team

The IT team supports SambaNova’s employees and infrastructure. We manage the servers, networks, and cloud accounts our engineering teams use to build and test AI chips and systems. We also handle employee laptops, accounts, and software, and we run security across the company. The team is small and works closely with engineering and DevOps.

About the role

As Director of IT on the IT team, you will lead infrastructure, end-user IT, security operations, and DevOps support across the company. You will set the direction for the function and grow the team, and you will also do hands-on work when the team needs it. This role can be leveled at Director or Senior Director depending on experience.

Responsibilities

• Lead server and backend infrastructure, including on-prem and cloud systems, networking, storage, and identity

• Run desktop and end-user IT, including laptop provisioning, SaaS tools, help desk, and onboarding and off boarding

• Build and run the security program and security operations, including endpoint protection, access control, monitoring, and incident response

• Partner with engineering on DevOps tooling, CI/CD infrastructure, and automation

• Hire and manage the IT team, and set its roadmap and budget

• Manage vendors and contracts for IT and security tools

• Configure systems, troubleshoot outages, and write automation yourself when needed

Required qualifications

• B.S. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure and operations

• 5+ years of experience leading IT teams

• Experience running both backend infrastructure and end-user IT

• Experience building or running a security operations program

• Experience with DevOps tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

• Hands-on experience with Linux, Windows, and macOS administration, identity management such as Okta or Entra ID, and MDM

• Able to work onsite at our Bay Area office on a regular basis

Preferred qualifications

• Experience at a startup or high-growth company

• Experience supporting hardware or semiconductor engineering teams, including HPC or lab environments

• Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance programs

• Experience scaling an IT team through rapid headcount growth

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range

$1—$999,999 USD

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. jobs.title: Loads & Dynamics Engineer (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LOADS & DYNAMICS ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)
Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads.

In this role, you will work closely with Starshield responsible engineers as well as the Falcon dynamics team to drive hardware and mission design decisions and the reliable operation of Starshield satellites. This role will involve performing dynamic analysis, contributing to in-house codes, as well as hands-on testing. You will be responsible for all low- and high- frequency loads and vibration for the satellites during ground transportation, ascent/launch, and on-orbit operation. Strong candidates for this role will have excellent hardware intuition as well as experience with frequency-domain signal processing and analysis.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Resolve dynamics problems through analysis and test

• Execute dynamic testing from start-to-finish including pre-test analysis, sensor selection & installation, testing, data analysis, signal processing and model correlation

• Build finite element models and run coupled loads analysis

• Perform analyses using commercial and in-house codes as well as write new code

• Perform other analyses as required such as satellite dispense, on-orbit jitter, fatigue analysis, etc.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in physics, mathematics, or an engineering discipline

• 1+ years of professional experience with dynamics

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Hands-on experience either analyzing data or building hardware

• Experience with vibration and shock testing

• Experience with NASTRAN

• Finite element modeling experience (use of FEMAP)

• Working knowledge of structural analysis and test, including a fundamental understanding of strength, stability and fatigue failure mechanisms

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Liquid AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across every kind of hardware, from data center accelerators to on-device chips, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.

The Opportunity

Our People team shapes how Liquid AI grows and how we look after our people, across the US and around the world.

We’re hiring a People Operations Manager to own our HR data and the operations that run on it, so every moment in someone’s time at Liquid AI is handled properly: their offer, their first day, a move to a new country, a visa, a pay review, their last day.

Behind every record is a person. Getting the details right is one of the most direct ways we look after our team, and you’ll make sure they’re right without needing to be chased.

You’ll report to our Head of People Operations and work closely with the engineers on our People team, testing and shaping the internal operating system they’re building. This is a hands-on operator role, not an HR business partner role.

This role will be based in our SF office, typically 4 days a week.

What We’re Looking For

We need someone who is:

 - Detail-oriented: You notice when something doesn’t match, see how one change affects everything downstream, and fix it.

 - A team player: You pitch in wherever the team needs you, and no task is too small.

 - Self-directed: You get things done without much supervision, and you know when to escalate.

 - Someone who ships: You work at pace, get through a high volume of work, and don’t let quality slip while you do it.

 - Someone who cares about people: You see this work as part of how we look after our team, and you handle sensitive information with care.

The Work

 - Own our HR data: keep HR, payroll and headcount records accurate and matching across systems, run regular checks, fix errors fast, and flag where they’re coming from

 - Handle onboarding and offboarding admin: take care of the paperwork and system setup for every new starter and leaver, so their records are complete and correct from day one to their last

 - Manage employee changes: process contractor conversions, moves between states or countries, contract amendments, salary changes, leaves and visa updates, so each one is touched once and done right in every system; for visas, work with our outside immigration counsel on documents and deadlines

 - Run benefits operations: lead open enrollment, keep plan documents current and on hand, and work with our broker on renewals and compliance

 - Manage our people vendors: be the day-to-day admin and escalation point for our HRIS, payroll, benefits and global EOR providers, and push open issues until they’re closed

 - Run comp analysis and offer letters: benchmark roles against market data, model the full cost of offers and changes across countries, and prepare accurate offer letters consistent with approved terms

 - Help run cross-functional projects: work with teams across the company on People projects, including our coworking weeks, which bring the team together several times a year

 - Test and shape our internal operating system: be our main beta tester, running new features against real cases and working with the engineers until it’s right

Experience & Capabilities

What you’ll need:

 - Experience in People Operations, HR operations or payroll, including time at an early-stage startup or on a small team where you covered a bit of everything

 - Hands-on admin experience with a modern HRIS (Rippling, Workday, Deel or similar), owning the data and processing onboarding, offboarding and employee changes in it

 - Experience with employees across multiple US states and countries

 - Working knowledge of US benefits and compliance (open enrollment, ERISA, COBRA)

 - Strong spreadsheet and analysis skills: comp benchmarks, cost models, headcount reporting, and the habit of checking your own numbers

Helpful, not required:

 - A background in finance, accounting or payroll

 - Experience with US immigration processes (H-1B, O-1, green cards) alongside outside counsel

 - Experience with comp benchmarking tools such as Pave or Carta

What Success Looks Like (Year One)

 - HR, payroll and headcount records match across every system, with regular checks that catch errors before anyone else does

 - Every employee change, benefits cycle and vendor issue is closed and tracked in one place

 - Our internal operating system has a tight feedback loop with the operations work you do every day

What We Offer

 - Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.

 - Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.

 - Paid Leave: Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality & Readiness Engineer
jobs.description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Supplier Quality & Readiness Engineer

As a Supplier Quality & Readiness Engineer, you will own purchased parts from sourcing award through steady-state production as we build our vehicles and the factory to produce them at volume. You will work closely with Procurement, Design Engineering and Manufacturing to qualify and launch new suppliers so parts are ready before the line needs them. Then you will keep those suppliers in control by catching problems at the source, driving root cause and corrective action, and raising the capability of the supply base. As an early employee at a fast-moving startup, you will help shape how Parallel builds and manages its supply base.

Responsibilities:

• Assess and qualify new suppliers with Procurement, covering capability, quality system, capacity, and operational and financial risk

• Run APQP with each supplier, including timing plans, design and process FMEAs, control plans and gated readiness reviews

• Drive PPAP (or FAI to AS9102 where applicable) to approval by reviewing submissions, witnessing first-article builds and dispositioning gaps

• Lead run-at-rate and capacity verification at supplier sites to prove they can meet the production ramp

• Track tooling, gauge and fixture build and buy-off, and confirm tooling ownership and identification

• Feed supplier design-for-manufacturing and tolerance feedback to Design Engineering before release

• Maintain a part-level readiness tracker and report status and risk at program build gates

• Own supplier quality performance for an assigned commodity portfolio (e.g., machined and fabricated structures, castings, electrical harnesses, battery and power electronics, motors and drivetrain)

• Lead the response to nonconforming material, including containment, MRB disposition, 8D / root cause and verification that corrective actions work

• Issue and manage Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs) and drive them to closure on time

• Run supplier process and quality-system audits on site and close out findings

• Define incoming inspection plans, sampling levels and acceptance criteria with receiving inspection

• Track and report supplier scorecards (PPM, SCAR cycle time, cost of poor quality) and escalate at-risk suppliers

• Approve supplier change requests (process, material, site, sub-tier) and require re-validation where needed

• Lead supplier development projects to improve process capability (Cpk), error-proofing and control plans

What Success Looks Like:

• After 30 Days: You’ve reviewed every open part, taken over the readiness tracker, and learned our process for nonconforming parts and SCARs. Your tracker covers every assigned part, and you’ve visited 3–5 critical suppliers.

• After 60 Days: You’re running APQP reviews with every critical new supplier and have set a PPAP timeline for each part. You own corrective actions for your portfolio, your first supplier scorecard is out, at least 2 audits are complete, and SCARs older than 30 days are cut in half.

• After 90 Days: Your first PPAP approvals have landed in time for the next build gate, and at least one critical supplier has proven it can build at rate. A monthly scorecard is running, and no parts in your portfolio have stopped the line.

Basic Qualifications:

• BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing or Materials Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in supplier quality, supplier development or new-product introduction in automotive, rail, aerospace, heavy equipment or a similar regulated industry

• Hands-on experience running APQP and approving PPAP or FAI packages

• Experience with structured problem solving, including 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis

• Working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC and process capability studies

• Proficient in reading engineering drawings and GD&T and judging manufacturability

• Experience leading supplier audits against ISO 9001 or IATF 16949

• Strong program management skills, including timing plans, risk tracking and cross-functional reviews

• Willing to travel to supplier sites roughly 30–50% of the time, with heavier travel during launches

Preferred Qualifications:

• ASQ CQE or CQA certification, Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, or PMP

• Experience launching a new factory or new vehicle program, or working through a rapid production ramp

• Process knowledge in one or more of machining, fabrication and welding, castings, injection molding, wire harness, or battery cells and modules

• Experience with rail standards (ISO/TS 22163 / IRIS, AAR M-1003) or EV high-voltage components

• Familiarity with a QMS or ERP system for NCR and SCAR tracking

We are committed to providing fair and transparent compensation in accordance with applicable laws. Salary ranges are listed below and reflect the expected range for new hires in this role, based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and location. Final compensation may vary and will be determined during the interview process. The target hiring range for this position is listed below.

Target Salary Range:

$112,000—$138,000 USD

Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.

Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist (Contractor)
jobs.description:

Location: San Jose, California

Contract Duration: 6 months

Contract Tentative Start: March 2027

About the Role

SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. is seeking an HR Generalist (Contractor) to support day-to-day HR operations and employee programs across our technical and corporate organizations.

This role works closely with the HR Director, HR Business Partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver a positive employee experience and ensure accurate, timely execution of HR processes. jobs.title: Senior Video Editor
jobs.description:
Datadog is the observability and security platform for cloud applications. Engineers at tens of thousands of companies use us to understand what their systems are doing in real time. We are a public company with the pace and ambition of a much smaller one, and we build products for a technical audience that has very little patience for marketing fluff.

We are hiring a Senior Video Editor to join our video team and own video end to end — from concept and script through edit, motion, color, and final delivery. You will work across two kinds of content: brand and marketing video (campaigns, customer stories, event films, social and paid cutdowns) and product and technical video (launch films, feature demos, release explainers, conference keynote support).

You will partner closely with brand designers, product marketing, developer relations, and the events team. You will also help develop AI tools to speed up the pipeline.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Cut brand and product video from raw footage to final delivery in Premiere Pro, working across multiple active projects and deadlines.

• Script and storyboard your own pieces — take a rough brief or a product demo and shape it into a story with a clear arc before a single clip is on the timeline.

• Create motion graphics as projects require — lower thirds, UI callouts, titles, and simple data visualizations — in After Effects, and build supporting illustration and vector assets in Illustrator.

• Color grade in DaVinci Resolve Studio, including conform, node-based grading, and matching shots across multi-camera and mixed-source footage.

• Prep, retouch, and composite stills and textures in Photoshop for use in motion work and thumbnails.

• Use AI-assisted tools in production — transcript-based rough cuts, auto-reframe, speech enhancement, rotoscoping and masking, generative fill and extend, upscaling — and tell us honestly which ones earn their place in the workflow.

• Deliver versioned cutdowns and aspect-ratio variants for YouTube, LinkedIn, paid social, event screens, and the Datadog website, with correct specs every time.

• Keep projects organized: clean bins, consistent naming, archived masters, and handoff files a teammate can actually open and finish.

• Set and defend the quality bar — give direction to freelancers where necessary and review their work.

Who You Are:

• 6+ years of professional video editing experience, with a reel that shows both narrative/brand work and clear, well-structured technical or product content.

• Advanced Premiere Pro — multicam, nested sequences, proxy workflows, dynamic link, Essential Graphics templates, and the keyboard-driven speed that comes from years in the application.

• Highly Competent in After Effects — expressions, shape layers, 2D/3D camera work, motion tracking, and original graphic and illustration design rather than template assembly.

• Highly Competent in Illustrator and Photoshop — you create assets from scratch, not just resize them.

• Hands-on color grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio — primaries and secondaries, power windows, LUT and color-space management, and delivery-safe output.

• Proven ability to script and storyboard: you can write a VO, structure a demo, and pitch a board before production starts.

• Demonstrated ability to edit highly technical content in an engaging way through product screens.

• Familiarity with developer tooling, cloud infrastructure, or observability concepts.

• Active, practical use of AI tools in an editing workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help, where they fall apart, and how to use them without compromising quality or accuracy.

• Strong audio instincts — mix, music selection, dialogue cleanup, and knowing when silence is the right choice.

• Comfortable working on technical subject matter and willing to learn enough about the product to cut it accurately.

• Self-directed and unfazed by shifting priorities, short turnarounds, and simultaneous projects.

Bonus Points:

• Experience filming — camera operation, lighting, and location or studio audio.

• Live event and conference production experience, including keynote playback and show graphics.

• 3D work in Cinema 4D, Blender, or Element 3D.

• Experience building reusable motion systems and Essential Graphics templates for other teams to use.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

• Generous and competitive benefits package

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities

• Employee-focused best in class onboarding

• Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program

• Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Hybrid

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Legal Specialist, Law Enforcement
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Legal Specialist (Law Enforcement) to join our Litigation, Regulatory & Policy team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a key player in building out our legal function and running how Anthropic responds to law enforcement and government requests for user data, while navigating the intricate regulatory landscape of the AI industry. We expect this role to flex beyond the law enforcement queue into legal operations to support the broader litigation, regulatory, and policy team. The successful candidate will be a strong team player, able to build positive relationships with colleagues and work collaboratively toward shared goals.

Key responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end response to law enforcement and government requests for user data, from intake and validation through production and closeout, including subpoenas, court orders, search warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests from domestic and foreign authorities
• Prepare and execute data productions: scoping, data retrieval, coordination with counsel, and eventual production
• Handle foreign and cross-border process, including MLATs and letters rogatory, and manage escalations across jurisdictions
• Handle civil third-party subpoenas and preservation demands
• Maintain expertise in where user data lives across Anthropic's product surfaces and operate the internal data retrieval tooling
• Run and improve the law enforcement response process and tooling
• Partner with Trust and Safety, Security, Privacy, and Engineering on requests that touch user accounts, investigations, or safety escalations
• Coordinate with outside counsel, alongside in-house counsel, on objections, challenges, and narrowing
• Produce recurring reporting on request volume, deadlines, and queue health, and support Anthropic's periodic transparency reporting on government requests
• Monitor legal developments in government access to user data and advise the team on their operational impact
• Support litigation and regulatory matters and stretch beyond core responsibilities as needed to support the legal team's objectives

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in a legal operations, business/operations manager, or paralegal role in an in-house legal department, or similar experience
• Direct, front-line experience handling law enforcement or government requests for user data, including subpoenas, court orders, warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests
• Working knowledge of the legal framework for law enforcement access to user data, including the Stored Communications Act and the mechanics of foreign and cross-border requests such as MLATs
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization
• Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment and maintain the highest standards of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive legal matters, including under time pressure
• Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Experience owning an intake, queue, or docketing process end to end, including deciding what gets escalated and maintaining rigorous tracking
• Comfort operating and improving the tooling a legal process runs on (trackers, spreadsheets, forms, aliases, and simple automations), with a willingness to make changes directly rather than route every change to someone else
• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to identifying, recommending, and implementing process improvements within the legal department

Preferred qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in legal operations, business/operations management, or a paralegal role in an in-house legal department
• 2+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company, with exposure to the legal challenges and opportunities presented by emerging technologies
• Experience building or scaling a law enforcement response process
• Experience managing legal intake process within a growing company
• Demonstrated ability to think critically and creatively, adapting to new challenges and finding practical solutions to complex legal issues
• Familiarity with legal project management software such as Asana, Trello, or Jira, and a willingness to learn and adopt new tools to streamline legal processes

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$1—$2 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

You'll join the Grok Voice Model team as a software engineer. You'll design, build, and run the software systems behind Grok Voice, which delivers natural, low-latency, multilingual spoken interactions across devices and in real time. • Build automated evaluation and testing systems that measure accuracy, audio quality, latency, and real-time performance, plus the experimentation infrastructure used to validate every model release

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or another engineering discipline

• Experience writing production-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C++

• 2+ years of experience working with large scale voice related products

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience building and running large-scale distributed training and inference systems on Kubernetes

• Expert-level Python, writing clean, efficient, production-quality code for large-scale systems

• Experience implementing and optimizing model training and inference software in JAX or PyTorch

• Experience building automated testing, evaluation, and A/B experimentation pipelines for production systems

• Hands-on experience building distributed data processing systems with tools like Spark and Ray

• A proactive, self-driven attitude and the ability to deliver in a fast-paced, high-caliber team
