jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Machining & Additive Associate (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Manufacturing Engineer, Machining Associate (Winter 2027)

This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of hands-on machining and high-level process ownership creating complex, precision hardware for space.

As an Associate, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on challenging projects, no matter their seniority. Many past Interns and Associates have designed and tested hardware/software that is heading to space on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

The Manufacturing Engineer focused on machining owns the entire lifecycle of our machined and additively manufactured components — from working closely with the mechanical engineering team to ensure parts are designed for manufacturability to developing production processes, tooling, and inspection procedures on the factory floor. The Manufacturing Engineer is a highly cross-functional role requiring both technical and hands on skills to bridge the gap between design and production.

A successful candidate will apply knowledge of GD&T, 5axis CNC machining, additive manufacturing, and CMM inspection to solve difficult problems in real time and drive improvements that directly impact our ability to get to space faster.

Role

• Design and build the factory that builds satellites.

• Grow and improve

• Design and implement lean systems for continuous improvement.

• Own 5S activities throughout the machine shop and additive manufacturing spaces.

• Work with design engineering teams to drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM), including participating in design reviews and assisting in tolerance stackup analysis.

• Develop and qualify manufacturing and inspection processes, including performing process validation, documenting procedures, and supporting processes in production.

• Operate, maintain, and develop processes for our in-house additive manufacturing capabilities, including Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) metal and advanced polymer printing systems.

• Write work instructions, work order templates, process specifications, and other build documents.

• Work with supplier quality and contract manufacturers, to develop their manufacturing and quality processes and respond to questions and issues.

• Troubleshoot non-conformances on the floor to determine a disposition, root cause, and drive corrective actions.

• Assist in machining and programming operations as required for R&D and production.

• Assist in designing and creating fixturing for production.

Requirements

• Currently hold a Bachelor's of science in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering.

• Hands on experience making something cool such as cars, robots, etc.

• Hands on experience machining parts, either manual or CNC.

• Proficiency in CAD software (Solidworks, Creo, NX, etc.)

• Experience with CAM software (Fusion, Esprit, Siemens NX, Magics, or similar).

• Competent in fundamentals of GD&T and engineering drawings.

• Must be onsite 5 days a week.

Bonus

• Hands on experience working as a Machinist programming and running 5-axis parts.

• Exposure to or hands-on experience with additive manufacturing technologies, specifically metal LPBF and/or advanced polymer printing.

• Experience in writing technical documents.

• Knowledge of different manufacturing process and their general quality capability.

• Mechanical design experience including creating solid models and prints.

• Hands-on experience reading and interpreting first article inspection reports, using precision hand tools, and implementing tolerance stackup analysis on parts.

• Experience implementing MES/ MRP systems in a production environment.

jobs.title: Second Shift Senior Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.



What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will maintain production equipment used to build high-voltage capacitors and integrated modules for Helion’s fusion reactor systems. You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical issues, perform preventive and corrective maintenance, restore equipment safely, and improve equipment readiness.

This is an onsite role in Everett, WA reporting to the Supervisor of Technical Maintenance, and may require schedule flexibility as operations grow toward multi-shift and eventual 24/7 coverage.

You Will

 - Maintain and repair automated and industrial production equipment, including high-voltage test systems, laser welding equipment, soldering equipment, material handling equipment, pumps, presses, conveyors, and related systems.

 - Work safely around industrial hazards including high voltage, stored energy, pressurized systems, lasers, and robotic equipment using established safety controls such as LOTO and electrical safe work practices.

 - Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and basic controls issues using schematics, manuals, OEM documentation, maintenance history, and structured escalation.

 - Install, replace, and repair common electrical and mechanical components such as sensors, relays, contactors, motors, bearings, belts, gearboxes, pumps, valves, and seals.

 - Document work in a CMMS or similar maintenance system, including labor, failures, repairs, parts, and equipment history.

 - Support emergency repairs and reliability improvement by identifying failure modes, needed tools and spares, return-to-service checks, and opportunities to improve PM quality, uptime, MTTR, and equipment readiness.

 - Other duties as required.



Required Skills

 - Able to support a second shift schedule 2:00pm to 10:30 pm Monday through Friday.

 - 5+ years of relevant hands-on technical maintenance experience. Relevant backgrounds may include industrial or manufacturing maintenance, equipment service, military maintenance, aviation, automotive diagnostics, field service, or machine building.

 - High school diploma or equivalent required; technical degree, apprenticeship, military technical training, or formal controls training may be considered in place of some direct experience.

 - Electro-mechanical troubleshooting capability, with depth in either electrical or mechanical systems and safe working ability across both.

 - Ability to troubleshoot industrial electrical and mechanical systems such as 480V equipment, motors, drives, sensors, power distribution, safety circuits, bearings, belts, gearboxes, pumps, valves, pneumatics, hydraulics, tooling, and mechanical assemblies.

 - Ability to perform basic controls troubleshooting, including fault codes, sensor and actuator checks, field device replacement, and escalation of programming, logic, robot, HMI, or drive configuration issues.

 - Ability to read and use schematics, manuals, OEM documentation, work instructions, and maintenance records to troubleshoot equipment.

 - Ability to document maintenance activity in a CMMS or similar work order system and support critical equipment issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

 - Ability to work assigned schedules as operations evolve, including day, swing, night, rotating, overtime, weekend, or on-call coverage as needed.

 - Ability to lift up to 49 pounds unassisted, stand and walk during shifts up to 12 hours, and regularly bend, lift, stretch, and reach below the waist and above the head.

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families

 - 10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break 

 - Up to 5% employer 401(k) match 

 - Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance 

 - Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks) 

 - Annual wellness stipend

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
About Abacum



Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.



Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.



We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.



Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our People team and support our growing North American organization.

This is a hands-on People Operations role with ownership across the US and Canada, with a strong focus on payroll, employee lifecycle management, compliance, benefits, office management, and operational execution.

You will manage key People processes from the moment an employee joins through onboarding, payroll, employee changes, leaves and off-boarding, ensuring every process is accurate, compliant and well documented.

A key part of this role is managing payroll operations across both the US and Canada, so we are looking for someone who already understands the operational requirements of working across both countries and can confidently partner with payroll providers, Finance and external advisors.

You will work closely with the Global People Manager, Finance, external payroll providers and managers across the company.

Note that this is a hybrid role in our beautiful Midtown office Tuesday-Thursday.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Employee lifecycle

Own People Operations across the full employee lifecycle for employees in the US and Canada, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, documentation and off-boarding.

Ensure employee records and documentation remain accurate and consistent across systems.



US & Canada payroll

Own the operational preparation and review of payroll across both the United States and Canada.

Manage payroll inputs including new hires, terminations, salary changes, variable compensation, benefits and other employee changes.

Partner with payroll providers and Finance to ensure every payroll cycle is accurate, compliant and completed on time.

Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies and continuously improve payroll processes.



People Operations & compliance

Act as an operational point of reference for employees and managers across the US and Canada on payroll, benefits, PTO, leaves, employee documentation and People processes.

Maintain awareness of relevant employment requirements across both countries and coordinate with external advisors when specialist guidance is needed.

Translate regulatory requirements into practical and scalable internal processes.

You will be the go-to representative for the People team in the NYC office and will need to provide on the ground support for the CEO and Chief of Staff.



Onboarding & off-boarding

Coordinate onboarding requirements, employment documentation and operational setup for new hires.

Manage voluntary and involuntary employee exits, including payroll, benefits, documentation and system updates.

Ensure every transition is handled accurately, consistently and with the appropriate level of care and compliance.



HR systems, data & documentation

Maintain accurate employee data across our HR systems and internal tools.

Own recurring People Operations workflows and documentation.

Build and maintain clear SOPs and scalable processes.

Identify opportunities to simplify or automate manual processes.



Benefits & employee support

Support the administration of employee benefits across the US and Canada.

Act as a trusted point of contact for employees on People Operations questions.

Provide clear and practical guidance while maintaining confidentiality, consistency and professional judgement.




ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on People Operations professional who enjoys making complex operational processes work smoothly.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.




JOB OVERVIEW

As a Material Planner, you’ll own the flow of material that keeps every Heron Link build on schedule. In this hands-on role, you’ll get the right parts to the right place at the right time, whether that means on site, kitted, or shipped to our suppliers, contract manufacturers, and rework partners. You’ll partner closely with Supply Chain, Desgin Engineering, NPI, Manufacturing and Warehouse to track purchase orders, surface risks early, and keep inventory records accurate as we scale our operations.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own Clear To Build (CTB) for each NPI build, leading daily review with the supply chain team, tracking POs and shipments.

 - Manage the constrained parts Heron Power buys and supplies to its suppliers and Contract Manufacturers (CMs).

 - Build automated alerts to escalate late or at-risk parts and drive corrective actions with partner teams before they impact the build.

 - Collaborate with the warehouse team to ensure parts are received correctly against POs and stored in an organized, labeled location.

 - Manage rework material, from defining BOMs and kitting parts with engineers to shipping and tracking PCBAs from rework sites.

 - Partner with our in-house software team to build/improve material ordering and inventory tracking system




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We’re looking for an organized, hands-on self-starter who’s eager to learn in a fast-paced hardware environment. Scope and responsibilities will grow with the right candidate.




MUST HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

 - 2 to 4 years of experience in materials, supply chain, production planning, or purchasing, ideally in hardware manufacturing

 - Comfortable reading BOMs, purchase orders, and shipping documents

 - Experience with CTB reports, MRP, and kitting

 - Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets (filters, lookups, basic formulas)

 - Strong attention to detail and a habit of keeping records accurate

 - Clear communicator who escalates problems early


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with an ERP or MRP system (for example NetSuite, Odoo, or SAP)

 - Experience supporting NPI builds or coordinating with a contract manufacturer

 - Exposure to electronics manufacturing: reels, trays, ESD handling, and moisture-sensitive (MSL) parts

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The base salary range for the role is from $85,000 to $115,000.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer (Vulnerability Management)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SECURITY ENGINEER (VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT)

SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer to join Information Security to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission. Information drives our business. We must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise, and defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems.

Information drives our business and we must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise. As a highly visible and dynamic organization, we must also value and guard against damage to our reputation and brand. It is paramount that we defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems, to guarantee the highest probability of success.

As a member of the SpaceX Vulnerability Management team, the Security Engineer will act as a trusted partner to application software development teams. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities and threats while developing and maintaining internal security tools. The role also includes hands-on work triaging bug reports, conducting Purple and Red Team activities, and continuous threat hunting. Strong communication skills and the ability to turn technical findings into practical, actionable guidance are essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Development of tools, processes, and guidance that make security easier to adopt without slowing delivery.

• Conduct software code reviews to identify insecure patterns and help teams remediate issues.

• Perform web application security testing using established frameworks and tools.

• Triage and validate Bugcrowd reports, coordinate with researchers, and work directly with internal teams on remediation and disclosure.

• Perform Purple Team exercises to test controls, improve detection, and close identified gaps.

• Contribute to Red Team operations or simulations, including scoping, execution support, and post-exercise analysis.

• Build and operate emerging vulnerability communication processes so teams receive timely, actionable alerts on new threats.

• Conduct continuous threat assessment by folding threat intelligence, emerging vulnerabilities, and attack trends into scanning coverage, notifications, and prioritization.

• Partner with other security sub-teams (detection/response, compliance, application security, infrastructure) to keep efforts consistent and reduce duplication.

• Escalate critical or time-sensitive issues promptly while offering practical mitigation options.

• Document findings, produce metrics, and provide regular risk summaries to leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience operating production infrastructure and high school diploma or equivalency certificate in lieu of a degree.

• 5+ years of experience operating on-premises Kubernetes in a production environment.

• 5+ years of experience with Linux system administration and with Python, Go, or another language used to automate infrastructure.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities (applications, infrastructure, or cloud).

• Experience working directly with engineering teams to close findings.

• Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) and the ability to develop internal tools.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls) and how they relate to vulnerability exposure.

• Reverse engineering or vulnerability development experience.

• Experience triaging or working reports from bug bounty platforms (Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or similar).

• Hands-on participation in Purple Team or Red Team exercises.

• OT Security Experience.

• Experience with continuous threat assessment, threat intelligence, or risk-based vulnerability prioritization.

• Experience developing internal security tools, dashboards, or automation pipelines (production-quality code, integrations, etc.).

• Experience with web application testing frameworks and tools.

• Experience performing software code reviews for security issues.

• Experience improving developer experience around security tooling and processes.

• Knowledge of network segmentation principles and implementation.

• Experience with asset discovery or inventory processes.

• Experience building or operating emerging vulnerability notification/alerting workflows.

• Familiarity with AI/LLMs and MCPs.

• Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native security/vulnerability features.

• Experience with configuration management, patching, or infrastructure-as-code.

• Knowledge of threat modeling, risk scoring (e.g., CVSS), and prioritization frameworks.

• Familiarity with enterprise security controls and best practices for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business impact and concrete remediation steps.

• Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, GSEC, or equivalent) or demonstrated equivalent experience.

• Demonstrable problem-solving skills and ability to quickly determine root causes of issues.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.

• This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.

• Must have a valid driver's license.

• Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

About the Position

The Structural Engineer – Renewable Structural supports project teams by performing structural analysis, engineering design, and technical documentation activities for renewable energy and power delivery infrastructure projects. jobs.title: Sales Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sales Compensation Analyst supports the design, modeling, administration, documentation, and governance of Trace3's sales incentive compensation programs. Reporting to the Director, Sales Compensation & Planning, this role delivers the analysis, plan documentation, and reporting that underpin incentive plan decisions across all go-to-market segments.

The analyst will work closely with GTM Strategy & Operations, Finance, and Sales Leadership to ensure compensation programs are accurately documented, well governed, and aligned with pay-for-performance outcomes.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Support the design and annual refresh of sales incentive plans, including commissions, SPIFFs, overrides, accelerators, and MBO components, by gathering requirements, preparing analysis, and drafting plan materials for review by the Director.

• Build and maintain financial models that forecast plan costs, payout scenarios, attainment distributions, and pay-for-performance outcomes. Run scenario analyses on proposed plan changes and summarize business impacts prior to implementation.

• Draft and maintain sales compensation plan documents, policies, crediting rules, and participant plan agreements, and keep the sales incentive plan document library current.

• Administer the incentive plan governance workflow, including tracking plan approvals, documenting exception requests, logging plan changes, and maintaining a complete audit trail of plan decisions.

• Support quota setting, territory planning, and account coverage analysis through data analysis, modeling, and validation of capacity assumptions across go-to-market segments.

• Develop and maintain recurring incentive compensation reports and dashboards that measure attainment distribution, plan effectiveness, participant behavior, and return on incentive spend.

• Respond to questions from sellers and sales leaders on plan interpretation and crediting rules, escalating complex or precedent-setting matters to the Director.

• Partner with Payroll, Finance, Revenue Operations, and systems teams to ensure incentive plans are accurately configured within downstream systems. This role supports plan governance and administration and does not directly calculate, approve, or disburse incentive payments.

• Prepare analysis and materials for recurring business reviews with GTM and Finance leadership on program performance and recommended enhancements.

• Support the annual sales compensation planning cycle by managing timelines, tracking deliverables, and preparing plan design inputs aligned with segmentation strategy and revenue growth objectives.

• Maintain documentation and controls, and prepare supporting materials for internal and external audits of sales incentive compensation programs.

• Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting automation, and process efficiency across sales compensation programs.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 3-5 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, finance, compensation, or related analytical disciplines, including experience supporting incentive plan design, financial modeling, or sales performance analysis.

• Working knowledge of sales incentive plan components, including commissions, SPIFFs, overrides, accelerators, quotas, and crediting rules.

• Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, quota attainment reporting, compensation effectiveness measures, and key go-to-market performance indicators.

• Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to build scenario models, interpret results, and summarize findings clearly.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and data modeling. Experience with CRM, ERP, and Sales Performance Management (SPM) platforms preferred.

• Familiarity with quota setting, territory planning, account coverage models, and go-to-market segmentation.

• Experience developing reports, dashboards, and executive-ready analyses to support compensation, sales, and financial decision-making.

• Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation, and process discipline.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines, particularly during the annual planning cycle.

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and executive stakeholders.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain compensation concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Experience within a technology, value-added reseller (VAR), distribution, or similar sales-driven environment preferred.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

Estimated Pay Range

$70,000—$80,000 USD

The Perks

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability

• Competitive Compensation

• Training and development programs

• Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages

• Collaborative and cool culture

• Work-life balance and generous paid time off

Our Commitment

At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3.com.

***To all recruitment agencies: Trace3 does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Please do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email addresses, Trace3 employees or any other company location. Trace3 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

jobs.title: Growth Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Revenue Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving revenue generation across the business by informing business strategy, improving operational efficiency, and delivering data-driven insights. This role requires cross-functional collaboration across business development, finance, engineering, operations, planning, and production teams. Given our rapid growth and the uniquely challenging problems we tackle as a business, this role will naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and will be adept at navigating organizational hurdles. The ability to build trust quickly in a fast-paced environment and execute with high dependability is critical to success in this role.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Growth Operations Associate to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa. In this role, you will be responsible for partnering across the business to design scalable processes, drive operational excellent, and optimize tools and systems that support our growth team. You will inform business strategy and deliver data-driven insights that enable revenue generation across the organization. This will require strong analytical skills, a knack for process improvement, and experience working with cross-functional teams. If you are someone who communicates effectively, takes initiative, and thrives in a high-growth, fast changing environment then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• System Design

• Proactively identify and address recurring business challenges, innovating and iterating on processes to foster long-term solutions

• Project manage from start to finish the rollout of new systems and features (including discovery, builds, testing, communications, and roll-out)

jobs.title: GTM Forecasting & Pipeline Governance Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

JOB SUMMARY:

The GTM Forecasting & Pipeline Governance Manager is responsible for supporting and enhancing Trace3's sales forecasting and pipeline governance processes. As part of GTM Strategy & Operations, this role partners closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, business-unit leaders, and data teams to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline visibility, data quality, and reporting consistency across the organization.

This role develops forecasting models, analyzes pipeline performance, and provides data-driven insights that support planning, forecasting, and business decision-making. Through ongoing monitoring of pipeline health, forecast trends, and governance standards, the Revenue Forecasting & Pipeline Governance Manager helps identify risks, improve predictability, and support revenue growth objectives.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Develop, document, and maintain opportunity stage definitions, stage-entry requirements, exit criteria, required fields, and governance standards across the opportunity lifecycle.

• Support the administration and continuous improvement of sales forecasting processes, methodologies, submission requirements, review cadences, and reporting standards.

• Conduct recurring pipeline and forecast analyses to identify forecast risks, pipeline gaps, conversion trends, and business performance opportunities.

• Monitor pipeline data quality, including close-date accuracy, opportunity aging, stage duration, data completeness, and forecast category alignment.

• Develop and maintain forecasting models, assumptions, and analytical frameworks used to evaluate expected business performance.

• Measure and report forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, win rates, conversion rates, slippage, opportunity aging, and other key sales performance indicators.

• Analyze opportunity-level and portfolio-level data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.

• Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance stakeholders to investigate forecast variances and support reforecasting activities when needed.

• Maintain documentation for forecasting methodologies, metric definitions, reporting logic, governance standards, and business processes.

• Collaborate with CRM, BI, and systems teams to enhance reporting capabilities, automate processes, strengthen data quality, and improve forecast visibility.

• Develop recurring dashboards, reports, and analyses that provide visibility into pipeline health, forecast performance, and key business trends.

• Support change management, training, and adoption efforts related to forecasting processes, pipeline governance standards, and system enhancements.

• Identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy, reporting effectiveness, pipeline visibility, and operational efficiency through process improvements and analytical insights.

• Prepare executive-ready reporting and presentations that communicate forecast performance, pipeline trends, business risks, and recommended actions.

• Maintain documentation and controls supporting reporting accuracy, forecasting consistency, and audit readiness.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, forecasting, pipeline management, finance, business analytics, or a related analytical discipline.

• Strong understanding of B2B sales forecasting and pipeline management concepts, including opportunity stages, qualification methodologies, forecast categories, pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win rates, sales cycles, and forecast accuracy measurement.

• Experience developing forecasting models, pipeline analyses, performance reporting, and business intelligence dashboards.

• Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and Power BI skills required; experience with CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Salesforce preferred.

• Experience working with large datasets, integrating information from multiple systems, and developing scalable reporting and analytical processes.

• Ability to identify and investigate data quality issues, forecast variances, performance trends, and operational risks.

• Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-ready analyses that support planning, forecasting, and business decision-making.

• Strong collaboration and business partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, and business-unit leadership.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience within a technology, value-added reseller (VAR), distribution, managed services, or similar multi-offering sales environment preferred.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability

jobs.title: Instructional Designer - Hybrid
jobs.description:
The Instructional Designer creates, develops, and maintains instructional materials to support online, hybrid, and face-to-face delivery of healthcare courses in higher education. This role ensures course quality, alignment with learning outcomes, and effective use of instructional technologies. The position also supports faculty and academic teams by applying instructional design best practices and facilitating continuous improvement in course delivery.

• Design and develop courses within the institution’s Learning Management System (LMS) to ensure high-quality student learning experience.
• Create engaging instructional content including course overviews, syllabi, learning outcomes, multimedia activities, and assessments.
• Build and publish eLearning modules that integrate interactive elements and align with course outcomes.
• Collaborate closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) to translate technical or specialized knowledge into engaging, student-centered learning experiences. Guide SMEs in applying instructional best practices, align content with program outcomes, and ensure materials are accurate, accessible, and pedagogically sound.
• Apply evidence-based instructional strategies grounded in adult learning theory and best practices for higher education.
• Ensure curriculum alignment by participating in committee meetings and integrating approved updates into course design.
• Review and revise instructional materials to maintain accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with institutional and regulatory standards.
• Document and maintain course resources while contributing to shared training and knowledgebase materials.
• Pilot and evaluate new learning technologies and recommend appropriate tools for adoption.
• Stay current with instructional design trends and apply knowledge of accessibility, copyright, and compliance requirements.
• Support continuous improvement by gathering feedback, analyzing outcomes, and suggesting course enhancements.

*Please note that this position is hybrid at our Tempe Corporate Office

• Master’s degree in instructional design, instructional technology, or related field.
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience designing and delivering higher education courses.
• Proficiency with instructional technology and multimedia authoring tools.
• Strong knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models.
• Experience with course development software and LMS (Canvas experience preferred).
• Excellent writing and editing skills for instructional content.
• Strong project management and organizational skills.
• Ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders, provide excellent customer service, and adapt to new technologies.
• Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements for online learning (e.g., FERPA, copyright, ADA).
• Experience applying learning theory to develop online courses (4+ years preferred).
• Higher education administration experience a plus.

• Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
• Leadership development and training for career advancement
• Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on program

jobs.title: Workplace Manager - NYC
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.



We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.



Job: You will own the NYC office. Parallel’s New York team works out of NeueHouse Madison Square, and your job is to make it feel like ours. You’ll manage the space, vendors, supplies, access and meals, and fix what’s off before anyone notices. You’ll run the in-person side of hiring and onboarding: candidate onsites, Day 1 for new hires, guests and visitors. Everyone who walks in should leave with the right impression. You’ll plan team gatherings, help bring company events to New York, and work with People Ops and the Palo Alto and SF office leads to keep all three offices consistent. As the NYC team grows, you’ll write the playbooks that let the office scale without you handling every detail yourself.
You: Have run an office or workplace on your own, ideally at a startup or in a coworking space where you were the only person on the ground. You’ve managed vendors, building relationships and events without a facilities team behind you. You notice the empty supply closet, the broken A/V and the guest no one met at the door. You make people feel welcome without making a production of it. You don’t sort tasks into above or below your job description. You keep many threads moving at once, you’d rather fix a process than repeat it, and you act before anyone asks.




LIFE AT PARALLEL

Our team works fully in-person, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.



We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

 - Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

 - Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

 - Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

 - Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

 - Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary

 - Generous equity

 - Visa sponsorships

 - 401K plans

 - Daily lunch & office snacks

 - Dinner at the office

 - Unlimited vacation

 - Caltrain pass reimbursement

• Prepare, support, and lead supplier onsite audits and reviews for contract deliverables for quality management and compliance.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred)

• Experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense or similar hardware across one or more of the following commodities: PCBA, structures and power, radar, or imaging

• Experience driving high quality assembly and/or disassembly of complex projects and mechanical or electronic structures through developing drawings, schematics, and work instructions with other engineering functions

• Experience with driving supplier performance and evaluation. Experience with Statement of Work (SOW), quality clauses, intellectual property (IP), and government regulations such as ITAR, etc.

• Working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements such as Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) quality improvement techniques, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

• A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion

• Analytical skills and experience with data mining, data quality, metrics generation, issue management systems, and statistical analysis tools (MatLab, JMP, MiniTab, etc.)

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. TS/SCI security clearance

• Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time to suppliers, sourcing partners, and manufacturing locations

• Master's degree in a technical field

• 5–7 years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complexity manufacturing environments and suppliers

• Experience across multiple Sentry commodity families (PCBA, structures and power, radar, imaging)

• Working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001) and AS9100/ISO 9001-based Quality Management System requirements

Assiste le Directeur de la Restauration dans l’administration et le management des équipes et des opérations quotidiennes. Il est en charge de superviser l’ensemble des services opérationnels liés à l’activités de la Restauration.

Assume la responsabilité du département de la Restauration en l’absence du Directeur de la Restauration.

Responsabilités Générales

• Est en charge, avec le Directeur de la Restauration, de la gestion générale et de la stratégie commerciale des points de vente du département.
• Maîtrise parfaite des codes de la relation client.
• Il participe aux réunions hebdomadaires en l’absence du Directeur de la Restauration

• Dynamise et accompagne les équipes dans le management grâce à ses compétences opérationnelles et à son savoir-être.

Missions Générales

Missions Opérationnelles

• Veille au professionnalisme de son équipe.

jobs.title: Food Safety & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Food Safety & Quality Manager is responsible for leading and maintaining the facility’s food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance programs. This position ensures that citrus juice, concentrates, pulp cells, and related products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and company standards. The manager works collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to promote food safety, product consistency, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Here's what you'll do:

Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance

• Develop, implement, and maintain the Food Safety Management System (FSMS), HACCP plans, and prerequisite programs.
• Ensure compliance with FDA regulations, customer requirements, and applicable food safety certification standards.
• Lead food safety audits, inspections, risk assessments, investigations, and corrective actions.
• Maintain effective sanitation, environmental monitoring, pest control, and product traceability programs.
• This role is the audit representative for the company.

Quality Assurance & Process Control

• Establish and maintain product specifications, quality standards, testing procedures, and product release requirements.
• Oversee quality control throughout extraction, processing, pasteurization, concentration, storage, and shipment.
• Monitor product characteristics, including Brix, acidity, color, flavor, microbiological quality, and pulp content.
• Manage nonconforming products, customer complaints, product holds, and corrective actions.
• Partner with Operations to improve product consistency, reduce quality losses, and optimize processing performance.

Laboratory & Technical Management

• Direct laboratory operations, analytical testing, sampling procedures, and equipment calibration.
• Ensure accurate, reliable, and timely reporting of quality and food safety data.
• Maintain testing documentation, Certificates of Analysis, and product records.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

• Lead, develop, and hold accountable quality assurance and laboratory personnel.
• Establish performance expectations, training programs, and a strong facility-wide food safety culture.
• Drive root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Utilize data, technology, automation, and process standardization to improve quality, efficiency, and cost performance.
• Collaborate with plant leadership to identify risks, implement improvements, and achieve operational objectives.

Performance Management & Customer Relations

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators for food safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, and cost of poor quality.
• Manage customer specifications, quality complaints, audits, and technical communications.
• Provide timely performance reporting and recommendations to plant leadership.
• Manage departmental resources, laboratory expenses, and quality-related costs.

Here's what you'll bring to the table:

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in food manufacturing quality assurance or food safety, preferably in citrus or beverage processing.
• Demonstrated knowledge of Juice HACCP, FDA FSMA regulations, GMPs, sanitation, and food safety management systems.
• Experience leading teams, managing audits, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
• Proficiency in quality data analysis, reporting systems, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop; talk or hear; and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Key Performance Expectations

• Maintain regulatory compliance and effective food safety controls.
• Improve first-pass product quality and reduce customer complaints.
• Reduce quality-related product losses, rework, and operating costs.
• Ensure timely completion of corrective actions, audits, and employee training.
• Strengthen data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across the facility.
• This position may require long hours during the fruit season. Including working weekends and nights.

Wonderful's dedication to you:

• Competitive benefits package including Medical, Vision, Dental, 401k
• Continued training and generous Education Reimbursement Program
• Paid sick, vacation and holiday time
• Wonderful Giving (www.wonderfulgiving.com) -- allowing you to donate company money to a cause of your choice

Why Choose Wonderful?

Wonderful Citrus is part of The Wonderful Company, a privately held $6 billion global company dedicated to harvesting health and happiness around the world. Its iconic brands include FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, Wonderful Pistachios, Wonderful Halos, Wonderful Seedless Lemons, Teleflora, and JUSTIN and Lewis Cellars wines. The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back in its DNA.

To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products, and its core values, please visit wonderful.com, or follow The Wonderful Company on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. To learn more about the company’s corporate social responsibility impact, visit csr.wonderful.com.

Wonderful Citrus and The Wonderful Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer and with opportunities for advancement. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected categories.
