jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero-to-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works.

We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself.

Agentic Commerce is a small, high-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan.

You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards.

 - Run a fast build-measure-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it.

 - Prototype hands-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters.

 - Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to.

 - Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait.

 - Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one.

 - Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help shape how Imprint takes agentic products to market.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 90 days: you've talked to dozens of power users and partners, picked the first two or three bets, and shipped at least one experiment to real users.

 - First 6 months: a repeatable cadence of small releases, with clear evidence on which agentic use cases drive engagement, spend or rewards value.

 - First 12 months: at least one agentic product live with brand partners, and a point of view on agentic commerce that shapes Imprint's broader product strategy.


YOUR PROFILE

 - 8+ years building products, as a product manager, founder or both, with a track record of taking something from zero to real usage.

 - Strong payments experience: card networks, issuing, acquiring, tokenization, wallets or money movement. You understand how a transaction actually flows and where the hard problems live.

 - Demonstrated high agency in ambiguous environments. You've been handed a blank page with no team, playbook or clear owner and delivered measurable impact anyway.

 - A genuine, hands-on passion for AI agents, shown through what you've built, shipped or tinkered with, not just what you've read.

 - Fluency with core LLM and agent concepts (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails) and the judgment to turn them into reliable products that handle real money.

 - Comfort prototyping with modern AI-native tools and working directly in code alongside engineers.

 - Clear, concise communication. You can explain a complex system to an engineer, a bank partner and an executive in the same afternoon.

We care more about what you've done than how your resume is titled. If you meet most of these and are excited by the role, we encourage you to apply.




BONUS POINTS

 - You've founded a company, ideally after starting your career as a PM, and spent time building in payments along the way.

 - You were the first PM at an early-stage startup.

 - You've built or shipped an agent, agent integration or agentic payments product.

 - Experience with credit cards, rewards or loyalty programs.

 - You're a rewards optimizer yourself, and you already have agents doing some of that work for you.


LEARN MORE

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog: https://tech.imprint.co/




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At EdSights, we're building the technology for higher education to understand what students are actually thinking and feeling, so they can act before small struggles become big problems. We call it Student Voice Intelligence: engaging students in real-time, AI-powered conversations, uncovering the real drivers of attrition, and delivering those insights to power student success and enrollment workflows.



Today, we partner with 300+ colleges and universities across the country. We're backed by an $80M investment https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250925255277/en/EdSights-Raises-%2480M-to-Lead-the-Next-Era-of-Student-Engagement-and-Retention-Software-in-Higher-Education from JMI Equity and are in a phase of rapid execution and expansion. This is an opportunity to do meaningful, hands-on work at a high-growth startup https://www.inc.com/profile/edsights tackling one of higher education's most urgent challenges: helping more students persist from enrollment through graduation.



You’ll join a driven, thoughtful team that values ownership, moves quickly, and cares deeply about building products that make a measurable difference for students.



“EdSights has perhaps the world’s most valuable data set on what college students need to navigate their academic lives.”

          - The Washington Post



The Opportunity

We're looking for a results-oriented, entrepreneurial Account Executive with strong intellectual curiosity and a passion for sales and business development. You'll own a territory end to end—learning your prospects' strategic priorities, crafting effective outreach, and leading the full sales cycle from prospecting through close. This role is highly visible and offers the chance to grow quickly while making a real impact in education.

This opening is for our Admit sales team. 



What you’ll do

 - Work closely with your manager to target, map, and execute prospecting strategies within your territory

 - Drive daily outbound activity via phone, email, and social to book introductory meetings

 - Lead prospect presentations and manage opportunities from first contact through close

 - Build, manage, and forecast a healthy sales pipeline

 - Travel 1–3 times per quarter for tradeshows and on-site meetings

 - Act as a trusted advisor, bringing industry insight and clearly articulating the value EdSights provides



About You

 - 2+ years of experience in a full-cycle SaaS closing sales role

 - Consistently meet or exceed quota (100%+) and rank in the top half of your team

 - Closed deals with multiple stakeholders where you ran discovery and led the process

 - Coachable, with a desire to build on existing sales fundamentals

 - Proven experience building your own pipeline through outbound (calls, email, social)

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Resilience and consistency in a results-driven environment

 - Strong time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for learning, growth, and making an impact in education
   
   

Nice to Haves

 - Experience in or selling into the higher education market

 - Experience managing sales cycles of 3+ months



The Process

 1. Async Video Recording - Your application will be reviewed by humans, if we’d like to learn more we will send you a link to record a quick video! 
    

 2. Recruiter Screen/Intro - You’ll chat with Mary, our Head of Talent, to discuss the role, your background, and logistics.
    

 3. Hiring Manager Interview - You’ll meet with Rocco, the hiring manager, to dive deeper into role-specific experience and expectations.
    

 4. Take-Home Assignment / Group Interview - This is an opportunity to showcase your skills in a tangible way. You'll meet more of the Sales team on this call.
    

 5. Leadership Interview - You'll chat with our CRO, Nick. (If schedules allow, we will merge this with the co-founder chat)
    

 6. Co-Founder Call - You’ll meet with one of our co-founders, Carolina, for a final chat!
    

 7. References - We’ll ask for 3 references. Ideally, 2 will be previous managers. We typically do these in tandem with the Co-Founder call. 
    

 8. Offer!
    

Why join EdSights?

 - Make a real impact in higher education — Be part of a mission you can be proud of https://www.edsights.io/company to help colleges and universities better support students through AI-driven insights, real-time engagement, and student-centered technology.

 - Join a values-driven, collaborative culture — Be part of a kind, inclusive, “no-ego” team that prioritizes trust, transparency, and respect.

 - Grow with a fast-scaling EdTech company — EdSights is ranked on Inc. 5000 for rapid growth and innovation.

 - Enjoy flexibility and competitive benefits https://www.edsights.io/careers — Remote-friendly work, unlimited PTO, paid parental leave, competitive compensation, new Apple hardware, 401k matching, and strong health and wellness benefits.



EdSights provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Director of FP&A and Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
ABOUT GOODR

We create and sell active eyewear for anyone. No Slip. No Bounce. All Polarized. All Fun. Interested in joining our team? Keep reading.

OUR VALUES: We have two core values: Fun & Authenticity.

• FUN = Being sh*tty isn’t fun. Agreed? Taking pride in your work, finding joy in being GREAT, and celebrating wins… and losses. Now, that’s fun!

• AUTHENTICITY = Focusing on being authentic over being liked. (Next-level guru stuff. Count it.)

Fun Fact: We do not allow email to be sent internally. Carrier pigeons only. JK, we use Slack.

LEADERSHIP: We expect our leaders to be guiding lights for their teams. To support that, we provide leadership courses to sharpen their leadership abilities, including an in-house leadership coach.

AUTONOMY: We practice autonomy, empowerment, and accountability so that every team member can be in control of their own life.

• HYBRID WORKING: This role is required to be in our Inglewood office every Tuesday and Thursday with the occasional third day thrown in.

• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: We have an all-company learning program so that we’re constantly leveling up our skills.

SUSTAINABILITY: We think Earth’s pretty rad. That’s why we take action wherever possible to limit our impact on the planet.

• 1% FOR THE PLANET MEMBER: 1% of goodr’s annual sales go directly to environmental organizations.

• CARBON NEUTRAL: In 2019, goodr became a 100% carbon neutral company.

Fun Fact: goodr celebrates every Earth Day by releasing limited-edition sunglasses with frames made from 100% recycled materials—and the packaging is 100% sustainable, too!

ABOUT THE ROLE

When others see numbers, you see the story behind them. You’re the kind of leader who can turn ambiguity into a clear financial roadmap… and make it actionable! Forecasts don’t scare you, endless scenarios excite you, and you’re always thinking three steps ahead.

As our Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Business Intelligence, you’ll own company-wide planning, forecasting, and long-range strategy, delivering insights that guide leadership decisions and fuel smart growth. You’ll partner closely with teams across the business to connect performance to strategy, model what’s next, and help goodr invest in the right opportunities at the right time.

If you love big-picture thinking, sharp analysis, and using data to shape the future, keep reading!

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide clear insights into business performance and key financial metrics

• Partner with our Controller and other key role holders to interpret financial results and support strategic decision-making

• Oversee cash flow management, working capital strategy, and liquidity planning to ensure financial health and flexibility

• Lead company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning of both revenue, demand, and expenses in collaboration with department leaders

• Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of FP&A and business intelligence analysts, establishing scalable processes and ensuring strict accuracy across all financial outputs

• Identify strategic and operational financial risks and opportunities, providing proactive, forward-looking recommendations

• Provide detailed financial modeling and scenario planning for key initiatives, M&A opportunities, and capital allocation decisions

• Own the Budget vs. Actuals (BvA) process, partnering with department leaders across all teams to understand operational velocity and OPEX movement

• Deliver high-impact executive presentations, narrative-driven storytelling, and board/investor-level reporting

• Build and manage a high-performing team while partnering across functions to ensure financial alignment

• This role is in the Money department and will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer

• Perform other related duties as assigned

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead by example by consistently living into goodr’s values of Fun and Authenticity

• Be a culture carrier by leaning into our three fundamentals of communication, professionalism, and vision

• Hold monthly one-on-ones with each team member to build upon their role duties and hold everyone accountable

• Ask clear questions, increase everyone’s knowledge, and empower the team so that we can get the best out of every person in your department

• Give consistent, continuous feedback and challenge your flock to perpetually grow so they become the best version of themselves

• Own your team’s budget and ensure its accuracy

• Use imagination and wisdom to set team goals and communicate them clearly

• Challenge the status quo ALWAYS; the phrase “this is how we’ve always done it” is banned here at goodr, so don’t be afraid to push out of your comfort zone and encourage your team to do the same

ABOUT THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

• May or may not have a degree...we don’t care (bonus points for Basset Hound Science or Dinosaur Law)

• 7+ years of financial planning and analysis experience with 4+ yrs of experience as a Director

• Deep understanding of both financial & accounting principles

• Ability to develop financial strategies that align with company goals

• Effectively communicating financial information to senior management

• Expert level in Microsoft Excel

• Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Planning (Adaptive Insights)

• Understanding of coding languages and analytical models (SQL, Python, data warehouses, machine learning models)

• Knowledge of ERP systems (we use Netsuite!)

• Experience with Figma is a HUGE plus!

• Proven experience leading financial reporting, budgeting/forecasting, and long-range planning

• Has an in-depth understanding of team dynamics

• Experience in a scaling or high-growth environment

• Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills

• Strong communicator who lives into collaboration

• Driven by personal growth and thrives in an environment of constant feedback

• Is proactive and an independent problem solver! (Can you google a question?)

WHAT YOU GET

• A role at a company that is going to the moon

• The opportunity to show up every day and have fun

• The ability to learn and grow as a person

• Paid vacation (we encourage you to take time off!)

• Paycheck... obviously. Salary range: $180-$200k, final offer will be made within this range based on experience

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401(K) with company matching

• Financial Wellness Counseling

• Sunglasses. Obviously.

**No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.

NEXT STEPS

Here's what we expect the hiring process for this role to be, should all go well with your candidacy. This entire process is expected to take 8 weeks to complete and you'd be expected to start on a specific date.

1. Application

2. Fill out a form with basic questions

3. 30 minute introductory interview with HR team member

4. 30 minute virtual interviews with peers and manager

5. Final assignment and presentation

6. Offer!

TO GET THE PROCESS STARTED, REVIEW & SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING:

• Review goodr's Applicant Privacy Policy. By submitting an application to goodr, you are confirming that you have read the Applicant Privacy Policy and agree to its terms. (Because nothing says “fun” like reading legal documents!)

• Resume

• Links to projects or groups you’re involved with (if you have them)

• A drawing of an octopus fighting a pirate (not joking)*

• We may ask you to enter a code. But don't worry, it's just our attempt to keep the bots at bay.

*We accept submissions using accessibility tools.

goodr is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application, interview, or hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@goodr.com so we can discuss appropriate accommodations.

jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

The role

Title: Head of Growth

Reports to: SVP of Marketing

Location: SF Bay Area

The Head of Growth is a hands-on commercial growth leader responsible for turning Avathon’s strategic enterprise accounts into buying-group engagement, qualified opportunities, pipeline, and bookings acceleration. You will lead a US–India growth organization spanning account-based marketing, demand generation, digital performance, marketing operations, and five SDRs based in the US and India. You are a member of the marketing leadership team responsible for turning a category-defining platform into durable, efficient ARR growth.

What you'll work on

• Own Avathon’s account-based growth strategy for priority enterprise accounts across six industrial verticals, in close partnership with Sales leadership.

• Build account tiers, buying-group maps, account plays, engagement programs, and executive outreach to create and accelerate qualified pipeline.

• Lead, coach, and establish operating standards for five SDRs, including research, outbound sequencing, qualification, handoffs, and meeting quality.

• Manage the India-based Associate Director, Growth Marketing & Digital, responsible for digital channels, performance campaigns, website, SEO, and campaign execution.

• Own Marketing Operations within Growth, including campaign automation, segmentation, nurture, experimentation, and marketing workflow priorities. Partner with RevOps on CRM architecture, data governance, routing, attribution standards, and revenue reporting.

• Coordinate integrated account programs with Product Marketing, Brand/Communications, Events, and Sales; align digital paid media with account and pipeline objectives.

• Establish disciplined growth measurement: buying-group coverage, account progression, accepted opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, deal velocity, SDR productivity, and program efficiency.

• Deploy AI-enabled account intelligence, personalization, campaign operations, and SDR productivity workflows with appropriate governance and human review.

• Launch a measurable 20-account pilot in the first 90 days, then scale proven programs across the priority account portfolio.

• Own Growth planning, budget allocation, agency and technology partnerships, experimentation, and executive performance reporting.

What we’re looking for

• 10–12+ years in enterprise B2B growth marketing, demand generation, or ABM, ideally in industrial technology, enterprise AI, infrastructure, or complex SaaS.

• Demonstrated ability to create pipeline and accelerate opportunities in long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments.

• Experience designing and operating tiered named-account programs in close partnership with enterprise sales leaders.

• Proven leadership of distributed teams, including SDRs and digital/demand generation specialists, with clear performance management.

• Working fluency in Salesforce, HubSpot, marketing automation, account intelligence, sales engagement platforms, and performance analytics.

• Ability to integrate outbound, paid digital, executive engagement, content, and events into cohesive account programs.

• Strong commercial judgment, analytical discipline, experimentation mindset, and comfort operating hands-on in a lean, fast-scaling organization.

About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences. Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We are hiring Sales Development Representatives to build the pipeline behind HeyGen's next phase of growth. This is a full-funnel prospecting role with a heavy emphasis on outbound. You will research target accounts, run creative outbound campaigns, work product-led signals, qualify interest, and book first meetings for our Account Executives. This is not a traditional SDR role where you work someone else's list and a fixed script. We are looking for hunters who are comfortable moving fast, testing new outbound ideas, starting conversations with busy buyers, and earning meetings through persistence, creativity, and sharp research. You will prospect into companies using HeyGen's web app and API, helping buyers see how AI video can transform marketing, sales enablement, customer education, training, localization, product onboarding, and developer-powered video workflows.

What You'll Do

Build pipeline from scratch - You will run high-volume, high-quality outbound into target accounts. This includes cold email, phone, LinkedIn, personalized video, account research, trigger-based outreach, and creative campaign ideas. You should be excited by the idea of starting conversations that would not have happened without you.

Mine product-led signals - You will work with self-serve users, product usage data, sign-ups, and inbound interest to find the teams already getting value from HeyGen who are ready for a bigger conversation.

Qualify with discipline - You will run first conversations that uncover real pain, identify who owns the budget, and understand timing, so every meeting you book is one an Account Executive wants to take.

Sell the outcome, not just the meeting - You will help prospects see how HeyGen can reduce video production costs, speed up content creation, improve localization, personalize customer communication, and unlock new video workflows, so they show up to the first call already curious.

Move fast and test - You will try new messaging, channels, personas, and sequences, measure what works, and share it with the team. Most experiments fail; the ones that work become the playbook.

Partner with Account Executives - You will align with AEs on target accounts, share what you are hearing in the market, and hand off the context they need to run a strong first meeting.

Maintain strong pipeline discipline - You will keep CRM data clean, log activity accurately, and understand the difference between a real opportunity and a polite maybe.

What We're Looking For

• 1+ years of experience in sales, business development, or another target-driven role.

• A track record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, or pipeline targets.

• Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Strong discovery instincts and the ability to find a real business problem in a first conversation.

• Comfort reaching out to marketing, sales, customer success, L&D, product, operations, founder, or technical stakeholders.

• A high-agency, builder mindset. You do not wait for perfect playbooks. You test, learn, and iterate.

• Strong written communication skills. Your cold emails and follow-ups should be clear, short, and get replies.

• Curiosity about AI, video, creative workflows, and API-driven products.

Nice-to-Haves

• SDR or BDR experience at a PLG, usage-based, API, creative software, marketing technology, sales technology, or AI company.

• Experience prospecting into marketing, localization, customer education, learning and development, sales enablement, ecommerce, media, or product teams.

• Experience using video, personalization, AI tools, or creative outbound to start conversations.

• Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

Who Will Thrive Here

• Gets energy from prospecting and hunting.

• Can write a sharp cold email without waiting for marketing to give you a template.

• Is comfortable making calls, sending videos, testing messaging, and following up persistently.

• Treats a target as a game to win, not a burden.

• Does not need a fully built sales playbook to be productive.

• Wants to become a top-performing Account Executive and is willing to earn it.

• Is competitive, resourceful, and organized.

Compensation & Benefits

• High ownership, high velocity, and direct impact on revenue growth.

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer - Sentry
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer on the Sentry products team, you will work inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality and reliable products for Anduril's Sentry autonomous surveillance systems and the critical components that make successful sourcing solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, quality, and performance of components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's core commodity families — PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging — that enable Sentry to operate in demanding field environments. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers, and partnering with them for world-class results is essential across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing across multiple commodity types, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria and metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout the product development stages with the Sentry product engineering team through design reviews, supplier process development, testing, and qualification for components and sub-assemblies across Sentry's commodity families: PCBA, structures and power, radar, and imaging. Review supplier processes and capabilities to ensure alignment to product, part, and sub-assembly requirements.

• Provide technical expertise for manufacturing and outsourcing processes across commodities — including printed circuit board assemblies, structural and power systems, radar modules, and imaging sensor assemblies. Drive the gathering of data and insights from suppliers to conduct top-tier evaluations of manufacturability, quality, cost-efficiency, capability, and audit compliance.

• Partner with development engineering (mechanical, electrical, RF, and optical/systems), product quality engineering, and program management to deliver predictable supply to Sentry development programs and production programs, and manage exceptions, containments, and deviations for supplier technical performance.

• Drive supplier quality readiness by analyzing key and critical characteristics for drawings, schematics, and supplier specifications, develop measurement systems and inspection criteria, and lead supplier qualification activities (PPAP, FAIR, MSA, Audit, inspection development, PFMEA & AS9102, etc.).

• Partner with Category Management and Sourcing Engineering to drive overall supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and fulfillment of strategic goals across all four commodity families.

• Own the elimination of supplier risk to improve quality and reliability across the Sentry product lifecycle, from early prototyping through scaled production. Utilize audits, readiness reviews, and training and documentation to ensure compliance.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the technology/vendor capability roadmap and delivery schedules needed for future Sentry variants, proof-of-concepts, prototypes, and explorations.

• Support Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) and Material Review Board (MRB) activities. Review supplier effectiveness of actions and share lessons learned across the Sentry product team. Drive supplier corrective action and response (SCAR) process.

• Audit the Quality Management System at our suppliers as it pertains to supplier quality and performance. Define and improve required documentation and activities as needed to ensure Anduril's compliance to flow-down requirements from customers.

• Prepare, support, and lead supplier onsite audits and reviews for contract deliverables for quality management and compliance.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, or Manufacturing Engineering preferred)

• Experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense or similar hardware across one or more of the following commodities: PCBA, structures and power, radar, or imaging

• Experience driving high quality assembly and/or disassembly of complex projects and mechanical or electronic structures through developing drawings, schematics, and work instructions with other engineering functions

• Experience with driving supplier performance and evaluation. Experience with Statement of Work (SOW), quality clauses, intellectual property (IP), and government regulations such as ITAR, etc.

• Working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements such as Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) quality improvement techniques, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

• A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion

• Analytical skills and experience with data mining, data quality, metrics generation, issue management systems, and statistical analysis tools (MatLab, JMP, MiniTab, etc.)

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance

• Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time to suppliers, sourcing partners, and manufacturing locations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in a technical field

• 5–7 years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complexity manufacturing environments and suppliers

• Experience across multiple Sentry commodity families (PCBA, structures and power, radar, imaging)

• Working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001) and AS9100/ISO 9001-based Quality Management System requirements

• Experience with government contracts and MIL standard requirements

• Experience with Teamcenter, SolidWorks, Oracle/Netsuite, Jira, Tableau, and Foundry

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

 - Partner with Merchandising on store allocations and the timing of new product launches.

Inventory Strategy & Open-to-Buy

 - Track and manage owned inventory and product lifecycle with the Merchandising team.

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Partner with the Data Analytics and Tech teams to develop and implement an inventory tracking and forecasting system.

 - Collaborate with Merchandising, Store Operations, and Finance to align inventory strategy with business priorities.

 - Represent the planning function to senior leadership, clearly communicating inventory position, risks, and opportunities.

Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience at the senior manager level or above in retail inventory planning or management.

 - Experience building merchandise planning and inventory management tools and processes from the ground up.

 - Experience consolidating data sources into clear, actionable insights.

 - Experience working with distribution center operations and retail store allocation.

jobs.title: Home Builder Sales Director - California
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION  


SPAN IS ENABLING ELECTRIFICATION FOR ALL ⚡

 


WE ARE A MISSION-DRIVEN COMPANY DESIGNING, BUILDING, AND DEPLOYING PRODUCTS THAT ELECTRIFY THE BUILT ENVIRONMENT, REDUCE CARBON EMISSIONS, AND SLOW THE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE.

 

 - Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.

 - Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.
   
    


AT SPAN, WE BELIEVE IN:

 - Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy

 - Making electrification upgrades possible

 - Building more resilient homes with reliable backup

 - Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid





THE ROLE

We are looking for a driven, dynamic sales leader to manage the home builder business in California. This role blends strategic planning, business development, and in-market relationship building. You will play a critical part in setting the strategic direction of the market - working with financing companies, large install partners, and OEMs in the solar and storage market to aid builders in meeting the building code while delivering an excellent homeowner experience.

This is an exciting opportunity for a sales leader eager to build a profitable new market category that challenges industry norms while building and expanding existing partnerships. Join SPAN and become a vital force in shaping a sustainable future, enabling electrification across diverse industries and applications.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategic Sales Success
   
   - Develop a sales strategy with clear objectives, actions and outcome metrics that delivers incremental home builder volume in California. Requires an understanding of TPO (third-party-ownership) financing models that exist in the solar and storage industry.
   
   - Directly manage a territory to deliver sales. Build a deep understanding of the product, market fit, customer journey, go-to market models, and SPAN value to effectively build market sales volume.
   
   - Deliver clear, tailored pitches that highlight SPAN’s product value and program benefits, adapting your discussions based on the customer’s needs and business opportunities.
   
   - Lead strategic high-value partner engagements with your communication skills, business acumen and executive presence.
   
   - Collaborate with Eaton and SPAN Builder Ops teams in the market to ensure projects are developed and executed to the technical specifications of the builders while reducing channel conflict that results in maximized sales outcomes for both SPAN and Eaton.
   
   - Participate in key market visits (~6-10 days/month) to deliver on sales targets - includes sales calls with builders and installers, trade shows, training, or site visits.

 - Data-Driven Decision Making
   
   - Regularly analyze home starts, home closings, and production builder market movements to identify top opportunities, applying strategic thinking and keen business acumen.
   
   - Develop data-driven QBR templates that result in deeper commitment and sales outcomes in the category.
   
   - Use Salesforce to track engagement, funnel conversion, and activation status.
   
   - Maintain clean, accurate CRM data and contribute to team-level forecasting, showcasing excellent planning and priority setting.

 - Business Planning and Execution
   
   - Develop region, territory and channel business plans, collaborating closely with territory managers and sales leadership to align on strategic targets and priorities, that drive increased demand for SPAN products.
   
   - Manage and contribute to team enablement efforts—sharing feedback, identifying blockers, and supporting continuous improvement.
   
   - Collaborate with Product Management to support voice of customer, feature prioritization, and customer experience visits to deliver on a robust product roadmap that meets customer needs.
   
   - Partner with Channel Marketing Program Leads to develop robust programs that optimize sales impact across production builders, installers, and other entities that influence the outcomes of regional sales success.


ABOUT YOU

Required Qualifications

We are seeking an experienced and driven sales professional with:

 - 7+ years of experience in production home builder sales

 - Analytic skills: Proficient in analytic software tools (e.g. Google Sheets, AI), ability to filter and analyze data and Salesforce reports, and use insights to prioritize activity and develop business plans across the region

 - Demonstrated ability to prioritize and plan in a complex and ever changing sales environment

 - Forecast management: Skilled in developing and delivering a forecast with >80% accuracy and working across functions (e.g. supply chain, sales ops, territory managers)

 - Proficient with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and high learning agility for new sales tools

 - Must reside in territory to facilitate in-market engagements

 - Must have a valid driver’s license

 


LIFE AT SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges. 

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.

 


THE PERKS:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage.  Parental leave up to twenty four (24)  weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

 

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

jobs.title: Flight Test Site Manager
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Role Summary

At Zone 5 Technologies, Flight Test Site Managers lead the day-to-day operations, coordination, and execution of flight-test activities at remote test locations supporting multiple unmanned aircraft programs.

This role is highly hands-on, execution-focused, and leadership-driven, working cross-functionally with Flight Test, Engineering, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), Logistics, Safety, Security, and external range personnel to ensure flight-test operations are properly planned, resourced, and executed.

The Flight Test Site Manager serves as the primary operational leader at assigned test locations, responsible for site readiness, personnel coordination, equipment availability, infrastructure, and daily operational execution.  This includes establishing and maintaining processes that enable safe, efficient, and repeatable flight-test operations.

In this role, you are expected to operate with extreme ownership, independently resolving operational challenges, anticipating resource requirements, and ensuring personnel and equipment are positioned to support scheduled testing.  You will serve as the primary point of contact between remote flight-test operations and company leadership.

Responsibilities

Flight Test Site Operations & Leadership

• Support daily flight-test site operations across multiple programs and test activities

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned remote test locations

• Coordinate personnel, facilities, equipment, and operational resources required for test execution

• Establish daily operating priorities and communicate operational status to leadership

• Identify and resolve operational challenges before they impact scheduled testing

Site Readiness & Infrastructure

• Maintain operational readiness of test-site facilities, ground-support equipment, vehicles, and infrastructure

• Coordinate site setup, mobilization, demobilization, and equipment staging

• Ensure required communications, power, network connectivity, and support systems are available

• Establish and maintain site operating procedures, inspection requirements, and readiness checklists

• Coordinate facility maintenance, repairs, and infrastructure improvements

Personnel & Resource Coordination

• Coordinate daily personnel assignments and operational support requirements with functional managers

• Ensure qualified personnel and required resources are available for scheduled activities

• Manage site-level resource conflicts and elevate unresolved priorities to operational leadership

• Coordinate with Logistics to ensure equipment is properly tracked, maintained, and available

• Support personnel onboarding, site orientation, training coordination, and operational accountability

Range Coordination & Operational Compliance

• Serve as a primary interface with range representatives, test-site authorities, and external support organizations

• Coordinate site access, operating restrictions, range requirements, and local procedures

• Ensure personnel follow established safety, security, environmental, and operational requirements

• Support operational risk assessments, readiness reviews, and test execution planning

• Maintain site documentation, inspection records, and required operational reporting

Test Execution & Communication

• Lead daily operational coordination meetings and communicate test-site readiness

• Support flight-test execution by resolving personnel, equipment, facility, and scheduling constraints

• Coordinate rapidly changing requirements resulting from weather, technical issues, or program priorities

• Communicate operational risks, resource limitations, and schedule impacts to leadership

• Support post-test activities, equipment accountability, and lessons-learned reviews

Process Development & Continuous Improvement

• Develop standardized site operating procedures, checklists, and resource-management processes

• Establish site readiness metrics and track recurring operational constraints

• Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, equipment utilization, and test-site capacity

• Support expansion and activation of new remote flight-test locations

• Drive accountability, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement across site operations

Qualifications

• 5–10+ years of experience in flight-test operations, aviation operations, military test operations, aerospace operations, or similar technical environments

• Demonstrated experience coordinating personnel, equipment, facilities, and operational resources

• Proven ability to lead teams and manage complex operations in remote or geographically separated environments

• Strong understanding of operational safety, risk management, and procedural compliance

• Ability to independently resolve problems, prioritize competing requirements, and make time-sensitive operational decisions

• Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Recruiter
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

The Role

We're seeking a Senior Corporate Recruiter to lead full-cycle hiring across all our business functions. This role is central to our ability to build a world-class team—you'll partner directly with hiring managers, shape hiring strategies, and identify exceptional talent in highly competitive and specialized markets. Each of these teams require unique strategies: identifying a cost accountant who can stand up standard costing for reactor manufacturing, a licensing specialist fluent in 10 CFR, a legal operations lead who knows DOE Part 810. Each is a thin market, and each search needs a recruiter who can learn the domain well enough to tell a strong candidate from a plausible one The right person operates with urgency, ownership, and a high bar for talent, helping us scale quickly without compromising quality. This is a fully on-site role based at our Torrance, CA headquarters.

Key Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting across Finance, Accounting, Regulatory and Licensing, IT, Commercial & External Affairs, Facilities, Security, and Marketing — from search kickoff through signed offer.

• Become the market expert for each function you support; map the talent landscape, name the companies and career paths that produce strong candidates, and bring that intelligence to leaders defining a role for the first time.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and hiring managers, converting vague needs into sharp role definitions, interview plans, and hiring criteria before a req opens.

• Source passive candidates directly; build and run outbound campaigns rather than waiting on inbound applications for scarce regulated-industry profiles.

• Screen for substance over credential, probing actual scope, decisions owned, and systems built so hiring managers interview a short list of real contenders.

• Negotiate and close senior candidates against competing offers, navigating relocation to Orangeville, Utah and Torrance, California.

• Build the corporate recruiting playbook as you go: scorecards, interview loops, calibration standards, and sourcing channels that the next recruiter inherits.

• Keep a no-job-too-small posture — host onsites, chase references, and run the search yourself when that is what moves a critical hire.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience hiring for corporate and G&A functions such as finance, accounting, legal, supply chain, or operations for niche applications.

• Track record closing senior and hard-to-fill roles in competitive markets, including offers against counteroffers.

• Demonstrated ability to source passive candidates directly rather than relying on inbound applicant flow.

• Ability to assess candidates beyond the resume and defend a hiring recommendation to an executive.

• Experience partnering with senior stakeholders who have never written a job description or run a hiring loop.

• Ability to run multiple concurrent searches across unrelated functions without losing momentum on any of them.

• High level of ownership, accountability, and follow-through on every candidate touchpoint.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience recruiting in nuclear, energy, aerospace, defense, or regulated manufacturing environments.

• Familiarity with hiring for regulatory, licensing, quality assurance, or compliance functions.

• Experience hiring in a company scaling past 300 employees, and in markets outside major metros.

• Experience building recruiting processes, scorecards, or sourcing channels where none existed.

• Exposure to executive search or leadership hiring.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary

$120,000—$150,000 USD

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II, Commercial Markets
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

This role is for a Customer Success Manager for Planet’s commercial markets. You will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with customers, especially in the agriculture vertical. You will help customers maximize the value of Planet’s imagery and geospatial solutions, ensuring that they can effectively integrate Planet data into their business workflows.

The ideal candidate is a consultative strategist who naturally takes ownership of the account lifecycle post sales supporting renewal and expansion opportunities. We are looking for a thought partner with deep business acumen and situational awareness who can adapt seamlessly from an executive briefing to a deep dive with technical teams. You will operate in lockstep with your sales counterparts, combining technical value realization with commercial strategy to build a unified account front. As the customer success manager, you will seek to understand our customers' business models and anticipate their downstream needs. This includes a relentless drive for value realization, ensuring our customers can clearly measure and articulate the tangible ROI Planet delivers.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Denver office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

• Take full accountability for gross and net retention metrics across your book of business, ensuring long-term customer health and growth.

• Partner closely with Account Executives to build unified commercial strategies by bringing actionable account insights and forward-looking recommendations to internal syncs.

• Map out long-term account trajectories proactively to identify capacity gaps, risks, and expansion opportunities early.

• Co-create success plans and QBRs that enable customers to clearly measure and present the business impact and ROI of Planet solutions.

• Build solid relationships across complex stakeholder networks, equipping internal champions with the data they need to advocate for the partnership.

• Lead cross-functional internal teams through critical account milestones to ensure alignment and clear execution.

• Navigate high-stakes customer situations with composure and sound judgment, prioritizing effectively under pressure.

What You Bring:

• 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a strategic customer-facing role.

• Good working knowledge of remote sensing, GIS, or geospatial imagery products, with the ability to bridge technical workflows with commercial value.

• A track record of acting as a thought partner by asking reframing questions that probe client motivations, pressures, and business context.

• A solid understanding of commercial business models (how clients make money, industry market shifts, and regulatory changes) and the ability to weigh the trade-offs of customer requests.

• Situational awareness with an ability to read between the lines, dynamically adjust your tone, depth, and detail whether presenting to an executive or collaborating with a technical lead.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a professional presence that earns trust.

• Flexibility to support global business needs, including availability for US calls.

• Willingness to travel to connect with customers and internal teams.

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Experience as a Customer Success Manager or Account Manager.

• Proficiency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Success (CS) tools (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk) to manage workflows and report on team metrics.

• Ability to translate customer data into actionable insights.

• Experience leading organizational change management efforts.

• Experience working within the utility or oil & gas sector, with a deep understanding of how Energy companies evaluate and implement geospatial solutions.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 PT on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution

• Generous Paid Time Off in addition to holidays and company-wide days off

• 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

• Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Home Office Reimbursement

• Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement

• Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning

• Equity

• Commuter Benefits (if local to an office)

• Volunteering Paid Time Off

Compensation:

The US base salary range for this full-time position at the commencement of employment is listed below. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives (bonus and equity). The final salary range is determined by job related experience, skills and location. The range displays our typical hiring range for new hire salaries in US locations only. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. This role is eligible for commission.

San Francisco Salary Range

$121,840—$152,320 USD

US National Salary Range

$105,040—$131,280 USD

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why we care so much about Belonging.
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. jobs.title: Hostperson, Binchotan Bar and Grille (Full Time)
jobs.description:
Binchotan Bar & Grille is where fireside cooking meets modern flair. At Fairmont Orchid’s hottest new restaurant guests explore the long-running creative culinary exchange between Hawai’i and Japan at our Traditional northern Japanese grill utilizing centuries-old practices of robatayaki: fireside cooking, grilled to perfection. Originating from Hokkaidō, Japan, robatayaki reflects the seafaring lifestyle: seasoned fishermen grilling up their fresh catch over the irori, or glowing white coals, served sizzling hot.

What you will be doing:

• Provide unique dining experiences to all of our guests through warm, personal & detailed service in a luxury, upscale and fast paced environment.
• Ensure a positive first impression of the restaurant for our guests through detailed cleanliness, set-up and ambiance control.
• Prepare appropriately for anticipated dining traffic by creating communication for servers & designating server section assignments.
• Ensure guests receive warm welcome, timely service and a fond farewell using guest names to offer a personalized service
• Maintain menus to ensure we always have an adequate clean supply
• Ensure cleanliness & orderliness of host stand including surrounding work areas.
• Control the flow of service in the dining outlet by seating guests in station rotation while maintaining the guest center reservation management system (Open Table)
• Handle reservation inquiries, take incoming telephone calls, note special requests by guests and indicate special attention to VIP guests
• Perform opening/closing side duties as assigned and set all tables according to standards and procedures
• Assist other Food & Beverage outlets with their operations during peak times or when required
• Apply necessary precautions with regards to the hotel food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP)
• Be well versed in hotel fire & life safety/emergency procedures
• Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times
• Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel

Your experience and skills include:

• Ability to focus attention on guest needs, remaining calm and courteous at all times
• Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
• Ability to speak other languages and basic understanding of local languages will be an advantage
• Ability to work cohesively and collaboratively as part of a team
• Detailed & service oriented with an eye for detail to be self-motivated and energetic.
• Provide the necessary State and Federal Requirements to work in Food and Beverage (Tuberculosis Clearance)

Hourly Rate: $28.08 USD

Visa Requirements: Must be legally eligible to work in the United States. The hotel is unable to assist candidates in obtaining U.S. work authorization.

Your team and working environment: Join a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional luxury experiences. You will work alongside passionate Heartists who support one another, anticipate guest needs, and bring our commitment to Make Special Happen to life every day.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality.

We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

About Fairmont Hotels & Resorts: At Fairmont Hotels & Resorts we offer our guests the finest hospitality experience in each of our destinations. And we know that, to offer our guests the best, we first need to offer our employees the best. That’s why you’ll find exceptional work opportunities – throughout North America and the Caribbean, Europe and Africa, the Middle East and Asia Pacific – as well as industry leading training, career development, recognition and rewards. A community and environmental leader, Fairmont is also regarded for its responsible tourism practices and award – winning Green Partnership Program. An exciting future awaits!

jobs.title: Senior Structural Designer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

About the Position

The Senior Structural Designer - Power is responsible for preparing and coordinating structural design deliverables for utility infrastructure, renewable energy, transmission, and substation projects. This role independently develops and coordinates technical documentation and project deliverables while providing guidance and technical support to less experienced designers. In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in regard to the essential functions of the job below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Develop structural design deliverables for utility infrastructure, renewable energy, transmission, and substation projects with minimal oversight.

• Prepare and coordinate structural drawing packages including plans, elevations, sections, details, and construction documentation.

• Support design and detailing of foundations, structural steel systems, equipment supports, transmission structures, and related infrastructure.

• Review project specifications, standards, calculations, and technical requirements for incorporation into project deliverables.

• Coordinate project activities with engineers, designers, project managers, and multidisciplinary project teams.

• Perform design reviews and support QA/QC activities to ensure technical quality and consistency.

• Review vendor drawings, shop drawings, and project documentation for conformance with project requirements.

• Support project planning, scheduling, and execution activities.

• Provide technical assistance and guidance to junior designers and CAD personnel.

• Participate in site visits, field assignments, and construction support activities as required.

• Support client communication and project coordination activities.

• Perform other job-related responsibilities as assigned.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of structural design principles, construction practices, and utility infrastructure projects.

• Ability to independently develop and coordinate complex design deliverables.

• Ability to perform technical reviews and support QA/QC activities.

• Strong understanding of structural systems, foundation design, and construction documentation.

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to mentor and support less experienced designers and technical staff.

• Commitment to technical excellence, quality, and continuous improvement.

• Technical certificate or Associate’s Degree in drafting, design or related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and/or relevant experience may be considered.

• 4-7 years of experience in the Electric Power Industry as a Designer.

• Demonstrated ability to independently perform complex structural design assignments and coordinate project deliverables.

• Experience supporting utility infrastructure, substations, transmission, renewable energy, or related engineering projects preferred.

Additional Position Details

• Work is performed in a professional work environment, with work location and reporting expectations determined by business needs and position requirements. Some field work may be required.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and operate a computer and other office productivity equipment.

• Frequently communicates and collaborates with clients, engineers, designers, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.

• Must be able to move around project sites and work in indoor or outdoor environments as required.

• Travel may be required based on client and project needs.

Cultural Fit

• Independent yet Collaborative

• Dependable

• Creative Problem Solver

• Natural Communicator

• Flexible

• Results oriented

• Client Focused

• Enthusiastic

Fair Labor Standards Act

• Non-Exempt | Overtime pay is required

Disclaimer

• The information contained herein is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the USA.

• If your current job responsibilities differ from your assigned duties, please contact Human Resources.

$42—$51 USD
