jobs.title: School Break Day Camp Site Director (Boston)
jobs.description:
About NORY:

At NORY, we design learning journeys where every child in NYC and Boston becomes a risk-taking entrepreneur, inquisitive problem solver, and empathetic leader. As the largest STEM camp provider in NYC with 3000+ campers annually, we are the Disney World of STEM education, where each learning experience is magical, impactful, and memorable. Dive into our world at: www.nory.co/summer http://www.nory.co/summer, and watch this video: https://youtu.be/G8vgorW3y7U



Why Working as Site Director Rocks:

 - Professional Development in Leadership: Enhance your leadership abilities and build a strong track record for your resume. Our role is designed to prepare you for future leadership positions.

 - Training in Diverse STEM Topics: Develop your skills in a variety of STEM areas, including robotics, coding, and woodworking. No prior STEM experience? No worries-we offer comprehensive training that can be transferable to your future educational career.

 - Build Lasting Professional Relationships: Join a community of dedicated, excellence-driven colleagues.

 - Pathway to Year-Round Opportunities: Access a development pipeline that supports sustainable professional growth, helping you forge a lasting and impactful career.

School Break Day Camp Site Director Responsibilities:

 - Teach and Inspire: Lead your assigned group of campers with engaging activities that bring NORY’s core values to life, inspiring curiosity and enthusiasm.

 - Coach and Train Educators: Mentor and develop our teaching staff, ensuring they grasp the purpose behind each activity and properly implement protocols to create a fun and safe camp environment.

 - Nurture and Support Campers and Their Families: Build nurturing and supportive relationships with NORY campers and their families to enhance the camp experience for everyone involved.

 - Resource Management: Efficiently oversee and manage essential resources necessary for the success of our NORY camp, including materials, facilities, and daily schedules.

 - Administrative Oversight: Keep accurate and up-to-date administrative records for all aspects of the camp, ensuring smooth operations and compliance.



School Break Day Camp Site Director Qualifications:

 - You have experience managing and coaching a team of 4+ teachers and fostering a positive team environment.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We believe powerful AI can compress a century of scientific progress into a decade. Bringing Claude to scientists and engineers is a big part of building toward that future.

Claude has already helped uncover a novel enzyme system, formalize Fermat’s Last Theorem, design more efficient quantum circuits, and compute new results in theoretical physics — and this is just the beginning. You’ll figure out what scientists and engineers need from Claude and build it from 0→1.

You’ll be a technical leader with a high degree of autonomy, helping clear the path to harnessing scientific AGI. You’ll work with internal experts and industry partners. Initiatives like our AI for Science Program will connect you with researchers we support in high-impact work across scientific fields.

Key responsibilities

• Build products that unlock scientific discovery

• Partner with product management, design, and go-to-market to make complex workflows, like modeling and simulation, simple to run with Claude

• Work closely with research to make models better at science and engineering

• Spend time with users in academia and industry to decide what to build next

• Own technical design and delivery end to end, shipping product quickly rather than just executing a spec

Minimum qualifications

• Software engineering experience, including owning the technical design and delivery of products

• Experience building products from 0 to 1 in fast-moving environments, and setting technical direction with limited precedent to lean on

• Experience building AI products, and knowledge of what it takes to turn model capabilities into applications people actually use

• Ability to think holistically about user experience and craft tools that are a pleasure for scientists and engineers to use

• Comfort working directly with technical domain experts and customers, and turning what you learn into product

• Enjoyment of solving hard problems together with researchers, scientists, and other engineers

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level

• Background in math, physics, materials science, mechanical or electrical engineering, or another science or engineering field

• Experience building software for scientists or engineers, such as CAD, simulation, electronics design, or scientific computing tools

• Experience as a founder or early engineer at a company building tools for scientists or engineers

• Experience working with research teams to improve domain-specific model capabilities, including evaluation frameworks

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Commercial Development
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead global commercial strategy and lifecycle development for the pancreatic cancer portfolio. This job description is across numerous positions, including daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib and future pipeline candidates, supporting opportunities in first-line metastatic, locally advanced, perioperative, and adjuvant disease, as well as future indications. This leader will translate evolving clinical evidence, patient and biomarker insights, and competitive dynamics into integrated global commercial strategies, portfolio investment recommendations, and stage-appropriate launch readiness. The role requires strong cross-functional leadership and close alignment with existing asset and indication teams.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Own integrated pancreatic portfolio strategy: Lead global commercial development across therapeutic and pancreatic cancer settings; connect indication strategies to overall portfolio value.

• Guide indication and lifecycle prioritization: Evaluate clinical and commercial opportunities, unmet need, competitive differentiation, treatment sequencing, and investment trade-offs; present clear recommendations for development and governance decisions.

• Build treatment-setting strategies: Develop differentiated commercial hypotheses for first-line treatment, locally advanced disease, surgical/perioperative pathways, and adjuvant therapy, recognizing distinct patient journeys, customers, and evidence requirements.

• Integrate asset and combination positioning: Partner with relevant product teams to shape complementary daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib strategies, including biomarker-defined populations, potential combination approaches, and implications of future portfolio evolution.

• Lead patient and market forecasting: Develop global epidemiology, treatment-flow and patient-segmentation models, revenue scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and commercial value assessments across the continuum of pancreatic cancer care.

• Shape clinical development through a commercial lens: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Market Access on target populations, meaningful endpoints, duration of therapy, standards of care, and evidence needed for future adoption.

• Advance biomarker and patient-identification strategy: Work with Precision Medicine and Diagnostics on RAS/KRAS testing, KRAS G12D-defined populations, laboratory and referral workflows, accessibility, and the commercial implications of molecularly guided care.

• Connect the multidisciplinary ecosystem: Build a unified commercial understanding of oncologists, pancreatic surgeons, gastroenterologists, radiologists, pathologists, multidisciplinary tumor boards, academic centers, and community settings, in partnership with Medical Affairs and existing engagement teams.

• Align with cross-portfolio leaders: Coordinate with established first-line/metastatic teams, regional affiliates, and global brand teams to share insights and ensure best in class launches.

• Prepare for future launches and expansions: Develop stage-gated global commercialization frameworks, value propositions, brand positioning, affiliate readiness, access and customer-pathway assumptions, and launch scenarios for the U.S. and global markets.

• Track market evolution and performance: Monitor scientific milestones, competing programs, diagnostic adoption, treatment patterns, and commercial assumptions; adjust strategic plans and forecasts as evidence and investment decisions evolve.

• Lead execution and influence: Guide cross-functional working teams, agencies, market research and analytics partners; communicate succinctly with senior leaders and governance forums and apply innovative digital and data-driven approaches.

• Up to 40% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

• Proven success developing global oncology commercial strategies across products, indications, or stages of disease and influencing complex cross-functional product teams.

• Demonstrated ability to develop patient and revenue forecasts, interpret market and clinical insights, and evaluate strategic trade-offs that inform portfolio investment decisions.

• Strong leadership, ability to build high-performing teams and partnerships, and ability to influence without direct authority.

• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills and the ability to deliver high-quality strategic work under evolving timelines.

• Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate emerging clinical evidence, trial design, and oncology treatment pathways into commercial implications.

• Excellent executive communication, presentation, and external stakeholder engagement skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and commitment to improving outcomes for people with cancer.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, including first-line metastatic and earlier-stage treatment settings.

• Experience with precision oncology, KRAS/RAS-targeted medicines, molecular testing, or biomarker-defined patient populations.

• Experience developing global commercial strategies for oncology launches, indication expansion, or lifecycle management.

• Familiarity with oncology care pathways and patient journeys in pancreatic cancer.

• Experience working in a rapidly growing biotechnology company and partnering with global and regional commercial organizations.

About Formance

Formance builds open-source ledger infrastructure for companies that move money across fiat, crypto and payment rails. Engineering teams use it to track, route and reconcile funds without building their own ledger from scratch.

We are a team of about 30 people across New York and Europe. We went through Y Combinator (S21) and raised a $21M Series A led by PayPal Ventures in 2025.

Why join us

 - Hard, interesting problems. Our customers move money at scale. You will help their engineering teams design how funds flow through their systems, and see the inside of fintechs, payment companies and crypto platforms.

 - Real impact on revenue. You will be one of a small group of Solutions Engineers in the US. Your demos and POCs will directly decide whether we win deals.

 - Room to shape the role. There is no fixed playbook. You will help define how we run discovery, demos and POCs, and build the tools the team uses.

 - A global team. You will work closely with our engineering team in Europe, with regular trips to Paris.

Why this role exists

Our buyers are engineers. CTOs and Staff Engineers decide whether Formance is credible, and they want to talk to someone who has built systems like theirs. Our US team is growing, and we need a Solutions Engineer who owns the technical side of every deal, from first discovery call to signature.

What you will do

 - Partner with our Account Executives on US deals.

 - Lead technical discovery with CTOs, engineering teams and finance stakeholders.

 - Build and run custom demos based on each prospect's flows of funds.

 - Scope and run POCs with clear success criteria and an end date.

 - Answer security questionnaires and architecture reviews.

 - Design the first version of the prospect's model: accounts, transactions and edge cases (refunds, reversals, disputes).

 - Build tools, templates and demo environments that make the team faster.

You will report to our Head of Revenue in New York and work closely with our CTO and our existing Solutions Engineers.

What we are looking for

 - 3+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer or Software Engineer.

 - Hands-on with APIs and data modeling, with solid knowledge of databases. You can write code and call an API yourself.

 - Experience in fintech, payments, crypto or developer infrastructure.

 - You want to be in front of customers, and you chose pre-sales on purpose.

 - You explain complex systems simply, and you never overpromise.

 - Based in New York and authorized to work in the US.

Nice to have

 - Pre-sales experience at a developer or fintech infrastructure company.

 - Experience with ledgers, double-entry, reconciliation or accounting systems.

 - Experience with Kubernetes or self-hosted infrastructure reviews.

 - You use AI to build, and you know what to check by hand.

What to expect

This role is hands-on. There is no fixed playbook: you will shape how we run discovery, demos and POCs. You will learn how money moves inside the companies we work with, and your work will directly impact revenue.

What we offer

 - Base salary: $136,000 + $34,000 on-target bonus ($170,000 OTE).

 - Stock options.

 - Regular trips to Europe to work with our product and engineering teams.

 - Direct exposure to our founders and to engineering leaders at our customers.

 - Hybrid work from our New York office.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Materials Test
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

Test Engineering is a brand new team at Hadrian! As Engineering Manager, Materials Test, you'll build and lead our materials testing capability, working without the constraints of a legacy test framework. You'll run the flagship materials test lab at our Los Angeles HQ and lead the engineers and technicians who work in it.

Our welding, casting, forging, and additive teams all depend on this lab for the data behind their process decisions. Welding has the first needs, and the other teams are growing fast. You'll choose the equipment, set how we collect and store data, and decide how the lab balances work across all of those teams. Once the flagship lab is running, you'll turn it into a package we can stand up at any of our factories on short notice.

There is very little existing structure around materials testing at Hadrian. If you want to build a lab from an empty floor, lead a team through it, and own the outcome, this role is for you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead day-to-day operations of the flagship materials test lab

 - Hire, manage, and develop a team of engineers and technicians

 - Make the final call on technical direction for materials testing

 - Select, buy, and install tensile, impact, hardness, metallography, and chemistry equipment, plus specimen prep machines like saws, waterjets, and EDMs. Design custom test equipment when nothing off the shelf fits.

 - Set data collection, labeling, and storage requirements for all materials testing. Work with our software and data teams to build the tools.

 - Write test automation, work instructions, process plans, and technician training

 - Set priorities across welding, casting, forging, and additive so every team gets on-time, quality data

 - Own lab safety and quality risks through engineering controls

 - Work with quality to keep full traceability on every material and test result

 - Standardize workflows and tools with the rest of the test team

 - Package the lab so we can deploy it to new factories and programs


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree in mechanical, materials, aerospace, or electrical engineering, or 8+ years of equivalent experience

 - 3+ years designing, buying, or installing test or manufacturing equipment

 - 1+ years leading people. You've managed engineers, technicians, or both.

 - Hands-on materials testing experience on metals or composites

 - Working knowledge of ASTM test standards, the equipment used to run them, and when each one applies

 - Experience writing work instructions and process documentation for a lab or production floor

 - Able to set technical direction and defend it with teams you don't manage

 - Able to travel to other sites


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - You've stood up a new lab or test capability from scratch

 - You've supervised both engineers and technicians

 - System-level testing on hardware more complex than materials specimens

 - Test automation in Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar

 - Work in a regulated environment with strict traceability requirements (AS9100, ISO/IEC 17025, Nadcap, or similar)

 - Rolling out a process or capability across multiple sites

 - 5S or a similar program in a high-mix shop


COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $126,000 - $180,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Customer Experience, Amazon Air, Amazon Air - Customer Experience
jobs.description:
Amazon Air operates more than 100 flights a day across North America and is growing fast. The Customer Experience (CX) team owns the analytical frameworks that connect fleet performance, network operations, and on-time delivery outcomes for customers.
We are looking for a Business Analyst who can work on complex, ambiguous problems and turn operational data into clear, actionable insights. You will build and maintain the metrics, dashboards, and data pipelines that drive daily and weekly decision-making across the Amazon Air network. Your work will directly shape how the team understands and improves delivery performance for customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the design, development, and maintenance of operational dashboards and performance metrics that track delivery quality across the Amazon Air network, including DEA (Delivery Experience Attainment) and related indicators.
• Identify and investigate delivery performance gaps by diving deep into large, complex datasets across multiple data sources including Redshift, Andes, PerfectMile, and DataCentral.
• Build and maintain ETL pipelines and automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the speed and accuracy of operational insights.
• Own the Misbucketing AIR process — identifying packages incorrectly attributed to Air operations and driving corrections through data — and continuously improve the intake and classification workflow.
• Support the AirWatch program by maintaining and improving dashboards that provide visibility into aircraft out-of-service events and their downstream impact on delivery performance.
• Partner with supply chain managers and operations leaders to translate business questions into analysis requirements, and present findings to senior stakeholders.
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis validation, and documentation — ensuring pipelines and dashboards can be independently maintained by others.
• Apply generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation and automate routine monitoring and reporting workflows.

A day in the life
On Monday, a delivery performance gap surfaces overnight. You pull the data, trace it to a root cause in the misbucketing pipeline, and have a draft fix to the data engineering team before the morning stand-up.
On Wednesday, an ops leader needs to understand why one gateway is running 15% above its defect target. You build the breakdown, identify the two drivers, and present a one-page summary that gets acted on the same day.
By Friday, you have pushed an updated dashboard to production, cutting a three-hour manual reporting process to fifteen minutes. The team uses it in Monday's business review.
No two weeks look the same.

About the team
Amazon Air's Customer Experience team sets the course for delivering more promises on time across a fast-growing network. We spot risks before they hit customers, and we build the mechanisms that turn a single root cause fix into a lasting improvement across the network.
We work directly with flight planning, linehaul, and data science teams to turn operational insight into action. We use GenAI to automate manual work so we can spend more time solving the next problem instead of reporting on the last one.
We are a small, hands-on team. Every person owns real outcomes, not just analysis.

- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Global Operations and Workplace Reputation Team
jobs.description:
Amazon’s last-mile delivery network touches millions of customers every day — and with that scale comes real scrutiny. Legislation, regulatory shifts, and coordinated advocacy campaigns can move fast, and the stories they generate don’t wait for anyone. This role puts you at the center of how Amazon identifies, understands, and responds to the issues that matter most to its last-mile delivery operations.

As Communications Manager, Last-Mile Issues and Campaigns, you'll own the communications strategy for a portfolio that touches aspects of Amazon's last-mile delivery model. Last-mile delivery touches regulation, safety, and public trust, and this role sits at the center of how we communicate across all of it. You'll lead strategic narrative development and scenario planning that keeps the team ahead of legislative shifts, emerging campaigns, and related issues. You'll coordinate across relevant business lines and communications teams, partnering with Policy Comms, Field Comms, and others, to bring the right expertise to bear at the right moment and ensure Amazon speaks with one clear, strategic voice. You'll draft the statements, talking points, and briefing documents that represent Amazon externally, and you'll manage the feedback and approval cycles that come with them. You'll spend as much time seeding stories and shaping narratives as you do managing the reactive moments that come with the portfolio.

You're a high-judgment communicator who doesn't flinch when things get complicated. You can hold multiple fast-moving situations at once without losing your footing, but what sets you apart is your ability to spot the issue before it breaks and start building the strategy, not just the response. You think clearly under pressure, write precisely on deadline, and know how to bring the right people together at the right moment. You're comfortable as an on-the-record spokesperson, and you know how to work with reporters to shape a story before it spirals. You think like a strategist, connecting dots across policy, operations, and reputation to protect and advance the business. You don't wait to be told there's a problem. You've already mapped the landscape, built the plan, and brought the right people to the table.

This is a strong independent contributor role that reports into the Core Operations Communications team within the Global Operations and Workplace Reputation team.

Key job responsibilities
Manage complex, fast-moving, and unexpected communications challenges with high judgment and professionalism.

Be precise under tight deadlines and prioritize and manage multiple situations simultaneously.

Effectively represent Amazon as an on-the-record spokesperson.

Work with reporters to correct and clarify breaking news stories.

Write, develop, and manage approvals of external communications materials dealing with sensitive and timely topics.

Participate in multi-stakeholder emergency response meetings to provide insight and guidance from an external communications point-of-view.

A day in the life
You might start your morning scanning media coverage and legislative trackers to flag any new developments that could affect Amazon’s last-mile operations — then pull together a quick brief for a leader heading into a sensitive meeting. By midday, you could be on a call with legal and public policy partners to assess the communications implications of a pending bill or regulatory action, working through the messaging framework and drafting an initial statement. In the afternoon, you may shift to handling a reactive media inquiry on a breaking story, coordinating approvals in real time while staying in close contact with the reporter to manage the narrative. You’ll close out by updating scenario plans for upcoming legislative milestones and checking in with issues managers across the team to make sure nothing’s falling through the cracks.

About the team
We’re a team of strategic communicators responsible for telling the story of how Amazon gets people their packages — from the first mile to the last. We work across organizational boundaries to develop integrated communications strategies that inform, engage, and build trust with the audiences that matter most. We use data to shape our decisions, and we anticipate and mitigate reputational headwinds through cross-channel efforts. We value thoughtful collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to getting the details right.

On the issues side of the team, we move fast and we move together. When a legislative campaign or regulatory challenge emerges, we’re the ones coordinating the response — aligning messaging across legal, policy, and business partners and making sure Amazon’s voice is clear, consistent, and credible. We’re building for the long term — investing in mechanisms, relationships, and talent that will scale as Amazon grows. If you want to do meaningful work alongside colleagues who care deeply about their craft and support each other’s growth, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Program Development & Operations Intern (Boston)
jobs.description:
About NORY

At NORY, we design learning journeys where every child in NYC and Boston becomes a risk-taking entrepreneur, inquisitive problem solver, and empathetic leader. As the largest STEM camp provider in NYC and now expanding in Boston, we are the Disney World of STEM education...where every learning experience is magical, impactful, and unforgettable.



About the Role

We are looking for a motivated, creative, and entrepreneurial Program Development & Operations Intern to support our growing Boston after-school, School Break Day Camp, and summer camp programs.

This is a unique opportunity for an ambitious individual to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, mission-driven startup. You'll work directly with NORY Boston's Regional Director and collaborate with our broader leadership team to support daily operations, develop engaging educational experiences, communicate with families, and help grow our presence throughout Greater Boston.

Unlike a traditional internship, this role offers meaningful ownership of projects, exposure to multiple areas of the business, and opportunities to make a real impact.

No two days will look exactly the same! One day you might be building a new STEM project, the next you could be analyzing enrollment trends, coordinating camp materials, or helping launch a new program.



Why This Role Rocks

 - Make an Impact: Your ideas will be heard, valued, and often implemented right away.

 - Work Directly with Leadership: Gain mentorship and collaborate closely with NORY's Boston Regional Director and HQ team.

 - Accelerated Learning: Experience different sides of a growing education company, from marketing and operations to curriculum development and customer experience.

 - Career Development: Build practical skills in project management, logistics, educational programming, and business operations.

 - Creative Freedom: Help develop exciting STEM projects and contribute ideas that enhance the experience of our campers.

 - Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a team creating unforgettable learning experiences that inspire the next generation of innovators.



What You'll Learn

 - Program development and implementation for STEM education

 - Supply chain, purchasing, and inventory management

 - Marketing, community outreach, and enrollment growth strategies

 - Customer service and family relationship management

 - Business operations and administration in a growing startup

 - Curriculum development and educational project design

 - Staff coordination and operational planning

 - Data tracking, reporting, and organizational systems

 - How to cultivate a thriving, joyful team culture

Key Responsibilities



Program Development & STEM Education

 - Assist with designing, building, and testing hands-on STEM projects for after-school programs and School Break Day Camps.

 - Prepare curriculum materials, classroom supplies, and project kits for upcoming programs.

 - Help organize and maintain NORY Boston's makerspace, ensuring materials and equipment are ready for use.

 - Provide substitute teaching and classroom support for after-school programs as needed, following required onboarding and supervision procedures.

 - Collaborate with the team to improve educational activities and the overall student experience.



Operations & Logistics

 - Coordinate material ordering, purchasing, and supply preparation for upcoming camps and after-school programs.

 - Organize, track, and maintain inventory across NORY Boston programs.

 - Assist with logistical planning and preparation for upcoming educational programs.

 - Support day-to-day administrative tasks and help improve internal organizational systems.

 - Work closely with the Regional Director to ensure programs run smoothly and efficiently.



Enrollment & Family Communications

 - Monitor daily and weekly enrollment numbers and assist with preparing enrollment reports.

 - Respond professionally to parent phone calls and emails, including helping manage the Boston team inbox (boston@nory.co).

 - Assist families with registration questions, program transfers, and enrollment adjustments under staff guidance.

 - Conduct parent follow-up calls, gather feedback, and help strengthen relationships with NORY families.

 - Encourage satisfied families to share their experiences through online reviews.



Marketing & Community Outreach

 - Create first drafts of newsletters, promotional emails, and other family communications.

 - Support outreach to local PTAs, PTOs, schools, and community organizations to promote NORY programs.

 - Assist with marketing initiatives to increase enrollment in after-school programs, School Break Day Camps, and summer camps.

 - Help identify opportunities to expand NORY's presence throughout Greater Boston.



We're Looking for Someone Who

 - Is currently pursuing a college degree or is a recent graduate interested in education, business, operations, marketing, or a related field.

 - Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects.

 - Has excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Is proactive, resourceful, and excited to take initiative.

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

 - Enjoys problem-solving and finding creative ways to improve systems and processes.

 - Is comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

 - Has a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and genuine interest in helping children learn and grow.

 - Is comfortable using technology, spreadsheets, and digital organizational tools.

 - Can work in person at our Brookline headquarters for approximately 10-15 hours per week.

 - Preferred: Previous experience working with children, educational programs, summer camps, or after-school programs.

 - Embodies NORY's core values: https://www.nory.co/value

Internship Details

 - Pay: $20 per hour

 - Schedule: Approximately 10-15 hours per week

 - Duration: ASAP through August 31, 2027

 - Location: In-person at NORY Boston Headquarters in Brookline, Massachusetts

 - Reporting To: Boston's Regional Director

This internship is ideal for someone seeking meaningful experience in business operations, educational leadership, program management, or entrepreneurship.



How to Apply

Apply with your resume through this posting. Please include your availability and a brief example of a project or process you improved. If you have a special reason to apply, please email Liza@nory.co

jobs.title: Associate Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want. 



As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment.  



Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives!




THE ROLE

Medely helps healthcare facilities find the clinicians they need to provide consistent, high-quality patient care. As an Associate Customer Success Manager (Scale), you’ll help outpatient and post-acute facilities across the country get lasting value from our platform.



You’ll manage a high-volume portfolio and use customer insights, thoughtful outreach, and scalable programs to strengthen engagement and retention. You’ll help customers overcome common challenges, reconnect with the platform, and make the most of Medely’s tools. Along the way, you’ll help us spot emerging needs and improve how we support customers at scale.



This is an opportunity to build your Customer Success skills while making a meaningful contribution to a team using technology to address real healthcare staffing challenges.




THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

 - Help customers stay engaged: Monitor account activity and health signals, then reach out with relevant guidance when a customer needs support or could benefit from renewed engagement.

 - Make customer education easy to access: Help create and deliver useful communications, webinars, resources, and automated programs that show customers how to get more from Medely.

 - Support retention and growth: Recognize signs of risk or changing staffing needs, take action where you can, and connect customers with the right internal partners.

 - Bring customer needs back to the team: Identify recurring questions and platform challenges, and share clear feedback with Product and other teams.

 - Learn from the results: Track engagement, account health, and campaign performance to understand what’s working and help improve our approach.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You’ll help customers remain active and engaged, contribute to retention and re-engagement, and make it easier for facilities to get value from Medely. You’ll also help the team recognize at-risk accounts, surface growth opportunities, and build more effective ways to support customers at scale.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, or another customer-facing or operations role.

 - A genuine interest in helping customers solve problems and get more value from a product or service.

 - Comfort reviewing data, spotting patterns, and using what you learn to prioritize your work.

 - Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills - helping customers get more value from Medely.

 - Strong organization and follow-through across multiple accounts and priorities.

 - Curiosity about technology and the ability to learn tools such as Salesforce, Intercom, or similar customer and CRM platforms.

 - A collaborative approach and good judgment about when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring in a partner.

 - The flexibility to balance consistent programs with customer needs that require individual attention.



Compensation: $84,000- $93,000 OTE (base + commission at plan).



Why Medely: Benefits & Perks

 - Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance

 - Long-term Incentives: 401k

 - Healthcare Benefits: Full suite of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexibility: We believe that work/life balance is important, so we offer flexible and unlimited PTO

 - Paid parental leave

 - Purpose: Join a growing mission-oriented startup that is modernizing the healthcare industry nationally!

 - Ownership: Drive meaningful business impact on a team you’ll help build and define!

 - Remote: Work in a digital environment with all the tools to achieve your work as though you were in the office!



We're an equal opportunity employer to all. We interview and hire applicants of all backgrounds, orientations, expressions, and identities.



Work location is flexible if approved by Medely.



Medely does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We consider any resume (CV) or biography received from an agency or outside recruiter without prior approval from a member of the Medely Human Resources or Recruiting team to be unsolicited and gratuitous, and such submissions will not be recognized by Medely for purposes of “ownership” of the candidate.



We are an E-Verify company.

Primary Function of Position

The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program support & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program.   This role focuses on staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support working alongside the daVinci Clinical Sales Representative who is primarily responsible for surgeon adoptions, new account growth, and surgeon-focused training.

Essential Job Duties (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)

Clinical & Technical Support

• Provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

• Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting within approved use and training.
• Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
• Provide real-time support across multiple ORs as needed, prioritizing patient safety, customer experience, and efficient case flow.
• Demonstrate proficiency across platforms and solutions (e.g., Multiport, Single Port, and digital solutions) to meet customer needs.
• Support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

• Support day-to-day execution of the robotic program by coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams to promote consistent readiness and workflow.
• Assist with operational support activities such as:RMA coordination and tracking (as applicable)Scope exchange coordination (as applicable)Facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs
• Help reduce friction for the hospital by ensuring the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding.
• Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)

• Deliver hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
• Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
• Assist with new site start-ups by delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
• Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
• Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization aligned to approved materials and guidance.

Troubleshooting, Escalation & Customer Issue Management

• Provide first-line troubleshooting for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
• Identify and escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts) and help coordinate follow-through to resolution.
• Support field action activities when necessary, following company guidance and documentation requirements.

Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)

• Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to execute account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase autonomy over time.
• Provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
• Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

Market & Clinical Insights

• Collect and communicate customer feedback and experiences to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Reporting customer feedback, in real time.
• Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
• Assist in clinical trial support when required.
• Assist in field action activities when necessary.

Required Skills and Experience (Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that an individual must possess in order to successfully perform in job)

• Experience: 2+ years in a operating room-related role
• Clinical experience is preferred.
• Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
• Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
• Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
• Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
• Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
• Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
• Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President of Sales, Providers
jobs.description:
ABOUT FRESHPAINT: 

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.


FRESHPAINT ELIMINATES THAT TRADE-OFF.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.


BACKED BY TOP INVESTORS

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

 - Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

 - Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

What You'll Do

As the Regional Vice President of Sales, Providers at Freshpaint, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of seven Account Executives responsible for winning new business across Regional Health Systems, Multi-location Specialty Practices, Dental Service Organizations (DSOs), Urgent Care, and Health Tech organizations.

This is a hands-on sales leadership role for someone who knows how to win complex deals and make the people around them better. You will work directly with your AEs on customer calls, deal strategy, negotiations, and closing opportunities while building the coaching, accountability, and sales execution needed to consistently exceed revenue targets.

You will own your team's performance, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and talent development, with responsibility for delivering $6-8 Million new-business ARR in FY2027. You'll report directly to the VP of Sales and play a critical role in expanding Freshpaint's market leadership across healthcare providers.

We're looking for a proven sales leader who combines deep industry knowledge with strong sales fundamentals, leads by example, and knows how to turn individual talent into consistent team performance.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead, Coach, and Develop a High-Performing Sales Team

 - Lead a team of seven Account Executives, 2 SMB and 5 MM/Small Enterprise segments, driving consistent quota attainment and revenue growth.

 - Conduct weekly 1:1s, deal reviews, call reviews, and team coaching sessions focused on improving selling skills, execution, and individual performance.

 - Reinforce consistent application of MEDDPICC, Challenger, and value-based selling methodologies.

 - Partner with Enablement and internal subject matter experts to accelerate onboarding, ramp time, and ongoing development.

 - Set clear performance expectations, recognize top performers, and proactively address skill gaps, underperformance, and retention risks.

 - Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance.

Drive Revenue Growth and Pipeline Generation

 - Own the team's new-business revenue targets, driving toward 100% quota attainment while maintaining a minimum average attainment of 85% across total team quota capacity.

 - Maintain at least 3x qualified pipeline coverage to support consistent revenue generation and predictable growth.

 - Drive at least 40% sales-sourced pipeline generation through Account Executives and their aligned SDRs.

 - Build and execute repeatable, segment-specific sales plays across Regional Health Systems, Specialty Practices, DSOs, Urgent Care, and Health Tech.

 - Monitor pipeline creation, conversion, and coverage, proactively addressing gaps before they impact revenue performance.

Lead Strategic Deals and Improve Win Rates

 - Actively participate in strategic customer opportunities, providing hands-on support with discovery, deal strategy, executive alignment, negotiations, and closing.

 - Coach AEs to navigate complex buying processes involving marketing leadership, executive stakeholders, legal, procurement, security, and compliance.

 - Maintain an opportunity open-to-closed-won win rate above 22%, continuously identifying opportunities to improve conversion.

 - Analyze lost deals, competitive dynamics, and buyer objections to identify recurring challenges and implement improvements.

 - Partner with Product and Product Marketing to strengthen competitive positioning, customer messaging, and sales effectiveness.

 - Know when to step directly into a deal and when to coach an AE to lead independently.

Own Forecast Accuracy and Sales Execution

 - Maintain a reliable, accurate, and up-to-date weekly sales forecast, with clear visibility into expected results, opportunities, and risks.

 - Inspect pipeline health, stage progression, close dates, next steps, and forecast categories to ensure deal quality and realistic expectations.

 - Hold AEs accountable for maintaining accurate opportunity data, documenting next steps, and proactively identifying deal risks.

 - Partner with the VP of Sales during weekly forecast reviews, clearly communicating expected performance, risks, and action plans.

Build and Execute Repeatable Sales Strategies

 - Develop scalable, segment-specific sales strategies that reflect the unique business needs, buying processes, and competitive dynamics of healthcare providers.

 - Help AEs engage CMOs and senior marketing leaders with compelling business cases tied to patient acquisition, marketing performance, digital advertising, and data privacy.

 - Identify successful sales approaches, translate them into repeatable plays, and drive consistent adoption across the team.

 - Adapt strategies as Freshpaint expands its product capabilities, customer segments, and market opportunities.

Desired Skills and Experience

 - Proven B2B sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing quota-carrying Account Executives, with a demonstrated record of achieving or exceeding team revenue targets.

 - Direct, successful closing experience as an Account Executive, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota and independently navigating complex sales opportunities.

 - Strong experience selling to CMOs, senior marketing executives, and business decision-makers, preferably within healthcare providers or similarly complex organizations.

 - Background in digital marketing, advertising technology, marketing agency services, or marketing-focused SaaS, with an understanding of how organizations evaluate marketing investments and measure business outcomes.

 - Deep understanding of complex B2B sales, including consultative discovery, value-based selling, executive engagement, multi-threading, negotiations, and closing.

 - Demonstrated coaching ability, with specific examples of improving AE performance, developing talent, and building high-performing sales teams.

 - Strong command of MEDDPICC and structured sales methodologies, with the ability to reinforce consistent qualification and execution across an entire team.

 - Excellent pipeline management and forecasting skills, including the ability to identify deal risks, assess opportunity quality, and communicate reliable revenue expectations.

 - Proven ability to develop and execute repeatable sales strategies, generate pipeline, improve win rates, and drive consistent sales execution across multiple segments.

 - Hands-on, player-coach leadership style, with the credibility and commercial judgment to join customer calls, influence deal outcomes, and help AEs close business.

 - Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to hold people accountable, deliver direct feedback, and build trust across teams.

 - High ownership, adaptability, and a growth mindset, with the ability to execute effectively in a fast-growing environment where priorities, products, and processes continue to evolve.

Nice to Haves

 - Experience selling into Regional Health Systems, Multi-location Specialty Practices, DSOs, Urgent Care, or Health Tech organizations.

 - Established knowledge of healthcare marketing, patient acquisition, digital advertising, marketing technology, and the healthcare provider buying landscape.

 - Familiarity with HIPAA, data privacy, security reviews, and compliance-related challenges that influence healthcare technology purchasing decisions.

 - Background leading a mix of SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise Account Executives.


PERKS & BENEFITS

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

 - Competitive pay + generous equity

 - Half-day Fridays, every Friday

 - 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

 - Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

 - Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

 - Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page https://www.freshpaint.io/careers for the full list.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Science
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, advancing diagnostics in oncology, women’s health, and organ health to support better patient care. As a Data Science Manager in R&D Operations, you will lead a team of data scientists to design and implement data solutions to accelerate R&D at Natera. You will take ownership of operational data workflows, establish scalable processes and SOPs, and apply ML and/or AI expertise to enable informed decision-making and drive efficiency. You will work closely with our Data Engineering Manager and Data Analytics Manager to deliver integrated, reliable data solutions across the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Direct, mentor, and develop a team of data scientists, including hiring, performance management, and career development

• Set the technical direction for the data science team and advance its ML/AI capabilities

• Own the data science roadmap for R&D Operations, define success metrics, and report progress and status to R&D Operations and executive stakeholders

• Translate pain points and opportunities surfaced by data analytics into solutions–process changes, algorithms, or new tools–and drive their implementation to deliver measurable process improvement, championing efficiency gains in turnaround time and cost per activity across R&D Operations

• Own the sample governance process end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and accountability, and manage the associated stakeholder relationships

• Develop and oversee machine learning models, optimization strategies, and AI solutions to forecast demand, optimize resource allocation, and automate operational processes

• Lead the development of new data products, as well as the training and enablement around them to grow visibility, self-service, and data-driven decision-making across R&D Operations

• Design, document, and implement processes for data governance, data integrity, and reproducibility across R&D Operations

• Partner with the Data Engineering and Data Analytics Managers and collaborate cross-functionally across R&D and supporting functions to translate business needs into governed, reliable data solutions

• Write clear, testable requirements (e.g. acceptance criteria, data contracts) and define the path from prototype to production in partnership with Data Engineering

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 7+ years of experience in data science in biotechnology, life sciences, or operations research

• Demonstrated people-management experience, including hiring, mentoring, and developing data scientists through coaching on performance and career growth

• Experience owning a data science roadmap and communicating progress to senior and executive stakeholders

• Working knowledge of a relevant scientific or operational domain–biology or life sciences strongly preferred, operations research a close second–sufficient to partner effectively with R&D Operations stakeholders

• Experience working with laboratory or operational data (e.g., laboratory informatics management system (LIMS), sample management, inventory, purchasing/procurement, or equipment operations)

• Track record of driving process improvement–identifying root causes and delivering solutions through process changes, algorithms, or new tools

• Strong background in building data processes, SOPs, and governance frameworks

• Expertise in Python (including pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch) and SQL

• Hands-on expertise in machine learning and/or AI applied to real-world problems, setting technical direction for predictive modeling and optimization solutions

• Experience taking ML models or data products from prototype to production, including monitoring and maintenance

• Experience with modern cloud data warehouse and transformation tooling (e.g. Snowflake, dbt)

• Experience partnering with peer functions such as engineering and analytics to deliver end-to-end solutions, including writing requirements or technical specifications

• Clear, direct communication skills to translate complex data insights into actionable business recommendations

• Strong critical thinking and a drive for learning and problem-solving

Nice to Have

• Advanced degree in biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or operations research

• Familiarity with data integrity and audit-readiness practices in a regulated (GxP/GCLP) environment

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Annual performance incentive bonus

• Long-term equity awards

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$139,900—$174,900 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Social Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Portfolio Omnichannel Strategy & Operations Team is seeking a social media expert to manage commercial social execution across the Revolution Medicines oncology portfolio. This newly-created role spans tumor types, branded promotion and unbranded disease state education (DSE), and digital engagement with healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients and caregivers through direct-to-patient (DTP) initiatives.

The Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Social Strategy & Operations will serve as the US Portfolio Omnichannel team’s social subject matter expert, translating approved marketing and engagement strategies into effective paid and organic social programs. This individual will manage social profiles, maintain channel playbooks and execution standards, coordinate social deliverables with agencies and platform reps, and facilitate channel-specific discussions with the Promotional Review Committee (PRC). The role also provides hands-on email expertise, including campaign workbook population, tracking link creation and quality assurance (QA).  This role will also act as a SME in regard to the email channel.
