jobs.title: Technical Enablement Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI — the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.

Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies — from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises — run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast.

 


ABOUT THIS ROLE

Our product is deeply technical, and we sell into a brand-new category: voice AI infrastructure. As we grow our Sales team, our AEs, SDRs, and presales engineers need to understand how LiveKit works, and why real-time voice AI is hard, well enough to hold their own in a customer conversation.

We're hiring a Technical Enablement Engineer to own that. You'll build our technical training program from scratch, so ramp time doesn't depend on pulling engineers off the roadmap. You'll sit on the Sales team, report to our CRO, and have a direct line to the engineers building the product.

This is a hands-on, builder-first enablement role. You'll see the impact of your work directly in how fast new sellers ramp and how confident they are in front of customers.

You'll thrive here if you:

 - are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

 - can clearly explain complex technical concepts to people who aren't engineers

 - are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

The best way to impress us is to build something with LiveKit and show us how you'd teach it to someone who has never touched it.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Audit what AEs, SDRs, and presales know today and where deals stall on technical gaps

 - Build the core curriculum: LiveKit fundamentals, voice AI architecture, agents, and the competitive landscape

 - Ship hands-on labs and sandboxes so sellers build something real, not just watch slides

 - Run technical onboarding for new AEs and SDRs, and create a clear technical learning path for presales and Solutions Architects

 - Certify demo and discovery readiness through hands-on exercises

 - Keep technical content current with every product release, working directly with engineering and product

 - Measure what matters: ramp time, time to first qualified technical conversation, assessment pass rates, and seller confidence

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - A senior-level engineer or technical founder who has shipped production software

 - You've taught or enabled technical content to non-engineers (sales, SEs, or customers) and have a track record to show for it

 - You can explain complex technical concepts simply, to any audience

 - You're a fast learner who ramps quickly on new technology

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Ex-technical founder

 - Experience with voice AI, WebRTC, real-time systems, or LLM applications

 - Built a curriculum, bootcamp, or certification program

 - Ran SE or AE onboarding at a dev-tools or infrastructure company

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

 - An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organizations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energizes you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:

• Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production

• Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served

• Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Rust, Scala, R, and SQL

• Leveraged AI-assistive development tools for tasks like scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation

• Experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered features into products or systems (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP models, computer vision, predictive analytics)

• Used context-appropriate automated testing to inform software design choices and catch bugs

• Debugged and refactored pre-existing code to incrementally improve it

• Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD

• Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance

• Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving

• Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity

• Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues

• Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

• Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues

• Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. You’ll lead more complicated projects, leading teams to do so. You’ll work with colleagues who share your passion for technology solutions. You’ll invest time developing your skills and sharing what you know. You’ll be responsible for:

• Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients

• Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines

• Leading architecture and software design discussions

• Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring

• Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients

• Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives

• Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items

• Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values

• Ensuring your team has a healthy, prioritized, estimated backlog

• Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements

• Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders

• Regular syncs with the client to provide status updates, and for identifying and evaluating risks and presenting potential solutions

• Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress

• Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes

Strongly Preferred Skills

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

• MLOps: including tools like LangChain for application development and managing the ML lifecycle

• Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics

• DevSecOps & DevOps

• Infrastructure as Code

• Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.

How You’ll be Supported

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future.

Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:

• A robust L&D program featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.

• Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development

• Coworking support for our global team

• Flexible PTO

• 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits.

A Note on Compensation

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Lead Engineer position within our four US structures are as follows:

• Structure 1 (Tampa Metro, Ohio, Tennessee, Wisconsin) RANGE: $126,279-$157,849 USD

• Structure 2 (Chicago Metro, Miami Metro, Philadelphia Metro, Raleigh Metro ) RANGE: $132,700-$165,875 USD

• Structure 3 (Austin Metro, Boston Metro , DC Metro) RANGE: $141,261-$176,576 USD

• Structure 4 (Los Angeles, Seattle, New York City) RANGE: $147,254-$184,068 USD

Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

As a remote-first company, 8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

If you are hired into a hub, you will be a part of a team with regular rituals around co-working and community building. For team members outside of those cities, we offer access to coworking spaces to foster continued collaboration and connection across our global team.

In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply!

#LI-Remote

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

jobs.title: Compliance Controls & Monitoring
jobs.description:
ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

Compliance Controls & Monitoring (C&M) is OnePay’s second line of defense, responsible for establishing and overseeing the firm's compliance control environment. Distinct from independent Compliance Testing, C&M identifies and assesses regulatory risks, evaluates controls, and drives compliant product and operational outcomes across the product lifecycle. This role requires an experienced compliance professional who can independently evaluate complex regulatory matters, recommend practical solutions, and execute compliance oversight activities in a fast-paced, evolving financial services environment.

What Makes This Role Different:

OnePay is a growing company with a broad and evolving product set, and our regulatory landscape evolves alongside it. This role sits at the center of that growth. You'll assess new and changing products, apply regulatory requirements to situations that don't always have clear precedent, and help the business find compliant paths forward. Strong partnerships with Product, Legal, and Operations is a given, and your goal is to bring a clear, well-reasoned compliance perspective to that table. The best fit is someone who is energized by that kind of work: exercising sound judgment on complex questions, communicating risk clearly and constructively, and advocating independently for the right controls.

You will:

 - Regulatory Advisory & Business Partnership: Build trusted relationships across Product, Operations, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance. Independently evaluate business practices and controls against applicable regulatory requirements, provide practical compliance guidance, and confidently challenge potential noncompliance while influencing appropriate corrective actions.

 - Compliance Controls: Evaluate compliance control design and adequacy, identify gaps in regulatory coverage, and recommend and drive enhancements. Support control development, risk-to-control mapping, documentation, and maintenance of the centralized compliance control inventory within the firm's GRC platform.

 - Compliance Risk Assessment: Execute and maintain compliance risk assessments across products, processes, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate inherent risk, control coverage, and residual risk; recommend appropriate mitigation; and support implementation and ongoing maintenance of compliance risk assessment processes within the firm's GRC platform.

 - Execution & Continuous Improvement: Independently manage assigned compliance activities and initiatives through completion while balancing competing priorities and deadlines. Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enhance operational effectiveness.

 - Change Management: Assess regulatory compliance implications of new or modified products, business processes, systems, and operational changes. Partner with stakeholders to evaluate control impacts and support appropriate compliance measures throughout implementation.


YOU BRING

 - Mid Career (5-10 Years) with progressively responsible advisory experience within banking, fintech, or consumer financial services, with strong knowledge of applicable federal and state consumer financial protection laws and regulations.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently interpret regulatory requirements, provide credible challenge, and influence decisions across cross-functional stakeholders, including comfort making and defending well-reasoned judgment calls on nuanced questions and evolving regulatory guidance.

 - Hands-on experience conducting compliance risk assessments, evaluating control design and effectiveness, and working with risk registers or GRC platforms.

 - Strong critical thinking and communication skills, with the ability to explain regulatory risk clearly and constructively to business partners, and to advocate independently for the right controls.

 - Proven ability to manage competing priorities and drive work to completion with a high degree of ownership.

 - Experience in a fintech, startup, or similarly dynamic financial services environment preferred.

 - CRCM, CIA or equivalent certification preferred.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised ~$60M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.



About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/est and KMIP https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/kmip#kmip-integration, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

 - Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

 - Expand our newer Infisical PKI https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/overview, Infisical PAM https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/ssh, and Infisical KMS https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/overview product lines.

 - Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

 

Requirements

 - Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

 - A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

 - Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have 

 - Expertise in Go.

 - Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

 - Previous founder or startup experience.

 - Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

 - Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page https://infisical.com/careers.

jobs.title: Mailroom Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is seeking a Mailroom Specialist to join the Real Estate & Facilities division based in Costa Mesa. As mailroom specialist, you will be responsible for receiving all non-production mail and packages, sorting, and delivering to departments. This role is highly interactive and requires exceptional customer service, sharp attention to detail, and proactive communication to support our fast-growing campus. You will serve as a central point of contact for daily logistics, ensuring critical materials and general correspondence reach the right teams quickly and securely.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Mail & Package Intake: Unload courier delivery service and interoffice delivery trucks. Receive, inspect, log, sort, and process all incoming non-production mail, parcels, and freight deliveries from major carriers (USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, and local couriers). Troubleshoot shipments that may be unidentified or labeled with insufficient information.

• Campus Distribution: Accurately deliver packages, mail, and office supplies to designated drop zones, departments, and individual team members across multiple buildings.

• Outbound Shipping: Assist employees with outgoing mail, including proper packing, labeling, weighing, carrier selection, and customs documentation.

• Inventory & Supplies: Maintain an organized, secure, and fully stocked mailroom; track supply levels (boxes, tape, bubble wrap, labels) and reorder materials proactively.

• Internal Communication: Notify recipients of high-priority, fragile, or time-sensitive deliveries via Slack, email, or ticketing systems (e.g., Jira).

• Facilities & Security Collaboration: Partner with the broader Workplace and Security teams to track desk moves and maintain secure mail handling protocols, and ensure optimal operational efficiency and provide input on continuous process improvement.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Relevant Background: 2–3+ years of experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom operations, corporate facilities, warehouse logistics, or a fast-paced manufacturing / R&D environment.

• Systems & Software: Working knowledge of modern logistics and office tools, including:

• Carrier shipping platforms (FedEx Ship Manager, UPS WorldShip, DHL).

• Inventory/ERP management systems (Oracle).

• Slack, JIRA, and general computer/tablet hardware.

• Data Accuracy: Strong data entry experience with high attention to detail and accuracy when logging and tracking inventory.

• Equipment Certification: Current forklift certification strongly preferred; willingness and ability to complete onsite certification training upon hire if not currently certified.

• Communication & Customer Service: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; strong interpersonal and customer-facing skills with a service-oriented mindset. Should be comfortable collaborating with all departments and organizational levels.

• Security & Discretion: High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential documents.

• Adaptability & Accountability: Proven ability to troubleshoot, problem-solve with minimal direct supervision, and pivot quickly as priorities shift in a rapid-growth environment.

• Organization: Exceptional time management and organizational skills to handle concurrent incoming and outgoing logistics workflows.

US Salary Range

$88,000—$117,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. jobs.title: New Graduate Engineer, Mechanical
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, MECHANICAL

The elite engineering team at our test facility in Central Texas (Waco, TX area) focuses on test operations for Raptor, Starship, Falcon, Dragon, and more. We are looking for engineers who focus on testing operations (test set-up, on-console running tests, data analysis, troubleshooting, etc.) as well as ground support equipment operations (design & build test stands, propellant disbursement, etc.). This is a fast-paced, hands-on, constantly evolving, real-as-it-gets engineering environment for the ambitious. Some engineering groups design, build, activate, modify, and maintain the fluid and mechanical systems that power, restrain, and measure the most powerful high-volume rocket engines in the world, while others specialize in the design and execution of unique tests for engines, components, and spacecraft on an accelerated schedule. From thousands of gallons per minute of cryogens to tens of pounds per second of high-pressure gas, we develop clever solutions to meet the needs of a demanding test program both today and in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

TEST OPERATIONS:

• Develop and execute tests at the engine and component level to evaluate hardware performance and survivability during the mission

• Repeated ownership of test campaigns, including test plan creation, new system activation, test operations, data review, and test stand equipment design/fabrication

• Provide daily directions and instructions to technicians to fabricate and integrate test articles and stand equipment

• Develop and maintain test procedures, sequences, scripts, configuration files, and software

• Operate and troubleshoot data acquisition and control systems, wiring, and instrumentation (DAQ systems are primarily National Instruments-based)

• Operate and troubleshoot fluid and mechanical systems that include low to high-pressure gaseous working fluids and rocket propellants (including hypergols & cryogenics) as well as structural components and supporting infrastructure

• Operate mechanical systems; these include test stand support structures, heat exchangers, vacuum pumps, tooling, and fluid components such as valves, reliefs, burst disks, tubing, etc.

• Automate repetitive test operations to increase efficiency and safety

• Develop innovative processes to increase testing capability and rates, while maintaining high rigor of safety

• Identify and characterize system pitfalls and potential hazards, then work to resolve such anomalies by collaborating with design engineers on improvements for test stands and flight hardware

GROUND SUPPORT EQUIPMENT:

• Analyze, design, and build systems that support testing of fully integrated flight vehicles, individual rocket engines, and various rocket components

• Drive cradle-to-grave ownership of engineering projects through design reviews, decision justifications, equipment procurement, and coordination/participation in the construction of your ideas

• Work directly with skilled technicians to build your designs and fix real-world problems on the fly

• Maintain a tight feedback loop with the test operations team to rapidly alter plans as necessary to meet tight testing deadlines critical to company success

• Operate and troubleshoot equipment to achieve testing objectives, and apply lessons learned to iterate system designs for improved performance and maintenance

• Evaluate complex engineering needs and arrive at solutions to seemingly impractical problems that support test programs and achieve company objectives

• Take a hands-on approach to tackling rapidly emerging field projects that keep the company testing rocket engines and vehicles every single day

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or physics

• 1+ years of mechanical and/or fluids engineering experience via project team, research, internships, and/or professional experience

• Graduating with a bachelor’s degree, master’s degree or PhD in 2026 or 2027

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong fundamental understanding and intuition for fluid, structural, or mechanical systems

• Critical thinking and problem solving in stressful, dynamic situations

• Positive responses and outcomes to challenges posed by short deadlines

• Hands-on build—machining, welding, and other fabrication techniques are a plus

• Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch

• Driven approach to addressing challenges and opportunities—an enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive, can-do attitude

• Determining the best solution among several options, often balancing cost/schedule/complexity

• Acute attention to detail and ability to see interactions with related systems to avoid problems

• Instrumentation and testing, data review and analysis, verification of models against reality

• High-pressure or cryogenic fluid systems and components

• Complex structural or mechanical systems and components

• Design verification with simplified hand calculations and complex modeling—FEA or CFD is a plus

• Production of fabrication drawings for parts to be machined or welded

• Intermediate skill level using CAD—Siemens NX is a plus

• ASME piping and pressure vessel design

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• 3+ years of engineering design experience in an industrial setting or equivalent

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, take individual initiative, and communicate effectively with peers, leadership, and customers

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a fast-paced, challenging work environment

• Willingness to perform other related duties for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment

• Availability to respond to emergencies to support priority projects, missions, and launches

• Availability to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility is required

• Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting the upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings, and climbing hand over hand

• Ability to lift heavy objects unassisted—up to 25 lbs.

• Ability to work at elevated heights with proper PPE—up to 300 ft.

• Ability to work in extreme outdoor environments when needed—heat, cold, wind, rain, etc.

• Ability to work in environments with exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Working conditions may be in tight quarters; physical dexterity is required

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Principal Growth Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Growth Marketing is the activation and delivery arm of GitLab marketing: campaigns, regional and field marketing, lifecycle and product led growth, marketing engineering and operations, corporate events including Transcend, partner marketing, community programs and Co-Create. If a program connects GitLab to a customer or a buyer, it lives here, and the team is accountable for pipeline, first orders, Flex conversion and expansion, and post sale adoption.

As Principal Growth Marketing Strategist you work directly with the VP of Growth Marketing as a strategic partner and operator. You hold the whole picture of the engine: the goals every function has committed to, the budget and where it is moving, the strategic projects that do not fit cleanly inside any one function, and the decisions that are waiting on an answer. You keep that picture current, you act on it when the VP is engaged elsewhere, and you use it to move work faster.

This is an individual contributor role at the Principal level. You do not manage a team. You manage outcomes across ten functions through influence, judgment and follow through, and you are trusted to speak for Growth Marketing in rooms the VP cannot be in. The people on the leadership team are senior, experienced marketers; they will work with you because you make them faster and sharper, not because of the title.

You will be effective in this role if you have led marketing yourself at a senior level, understand how a modern B2B software company makes money, are curious and hands on with AI in your own work, and can move between a budget trade off, a partner negotiation, a pipeline review and a keynote plan in the same day without losing the thread.

What you'll do

• Run Growth Marketing's operating rhythm: goals, business reviews, planning cycles and the metrics inspection behind them, so decisions get made, recorded and followed through.

• Track commitments across the leadership team between their 1:1s with the VP, so those conversations are about strategy rather than status.

• Own the strategic projects that matter to Growth Marketing and have no single functional home: scope them, find the owner or be the owner, and land them.

• Hold the budget picture across the team, prepare trade offs with a recommendation, and act within the authority the VP has delegated in writing.

• Represent Growth Marketing on the VP's behalf in pipeline reviews, cross functional planning and partner conversations; carry the position in and the decision out.

• Unblock functional leaders when the VP is engaged elsewhere, or stage the issue so it takes one conversation rather than three.

• Be a thinking partner to any functional leader who wants one, offered rather than assigned.

• Partner with marketing's AI Transformation Owner so AI adoption across Growth Marketing is visible, measured and moving.

• Prepare the VP for high stakes moments: executive updates, leadership material, keynotes, customer and partner meetings, with the numbers checked and the first draft written.

What you'll bring

• Extensive experience in B2B software marketing with senior leadership experience: you have owned a marketing function, a large program budget or a go to market motion, and you have been accountable for a pipeline or revenue number.

• Breadth across marketing. You have worked in or closely with demand and digital, field and events, lifecycle or product led growth, partner marketing and marketing operations, and you can hold a credible conversation with an expert in each.

• A track record of landing cross functional projects that nobody owned, through influence rather than authority, with executives, peers and individual contributors.

• Business fluency: you read a P&L, a pipeline report and a budget model comfortably, you understand consumption and subscription business models, and you can explain a trade off to a CFO in plain language.

• Program and operating rhythm experience: goal frameworks, business reviews, planning cycles, and the discipline to keep them honest without turning them into bureaucracy.

• Hands on AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you have built or configured something with them, and you are curious about how they change the way a marketing organization operates. Prior experience in a chief of staff, strategy and operations, or business operations role is welcome but not required.

• Executive communication: concise writing, clear verbal briefs, comfort presenting to and being questioned by VPs and C level leaders, and the judgment to know what travels up and what does not.

• Discretion. You will handle confidential people, budget and strategy information every day.

• Familiarity with developer, DevOps or platform engineering audiences, or the ability to get there fast.

• The ability to use GitLab, and to travel occasionally for events and leadership offsites.

About the team

Growth Marketing at GitLab is one integrated engine of roughly 100 people across ten functions, led by the VP of Growth Marketing and reporting into the Chief Product and Marketing Officer. The team runs Transcend, GitLab's flagship event program, the GitHub competitive motion, the regional and partner marketing engines in AMER, EMEA and APJ, the lifecycle and product led growth motions behind GitLab's self serve business, and marketing's AI transformation. The leadership team operates on a small set of shared principles: speed with quality, an ownership mindset, and customer outcomes. You can read more about how marketing operates at GitLab in the handbook.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$152,800—$259,200 USD

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised ~$60M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.



About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/est and KMIP https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/kmip#kmip-integration, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

 - Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

 - Expand our newer Infisical PKI https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/overview, Infisical PAM https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pam/overview, and Infisical KMS https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/overview product lines.

 - Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

 

Requirements

 - Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript (3+).

 - Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

 - A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

 - Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have 

 - Expertise in Go.

 - Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

 - Previous founder or startup experience.

 - Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

 - Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page https://infisical.com/careers.

jobs.title: Special Police Officer Full Time
jobs.description:
Monumental Sports & Entertainment (MSE) is one of the leading integrated sports and entertainment companies globally. MSE’s portfolio spans premier professional sports teams, world-class venues, and next-generation media properties, with marquee assets including the NHL’s Washington Capitals, NBA’s Washington Wizards, WNBA’s Washington Mystics, NBA G League’s Capital City Go-Go, Capital One Arena, and Monumental Sports Network, along with an investment in Team Liquid.

Rooted in the nation’s capital, MSE brings Washington, D.C's distinct influence, ambition, and leadership to the global sports and entertainment landscape. The company harnesses the power of its platform to drive continuous innovation and deliver extraordinary experiences that inspire and unite our community, our fans, and our people.

Our success is powered by talented people who bring passion, creativity, and collaboration to everything they do. If you're looking to build your career in a dynamic, fast-paced organization that's shaping the future of sports and entertainment, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Overview:

The Special Police Officer is responsible for ensuring a safe and secure environment at Capital One Arena (COA) and MedStar Health Performance Center (MHPC) for patrons and employees by patrolling assigned areas and monitoring activities.

Are you an experienced security or law enforcement officer who is hardworking and passionate about safety?! We would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

• Allow only properly ticketed/approved guests into COA and MHPC facilities.

• Ensure safety of employees and patrons at all times; including preventing theft, protection of personal property, preventing assaults, gate crashing, or other disorders at meetings, events, or performances.

• Patrol premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.

• Protect participants at events from overzealous spectators.

• Detain individuals based on probable cause for an offense committed in their presence.

• Supervise and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain security of premises.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Director
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Role Summary

The Supply Chain Director owns the supply chain functions that keep production running and finished goods moving, including warehouse operations, receiving, inventory control, production scheduling, material flow to and from the line, outbound shipping (including returns), and domestic and international logistics. This role ensures that every site has the systems and discipline to get the right material and the right product to the right place at the right time.

The role is anchored in three outcomes: efficient material movement, accurate inventory, and reliable operational performance across every site it supports.

This role owns the operational backbone between Procurement and Production, translating purchased material into a reliable, visible, and well-organized flow that supports on-time, full-rate output.

The Supply Chain Director partners closely with the Procurement Director and Production leadership to ensure material availability never becomes the constraint on schedule.

What You'll Own

• Warehouse Operations, Receiving & Shipping

You are accountable for the physical flow of material in both directions between the dock and the line, and for finished goods moving out the door.

You will:

• Own receiving processes, including documentation, inspection coordination with Quality, and timely put away of incoming material

• Define warehouse layout, storage standards, and material handling practices that support efficient flow to production

• Own two-way material movement between the warehouse and the line, including line-side replenishment, return of unused or excess material to stock, and timely transactions so every move is reflected in inventory records

• Lead warehouse design and layout optimization, improving storage density, material flow, and labor efficiency as volume and site footprint scale

• Resolve receiving discrepancies (quantity, documentation, damage) in coordination with Procurement and Quality

• Maintain safety and organizational standards across all warehouse and stockroom areas

• Own shipping operations for finished goods, including packaging, documentation, carrier coordination, and on-time outbound shipment

• Manage returns processing and other inbound and outbound shipping requirements as they arise

Success looks like:

• Material moves to and from the line with minimal delay and no stockroom-driven line stoppages, and finished goods ship complete and on time

• Logistics & Trade

You are accountable for inbound and outbound freight, domestic and international, arriving and leaving on schedule with the right documentation.

You will:

• Own dock scheduling for receiving and shipping, balancing inbound appointments, outbound pickups, and dock labor to avoid congestion and idle time

• Manage carrier, freight forwarder, and third-party logistics (3PL) performance, including service levels, transit times, and freight cost, in partnership with Procurement

• Own international shipping and receiving, including Incoterms execution, import and export documentation, and coordination with customs brokers

• Ensure accurate and timely customs declarations, partnering with Trade Compliance and Legal on export classification and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) / Export Administration Regulations (EAR) requirements

Success looks like:

• Freight arrives and ships on schedule, clears customs without holds or penalties, and dock activity runs to a plan

• Inventory Control & Accuracy

You are accountable for knowing, at all times, what material we have and where it is.

You will:

• Own inventory accuracy programs, including cycle counting, physical inventory, and reconciliation processes

• Maintain inventory control systems (e.g., Kardex PowerPick or equivalent) to provide real-time visibility into stock status, with every material movement transacted so planning and buying decisions run on accurate data

• Manage quarantine, disposition, and stock sweep processes for rejected, recalled, or obsolete material

• Monitor the Government-Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) and other industry data sources for part-level risk affecting inventory

• Ensure warehouse, receiving, and inventory practices meet AS9100 and other applicable quality and regulatory standards

Success looks like:

• Inventory counts are consistently accurate and audit-ready, with no unexplained variances, and inventory data Planning and Procurement can act on with confidence

• Production Scheduling & Material Flow

You own how material moves to support the production schedule, not just where it sits.

You will:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules in coordination with Program Management and Production

• Determine which end items and critical components are planned at the master schedule level versus driven by MRP or Kanban

• Design and manage Kanban and pull-based replenishment systems to support consistent material availability at the point of use

• Partner with Procurement to translate production schedules into material requirements and flag availability risk early

• Maintain line-of-balance visibility across active programs, including current operation, completed steps, and remaining steps for each unit

• Implement the company's Manufacturing Operating System (MOS) standards for material readiness, release discipline, and work center sequencing at the site level

Success looks like:

• Production has the material it needs when it needs it, without excess inventory or expedite firefighting

• Demand Planning & Program Support

You coordinate planning and material information flow across Production, Procurement, and Program Management.

You will:

• Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Program Management to support demand planning and operational readiness

• Develop processes and procedures for project-level planning and data gathering

• Provide proactive visibility into at-risk components, by unit/serial number, with estimated completion dates for missing items

• Partner with the Procurement Director to establish vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and consignment programs, owning final approval of each program

• Lead supply chain support for New Product Introduction (NPI), helping establish production readiness and ensuring material readiness and inventory processes are in place as programs progress toward higher Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRL)

Success looks like:

• Programs have early, reliable visibility into material risk and can plan around it rather than react to it

• NPI and rapid ramps are fully supported without impacting existing production programs

• KPI Management & Continuous Improvement

You ensure that supply chain performance is measured, visible, and continuously improving.

You will:

• Establish and track KPIs for inventory turns, material availability, on-time-to-line performance, and inventory accuracy

• Drive continuous improvement and lean principles across warehouse, inventory, and scheduling functions

• Identify and resolve root causes of recurring material or inventory issues

Success looks like:

• Supply chain KPIs are stable or improving quarter over quarter, with issues caught before they affect production

• Team Leadership & Systems

You are responsible for building a supply chain organization that scales.

You will:

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing warehouse, inventory, and scheduling team with clear roles and development pathways

• Drive adoption and optimization of ERP and digital inventory/scheduling tools to improve visibility and decision-making

• Promote a culture of accuracy, discipline, and cross-functional collaboration

• Document and standardize warehouse, inventory, and scheduling practices so they can be stood up at new or franchise sites without rebuilding the system from scratch

• Lead best practice sharing across sites and franchise partners, building a common playbook and a regular cadence for lessons learned

Success looks like:

• The team operates with consistent process and discipline, independent of any one individual

Qualifications

Required Experience

• Proven experience leading warehouse, inventory, and production scheduling functions in a manufacturing environment

• Experience designing and running Kanban or other pull-based material flow systems

• Experience managing logistics, including dock scheduling, international shipping and receiving, and customs documentation

• Background in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries preferred

• Demonstrated success building scalable inventory and scheduling processes, not just operating them

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred

Technical & Operational Depth

• Deep understanding of: Inventory control, cycle counting, and warehouse management practices Material flow, scheduling, and planning discipline Kanban and pull-based replenishment systems Domestic and international logistics, including Incoterms and customs processes

• Experience with: ERP/MRP and warehouse management systems (e.g., Kardex PowerPick or equivalent) Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including PICO MES or equivalent Quality systems aligned to AS9100 or equivalent GIDEP monitoring and part disposition processes

Leadership Profile

• Builds structure, clarity, and accountability across warehouse and scheduling functions

• Thinks in systems and root causes, not just daily firefighting

• Comfortable operating in high-growth, fast-paced production environments

• Partners effectively across Production, Procurement, Engineering, and Program Management, as well as with peer sites and franchise partners

What Success Looks Like

• Material availability consistently supports the production schedule without line stoppages

• Inventory counts are accurate and audit-ready at all times

• Kanban and scheduling systems scale predictably as production rates increase

• Programs have reliable, proactive visibility into material risk

• Freight moves on schedule and clears customs without holds or penalties

• NPI and rapid ramps are supported without disrupting existing production programs

Additional Information

• Primarily based in San Luis Obispo, CA, with travel to other facilities required approximately 30% of the time

Pay range for this role

$196,000—$245,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Zone 5 Technologies is a federal contractor and participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. As required by law, we will verify the identity and employment authorization of all new employees using the E-Verify system. Learn more about your rights and responsibilities under E-Verify: https://www.e-verify.gov.

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description:
US-Remote

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Who We Are

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions provider that partners with organizations to solve meaningful challenges and drive sustainable growth. From early-stage startups to global enterprises, we work across industries to optimize our clients’ digital products through product strategy innovation, experiential design, AI solutions, and deep engineering expertise.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energizes you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You’ve spent 10+ years in custom software consultancies, and you’ve been a regular presence on both sides of the business: in the room helping win the work, and in delivery helping build it. You know how to pitch a client honestly and then stand behind what you promised.

You’re highly articulate and commercially fluent. You can talk architecture with a skeptical engineering lead in one meeting and talk ROI with a client’s CEO in the next, and both walk away trusting you. You understand how technical choices shape whether a project makes money because you’ve had to make those calls yourself.

Your technical judgment comes from years of hands-on work, and you keep it current in two ways: you read widely, and you keep doing the work. “Doing” might be a few hours each week staying sharp with new tools, or it might be real delivery responsibility on a live engagement. Either way, you don’t run on knowledge that stopped accruing years ago.

You’re comfortable leading by influence rather than authority. You may not be our deepest expert on any single topic, and that’s fine, because your value shows up differently:

• You ask experienced technologists the kind of sharp questions that send them back to their desk thinking.

• You know a good deal across a wide range of subjects and connect ideas others keep separate.

• You’re an excellent communicator, in writing and on your feet.

• You bring out people’s best work through interpersonal connection and high standards.

Your name carries some weight in the communities you’re part of. When you write or speak, senior engineers pay attention, and a few of them want to come work with you.

This is primarily a market-facing role. You’d rather be out in the market shaping where we go than waiting inside for an assignment.

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

We win work by earning technical trust before a contract is ever signed, and by being genuinely present in the market the rest of the time. This role carries both. You’ll report to the CEO and work most closely with the CEO, the VP of Growth, our practice Partners, and senior technologists.

Your primary focus will require you to:

• Join deal teams to help win new engagements. In a pitch that can mean proposing an architecture, shaping scope, sequencing the work into sensible stages, or recommending how to staff it. On our most important accounts, you’ll stay a technical presence the client trusts well after the work begins.

• Represent us and build relationships in the market. Give talks, write, and show up in person at events. In-person presence matters here, and writing alone won’t carry the role.

• Shape and sharpen what we sell. Turn what you’re seeing in the market into clearer, more current offerings, and keep our position honest: agentic products, deep platform expertise.

• Work with our Growth team to help identify and build relationships with platform and AI partners that put us in front of the right work and keep our teams current.

• Drive our go-to-market direction rather than wait for it. Bring a point of view and help us continuously iterate on where we should show up, what we should say, and which opportunities are worth chasing.

Internally, your footprint is lighter but real. You’re the standard other technologists measure themselves against, and you’re a mentor to those working on their business leadership and impact. You’ll weigh in from time to time on technical job standards and career pathing. You’ll start without direct reports and lead through influence, and as we grow, the role could grow into leading a small team.

Strongly Preferred Skills

We’d particularly like to hear from applicants with:

• A track record of pitching and winning enterprise engagements inside a consultancy

• A public technical presence: talks you’ve given, things you’ve written, communities you help lead

• Experience shaping the service offerings or the technical point of view a firm takes to market

• Relationships with cloud or AI platform partners, and the standing that comes with them

• A working grasp of where AI and agentic tooling is heading, enough to judge where the real opportunities are

• Experience mentoring senior technical talent and raising the bar around them

Compensation

Our pay range for the Field CTO role is $230,000–$287,500 USD, plus 20–30% variable compensation based on performance.

Travel Expectation

This role involves regular but not frequent travel, mostly for in-person events, client pitches, and the occasional team gatherings.

How You’ll Be Supported

At 8th Light, our culture is built on the belief that our collective growth and well-being are the drivers of our future. Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:

• A robust L&D program featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.

• Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development

• Coworking support for our global team

• Flexible PTO with floating company holidays

• 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

8th Light’s culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.

If you are hired into a hub, you will be part of a team with regular rituals around co-working and community building. For team members outside of those cities, we offer access to coworking spaces to foster continued collaboration and connection across our global team.

We hope to see you apply!

#LI-Remote

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
As a Supply Chain Manager with International SOS in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, you'll oversee the people, processes, and resources behind medical supply distribution, procurement, warehousing, and fleet operations.

This role combines hands-on operational oversight with financial management, supplier relationships, and strategic planning. You'll lead a supply chain team, coordinate with operations and sales, and ensure medical supplies, equipment, and vehicles are available when and where they're needed.

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: $90,000–$105,000 annually

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

Material Employment Conditions: This is an onsite position based in Baton Rouge, LA, requiring approximately 20–30% regional travel. Occasional short-term stays at assignment locations may be required.

Key Responsibilities

• Supply Chain Leadership: Oversee daily supply chain operations, including medical supply fulfillment, procurement, logistics, inventory management, and fleet readiness.
