jobs.title: Senior Database Engineer
jobs.description:
Why This Role Matters
The Senior Database Engineer at Bluestaq owns the data systems that move and protect information behind national security decisions — the schemas, pipelines, and datastores our enterprise platform runs on. This is not a ticket-closing seat. You are the go-to engineer for a data domain: you design the schemas, tune the queries that are actually slow, keep the pipelines healthy, and lead the medium-sized data work from requirements through production. You operate independently, call out risk before it becomes an outage, and set the bar for the engineers around you.

What You Own

• Own sets of tables, schemas, and data flows end-to-end within a larger product or program — including their data quality, performance, and operability over time.

• Design robust relational schemas and data models with sound normalization and denormalization tradeoffs, DDL, and extensive SQL.

• Work across SQL and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Postgres/RDS, Amazon Athena) following best practices, and represent practical DB constraints in data modeling discussions.

• Lead the design and delivery of medium-sized data features — new domains, new ingest, or significant schema changes.

• Build moderately complex ETL/ingest pipelines with incremental loads, error handling, and validation.

• Investigate and fix non-trivial performance problems — bad query plans, missing indexes, partitioning, table bloat — and tune queries, indexes, and configurations for real workloads.

• Apply database-level security controls — row-level security (e.g., Postgres RLS), roles and permissions, and auditing patterns — to protect sensitive data.

• Plan and execute database upgrades, patches, and migrations with minimal disruption to dependent systems.

• Serve as the escalation point for Associate and mid-level engineers on data correctness and performance, and mentor through code review and by explaining design choices.

• Partner with Software Engineering, Data Modeling, Systems, and Cyber to align data design, performance, and access patterns with mission needs.

• Keep database and process documentation current — schema and data-flow diagrams, runbooks, and how-to guides for operating and querying key datasets.

What You Bring

Required Education & Experience

• High School Diploma/GED and 8+ years of relevant experience, OR

• Associate degree in a related field and 6+ years of relevant experience, OR

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of relevant experience, OR

• Master's degree in a related field and 2+ years of relevant experience

Must-Haves

• Relational database mastery — production experience designing, tuning, and operating one or more of Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.

• NoSQL / large-scale stores — hands-on work with MongoDB, Athena, or equivalent, and sound judgment on when to use them.

• Schema and data modeling — designing normalized and denormalized structures that hold up under real-world query and storage conditions.

• Performance engineering — diagnosing bad plans and bottlenecks, and applying indexing, partitioning, and query rewrites that stick.

• ETL / ingest pipelines — building moderately complex loads with incremental processing, error handling, and validation.

• Database security — row-level security, roles and permissions, and auditing patterns applied in production.

• Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery — you know the plan and have exercised it.

• Linux environments and scripting / automation — PowerShell, Bash, Python, and SQL.

• SQL depth — Common Table Expressions, dynamic SQL, and the ability to reason about complex queries.

• Independent delivery — you scope the work, choose the approach, surface risk, and drive it from design through rollout without being managed through it.

• Mentorship and communication — you raise the bar through code review and clear technical writing for peers, leadership, and cross-functional teams.

• Ownership mentality — you follow through, document your work, check downstream impact, and know when to persevere vs. ask for help.

Nice-to-Haves

• Relevant certifications (e.g., DBA certifications).

• Cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

• Containerization — Docker, Kubernetes.

• Schema automation / migration tooling — Liquibase, Flyway.

• Monitoring and observability — Splunk or equivalent.

• DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.

Salary Range (US)

$115,000—$140,000 USD

Clearance Requirement: This position may require an active TS/SCI Clearance. Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply. If you don't currently hold one, Bluestaq will sponsor eligible candidates through the clearance process based on program needs.

Relocation: Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.

About Bluestaq
At Bluestaq, we build secure data platforms that matter for space missions, national defense, healthcare systems, and commercial innovation. Founded in 2018, we've become a leader in enterprise software and secure data management by staying focused on what counts: modern architecture, operational excellence, and mission impact.

We're engineers, problem-solvers, and builders who take the mission seriously, but not ourselves. We automate the repeatable, question the status quo, and design systems that are as reliable as they are scalable. Whether we're supporting space, defense systems, or healthcare advancements, we build with the same principles: cloud-native solutions, security by design, and relentless simplicity.

What We Offer:
For full-time positions

• 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents

• Up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one. Roth options available; no vesting period.

• Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus

• $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage

• $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee

• 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays

• Pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule

Bluestaq is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees on the basis age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by state or local law.

Bluestaq will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities and employees whose work requirements interfere with a religious belief unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to Bluestaq or a direct threat. Employees needing such accommodation are instructed to contact Human Resources immediately at contact.us@bluestaq.com.

Applications will be accepted for 60 days beyond the posting date, or until the position is filled, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel Content Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Portfolio Omnichannel Strategy & Operations Team is seeking an experienced omnichannel marketing content operations leader to support commercial customer engagement across the Revolution Medicines oncology portfolio. This newly created role will establish and scale content lifecycle planning, modular content operations, content taxonomy, content governance, and omnichannel content review, approval and activation processes across brands, tumor types, indications, and customer audiences.

The Associate Director, Omnichannel Content Strategy & Operations will serve as the US Portfolio Omnichannel team's subject matter expert for content strategy, content supply operations, and omnichannel content activation. This individual will partner closely with Marketing, Portfolio Omnichannel Leads, Medical, Legal, Regulatory (MLR), Analytics & Insights, IS/IT, and agency partners to ensure content is designed, approved, managed, and deployed efficiently across personal and non-personal channels. This role will own the commercial digital asset management (DAM) strategy and operating model, including asset lifecycle management, discoverability, reuse, and platform business requirements in partnership with IS/IT. The role will also own content taxonomy strategy and governance, establishing a consistent classification and metadata framework across brands, tumor types, indications, audiences, and channels.

The role will be responsible for translating brand strategy, customer journeys, and engagement objectives into scalable content plans and modular content frameworks that enable personalized customer experiences across email, websites, CRM, paid media, social media, field-triggered communications, congress activities, and future orchestration capabilities. This position will establish consistent content operations, governance standards, review processes, and measurement approaches to improve speed-to-market, reuse, compliance, and customer relevance. This role will also help shape the future state content ecosystem required to support launches, in-line brands, and evolving omnichannel capabilities.

Working in a matrixed environment, the Associate Director will collaborate closely with the Portfolio Omnichannel Tumor leads and Brand Marketing leads, who retain ownership of overall engagement strategy and business priorities. This individual will provide strategic leadership for content systems, workflows, modular content design, and omnichannel content activation while driving operational excellence across brands and customer segments.

The Associate Director, Omnichannel Content Strategy & Operations will also be the business owner for any content management related processes or platforms. In this function they will work closely with Commercial IT and A&I data teams to enable planned programs, projects, initiatives and measurement to efficiently and effectively be inculcated across the US Revolution Medicines Commercial business. This role will also liase with similar ex-US capability teams and roles as needed for strategic programs, lessons learned and innovation opportunities.

This role is effectively leading, managing and solutioning the framework to create, manage, and deliver content. This individual is not a literal content creator.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with Portfolio Omnichannel Leads, Brand Marketing, IS/IT, and Analytics & Insights to develop omnichannel content strategies aligned to customer journeys, business priorities, channel plans, and orchestration objectives.

• Develop and maintain omnichannel content architectures that enable coordinated activation of approved content across email, websites, CRM, social media, paid media, field and rep-triggered communications, congress activities, and emerging channels (including partnering with IS/IT on platform configurations).

• Lead the development of scalable modular content frameworks, reusable content components, and content design standards to support personalization, next-best-action, and future orchestration capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Commercial Development, Early Detection & Market Shaping
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Executive Director, Early Stage, Global Commercial Development – Pancreatic Cancer, this role will lead the global commercial strategy to enable earlier identification and diagnosis of pancreatic cancer. The Senior Director will shape the future early-detection ecosystem—connecting science, screening and surveillance pathways, diagnostic innovation, healthcare delivery, and disease education—with Revolution Medicines’ longer-term early-stage portfolio ambitions. This is a strategic and hands-on position requiring deep cross-functional influence, external ecosystem engagement, and the ability to build markets before established commercial pathways exist. The position is primarily remote, with travel for scientific, stakeholder, and team meetings.

Specifically, you will be responsible for

• Set disease-area strategy: Own the global commercial market-shaping strategy for pancreatic cancer early detection, including high-risk identification, surveillance, symptom recognition, diagnostic work-up, and referral to multidisciplinary care.

• Map the patient journey: Identify barriers and opportunities from first symptoms or high-risk status through imaging, testing, specialist referral, diagnosis, staging, and access to treatment; develop hypotheses to improve pathways to earlier-stage care.

• Evaluate diagnostics innovation: Assess the emerging landscape of blood-based detection tests, molecular biomarkers, AI-enabled imaging, radiology tools, and other diagnostic approaches; translate evidence maturity and workflow requirements into commercial implications.

• Build the external ecosystem: Develop a strategic map of academic centers, NCI and other research networks, healthcare delivery partners, technology and diagnostic companies, and patient advocacy organizations; recommend priority partnership opportunities.

• Develop market insights and forecasts: Lead global market research, epidemiology and patient-flow analyses, screening/adoption scenarios, potential stage-shift assumptions, and evidence-based assessments of the opportunity and investment required to enable earlier diagnosis.

• Shape education strategies: Partner with Medical Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Patient Advocacy, and appropriate review functions on compliant, unbranded disease-awareness, provider education, and patient-engagement strategies that address knowledge and referral gaps.

• Advance evidence and access planning: Collaborate with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Precision Medicine/Diagnostics, Market Access, and external partners to identify evidence needs, operational dependencies, and payer or health-system considerations for emerging detection approaches.

• Engage priority stakeholders: Translate insights from gastroenterologists, high-risk surveillance programs, primary care, radiology, genetics, pancreatic surgeons, oncology teams, and advocacy groups into practical market-shaping priorities.

• Connect detection to the portfolio: Coordinate with daraxonrasib and zoldonrasib early-stage commercial leaders to ensure early-detection planning is informed by likely treatment pathways, molecular testing needs, and future patient-identification opportunities.

• Lead global strategic planning: Prepare executive-level recommendations, scenario analyses, measurable milestones, and phased investment plans; align U.S. and key ex-U.S. perspectives with the broader pancreatic cancer disease-area strategy.

• Manage strategic partners: Select and direct agencies, research vendors, and specialist partners; establish effective ways of working and deliver integrated, high-quality outputs within budget.

• Build modern capabilities: Partner with IS Commercial and analytics teams to apply digital, omnichannel, and data-driven approaches to ecosystem intelligence and appropriately reviewed disease education.

• Up to 50% of travel required.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree with at least 15 years, or advanced degree with at least 8 years, of progressive commercial experience in a biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical company, including strategic marketing and ideally sales.

• Proven success developing and executing global commercial strategy and influencing cross-functional product or disease-area teams.

• Demonstrated ability to derive actionable insights and analytics that inform innovative commercial strategies and investment decisions.

• Strong leadership, with the ability to lead teams, collaborate effectively across functions, and influence without direct authority.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively and deliver results within established timelines.

• Strong clinical and scientific acumen; ability to translate preclinical and clinical data into commercial implications.

• Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills; ability to represent Revolution Medicines effectively with external stakeholders.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and passion for improving outcomes for people with cancer.

• Ability to assess the clinical, economic, and practical feasibility of screening, surveillance, and diagnostic strategies in a setting where scientific and commercial evidence continues to evolve.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in pancreatic or other gastrointestinal cancers, oncology diagnostics, or development of new disease-area markets.

• Experience with screening or surveillance initiatives, molecular diagnostics, liquid biopsy, imaging, or AI-enabled diagnostic pathways.

• Experience building external alliances across industry, academic medicine, patient advocacy, and healthcare systems.

• Prior involvement with a global oncology product launch or major market-creation initiative in a competitive environment.

• Experience in a smaller, rapidly growing company with evolving operating models.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Design
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As the Senior Director of Design, Governance & Compliance at Vanta, you'll lead design for our largest product pillar. You'll set the direction for how compliance work moves from manual workflows to agents that do the work alongside our customers.



Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. Those companies range from founders getting their first SOC2 to global enterprises managing hundreds of controls. As we move upmarket, the team's job is to make that complexity feel simple for every customer, at every size.



You’ll lead a team of senior, staff, and principal designers, with senior managers and directors reporting to you. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner as a peer with product and engineering leadership for the pillar. We're not starting from scratch. Vanta Agent works across the product, customers build and deploy their own custom agents, and our designers prototype and ship to production with our own AI design harness. Your job is to make that the way the whole pillar works.



What you’ll do as a Senior Director of Design at Vanta:

 - Lead the agentic direction for Governance & Compliance. Build on the agents we've already shipped, define what comes next, and shape how people and agents work together across the pillar

 - Own design quality across the pillar. Set the bar, drive consistency from concept to ship, and get into the details yourself when it matters

 - Design for platform and enterprise complexity. Lead the team through cross-cutting decisions on scoping, segmentation, org units, permissions, and multi-entity audits so the system holds together across surfaces

 - Bring AI into how the team works. Build on our design harness, help every designer prototype and ship faster, and keep craft high as speed goes up

 - Lead and grow leaders. Develop your design leaders and senior ICs, build a high-trust team, and hire well as the pillar grows

 - Partner as a peer with product and engineering. Co-own outcomes and quality with your counterparts, not just the design work



How to be successful in this role:

 - You've shipped agentic or AI-forward products and have a point of view on how design changes when outputs are non-deterministic

 - You use AI hands-on in your own process, from prototyping to building in a harness or in code, and you bring your team along

 - You have deep enterprise B2B SaaS experience. You understand custom configurations, multi-org workflows, and large deployments, and you've made complex products feel simple

 - You think in systems, designing object models and patterns that hold up across many surfaces, not just individual flows

 - You're comfortable going deep with engineers in a technical, domain-heavy space like GRC

 - You've led teams of 12 or more, including design directors, design managers, and staff ICs, and you move easily between strategy and the details

 - You have a portfolio showing how you've simplified complex products and shipped AI-forward experiences (required for interview)

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

 - Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results

 - Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.  



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Vehicle Structures Engineer I (Heat Shield)
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Structures and Mechanisms team is responsible for the full design, build, and test lifecycle of Terran R’s integrated structures and flight mechanisms. Whether you're working on highly iterative mechanisms that move or tight-margin structures that shouldn’t, you’ll get hands-on hardware ownership and see the rocket coming to life on the factory floor. Both teams fall under one department, sharing design principles, tools, and an integrated approach that provides a comprehensive view of Terran R. Team members work on multiple parts, not just within a single subsystem, and are empowered to make decisions that directly impact flight hardware. Beyond first flight, you’ll play a critical role in refining for manufacturability and speed.

The Base Heat Shield Structures team is responsible for the full design, build, and test lifecycle of Terran R’s base heat shield. Our team is responsible for all structure AFT of the engine gimbal plane with the core responsibility to isolate the engines from hazardous atmospheric environments from flight operations. Whether you're working on highly loaded structures under extreme thermal environments or isolating engines from one another you’ll get hands-on hardware ownership and see the rocket coming to life on the factory floor. Our team is organized under the greater Structures and Mechanisms department, sharing design principles, tools, and an integrated approach that provides a comprehensive view of Terran R. Team members work on multiple parts, not just within a single subsystem, and are empowered to make decisions that directly impact flight hardware. Beyond first flight, you’ll play a critical role in refining for manufacturability and speed.

About the Role:

To support our mission of changing the way rockets are built and flown, you will be responsible for bringing critical flight structures and supporting components from design concept to physical hardware ready to launch. The scope of work encompasses a full design cycle, including conceptualization, design, analysis, manufacturing and testing for primary and secondary structures associated with the Terran R Base Heat Shield. Here are some examples of projects you could be working on:

• OML Skins, Base Panels, High Temperature Seals, and internal supporting structures

• Review of static & dynamic load inputs, material properties & test as well as structural systems & subsystems requirements

• Analysis and sizing of flight structures to ensure timely design reviews and drawing release

• Develop and support hardware test campaigns, including test integration, operation and result evaluation

• Support manufacturing process development, including tools or fixtures design or analysis

• Your mission will be to deliver these projects on time and budget

In order to achieve this, you will be working closely with our Thermal Protection System (TPS), Design, Test and Loads & Dynamics teams. An ideal candidate would be self-motivated, thrives in ambiguity and is able to lead his or her own projects into completion. Ideally, you are someone who has come from a fast paced, aerospace environment, having completed difficult projects while collaborating effectively with other key groups. On a weekly basis, you will be designing flight or ground components using NX/TeamCenter, performing analysis using ANSA/META, ANSYS and/or hand calculations, creating and releasing drawings as well as supporting fabrication of your components. You will also use your strong organizational skills to properly document your work and move forward your recommendation when decisions are needed.

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ with an expectation to work onsite three days per week.

Position Summary

The Director, Global PV Management is responsible for assessing regional and international pharmacovigilance regulatory requirements and translating them into effective drug safety & pharmacovigilance (DSP) procedures and operational processes. In partnership with DSP team members and other cross-functional key stakeholders, the role monitors regulatory changes in existing markets, assesses PV requirements for entry into new countries, and drives the development and implementation of processes that enable ongoing compliance and operational readiness.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Review and interpret applicable international and regional pharmacovigilance regulatory requirements and assess their impact on company procedures, processes, and outsourced activities.

• Continuously monitor changes to pharmacovigilance requirements in countries where the company operates and coordinate timely assessment and implementation of necessary changes.

• Assess pharmacovigilance requirements for new countries and develop operational readiness plans, including required procedures, responsibilities, and implementation timelines.

• Conduct and document gap assessments comparing regulatory requirements with existing SOPs, work instructions, and operational practices.

• Lead the development and revision of pharmacovigilance procedures, working with Regulatory, Quality, Medical Safety, Risk Management, QST, other cross-functional stakeholders, and service providers, as applicable to ensure requirements are appropriately addressed.

• Collaborate with the Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) and local country pharmacovigilance responsible persons to assess country-specific requirements, confirm their operational impact, and ensure appropriate incorporation into company procedures and processes.

• Translate regulatory requirements into clear operational steps, defined ownership, and actionable timelines.

• Coordinate procedure review and implementation, and verify that required changes have been incorporated into operational practice.

• Maintain a centralized record of applicable requirements, identified gaps, action owners, implementation status, and supporting documentation.

• Regularly evaluate SOPs and processes to identify compliance gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

• Partner with the Head of Pharmacovigilance Operations and PV Quality Services & Training to periodically assess adherence to established procedures through targeted, routine process checks. Identify gaps and coordinate appropriate follow-up, including procedure clarification, training, or process improvements.

• Escalate compliance risks and overdue actions to PV leadership and recommend practical solutions.

• Support inspection readiness and responses to findings through regulatory assessments, procedure updates, and supporting evidence.

• Other responsibilities as assigned.

Education/Experience/Skills

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, life sciences or a related field. Targeting 10 years of progressively responsible experience in pharmacovigilance operations and or pharmacovigilance quality functions, with working knowledge of global pharmacovigilance requirements, preferably in a pharmaceutical or biotech environment.  An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

Key Skills:

• Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, Heath Canada) and industry best practices (ICH E2E, GVP modules), including safety monitoring and reporting in clinical trials, post-marketing surveillance, case processing, safety agreement requirements and reporting to Health Authorities worldwide.

• Experience representing PV in quality audits and inspections, including CAPA implementation.

• Proficiency in creating and maintaining quality systems, establishing and tracking performance metrics, compliance monitoring, developing and maintaining SOPs and training programs, and PV systems/databases.

• Ability to independently translate regulatory requirements into practical processes and drive cross-functional implementation.

• Demonstrated experience conducting regulatory gap assessments and developing or revising SOPs and work instructions.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear and concise documentation and training materials.

• Proficient in pharmacovigilance databases, quality systems, and training platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence, inspection readiness, and process improvements.

• Ability to motivate and train others; drive standards and change across functional areas and sites.

• Strong attention to detail in establishing priorities, scheduling and meeting deadlines.

• Demonstrated strong analytical thinking, strategic writing, project management, and clear, effective communication across diverse stakeholders.

• Collaborate with internal teams, including Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and Legal, to ensure alignment of PV quality strategies.

• Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure compliance with PV-related contractual agreements.

• Monitor and assess emerging regulations and industry trends to proactively enhance PV processes and ensure compliance.

• Foster continuous improvement by identifying process gaps related to PV and implementing best practices and ensuring scalable and efficient workflows.

• Contribute to the development of best practices, training materials, and procedural guidance.

• Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be able and willing to travel on occasion.

Physical Requirements

The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. jobs.title: Senior Majors Account Executive - Phoenix
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Phoenix, AZ

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will lead Cloudflare’s strategic engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Executive & C-Suite Engagement: Manage complex customer engagements across multiple business units, building strong relationships with executive sponsors and C-level stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional teams—including Product Managers and executive leadership—to advance strategic deals and resolve operational friction.

• Digital Transformation Guidance: Serve as a key advisor on digital transformation, helping customers navigate market shifts and position Cloudflare as a core strategic partner.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrated track record of success in B2B enterprise sales, closing multi-year, complex technology agreements demonstrating a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.

• Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.

• Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and managing executive sponsorship initiatives.

• Strong collaborative skills with experience working alongside cross-functional leadership teams.

• Familiarity with digital transformation trends and the ability to translate market insights into customer solutions.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

• Thoughtful decision-making approach focused on sustainable, long-term business success.

• Experience setting clear performance indicators and facilitating cross-team alignment.

• Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.

• Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• Estimated annual salary of $280,000- $350,000 (base/variable)

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Merchandising, Retail & Auto
jobs.description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER – MERCHANDISING, RETAIL & AUTO




ABOUT WORKWHILE

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability.

WorkWhile identifies the best hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.



ROLE SUMMARY

WorkWhile is looking for an Account Manager to join our Merchandising, Retail & Auto pod and build long-term, trusting relationships with our clients. This role is focused on managing a portfolio of accounts - from big-box, grocery, and specialty retailers to merchandising and consumer brands and other multi-location operators - ensuring they have the right in-store, reset crew, and distribution center workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, resets and remodels, inventory cycles, and high-volume periods.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, demand-driven nature of retail and merchandising operations.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for your clients, including staffing planning, escalations, and ongoing strategy

 - Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with store operations managers, district managers, merchandising and DC leaders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders

 - Develop a deep understanding of each client's environment - including seasonal hiring surges, reset and remodel calendars, inventory events, and customer traffic patterns - to proactively meet their workforce needs

 - Maintain and grow client contracts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across store locations, distribution centers, regions, or new job categories

 - Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, aligning WorkWhile's solutions to their operational goals and labor challenges

 - Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts and workforce solutions in line with client expectations and SLAs

 - Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal teams and client stakeholders

 - Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue growth

 - Prepare regular account health reports and business reviews tailored to operations leadership

 - Collaborate with the Sales team to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and expand WorkWhile's presence across new store locations, banners, or regions

 - Partner with Ops teams to ensure worker supply meets client demand, especially during peak periods (holidays, back-to-school, large reset programs, etc.)

 - Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize operational disruption


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3-5+ years of proven experience as an Account Manager, ideally within retail, merchandising, staffing, or workforce solutions. Experience in automotive is a plus, but not required

 - Strong understanding of retail operations, labor dynamics, and the staffing challenges unique to high-volume, shift-based environments

 - Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels — from store managers to VP-level executives

 - Experience managing multi-location or enterprise accounts is a strong plus

 - Solid experience with CRM software (Salesforce or similar) and Google Suite

 - Track record of delivering client-focused solutions and hitting retention and growth targets

 - Ability to juggle multiple accounts and competing priorities while maintaining sharp attention to detail

 - Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills

 - Undergraduate degree preferred


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive base salary + commission with clear OTE upside

 - Equity

 - Remote work culture with opportunities for co-working in SF, NY, Seattle & Toronto

 - In-person company off-sites

 - Medical, dental, & vision coverage

 - Flexible time off

 - 401(k)

 - WFH stipend to support your home office needs

WorkWhile has a diverse, mission-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we’d love to chat!

We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

• Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

Location: Remote in these states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KS, KY, IA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI

Role Description:

We are seeking an SFN Network Development Manager to own the economic model of our third-party fulfillment network. You will build the cost-to-serve model that sits behind every partner agreement, derive and validate the rate cards we contract on, and maintain a benchmarked shadow P&L for each partner. Alongside that you will own the measurement layer that tells us whether the economics are holding, translating the commitments in partner agreements into measurable metrics and owning the reporting that goes to partners and ShipBob leadership.

This is a build role for someone who understands fulfillment operations from the floor up and can translate what happens in a building into what it costs. Comfortable moving between a cost model, a contract and a partner conversation.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Network Development, and works in close partnership with SFN Operations, Pricing, Legal and the Data team.

What you’ll do:

Modeling

• Build and own the cost-to-serve model for SFN partner operations: labor, equipment, occupancy and overhead by activity, at site level.

• Model the economics of proposed commercial terms before they are agreed, so we understand what a rate card delivers for both parties at the volumes we actually expect.

• Run scenario and sensitivity analysis on the variables that move the answer and state which assumptions the conclusion depends on.

• Model the economics of network decisions including new sites, consolidations and inventory moves, and quantify the trade-offs.

• Establish standard cost and variance analysis across the network, so that where actual cost diverges from standard we know by how much and why.

• Model payback on capital investments using cost of capital, IRR, and associated throughput metrics to drive recommendations.

Partner Performance

• Serve as the validation gate on new agreements: before a commercial commitment is signed, confirm that what it obliges us to measure and enforce can be measured and enforced, and that its terms are economically viable and fair to both ShipBob and the partner.

• Keep contractual obligations and reporting in sync as agreements evolve, so every new term has instrumentation behind it.

• Design and own partner-facing performance reporting, including what is published, to whom, at what level of detail, and on what cadence.

• Specify product requirements for the publication mechanism and work with Product and Engineering to deliver it.

• Build the analytics that surface systemic insight across the network: productivity benchmarking by region and product profile, emerging risk patterns, and structural versus situational performance variance.

Shadow P&L

• Build and own the partner shadow P&L, benchmark partner, productivity and cost against comparables, and flag deteriorating economics early, with the drivers quantified.

• Define the financial and productivity insight shared back with partners and support the rate reviews, cost model validation, and negotiations with partner-level analysis.

Mechanisms and Escalation

• Own the performance escalation framework with SFN Operations, including thresholds, owners, and touchpoint sequence, and automate escalation so issues reach the right level without manual intervention.

• Supply the performance and financial inputs for Quarterly Business Reviews.

• Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary.

What you’ll bring to the table:

• 7+ years in operational finance, costing and pricing work, plant or site controllership, FP&A or commercial finance, within manufacturing, distribution, fulfillment or a comparable operating environment.

• Demonstrated experience building economic and cost-to-serve models from first principles, rather than operating a model someone else designed.

• Working understanding of fulfillment or warehouse operations and the cost drivers within them such as labor productivity, equipment utilization, occupancy, throughput and mix. You should be able to walk a floor and understand where the cost sits.

• Comfort working with cost and industrial engineers on design engineering.

• Excellent financial literacy. Comfortable building a P&L view, understanding cost structure and margin drivers, and forming a defensible judgement on whether a commercial arrangement is working.

• Fluency with data at scale. SQL is expected, and experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks is strongly preferred. You should be able to get at the data you need to build a model without waiting on someone else to extract it.

• Ability to read a commercial agreement and translate its obligations into measurable terms. Prior exposure to contracts, service levels or commercial terms is a significant advantage.

• Experience specifying requirements to product and engineering teams and seeing a build through to delivery.

• Ability to influence and drive accountability across functions without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders.

• Exceptional rigor. Numbers that go to partners and to leadership must be right, and this role is the last line of defense on that.

• Solid written and verbal communication. Able to explain an analytical conclusion to a commercial audience and a commercial constraint to an engineering one.

• Comfort with ambiguity. Much of what this role will own does not exist yet.

• Program or project management experience is a bonus.

ShipBob believes in transparency while providing a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance approach. We are targeting a salary range of $99,150 - $132,200 for this role. The full base pay range for this position in our compensation architecture is $99,150 - $165,250. In addition to base salary, this role includes the opportunity to be eligible for participation in the Company's discretionary bonus plan based on Company's plans and in accordance with Company’s policies.

Perks & Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance

• Paid Maternity/Parental Leave Program

• Paid Holidays & Flexible Time Off Program

• Paid Sick Leave

• Wellness Days (1 day/quarter)

• 401K Match

• Comprehensive Benefits Package >>> https://www.shipbob.com/careers/

• See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

#LI-EZ1

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About You:

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Mixpanel's Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) team is hiring a Staff Security Engineer to partner with our product and engineering teams on how we build and run Mixpanel securely. You'll help design and implement security features in our product, set the security approach for how we adopt and build with AI, and lead the work to reduce existing risk in our engineering environment through lasting, platform-level solutions rather than one-off fixes. This is a hands-on technical  role: you'll review designs, harden systems and pipelines, and build the kind of trust with engineering and product leaders that makes security part of how they plan and ship.

Responsibilities

• Secure product design: Partner with product managers and engineers from the start of new initiatives to threat model, review designs, and define security requirements before code is written.

• Security feature implementation: Design and build security features alongside product teams, such as SSO and SCIM, fine-grained access controls, audit logging, and encryption and key management, guiding engineers through implementation and validating the result.

• Strategic risk remediation: Identify systemic risks in our engineering environment, prioritize them by impact, and lead multi-quarter efforts that remove whole classes of issues through secure defaults, shared libraries, and guardrails.

• Infrastructure and Kubernetes security: Define and drive adoption of security baselines for our cloud and Kubernetes environments, including RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, workload identity, secrets management, and admission control.

• AI security: Set the security approach for how Mixpanel adopts and builds with AI. Threat model AI-powered product features and agentic workflows for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and over-permissioned agents, define guardrails for internal use of AI coding tools, agents, and MCP integrations, and review new AI vendors and integrations with engineering, IT, and legal partners.

• Secure development lifecycle: Harden each stage of our SDLC, from design and code review through build, release, and deployment. Own the security configuration of our GitHub organization and CI/CD pipelines, including access controls, branch protection, GitHub Actions permissions, secret scanning, dependency and code scanning, and software supply chain controls, in a way engineers will use rather than work around.

• Secrets management strategy: Define and drive Mixpanel's secrets management strategy across applications, CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes. Centralize secrets in a managed store, replace long-lived credentials with short-lived, identity-based access where possible, set standards for ownership and rotation, and lead the cleanup of hardcoded or exposed secrets.

• Partnership and influence: Build trusted relationships with engineering and product leaders, work through risk tradeoffs with them, and get security work onto team roadmaps.

• Technical leadership: Set technical direction for product and infrastructure security, mentor other security engineers, raise security knowledge across engineering, and use AI tools to scale design reviews and automation.

We're Looking For Someone With

• 10+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with significant time in product security or infrastructure security

• A track record of working closely with product and engineering teams, and of shipping security features or platform changes together with them

• Deep understanding of the full software development lifecycle, from design and code review through CI/CD, build, release, and deployment, and how to harden each stage. You should be comfortable reading code and pipeline configuration, though this role doesn't require writing production code

• Hands-on experience hardening GitHub at the organization level, including SSO and access management, branch protection and rulesets, required reviews and CODEOWNERS, GitHub Actions security (least-privilege workflow tokens, OIDC to cloud providers, pinning third-party actions), secret scanning and push protection, and control of personal access tokens and GitHub Apps

• Experience designing and rolling out a secrets management strategy, including centralized secret stores (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, AWS Secrets Manager), workload identity and short-lived credentials, automated rotation, and detection and response for leaked secrets

• Deep product and application security expertise, including threat modeling, secure design review, and common vulnerability classes such as authentication and authorization flaws and multi-tenant isolation issues

• Experience designing and implementing product security features such as authentication, authorization, SSO (SAML/OIDC), audit logging, or encryption

• Strong infrastructure security experience in GCP or AWS, including IAM, network security, and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform)

• Production Kubernetes security experience, including cluster hardening, RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, and container image security

• Experience securing AI and LLM-based systems or company-wide AI adoption, including risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and insecure agent tool use, and familiarity with guidance such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

• Experience leading cross-team remediation of systemic risk, from framing the problem and getting buy-in through to delivery

• Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior engineers and leaders without direct authority and to make pragmatic risk tradeoffs

• Clear written communication, including design docs and security guidance that engineers can act on

• Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to automate or scale security work

Nice to Have

• Experience securing a multi-tenant SaaS or data platform

• Experience with software supply chain security (e.g. SLSA, Sigstore, SBOMs)

• Experience with service mesh or zero-trust networking (e.g. Istio, mTLS)

• Experience building AI governance in practice, such as approved-tool policies, model and AI vendor reviews, or access controls for AI agents and MCP servers

• Experience building secure-by-default libraries or paved-road platforms for engineering teams

• Background as a software engineer before moving into security, or equivalent experience working inside engineering teams

• Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls in engineering environments

• CKS, OSWE, OSCP, or similar certification

What Success Looks Like

• First 3 months: You've built working relationships with key engineering and product leads, learned our architecture and threat landscape, and delivered a prioritized assessment of the largest risks in our engineering environment with a proposed remediation strategy.

• By 6 months: You're part of the design process for major product initiatives, including AI features, have shipped or co-built at least one security feature, the first strategic remediation effort is underway with engineering owners committed, and teams have clear security guardrails for adopting AI tools and agents.

• By 12 months: You've removed at least one class of risk across our environment through a platform-level solution, established GitHub, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and cloud security baselines that teams follow by default, moved production services onto our standard secrets management approach, and are the partner engineering and product teams seek out early on security decisions.

Growth Path

This is a staff technical leadership role in our security engineering career path. From here, you can grow into Principal Security Engineer, where you'll set Mixpanel's long-term security architecture and shape how security and engineering work together across the company.

Compensation

The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here.

Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.

Mixpanel Compensation Range

$230,000—$300,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.
