jobs.title: Procurement Director
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Role Summary

The Procurement Director leads all global procurement activities for the company, including strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, subcontract administration, and vendor performance management. This role ensures the company secures the materials, components, and services needed to support full-rate production at the best total cost, quality, and risk profile.

This role owns the supplier-facing side of the supply chain, from sourcing and negotiation through subcontract execution and performance, while maintaining the compliance discipline required in a regulated, government-contracting environment.

The Procurement Director partners closely with the Supply Chain Director, Program Management, Engineering, and Finance to ensure sourcing decisions translate into reliable, on-time material flow.

The Procurement Director ensures the procurement organization is aligned to meet Zone 5 needs for Production support, Engineering New Product Introduction (NPI), as well as the needs of franchise partners, while staying aligned with Finance and compliant with financial control requirements.

What You'll Own

• Strategic Sourcing & Purchasing

You are accountable for sourcing the right materials, components, and services at the right cost and risk profile, and for proactively derisking the supply base.

You will:

• Lead the procurement team's sourcing of raw materials, components, and services to support full-rate production

• Implement strategic sourcing initiatives, vendor qualification programs, and cost reduction programs while maintaining quality and compliance standards

• Ensure Zone 5 has a well-communicated, aligned set of suppliers that meets the technical and service needs of the organization and franchise partners

• Establish relationships with strategic suppliers that extend beyond the account team to the executive level between companies

• Systematically identify sole-source and single-source suppliers across the supply base and drive mitigation plans, including dual-sourcing, qualified alternates, or long-term agreements, to close the exposure

• Assess supplier capacity against projected production rates and proactively address suppliers unable to scale with the business, through capacity investment, dual-sourcing, or re-sourcing as warranted

• Build and maintain a diversified, resilient supplier base to mitigate single-source and capacity risk

• Identify and qualify alternate vendors for critical or at-risk parts

• Support New Product Introduction (NPI) by sourcing and qualifying long-lead and new parts in time to support production ramp

• Source and negotiate capital equipment, automation, and digital system purchases in support of the company's capital investment strategy

• Extend supplier qualification and performance standards to franchise and external manufacturing sites, ensuring they source from the same qualified supply base or an equivalent standard

Success looks like:

• Critical parts have qualified alternate sources before a shortage forces the issue

• Sole-source exposure and supplier scalability risk are known, tracked, and actively being mitigated across the supply base

• Suppliers proactively bring technology ideas to Zone 5 Engineering that facilitate new product development and give Zone 5 a competitive advantage in capability

• Supplier Negotiations & Cost Management

You own the commercial terms we get from our supply base.

You will:

• Negotiate pricing, terms, and contract conditions with suppliers and subcontractors to secure favorable terms and mitigate supply risk

• Partner with strategic suppliers to understand cost drivers and applicable market pricing, ensuring Zone 5 pricing supports a competitive cost advantage

• Negotiate and manage Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) with key suppliers to secure price stability, priority capacity, and favorable lead times

• Negotiate volume discounts and tiered pricing structures, consolidating spend across programs and sites where it creates leverage

• Establish and track purchase price variance and other cost-performance KPIs

• Lead cost reduction initiatives without compromising quality or delivery commitments

Success looks like:

• Total cost of ownership improves year over year across the supplier base

• Buyers can justify and explain market pricing for strategic components

• Supplier & Subcontract Performance Management

You are accountable for how well our suppliers and subcontractors perform, not just what they cost.

You will:

• Manage the procurement process and supplier performance, including escalation and corrective action where needed

• Administer complex subcontracts in compliance with FAR/DFARS and customer-specific flow-downs

• Maintain oversight of critical subcontractors for delivery, quality, and performance, coordinating with cross-functional teams as necessary

• Maintain supplier scorecards and drive corrective action plans for delivery or quality deficiencies

• Hold business reviews with strategic suppliers on a scheduled cadence, with participation from the Technical Program Manager (TPM), Engineering, and Quality

• Support supplier quality functions, including supplier audits, qualification, and corrective action, in partnership with the Quality organization, which retains ownership of these functions

Success looks like:

• Supplier and subcontractor performance is tracked, visible, and improving, with no surprises at the program level

• Strategic supplier business reviews happen on schedule with appropriate cross-functional participation

• Make/Buy Strategy & Outsourcing

You manage the make/buy decision framework.

You will:

• Conduct make/buy analyses and support outsourcing decisions, including evaluation of insourcing opportunities

• Partner with Engineering, Programs and Manufacturing to evaluate sourcing options for critical or at-risk parts

Success looks like:

• Make/buy decisions are data-driven and revisited as volume and risk change

• Procurement Compliance & Contract Governance

You ensure that how we buy holds up to scrutiny.

You will:

• Ensure procurement practices comply with FAR/DFARS, CAS, AS9100, and other applicable government contracting and quality standards

• Confirm required internal approvals (Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Programs, Finance) are obtained prior to PO issuance for purchases above defined dollar thresholds

• Verify that budget line allocations align with contract and proposal terms before reallocating funds across cost elements, escalating to Contracts/Legal when a reallocation may require formal notice or modification

• Ensure subcontractor security and compliance documentation (e.g., DD-254) is finalized prior to contract award

• Prepare for and participate in audits, reviews, and other regulatory evaluations

Success looks like:

• Procurement actions are audit-ready, with no findings tied to approval routing, budget realignment, or missing compliance documentation

• Team Leadership, Organization & Systems

You are responsible for building a procurement organization that scales.

You will:

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing procurement team with clear roles and career development pathways

• Ensure the procurement organization is structured and aligned to meet Zone 5 needs for Production support, Engineering NPI, and franchise partners

• Drive adoption and optimization of ERP and digital procurement tools to improve visibility and decision-making

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, cost discipline, and cross-functional collaboration

Success looks like:

• The procurement organization scales with volume without a corresponding increase in errors or compliance risk

• Production, Engineering, and franchise partners are supported by a procurement organization built around their needs, with clean financial controls

Qualifications

Required Experience

• Proven experience leading global procurement or strategic sourcing in a manufacturing environment, ideally at scale

• Experience administering subcontracts under FAR/DFARS and customer flow-down requirements

• Background in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex supplier and subcontract agreements

• Experience building executive-level relationships with strategic suppliers and running structured supplier business reviews

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree (e.g., MBA) preferred

Technical & Operational Depth

• Deep understanding of: Strategic sourcing, supplier negotiation, and cost reduction methodologies Subcontract administration and compliance under FAR/DFARS and CAS Make/buy analysis and outsourcing strategy

• Experience with: ERP/MRP systems and procurement/contract management tools Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Toyota Kata) Quality systems aligned to AS9100 or equivalent Supplier scorecard and corrective action programs

Leadership Profile

• Thinks beyond individual POs to total cost of ownership and supply risk

• Builds structure, clarity, and accountability across the procurement organization

• Comfortable negotiating and managing supplier relationships under schedule and cost pressure

• Builds supplier relationships that bring technology and capability to Zone 5, not just pricing

• Holds the line on compliance even when it creates short-term friction

What Success Looks Like

• Material and services are sourced at competitive cost without compromising quality or delivery

• Subcontracts are compliant, well-managed, and free of audit findings

• Supplier base is resilient enough to avoid single points of failure

• Procurement approvals and budget actions are routed correctly the first time

• Strategic suppliers proactively bring technology ideas that strengthen Zone 5 capability and new product development

Additional Information

• Primarily based in San Luis Obispo, CA, with travel to supplier, subcontractor, and other facility sites required approximately 40% of the time

Pay range for this role

$205,000—$253,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

jobs.title: Senior Client Relations Executive, Eurofins Built Environment Testing, Portland, OR
jobs.description:
Eurofins Built Environment Testing is seeking a Senior Client Relations Executive to join our team in Portland, OR.

The Senior Client Relations Executive (Senior CRE) typically focuses on managing and maintaining relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction, and driving business growth. The position also requires being responsible for facilitating the day-to-day communication between clients and laboratories ensuring exceptional client experience. CREs and Senior CREs serve as the primary contact at the laboratory

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management:

• Build and nurture long-term relationships with key clients.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs are addressed.
• Anticipate client needs and proactively provide solutions.
• Regularly meet with clients to understand their goals and challenges-Document this for retrieval

Client Retention and Satisfaction:

• Monitor and improve client satisfaction levels through surveys or direct feedback.
• Resolve client issues or conflicts quickly and effectively.
• Maintain and monitor the monthly client retention file, tracking client submissions, declines, and potential client losses.
• Closely analyze client activity and trends to identify at-risk accounts and take proactive measures to address retention challenges
• Monitor Relation wise portal-DAILY
• Respond to client issues on Relation wise ASAP
• Proactively engage with clients who provide positive feedback by sending personalized thank-you notes or making follow-up calls to express gratitude for their feedback and continued business.
• Demonstrate appreciation for client input and reinforce the value the company places on their partnership and satisfaction.
• Ensure timely delivery of services or products according to client specifications.
• Actively manage client expectations to avoid misunderstandings.

Business Development:

• Identify new opportunities within existing accounts to increase sales.
• Cross-sell or up-sell products/services to existing clients based on their needs.
• Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to generate leads and new business.
• Attend networking functions if applicable to expand business opportunities.

Strategic Planning and Reporting:

• Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve client objectives.
• Track and report on account performance, including revenue generation, retention, and satisfaction.

Collaboration and Coordination:

• Work closely with internal teams (such as other CREs, login staff, and technical teams) across the network to deliver seamless service to clients.
• Ensure effective communication between the client and internal teams.
• Oversee the delivery of services or products and ensure that all deadlines are met.

Market and Industry Knowledge:

• Stay up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics.
• Depending on field of testing-Advise clients on new trends, products, or services that could benefit their business

Financial Management:

• Monitor client accounts to ensure billing and payments are processed accurately and on time.
• Address any financial concerns or disputes from clients.

Team Leadership and Mentorship:

• Mentor and guide junior team members or client relations staff.
• Share best practices and provide training for improving client relations processes.

The role often requires excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills, along with the ability to work in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

Daily Responsibilities

Client Communication

• Manage and respond to client inquiries via phone, email, or in-person meetings to address concerns, provide updates, and ensure satisfaction with services. Manage inbound and outbound client communications via phone and/or email in a timely, solutions-oriented manner.
• Advise walk-in clients about service information and project preparation.
• Maintain a constant overview of projects in PLM/TEM/and IAQ departments that need login or client communication
• Confirming certification status
• Contact clients for clarification of analysis requested
• Monitor the status of all data projects in-house to ensure timely and accurate delivery of reports
• Scheduling sample submissions, sample container orders and sample pick-up via the laboratory courier service
• Send out reports in a timely manner on completed projects with invoicing issues
• Coordinating and communicating turnaround time (TAT) requirements for high priority samples/projects
• Answering common technical questions, facilitating problem resolution, and coordinating technical details with the laboratory staff
• Responsible to ensure that clients receive the proper sampling supplies
• Accountable for response to client inquiries concerning sample status.
• Responsible for assistance to clients regarding the resolution of problems concerning COC.
• Ensuring that client specifications, when known, are met by communicating project and quality assurance requirements to the laboratory.
• Notifying the supervisors of incoming projects and sample delivery schedules
• Responsible for staff familiarization with specific quotes, sample log-in review, and final report completeness
• Monitor the status of all data projects in-house to ensure timely and accurate delivery of reports.
• Update client and project data records in LIMS

Account Management

• Oversee the day-to-day activities of assigned client accounts, ensuring that all needs and expectations are met promptly

Issue Resolution

• Proactively address and resolve client issues or concerns, ensuring a high level of client satisfaction and retention.
• Check Relation wise portal Daily and respond quickly

Collaboration with Internal Teams

• Regular attendance and punctuality
• Work closely with internal departments (e.g., sales, marketing, operations) to coordinate and ensure the smooth delivery of products/services.
• Collaborate with laboratory/operations personnel to resolve client inquiries and improve processes.
• Maintenance of the department and lab, including stocking supplies and housekeeping
• Conduct all activities in a safe and efficient manner Perform other duties as assigned
• QC of samples/projects prior to sending into the laboratory
• Responsible to ensure that clients receive the proper sampling supplies

Reporting

Track and report on client account status, including progress on ongoing projects, client satisfaction levels, and any potential risks to client relationships.

Client Retention Activities

Identify opportunities for improving client relationships and retention through proactive outreach and tailored solutions.

Documentation and Record Keeping

Maintain accurate records of all client interactions, feedback, and relevant details in the client management system.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree required, Biology or related science degree preferred
• 3-5 years client relationship or customer service experience in the Environmental Testing and/or Built Environment industry.
• Experience working in a laboratory setting
• Prefer 1+ years bench Mold/Asbestos/Bacteria experience
• High level of experience working within Microsoft Excel
• Additionally, individuals will need to be level tempered and handle communications with clients in a professional and respectful conduct, handle and work well under pressure in fast pace and stressful situations.
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship
• Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write and speak in English

Additional Skills

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Compensation Range: $72,800 - $93,600 per year depending on level of experience and qualifications.

Position is full-time, and exempt from overtime pay.  Candidates must be available to work Monday - Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm.

We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays and vacation, personal days, and dental and vision options.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Demand Partnerships (P&C)
jobs.description:
MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more.

Hybrid: 3x/week in-office

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly motivated Senior Technical Account Manager to serve as a technical expert on our Demand Partnerships team, supporting our key Property & Casualty (P&C) advertisers. You’ll scope what each partner integration needs, set up campaigns, and make sure everything works once it’s live. From there, you’ll manage day-to-day campaign operations on our platform and use performance data to optimize accounts and grow results. You’ll also sit between our partners and our technology teams, translating advertiser needs into clear, build-ready requirements. The ideal candidate comes from a technical account management, solutions engineering, ad trafficking, or programmatic ad operations background. You should have an analytical mindset, work comfortably across internal teams, and thrive in a fast-moving, data-driven environment.

Responsibilities

• Analyze partner KPIs and campaign performance data to recommend optimizations to internal teams and directly to partners.

• Gather integration requirements directly from partners, including API specifications, authentication methods, and data formats, and translate them into clear, build-ready tickets for our engineers.

• Test and monitor integrations, including data passing, conversion tracking, and performance imports. When data is missing or inaccurate, identify the root cause and work with partners and technology teams to fix it.

• Serve as a platform expert, advising partners and internal teams on best practices, configuration, and what's technically possible.

• Partner with the Business Analytics team on performance models, providing partner context and validating real-time bidding (RTB) model outputs against account performance trends.

• Contribute to partner business reviews, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs), with performance analysis and forward-looking recommendations.

• Support new product launches and share a point of view on product improvements, based on partner feedback, JIRA ticket patterns, and data.

• Build trusted relationships across the organization and develop a strong understanding of how we operate, including our best practices and how we allocate resources.

• Maintain a holistic understanding of how our advertising products and technologies fit into the online advertising ecosystem, the consumer journey, and a client's broader marketing plan.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have most of the following qualifications:

• 5+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering, ad operations, or trafficking in online advertising.

• Background in performance-based marketing, ideally in a programmatic environment.

• Hands-on experience scoping and validating partner API integrations, including authentication (API keys, OAuth) and JSON payload formats.

• Track record of translating partner technical requirements into clear specifications that engineers can build from.

• Proficiency setting up conversion tracking methods, such as data imports and server-to-server (S2S) integrations.

• Skilled at testing and monitoring live integrations, including diagnosing failed, delayed, or malformed data transfers.

• Experience with RTB and programmatic auction mechanics.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data manipulation).

• Solid knowledge of relevant industry KPIs and a client-service focus within performance marketing.

• Knowledge of the insurance industry and ecosystem.

• Experience working alongside technology teams in a ticket-based workflow, such as Jira.

• Critical and creative thinking, with the ability to synthesize large datasets.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• A self-starter who manages multiple competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Highly organized, with a client-first mindset and meticulous attention to detail.

• Ability to use industry knowledge and insights gained across multiple clients to shape account strategy and recommendations.

• Eagerness to learn and a drive to improve.

Compensation & Benefits

We are excited to offer a competitive base pay range of $90,000 to $120,000 per year for this position, based on experience and qualifications. But that's not all - as a valued member of our team, you will also have access to an array of top-notch benefits, including:

• Annual bonus program and participation in our Restricted Stock Unit program

• 100% Employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for you, your dependents, and spouse or registered domestic partner

• 100% employer-paid long-term disability, and life insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions to help you plan for your future

• Open Paid Time Off policy with a birthday day off, 13 holidays, and 5 Recharge days

• Professional development reimbursement

• Cell Phone, Wellness, and Internet expense reimbursement, along with a subscription to the Calm App

• 100% fully paid parental leave for team members up to 22 weeks for the primary caregiver and 12 weeks for the secondary caregiver

• Dog-friendly offices (LA and AZ) along with a $300 pet adoption reimbursement

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

MediaAlpha is committed to fostering, cultivating, and maintaining a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our philosophy and actions are built on the premise that as an employer and citizens of our communities, we can create opportunities for lasting change.

Fair Chance

MediaAlpha will consider qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local "Fair Chance" laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans in our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at peopleops@mediaalpha.com or (213) 316-6256.

jobs.description:
Bethesda Brings out the Best in Talented, Caring People!

At Bethesda, more than 1,200 employees dedicate their careers to improving the lives of others.

As a team member at Bethesda, you'll enjoy great benefits such as: 403b, daily pay, bonuses, career advancement opportunities, and holiday pay.

Medical, dental, vision, prescription, and life insurance available for regular status full and part time employees.

jobs.title: Freelance Art Director
jobs.location: New York Office; Santa Monica, CA (Corp HQ)
jobs.description:
About The Company

goop is a lifestyle platform dedicated to exploration, curation, and groundbreaking conversation. From its award-winning beauty and fashion lines to its expansive editorial lens, goop invites women to embrace the process of becoming, and to discover deep joy in the pursuit of pleasure, beauty, and growth in all phases of life.

Gwyneth Paltrow began goop in the fall of 2008 as a weekly newsletter. It has expanded into a beauty, fashion, and food business that’s also known for its products, curation, podcast, TV shows, live events, and retail stores.

Culturally, results are the common language here — clear goals, clear numbers, a visible line from contribution to outcome. AI is native to the way the team works, in every function, which raises the bar on what a small group can accomplish. Authority sits with the work: your scope is defined, and inside it you have real decision rights that we expect you to use. Founder mode is not a phase we are in; it is how the company is built.

About You

You’re an art director with a background in luxury brands, and you can take a campaign from first idea to final file. You come up with the concept, you’re on set making the calls, and you stay with the edit until every asset meets a luxury standard. You specialize in either premium-to-luxury skincare and beauty or luxury fashion, and your portfolio shows it. You know how to make a product feel elevated and desirable: through restraint, texture, light, and a quiet confidence that never feels mass-market. You think beyond the hero image, so one shoot produces enough content to carry every channel until the next launch. You have a sharp eye for typography, pacing, and detail. You give clear, specific notes on video and can tell an editor exactly where to cut, what to trim, and which frame to hold on.

About The Role

goop is building a roster of freelance Art Directors to lead creative on 2027 launches for goop Beauty and GWYN, our fashion line. Projects are assigned by category, so beauty specialists lead beauty launches and fashion specialists lead GWYN collections. On each project, you own the creative from start to finish. That means concepting, executing on set, and managing post-production through to a final toolkit of approved assets that every channel uses until the next launch. Every touchpoint should carry the polish and sensibility of a luxury brand.

Category Focus

Beauty: Premium-to-luxury skincare and beauty launches. This includes the hero campaign film and imagery, the founder story, proof and results, how-to and tutorial content, and sensorial texture and product education that make the formulas feel indulgent and worth the investment. You also lead evergreen capture of hero products: texture macros, application and ritual videos, ingredient hero shots, and routine pairings, all held to the visual standard of prestige skincare.

Fashion (GWYN): Seasonal collections, including campaign and lookbook imagery, GP wearing GWYN, on-figure and flat-lay/ghost, detail and fabric close-ups that show the craftsmanship, runway and BTS video, and styling and fit content. You also create assets for presentations, trunk shows, and activations.

Responsibilities include:

Concept & Pre-Production

• Develop elevated campaign concepts, moodboards, and visual direction for each launch

• Map every needed asset before the shoot, across social, paid, PDP, Amazon, wholesale, retail, and event signage

• Build shot lists that cover the full set of baseline content for the category

• Plan for the special crops and versions needed for tentpoles and other initiatives

On-Set Execution

• Art direct photo and video shoots on set, holding every frame to a luxury standard

• Work with photographers, videographers, stylists, and talent to capture the concept and complete the full shot list

Post-Production Management

• Manage post-production through final delivery, including edit, retouch, color, and resizing

• Write clear, detailed edit notes on video cuts: where to cut and clip, pacing, frame selection, and versions for each platform

• Own typography and on-screen text across video and static assets

• Deliver a final toolkit, with links to every approved asset, for channel owners to use

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with brand, marketing, social, e-commerce, and retail teams so every channel pulls from one approved source

• Use final legal-approved copy and claims across all assets

• Keep each project on schedule against the 2027 launch calendar

Qualifications & Experience

• Experience: Proven art direction experience at luxury or prestige brands across concept, production, and post. You need a clear specialty in either premium-to-luxury skincare and beauty or luxury fashion

• Luxury Sensibility: A trained eye for what makes a brand feel luxurious, including composition, lighting, texture, and restraint, and experience bringing that to both campaign and everyday content

• Portfolio: Campaign work in your category for premium or luxury brands, taken from concept to final assets and including both video and stills

• Post-Production: Hands-on knowledge of video editing workflows and the ability to give precise, actionable edit notes

• Typography & Design: Strong typography and layout skills, and fluency in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite

• Skills: Highly organized, able to manage several projects at once, and calm and decisive on set

• Tools: Figma and AI platforms are both required

FAQ

• Engagement: This is a freelance, project-based contractor role. Projects are assigned by category (beauty or fashion).

• Compensation: Project-based fee, determined by the scope of each project.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for building and delivering shared AI capabilities across our platform. In this role, you will drive engineering execution, guide technical direction, and lead the development of scalable, secure, and reliable AI-powered solutions that enhance how legal professionals work.

You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, and senior engineering leaders to translate emerging AI technologies into meaningful product capabilities. This is a technical leadership role focused on driving delivery, developing engineering talent, and ensuring our AI solutions meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and enterprise readiness.

You will:

Drive Engineering Delivery & Execution

• Lead the planning and execution of engineering initiatives, ensuring predictable delivery of high-quality AI capabilities.

• Balance feature development with system reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.

• Strong understanding of large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context limitations, latency, cost considerations, and common failure modes.

• Familiarity with AI evaluation methodologies, retrieval systems, and approaches for measuring model accuracy, reliability, and performance.

jobs.description:

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Team
AI has made it possible to build almost anything. The constraint on great software is no longer engineering capacity, its judgment about what’s actually worth building. Product Managers at Mixpanel build products that help customers answer that question, and they dig deep into customer problems to answer it themselves.

Mixpanel’s Product Managers operate with high ownership and trust. As a team, we focus on helping every builder, not just the ones with a statistics background, get real answers out of messy product data and make the judgment calls that separate delightful products from bloated ones.

We’re also our own best customer. The team uses Mixpanel every day to build Mixpanel: testing our own product intuitions against our own data and catching what works and what doesn’t before our users ever see it.

About the Role
As a Director of Product Management for Core Product, you’ll lead a mid-sized team of Product Managers who are responsible for the key revenue-driving surface areas at Mixpanel.. You’ll own strategy for this group while developing the people and practices that help the whole team do their best work. You’ll partner closely with product leadership to set direction, raise the bar on product craft, and create leverage across the org.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor and grow a team of Product Managers through coaching, feedback and career development

• Set product strategy and direction across your area using customer conversations, market insight and Mixpanel’s own product data

• Raise the bar on product craft across the team, including written communication, prioritization, experimentation and storytelling

• Prioritize ruthlessly across a long list of possible bets, balancing customer impact, business value and team capacity

• Define and track the metrics that show whether what your team shipped actually worked, and course-correct when it didn’t

• Align engineering, design, sales, marketing and support around a shared roadmap and set of priorities

• Tell a clear story about what your team has shipped to internal and external audiences, leading with the customer problem and using customer stories to make the value tangible

• Stay close to the market and competitive landscape to inform where Mixpanel should invest next

• Partner with product leadership to shape the product function at Mixpanel: what it’s responsible for, how it works with other teams, and how it scales over time

• Help hire and build a high-performing product team

We’re Looking For Someone Who Has

• 7+ years of product management experience

• Experience managing a team of Product Managers and acting as a player-coach

• A track record of developing, articulating and executing product strategies that drove measurable business outcomes

• Experience coaching PMs and building strong product practices and rituals

• Deep experience doing user research and working with customers to test product hypotheses

• An ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals to drive clarity on what to build

• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams

• Experience using AI tools in product management workflows (e.g., competitive research, prototyping)

Bonus Points For

• Experience using Mixpanel as an end customer

• Experience in B2B SaaS, analytics or data products

• Experience writing production-grade software

• Experience designing products using tools like Figma, Sketch or Abstract

Compensation

The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here.

Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.

Mixpanel Compensation Range

$298,500—$373,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. jobs.title: Principal Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is looking for a Principal Product Security Engineer to serve as a hands-on technical authority at the intersection of application, cloud, and FedRAMP environment security. You will help secure Cribl’s cloud-native, customer-managed, and hybrid products as they process high-volume data for some of the world’s largest organizations.

As a Principal engineer, impact is defined by reach. You will set long-term direction across teams, resolve critical and ambiguous security problems, advise Engineering and Product leaders, and turn security requirements into secure designs, production-ready patterns, automation, and verified outcomes. This is not a documentation-only compliance role: you will work with Engineering, SRE, Cloud Operations, Compliance, and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) partners to make regulatory commitments real in product architecture and day-to-day operations.

This is a remote, hands-on individual-contributor role within Engineering. You will lead through expertise and influence, mentor engineers and security partners, and create durable systems that reduce risk while making the secure path easier.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Set long-term product and cloud security direction across multiple teams, shaping roadmaps, standards, secure-by-default patterns, and risk-informed design and release decisions.

• Lead Product Security Reviews for distributed, multi-tenant SaaS and customer-managed products, including architecture and design review, threat modeling, abuse-case analysis, targeted secure code review, and security test planning.

• Translate risk into concrete engineering requirements, mitigations, tests, and secure defaults; stay engaged through implementation and independently verify that the intended risk reduction was achieved.

• Serve as a principal cloud security authority across IAM and workload identity, organization and account boundaries, network exposure, KMS and encryption, secrets, logging and detection, containers and Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, hardening, and data isolation.

• Lead the Product Security component of FedRAMP engineering. Translate FedRAMP Moderate and NIST SP 800-53 control intent into sustainable technical controls and defensible evidence, and partner on authorization-boundary and significant-change decisions, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M and deviation remediation, incident response, vendor assessments, and 3PAO or assessor interactions.

• Investigate ambiguous signals and vulnerabilities from bug bounty, application and supply-chain scanners, penetration tests, cloud detections, and internal reports; determine exploitability, exposure, and impact; coordinate remediation; validate fixes and bypasses; and hunt for variants and root causes.

• Evolve scalable, risk-adaptive vulnerability management using exposure, exploitability, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities signals, asset criticality, customer impact, and regulatory timelines,not CVSS alone.

• Build and operate durable security capabilities and developer paved roads across CI/CD, SAST, SCA, secrets, infrastructure as code, containers, cloud posture, and testing. Automate repeatable work while preserving explicit human judgment for consequential security decisions.

• Scope and oversee external penetration tests, purple-team exercises, and relevant security vendors; ensure findings become owned, verified engineering outcomes; and provide evidence-based input to build, retain, replace, or retire decisions.

• Lead multi-team work through uncertainty and high-stakes situations, making clear tradeoffs among security, reliability, delivery, customer impact, and compliance while acting with appropriate urgency.

• Communicate complex risks, options, uncertainty, and recommendations in direct, audience-appropriate terms for engineers, senior leaders, customers, assessors, and external partners; represent Cribl credibly when needed.

• Multiply the team by mentoring Product Security engineers, security champions, and engineering partners; create standards, runbooks, automation, and continuity plans that prevent critical capabilities from depending on one person.

• Evaluate and responsibly apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted security engineering, with measurable outcomes, rigorous verification, secure operating boundaries, and clear human accountability.

• This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• Typically 10+ years of relevant software security, security engineering, or software engineering experience,or equivalent demonstrated scope and impact,including substantial hands-on Application Security or Product Security and cloud security work.

• Experience securing AI or agentic systems and applying AI responsibly to security engineering workflows.

• A Principal-level track record of setting technical direction across teams, leading multi-quarter initiatives, resolving ambiguous critical problems, and influencing senior Engineering and Product leaders without direct authority.

• Deep, hands-on AWS and Azure security experience in production SaaS or cloud-native systems, including identity and authorization, network controls, encryption and key management, secrets, logging and detection, containers or Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, and multi-tenant data isolation.

• Direct experience implementing or operating product and cloud security controls in a FedRAMP-authorized or FedRAMP-bound environment. You understand NIST SP 800-53 control intent and have supported technical control implementation and evidence, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M or deviation remediation, and assessor interactions.

• Expertise leading security design reviews and threat models for complex applications, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architectures, with the judgment to turn findings into practical countermeasures and risk-informed release recommendations.

• Strong knowledge of web and application vulnerabilities, exploit techniques, OWASP guidance, authentication and authorization protocols, cryptography, common network protocols, and secure cloud operating models.

• Ability to read production code and build maintainable automation in JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language; willingness to work directly with Engineering to implement and verify security improvements.

• Hands-on vulnerability-response experience, including exploitability analysis, root-cause and variant analysis, remediation design, fix and bypass validation, stakeholder coordination, and incident support.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex risk and tradeoffs clear to engineers, executives, customers, assessors, and external partners.

• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

• Preferred qualifications Experience securing enterprise data platforms, observability systems, high-volume data pipelines, agents, or customer-managed and hybrid software. Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP Moderate/High, NIST 800-53. Experience building developer security platforms, secure-by-default libraries, policy-as-code, or automated guardrails across SAST, SCA, DAST, software supply chain, containers, and cloud posture. Public security contributions such as open-source work, published research, CVE credits, standards participation, conference talks, or other demonstrated thought leadership. Relevant credentials such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or OSCP; demonstrated practical impact matters more than certifications.

#LI-Remote

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

$265,000—$320,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Channel Partner Sales

Department: Business Development

Work Location: US-Remote

About Genea

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including 401k matching, PTO, 100% paid parental leave, remote work options, and development/training opportunities.

Job Overview

Genea is creating this role to bring our enterprise security channel sales and partner organization under a single leader. The Director, Channel Partner Sales owns revenue delivered through the channel and leads a team of approximately twelve, including senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the go-to-market leadership team, this role sets channel strategy and builds the systems, metrics, and talent to execute it. The work is programmatic: designing repeatable motions, deepening partner relationships, and using data and AI to make the team more effective.

Because the role is new, the person in this seat will continue to define and refine how Genea sells through partners, working closely with the CEO and with real influence over company strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Own new business revenue delivered through the enterprise security channel, including pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and quarterly attainment.

• Lead senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers against a single channel strategy and set of priorities.

• Recruit, enable, and grow channel partners, building the partner base into a durable and predictable source of revenue.

• Design repeatable sales motions, including segmentation, territory design, playbooks, and stage definitions, that scale beyond individual performers.

• Establish the metrics, dashboards, and forecast discipline the go-to-market leadership team relies on to make decisions.

• Define how sales engineering supports the channel, from partner technical enablement through opportunity-level support.

• Apply AI tools to research, prospecting, partner planning, and forecasting, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

• Hire, develop, and retain sales talent; set performance expectations and coach managers and individual contributors against them.

• Partner with marketing, product, and customer success to align messaging, pricing, and roadmap input with what partners and end customers need.

• Represent Genea with senior stakeholders at partner firms and end customers, including at industry events.

Qualifications

Experience — Required

• 8–10+ years in B2B sales or business development, including at least three years leading and developing sales teams.

• Channel or partner sales experience: recruiting, enabling, and managing external partners as a durable source of revenue.

• Demonstrated record of building repeatable, programmatic sales processes rather than relying on individual performance.

• Experience carrying and delivering against a revenue number, with accountability for forecast accuracy.

• Experience building or scaling a sales function, including hiring and developing employees.

Experience — Preferred

• Selling physical security or property technology through a partner channel.

• Leading or working alongside sales engineering in a technical, solution-based sales environment.

Technical Skills — Required

• Proficiency with CRM and reporting tools; able to build and interpret pipeline and forecast dashboards without support.

• Practical experience applying AI tools to go-to-market work, and judgment about where they help and where they do not.

• Strong quantitative skills; comfortable working directly with data to diagnose performance and set targets.

Additional Skills — Required

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present credibly to executive and partner audiences.

• Willing and able to travel for customer, partner, and industry events.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation: $200,000 annual base salary / $275,000 OTE

On-target earnings reflect base salary plus variable sales compensation.

This range reflects what Genea reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer falls within the range depends on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills, and on internal equity.

Benefits

Full-time employees are eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts (FSA); life insurance; accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance; long-term disability (LTD) coverage; paid time off (PTO); and a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Eligibility is subject to plan terms and conditions.

E-Verify

Genea participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit the E-Verify website.

jobs.title: Promotional Review and Production Specialist
jobs.description:
Location:  This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Help bring accurate, high-quality materials to the people who need them. As Specialist, MLR Submissions & Production Quality Assurance, you will help move materials through Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review and into print production and distribution. Your work will make submissions easier to review and help ensure final materials match the approved content.

You will prepare submissions in Veeva RAPID, organize supporting references, and link and tag claims to source documentation. Working with marketing, medical, review teams, and agency partners, you will perform quality assurance checks in Veeva PromoMats, resolve submission and production gaps, and keep work moving with clear priorities and timely communication.

Primary Responsibilities

• Prepare complete, accurate submission packages in Veeva RAPID so MLR reviewers have the materials and supporting documentation they need to begin review.

• Upload and organize supporting references, link and tag claims to the relevant source passages, and confirm that reference annotations are complete and easy for reviewers to follow.

• Check submission details, document naming, metadata, version history, and required supporting files to ensure materials meet established process requirements.

• Partner with content owners and agencies to resolve missing references, incomplete annotations, formatting issues, and other submission gaps before review; raise unresolved issues promptly.

• Support revisions and resubmissions, maintaining accurate claim-to-reference links and confirming that updates and supporting files belong to the correct document version.

• Perform quality assurance checks on final materials in Veeva PromoMats, comparing production files against MLR-approved content and confirming that required changes have been incorporated.

• Review copy, references, footnotes, required disclosures, layout, and production details. Identify discrepancies, coordinate corrections with internal teams and production partners, and confirm resolution before release.

• Complete assigned production approval and release steps for print production and distribution, consistent with established procedures and approval authority.

• Maintain clear submission and production status, communicate priorities and risks to deadlines early, and recommend practical improvements that reduce avoidable rework and turnaround time.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

• Experience supporting biopharmaceutical promotional review, MLR submissions, editorial operations, or medical and marketing production, with examples of delivering accurate work against deadlines.

• Experience proofreading documents for print production, ensuring accuracy in spelling, grammar, punctuation, formatting, and consistency with final approved content before release to print vendors.

• Familiarity with preparing submission packages, managing references, and linking claims to supporting source documentation. Hands-on experience with Veeva PromoMats and Veeva MedProduction is required.

• Experience as an editor or medical editor, including proofreading, reference checking, and reviewing scientific or medical content, is required.

• Experience with medical production, promotional print production, or final material quality assurance, including comparing production proofs against approved content, is a plus.

• Strong attention to detail, demonstrated through identifying inconsistencies in copy, annotations, document versions, and production files and following corrections through to completion.

• Sound judgment and strong organizational skills: manage competing deadlines, make priorities visible, and ask for help or escalate issues before they put quality or delivery at risk.

• Clear, candid communication and a collaborative approach. Take ownership of your work, ask questions when requirements are unclear, and use feedback to improve how the team works.

• The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

To round out our world-class total rewards package, we provide annualized base salary in the range listed below.  This range reflects the base salary the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary

$95,000—$115,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to careers@praxismedicines.com.

Praxis does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

jobs.title: Marketing Engineer (AI Agents)

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s first Marketing Engineer (AI Agents), you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

The web platform

• Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.

• Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today.

• Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.

• Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.

• Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure

• Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.

• Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
About Us

Parabola is a workflow builder that makes it easy to organize and transform messy data from anywhere—even PDFs, emails, and spreadsheets—so that forward-thinking teams can automate the work they thought would always be manual.

Teams at fast-moving companies like Brooklinen, On Running, and Flexport use Parabola to save hundreds of hours and finally take on the projects that used to feel out of reach. Whether it’s reconciling inventory across multiple 3PLs, auditing invoices, or manually exporting the same report every Monday, Parabola gives teams the power to automate it—all without needing engineering support.

Parabola is backed by OpenView Partners, Matrix Partners, Thrive Capital and more.



About the role

The Applied AI team at Parabola is the conduit through which our largest and most strategic accounts pass through on their way to unlocking the maximum value from our product.

As an Automation Engineer on our Growth team, you will be directly responsible for partnering with key accounts post implementation to ensure value realization continues throughout their lifecycle.

Your mission is to drive sustained adoption, expansion of use cases, and measurable business impact across complex organizations. You’ll proactively monitor account usage and engagement signals, identify opportunities to deepen value, and work directly with customers to design and deploy new workflows that solve evolving business challenges.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to both technical and business stakeholders, ranging from the C-Suite to the analyst, for QBRs, workshops and building sessions.

You will own customer strategy, technical execution, stakeholder alignment, commercial renewals, and long-term success. You’ll make sure that your portfolio of growing customers continue to see Parabola as a core part of their operations.

You’ll lead with data, move fast, and operate comfortably in ambiguity while shaping how we support our most customers. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to solve customer problems and help shape what we build next.



About You

You love customers and are naturally curious about how their businesses truly work. You enjoy learning the ins and outs of their organizations, mapping company level goals to functional outcomes, and helping teams leverage automation to accelerate meaningful results.

You’re energized by meeting new teams, uncovering new use cases, learning new systems, and turning ideas into deployed, repeatable solutions. Along the way, you naturally build playbooks and best practices that scale across accounts.

You’re equally comfortable facilitating strategic conversations with senior leaders and getting your hands dirty technically. You can present confidently to executives, lead collaborative workshops, and seamlessly transition into working with APIs, prompting the latest AI models, and bringing Parabola flows to life.

You’re skilled at managing multiple initiatives at once, creating clear project plans, and maintaining momentum in complex customer environments.

Above all, you are a trusted advisor that is thoughtful, confident, and personable. You represent Parabola professionally, advocate for the customers you support, and take ownership of ensuring they continue to realize and expand value with our product.



What you'll be doing

 - Own post-implementation relationships for ~15-30 Mid-Market accounts, serving as a trusted advisor from executive sponsors to hands-on operators

 - Monitor and analyze product usage and engagement metrics to assess account health, identify risk, and surface expansion opportunities

 - Partner with customer stakeholders to map organizational goals to functional initiatives and high-impact automation use cases

 - Adapt your approach and be able to effectively context switch across the range of personas we serve, and tailor each conversation to what matters most to them

 - Quantify the value and ROI customers get from Parabola, and build frameworks to measure it consistently across your portfolio

 - Design, build, and deploy new workflows alongside customers, supporting end users through hands-on co-building and technical guidance

 - Lead QBRs, trainings, lunch-and-learns, and workshops

 - Develop and refine repeatable playbooks and best practices to drive sustained adoption across mature accounts

 - Build and maintain plans, timelines, enablement materials, and executive-facing presentations

 - Drive non-upsell renewals from start to close, handling proposals, negotiations, and the contracting process

 - Partner with Account Executives and internal Product/ Engineering teams to identify upsell opportunities, and surface actionable product feedback
   
   

What (we think) you'll need to do it

 - 2-5 years of experience in a customer-facing role, such as Technical Account Management, Technical Customer Success, Implementation Consulting, or Sales Engineering

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport across a wide range of stakeholders

 - Polished presentation and facilitation skills, including comfort presenting to executive audiences

 - Strong prioritization skills so you can focus your time where it will have the greatest impact within your book of business

 - Experienced in quantifying ROI and building business cases that clearly communicate impact and value to executive stakeholders

 - Comfort and familiarity with prompting modern AI models and applying them in real-world business contexts

 - Experience working with data and systems (Excel, SQL, and with APIs)

 - Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for breaking down complex challenges and designing effective solutions across industries

 - High ownership and intellectual curiosity with the ability to ramp rapidly in new industries, systems, and workflows

 - Based in San Francisco or New York City, with the ability to commute to the office 3–4 days per week
   
   

Nice to haves:

 - Previous experience working with AI tools

 - Previous experience working with ERPs, WMSs, TMSs (NetSuite, Uber Freight TMS, Microsoft Business Central, Blue Yonder)

 - Experience working in a project based role - i.e. consulting

 - Knowledge of supply chain fundamentals or finance/accounting

 - Previous experience working in a start up environment
   
   

OTE Range: $130,000 - $165,000

This OTE represents the minimum and maximum for this role based in San Francisco and New York. The salary given for this position is dependent on multiple factors, including years of experience, interview performance and anticipated responsibilities of the role. Our base salary is one component of Parabola’s competitive total package, which also includes equity and premium health and wellness benefits.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Discover Studio
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Software Engineer II - Discover Studio

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, capturing and making sense of human sentiment at scale is at the heart of what we do. As a Software Engineer on the XM Discover Studio team, you will build customer-facing applications, designing and crafting rich frontend experiences (and their supporting backends), that will be directly visible to customers.
