• Systems Mindset: You enjoy analyzing algorithms, data structures, and distributed architectures to identify bottlenecks and optimize performance.

How You’ll Grow

• Broadening Technical Scope: Start by taking ownership of story-level and epic-level features, with a clear path to driving broader platform initiatives and architectural decisions.

• Foster Agile Excellence: Actively participate in daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and planning poker, collaborating with teammates to unblock tasks and meet delivery commitments.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with product managers, tech-ops, and fellow engineers to turn real-world user feedback into immediate system improvements.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

• 3-5 years of relevant experience

• Strong computer science fundamentals, specifically in data structures, algorithms, and modular software design patterns

• Proven track record of applying engineering best practices, including continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD), test automation, and structured design documentation

• History of delivering impact in an agile/Scrum or XP team environment

What You Should Know About This Team

• We are an experienced, high-performing team supporting multiple web services and UIs, with disparate technology stacks as we transition off of legacy systems. If you are a self-starter, and someone who is rarely satisfied with maintaining the status quo, you will thrive.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

• Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical/Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.

To help achieve these efforts, Stratolaunch is seeking a Sr. Mechanical/Structural Engineer to support the development of an air-launched hypersonic flight vehicle development program. This position will include conceptualizing components, sizing and analyzing components, generating CAD model parts and assemblies, creating margin reports, detailed design, and supporting the manufacturing effort. In addition, this position will support the Talon-A structures lead with team guidance and mentorship.  You are responsible for contributing to the vehicle’s structural technical performance, including meeting design and mission requirements, resolving technical challenges, and implementing technology upgrades that improve the competitive basis of the Talon-A hypersonic vehicle architecture.

• Work hand in hand with the program responsible engineers, Payload Lead, and Talon-A Chief Engineer.

• Be responsible for making technical decisions for the structures subsystem.

• Lead the successful execution of structural design reviews to advance the program vehicles through manufacturing and flight test.

• Lead a structural systems engineering approach, which may include creating and dispositioning structural requirements, managing mass properties, guiding the configuration management of models, reviewing and approving documents, reports, and analyses, setting engineering and design best practices and standards for the structures team, waiving or approving ground testing based on structural technical risk assessments, etc.

• Experience with structures design and manufacturing.

• Ability to work on your own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals.

jobs.title: AI Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s first AI Growth Engineer, you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

The web platform

• Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.

• Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today.

• Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.

• Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.

• Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure

• Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.

• Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

• Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.

• Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.

• Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

• Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar.

• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.

• A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.

• High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.

• Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

• Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.

• Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

Nice To Have

• Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement.

• Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory.

• Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K  + Equity

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

jobs.title: Environmental Health & Safety Engineer (Satellites)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH & SAFETY ENGINEER (SATELLITES)

As part of the SpaceX Satellites Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) team, you will play a pivotal role in providing technical EHS support to our satellite manufacturing teams. You will provide technical expertise and assist in the implementation of all environmental, health and safety to our satellite and dish manufacturing teams. The ideal candidate is highly skilled with both environmental and occupational safety fields, hands-on, and works well in a fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Work closely with test engineers and technician teams to perform detailed safety reviews of complex hazardous operations to ensure safe execution

• Lead or assist in all aspects of incident investigations, including initial follow-up, root cause analysis, and corrective action development and closure

• Develop and maintain compliance with all applicable regulations and/or guidelines established by OSHA, NFPA, and NIOSH and other applicable regulatory agencies

• Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures

• Implement and develop safety and health programs including but not limited to:

• OSHA general industry and construction standards

• HAZCOM, hazmat, cryogenics, compressed gases

• Confined space, fall protection and lock-out/tag-out

• Radiation and laser safety

• Develop safety solutions to resolve EHS hazards/ concerns within cost and schedule constraints following a safety order of precedence to include elimination, substitution, engineering controls, work practice controls, training, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure that safety of personnel, property, and the environment are within acceptable risk boundaries

• Monitor employee exposure to physical and chemical hazards

• Inspect facilities, machinery, and safety equipment to identify and correct potential hazards and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations

• Develop, implement, and maintain safety contingency plans (fires, spills, etc.)

• Develop and maintain compliance with all applicable regulations established by the EPA, CERCLA, RCRA, DOT, ATF, TCEQ, TRRC and other applicable regulatory agencies

• Perform environmental compliance and due diligence audits to ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory agencies

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree

• 3+ years of experience in the design, development and operational oversight of environmental, health and safety disciplines

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• A dedication to the mission of making humanity multiplanetary

• A sense of curiosity for how things work

• High level of emotional intelligence and ability to adapt communication styles with all levels of the company

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)

• Proven track record of strong organizational skills and multi-tasking capabilities

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Experience and/or education in construction safety

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to lift up to 30 lbs. unassisted

• Willing to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain, wind

• Willingness to work extended hours when needed to meet critical deadlines

• Ability to pass relevant USCG examinations, federal facility background checks, re-certifications, and chemical testing

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Position occasionally requires the ability to work extended hours and weekends when needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $95,000.00 - $130,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: Fraud Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARDLESS

Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes.

In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year-end 2026.

We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Fraud Strategy Manager to lead the strategy for how we evaluate and respond to transactions across our credit card portfolio. This analytical, strategy-focused role sits at the heart of how Cardless protects cardholders and manages fraud losses while keeping the card experience smooth for legitimate customers.

Reporting to our Chief Risk Officer, you’ll shape transaction decisioning, account takeover and payment controls, and our response to coordinated fraud events. You’ll work closely with data science, product, engineering, compliance, and operations, and your work will directly shape how millions of cardholders experience our partners’ cards. The role is a great fit for someone who enjoys turning data into clear decisions and collaborating across teams to put them into practice.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Transaction decisioning: Lead the framework for approve, decline, and step-up decisions across all Cardless-issued cards, balancing fraud prevention with authorization rates and cardholder experience. Partner with data science to turn model scores into thresholds, segmentation, and policy.

 - Account takeover and account changes: Design detection and authentication controls for credential compromise, SIM swap, and social engineering, and for sensitive changes like address, phone, email, and card reissue, while keeping self-service easy for legitimate cardholders.

 - Payment risk: Set the strategy for placing and releasing holds on ACH payments and balance transfers, detect patterns like funding fraud and bust-out behavior, and define clear timelines and communication for customers.

 - Coordinated fraud events: Build real-time monitoring and response plans for BIN attacks, merchant compromises, and fraud rings, coordinate the response with operations, product, and network partners, and lead post-event reviews.

 - Measurement: Define fraud KPIs (fraud, false positive, decline, ATO, and chargeback rates), run regular portfolio reviews, and build reporting that supports quick policy updates.

 - Partnership: Translate strategy into system requirements with product and engineering, ensure controls meet Reg E, Reg Z, network rules, and UDAAP with compliance and legal, and support dispute and ATO recovery workflows with customer operations.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in transaction fraud strategy at a card issuer, fintech, payments network, or financial institution.

 - Experience with transaction fraud decisioning across card-not-present, card-present, account takeover, payment fraud, and coordinated fraud events.

 - Working knowledge of Visa, Mastercard, or Amex network rules, including authorization, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud monitoring programs.

 - Familiarity with payment hold strategy and funding fraud patterns such as ACH returns, payment reversals, and bust-out behavior.

 - SQL skills and experience using data to build, evaluate, and tune fraud rules and models.

 - Clear communication, including the ability to explain fraud tradeoffs and recommendations to executives, network partners, and compliance teams.

 - A collaborative, proactive approach: you’re comfortable acting on incomplete information, asking good questions, and bringing teams together around a decision.


COMPENSATION

This role has an annual starting salary range of $150,000-$210,000 + equity. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, and specific work location.




BENEFITS

We're proud to offer our team excellent benefits:

💸 Meaningful Start-up equity

🏥 100% health, vision & dental primary coverage

➕ 75% health, vision & dental dependent coverage

🍱 Catered lunches

🚎 $250/month Commuter benefit

👶 Parental leave

✈️ Team building events & happy hours

🌴 Flexible PTO with a minimum of 15 days off per year

🖥️ Apple equipment

💸 401k plan

 


LOCATION

We're headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a beautiful office in Jackson Square. We’re in the office at least three days a week, and most of us are there more than that, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s genuinely excited to be there alongside the team.



Cardless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Financial Aid Assistant (Stepful College)
jobs.description:
About Stepful:



Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.


Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.


Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.


Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-55m-series-c-to-scale-its-ai-powered-training-platform-across-the-healthcare-workforce. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025 https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list.



Our values:



We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

 - Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

 - Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.

 - Build together: We win when we rely on each other.

 - Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.



The opportunity:

At Stepful College https://stepfulcollege.edu/about/, an ABHES-accredited institution, our students are working towards launching new careers in healthcare, and our Financial Aid Assistant helps make that possible. In this role, you’ll be a friendly, steady guide for students from their first days of enrollment all the way through graduation.



The Financial Aid Assistant is often one of the first people a new student talks to. You’ll help them through the FAFSA, loan paperwork, and payment plans, explain things in plain language, and make sure they feel supported every step of the way. Our Financial Aid office is a small, close-knit team of two, so the work you do makes a real difference. You’ll get new students’ files across the finish line, answer payment questions with patience and care, and help students who’ve fallen behind find a path forward so they can stay enrolled. You’ll have structured onboarding and regular one-on-ones as you learn the ropes, plus support as you grow into handling day-to-day decisions on your own.



This is a full-time, hourly position based onsite at our Fenton, Missouri campus, Monday through Friday. This role reports to the Senior Financial Aid Administrator.



What you’ll do:



New Student Financial Aid

 - Partner closely with our Admissions team to ensure a smooth hand-off for newly enrolled students, so they feel welcomed and supported from day one

 - Welcome newly enrolled students by phone and email, and guide them through each step of the financial aid process

 - Help students complete the FAFSA and confirm it has been submitted and received

 - Review NSLDS to confirm students’ eligibility and prior aid history

 - Walk students through required documents in CampusIvy, including entrance counseling, the Master Promissory Note (MPN), and verification items

 - Track each new student’s file and follow up so it stays on schedule



Payment Plans & Collections

 - Set up payment plans and explain balances, estimates, and how payments are applied in clear, plain language

 - Send payment reminders and past-due notices on schedule, and respond to every payment-plan inquiry in writing

 - Work the past-due report: reach out to students who have fallen behind, set up payment arrangements, and follow through to resolution

 - Apply college policy to delinquent accounts, and escalate complex situations to the Senior Financial Aid Administrator with the details already gathered



Records, Compliance & Team Support

 - Document student interactions and account activity in our student information system (Anthology) and CampusIvy

 - Keep student files accurate, complete, and audit-ready, in line with Title IV, FERPA, and college requirements

 - Run and review basic financial aid and student account reports in Excel

 - Support the Financial Aid and Student Accounts teams during busy periods like new starts, disbursements, and graduation



What you’ll bring:

 - 2–4 years of professional office experience

 - Strong customer service skills: you’re patient, clear, and empathetic, including when conversations are about money

 - A quick learner who’s comfortable picking up new systems and processes

 - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including pivot tables) and Word/Google Docs

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through

 - Discretion and good judgment when handling confidential student information

 - High school diploma or GED required

 - Availability to work onsite in Fenton, Missouri, Monday through Friday



Bonus points if:

 - You have experience in financial aid, student accounts, billing, or collections

 - You’re familiar with CampusIvy, Anthology/CampusNexus, or NSLDS

 - You’ve worked at a career college, a vocational school, or in healthcare education



Interview Process:

 - Introductory call with Talent Acquisition

 - Interview with Hiring Manager

 - Take-Home Assignment

 - Final Onsite Interviews



Benefits and Compensation:

 - Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plan options

 - 401(k)

 - FSA, HSA and commuter benefits

 - Learning stipend

 - Open vacation policy, including:
   
   - Guidance of 15 days PTO annually
   
   - 10 public holidays observed for 2026



Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an @stepful.com email address to guide you through our interview process.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Accountant
jobs.description:
Who We Are & What We’re Building

At Goodwin, we build tech for companies that sell private charter flights. We work with charter brokers who manage client relationships, price trips, secure aircraft owned by operators, and keep complex itineraries moving under constant time pressure. Much of that work still depends on manual coordination across emails, spreadsheets, and phone calls, especially when matching client requests with the right aircraft.

Our tech gives brokers clearer visibility, faster workflows, and better control over their day-to-day work, so they can serve clients confidently as their businesses grow. In a detail-driven, high-responsibility industry where judgment matters and mistakes are costly, it helps reduce friction and brings clarity to complex charter workflows.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio with distributed talent across the US, Goodwin is on a fast-growth trajectory as we redefine private aviation technology from the ground up.

Why This Role Exists

Every flight booked through Goodwin generates financial activity that needs to be processed accurately, reconciled quickly, and monitored carefully.

As our Payment Operations Accountant, you'll help ensure the financial engine behind our platform runs smoothly. You'll own the day-to-day accounting operations that keep payments moving, books accurate, and financial controls strong while partnering closely with our Head of Finance and collaborating with international teammates who support our accounting operations.

What You’ll Work On

• Process high volumes of accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions accurately and efficiently.

• Perform daily ledger reconciliations and investigate discrepancies to ensure financial accuracy.

• Monitor payment systems for unusual activity, fraud risks, and compliance with internal controls.

• Support treasury and payment operations across multiple banking and fintech platforms.

• Collaborate with international accounting contractors to ensure timely and accurate financial processing.

• Help improve accounting workflows and identify opportunities to make financial operations more scalable.

• Maintain accurate financial records within QuickBooks, ERP systems, and Excel-based reporting.

• Support month-end close activities and other operational accounting initiatives as the company grows.

How You’ll Know You’re Succeeding

• The Head of Finance never has to wonder whether the day-to-day accounting operations are under control. She knows you've got them handled accurately and consistently.

• Payments are processed on time, reconciliations stay current, and discrepancies are identified before they become bigger problems.

• You can confidently manage a high volume of transactions without sacrificing accuracy or attention to detail.

• You spot opportunities to improve processes and help make our accounting operations more scalable as Goodwin grows.

• Our payment systems remain well-monitored, with strong controls that help prevent fraud and ensure compliance.

• Your teammates know they can count on you to communicate clearly, solve problems, and keep financial operations moving.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in high-volume accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, or payment operations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field?

• Understanding of cost accounting principles.

• Experience with fraud prevention, compliance, chargebacks, or payment risk management.

• Experience working with banking platforms, treasury systems, payment processors, or fintech platforms.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and QuickBooks

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to improving processes.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teammates across different countries and time zones.

• Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Range

• This position has an anticipated annual base salary range of $50,000–$70,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location, where applicable.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Technical Program Manager

Madison, WI

Role Overview

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex software programs across Commerce Services & Client Experiences within the PlayStation ecosystem. Working closely with engineering, product, design, and quality teams, you will help deliver reliable, scalable services and intuitive experiences that connect players with digital content.

You will bring clarity to evolving requirements, build actionable delivery plans, and coordinate execution across multiple teams. This role combines hands-on program leadership with technical understanding, strong judgment, and the ability to build trust and influence without direct authority. You will help teams navigate competing priorities and technical dependencies while keeping customer needs and business outcomes in focus.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own end-to-end delivery of complex technical programs across multiple engineering teams, driving alignment on outcomes, scope, milestones, dependencies, and launch readiness.

• Partner with engineering leads, product, and design to clarify requirements, drive technical alignment, surface integration and operational risks, and translate requirements into a sequenced delivery plan.

• Build and maintain delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies, working with engineering leads to account for team capacity and sequencing.

• Drive cross-team planning and alignment, facilitating the discussions and working sessions needed to make decisions and maintain progress.

• Manage dependencies across client experiences, backend services, and supporting platforms, ensuring integration points and handoffs are understood and coordinated.

• Identify delivery risks early, drive mitigation and recovery plans, and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations.

• Work with product and engineering partners to resolve competing priorities and make informed trade-offs across scope, timing, quality, and technical constraints.

• Coordinate with engineering, quality, and release partners to support integration testing, issue prioritization, and launch readiness.

• Communicate program progress, risks, and business impact clearly to technical partners and business stakeholders, highlighting decisions needed and presenting clear options and recommendations.

• Improve execution across teams by introducing practical changes to processes and tools, measuring their effectiveness, and incorporating feedback.

What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 6+ years of technical program or project management experience delivering software products, online services, or consumer-facing experiences.

• Demonstrated success leading programs across multiple engineering teams, including managing dependencies, aligning priorities, and coordinating releases.

• Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience supporting requirements definition, planning, development, testing, and deployment.

• Technical understanding of APIs, distributed services, and client-server integration, with the ability to engage engineers on design considerations, implementation trade-offs, and delivery implications.

• Experience partnering with product and engineering to clarify ambiguous requirements, break down complex work, and manage changes in scope.

• Practical experience with Agile methodologies, including facilitating planning and delivery activities and using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

• Strong planning and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess capacity constraints, anticipate risks, and adjust plans as conditions change.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues and present actionable recommendations to different audiences.

• Proven ability to build trust, resolve disagreements constructively, and influence partners without direct authority.

• Strong ownership and judgment, balancing attention to detail with an understanding of customer and business impact.

• Experience working effectively with geographically distributed teams across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with digital commerce capabilities such as storefronts, product catalogs, checkout, payments, subscriptions, or entitlements.

• Experience delivering customer journeys that span client applications and backend services.

• Familiarity with the reliability, scalability, security, and privacy considerations of high-volume consumer services.

• Prior experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or quality engineering.

• Experience coordinating service integrations, platform migrations, or releases across multiple client surfaces.

• Familiarity with gaming, digital entertainment, or other large-scale consumer technology environments.

jobs.title: SEO Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
THE POSITION
Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is seeking an SEO Marketing Associate to drive organic growth for FanDuel’s sportsbook, casino and marketing websites. In this role, you will lead search engine optimization to grow organic traffic and acquisition, while building a growing focus on generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) so FanDuel is found, cited, and recommended in AI platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini. You will collaborate closely with Content, Product, Marketing, Legal/Compliance, and Analytics teams to shape how customers find and engage with FanDuel across search engines, LLM platforms.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Lead SEO strategy for FanDuel’s websites to increase organic traffic, non-brand acquisition, and brand visibility across casino and sports casino

• Conduct keyword, topic, and competitive research to inform content creation, updates, and roadmap priorities

• Partner with writers, editors, product managers, and designers to optimize content for organic discovery from brief through publication

• Manage content calendars and page-level optimizations aligned with major sports seasons, live events, and business goals

• Audit and improve on-page and technical SEO elements (meta tags, headers, internal linking, crawlability, page speed, etc.)

• Develop GEO and AEO strategies to improve visibility in AI Overviews, LLM-powered search, and answer engines, including answer-ready content formats such as FAQs, concise definitions, and comparison and how-to guides

• Strengthen entity signals and brand authority across the web, including structured data (Schema.org/JSON-LD), consistent product information, and third-party mentions

• Build and track visibility in AI platforms, measuring how FanDuel is mentioned, cited, and described, and translating findings into content and product priorities

• Monitor and report on performance using Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, app store analytics, and emerging AI visibility tools, translating data into clear recommendations

• Stay on top of search, & AI algorithm updates and evolving platform behavior

• Collaborate with engineering, analytics, and legal/compliance teams on technical SEO initiatives, A/B testing, and responsible content standards for regulated products

THE STATS
What we’re looking for in our teammate

• 2–3+ years of experience in SEO, digital content marketing, or editorial SEO operations

• Deep understanding of SEO fundamentals including keyword targeting, content structure, and technical hygiene

• Working knowledge of GEO and AEO, including how LLMs and answer engines retrieve, synthesize, and cite web content, and how to measure visibility within them

• Demonstrated success growing search traffic through editorial, sports, gaming, or other high-volume consumer content

• Familiarity with major SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in cross-functional or editorial environments

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Ability to synthesize SEO, GEO, & AEO insights into actionable strategies

• Passion for digital media, sports, iGaming, and prediction markets

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in fast-paced editorial, newsroom, or sports media environments

• Hands-on experience optimizing for AI search, such as structuring content for AI Overviews, testing prompts across LLM platforms, or tracking AI citations and referral traffic

• Experience with app store analytics tools or running ASO experiments on app store listings

• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and structured data markup (Schema.org, JSON-LD)

• Understanding of conversion rate optimization and A/B testing frameworks

• Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Asana, or other project management tools

• Knowledge of sports betting, online casino games (slots, table games, live dealer, etc.), or prediction market products, or experience in the sports/gaming industry

• Exposure to legal/regulatory compliance standards in digital publishing, gaming, or prediction markets

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS
We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, “We are One Team!”. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

The applicable hourly range for this position is $35.10 - $43.75 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. jobs.title: Senior Copywriter
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are

You are a conceptual creative who understands that great brand work begins with a great idea and is brought to life through exceptional craft. You excel at turning business objectives, customer insights, and brand strategy into integrated campaign concepts that work across every channel and touchpoint. You are equally comfortable shaping a creative brief alongside Strategy as you are writing a manifesto, a film script, or a single line that defines a campaign.

You are an uncommon combination of big-picture thinker and meticulous writer. You approach every project with 360-degree campaign thinking, building ideas that are flexible enough to live across film, social, digital, out-of-home, web, and live experiences, and focused enough to remain clear and recognizable in each one. Copy is your craft, and you hold it to a high standard.

As Senior Copywriter, you will contribute to anything and everything that represents the Justworks brand. Projects range from brand campaigns and product films to conceptual website copy and fully realized brand experiences. You will lead projects from strategy through final copy, and you will collaborate closely with filmmakers, strategists, designers, animators, and producers to bring your creative vision to life.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

Campaign Concepting & Creative Leadership

• Develop original, integrated campaign concepts that translate brand strategy into distinctive, memorable creative work.

• Lead projects from initial brief through concept development, production, and launch, maintaining the integrity of the idea throughout.

• Create campaign lines, headline systems, and creative platforms that teams across Marketing can build from.

• Present and defend creative work to senior stakeholders, articulating the strategic rationale behind each idea.

Strategy & Creative Development

• Partner with Brand Strategy to sharpen insights, define audiences, and shape creative briefs.

• Explore and develop multiple creative territories, and recommend the strongest direction based on strategy and business objectives.

• Translate Justworks' positioning and brand narrative into creative work that resonates with small and medium-sized business owners.

Copywriting Across Channels

• Write across a broad range of formats, including manifestos, film and video scripts, voiceover, social, digital, out-of-home, website copy, and experiential.

• Produce both long-form and short-form copy with consistent quality, clarity, and voice.

• Write for the ear as well as the page, ensuring copy performs when read aloud, timed to an edit, or animated on screen.

• Uphold and elevate the Justworks brand voice across every piece of work.

Collaboration & Production

• Collaborate with directors, editors, animators, designers, and producers to bring concepts to life across film, motion, and live experiences.

• Write treatments and scripts that inspire production partners and give them a clear creative direction.

• Participate in shoots, edits, and creative reviews to ensure the final work reflects the original idea.

• Partner with Brand Experience, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Content, Social, and Communications to extend campaigns across channels.

Creative Innovation

• Explore emerging formats, platforms, and technologies that create new opportunities for brand storytelling.

• Use AI tools to expand creative exploration and accelerate ideation, while applying strong editorial judgment to the final work.

• Bring new ideas and perspectives to the creative team, raising the bar for conceptual and written craft.

How You Will Do Your Work

As a Senior Copywriter, your success is measured by the strength of your ideas, the quality of your craft, and your ability to lead creative work from concept to completion. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following:

• Conceptual thinking – develops original ideas that are rooted in strategy and built to work across channels

• Craft excellence – writes with precision, clarity, and a distinctive voice across every format

• Integrated campaign thinking – builds ideas that hold together across film, social, digital, web, out-of-home, and experiential

• Project leadership – guides creative work from strategy through production with clarity and accountability

• Collaboration – works closely with creative and production partners, and makes the work stronger through shared vision

• Presentation and influence – presents creative work persuasively and builds confidence with senior stakeholders

• Judgment and resilience – knows when to protect an idea and when to evolve it in response to feedback

• AI fluency – understands how AI tools can support creative exploration, and applies human judgment where it matters most

In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:

• Camaraderie – Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You're an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.

• Openness – Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You're curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit – You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You're committed and earnest and dive in to get the job done with a positive attitude.

• Integrity – Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You're honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity – Be like Einstein: "Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler."

Qualifications

• 7–10 years of copywriting experience at an agency or in-house creative team

• A portfolio of integrated, multi-channel campaigns, with clear examples of ideas you originated

• Demonstrated range across brand campaigns, product storytelling, website copy, and experiential work

• Experience leading projects through strategy and creative development, not solely execution

• Film and motion experience, including close collaboration with directors, editors, and animators from script to final cut

• Exceptional long-form and short-form writing skills, with a strong ear for cadence and voice

• Strong presentation skills and the ability to sell in and steward creative work through stakeholder review

• Experience working with external production companies, agencies, and creative partners

• Comfort with ambiguity and evolving priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

• Familiarity with AI tools in the creative process, or a strong learning orientation

• Experience in B2B or SMB-facing brands is a plus

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $131,000.00 to $169,000.00 per year.

#Hybrid #LI-DW1

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks.

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at accommodations@justworks.com. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Mixpanel's Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) team is hiring a Security Engineer to run the day-to-day work of our security operations: vulnerability management, detection and monitoring, and incident response. You'll work closely with engineering teams to find and close real risk, tune our detections so every alert is worth investigating, and use AI to make triage and investigation faster. This is a hands-on role for an engineer early to mid-way in their career, with a defined path to Senior Security Engineer.

Responsibilities

• Vulnerability management: Triage findings from vulnerability scanners, penetration tests, bug bounty reports, and dependency tooling. Validate exploitability and impact in our environment, and assign severity accordingly.

• Remediation with engineering: Work with engineering teams to agree on fixes and timelines, track each vulnerability through to closure within SLA, and escalate items at risk of missing it.

• Detection and monitoring: Build, tune, and maintain detections in our SIEM across cloud, identity, endpoint, and application logs, and cut false positives so on-call time goes to real threats.

• AI-assisted security operations: Use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to speed up alert triage, enrich investigations, write and test detection logic, and automate repetitive SecOps work.

• Incident response: Investigate and respond to security incidents from first alert through containment, eradication, and recovery, and write clear post-incident reviews with follow-up actions.

• Coverage and runbooks: Identify gaps in log sources and detection coverage, onboard new sources, and keep runbooks current so the team responds consistently.

• On-call: Take part in the security on-call rotation.

We're Looking For Someone With

• 3-5 years of experience in security engineering, security operations, detection and response, or a related role

• Hands-on vulnerability management experience, including triaging and validating scanner and pentest findings and working with engineers to remediate them

• Experience working in a SIEM (e.g. Splunk, Google SecOps/Chronicle, Panther, Elastic), including writing queries and building or tuning detections

• Experience investigating and responding to security incidents

• Understanding of common attack techniques and how to detect them, for example using MITRE ATT&CK

• Working knowledge of cloud security in GCP or AWS, including IAM, audit logging, and common misconfigurations

• Scripting skills in Python, Go, or a similar language to automate tasks and work with log data

• Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to automate security workflows, or a strong interest in building that skill

• Sound judgment on severity and risk, including knowing when to escalate and when an issue can wait

• Ability to explain security issues clearly to engineers and get fixes prioritized without slowing teams down unnecessarily

• Strong written communication and follow-through, with the ability to manage many concurrent items and work independently

Nice to Have

• Experience with detection-as-code (e.g. Sigma rules, version-controlled detections with CI testing)

• Experience with EDR tools (e.g. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne)

• Experience with SOAR or workflow automation platforms (e.g. Tines, Torq)

• Experience with Kubernetes and container security

• Experience running or supporting a bug bounty program

• GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, OSCP, or similar certification

What Success Looks Like

• First 3 months: You understand our environment, log sources, and vulnerability pipeline, triage incoming findings and alerts on your own, and have joined the on-call rotation.

• By 6 months: You own the vulnerability triage queue end-to-end, have tuned our noisiest detections to reduce false positives, and have led the response to incidents.

• By 12 months: You've shipped at least one AI-assisted workflow that measurably reduces triage or investigation time, added detections for coverage gaps you identified, and are taking on larger projects as you grow toward Senior Security Engineer.

Growth Path

This role is part of a defined security engineering career path. As you build experience, you can grow into Senior Security Engineer, where you'll set the direction of our detection and response program, lead complex incidents, and design security improvements with engineering teams.

Compensation

The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here.

Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.

Mixpanel Compensation Range

$160,000—$210,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

jobs.title: Staff Materials Development Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

You are an innovative and results-driven scientist with a passion for pushing the boundaries of clean energy technology. You are a creative, diligent, resourceful, and hands-on technical contributor dedicated to driving critical initiatives for our input materials. You have a strong background in polymer chemistry and/or material science, synthesis, and characterization of advanced materials. Your ability to interpret and utilize analytical data will be key to driving design improvements and optimizing cost-effective precursor materials. You approach challenges methodically, employing strong analytics skills to assess complex problems and develop effective, data driven solutions. You are excited to combine a mix of theoretical and empirical knowledge and reduce to practice concepts developed in the laboratory and take them to commercial scale production.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Identify, evaluate, and process feedstocks for generating high-purity porous carbons.

• Design and execute material studies to optimize the thermal conversion processes of precursors into high-quality porous carbons.

• Utilize internal and external experimental data, statistical techniques, and design of experiment (DOE) to develop process-properties-performance models and define material specifications.

• Work with external partners to optimize raw material properties and processes to meet our performance targets.

• Collaborate with technical leads and adjacent groups to establish product development standards and set technical specifications.

• Proactively identify safety hazards and work cooperatively to implement improvements.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

• Degree in Chemistry, Material Science, or equivalent with minimum of 8+ years (Bachelor’s degree), 6+ years (Master’s degree), or 4+ years (Ph.D.) of industry experience.

• Extensive hands-on experience transforming precursors into porous carbons and a strong background in polymer and carbon analytical characterization techniques.

• Experience synthesizing materials, characterizing properties and measuring impact of properties on product / device performance. Familiarity with electrochemical testing is preferred.

• Track record of bringing new processes and products from concept phase through New Product Introduction (NPI) a plus.

• Proficiency in statistical analysis, knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

• Pass a respirator fit test and be able to wear respiratory protection on a periodic basis.

• Wear personal protective equipment including, but not limited to, a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, and steel toe safety shoes on a periodic basis.

• Move items up to 25 lbs with the assistance of lift equipment and carts.

• Move long distances (such as from building to building) and be stationary for extended periods of time.

• Operate a computer and other office equipment, such as a laptop, copier/printer, etc in a fixed location.

Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 6:00pm

Valued Experience

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

About the Position

The Associate Civil Engineer – Renewable Civil performs defined civil engineering assignments for utility-scale solar, wind, battery energy storage, substation, and related renewable infrastructure projects. This role develops calculations, models, specifications, reports, and design packages and coordinates assigned work with designers, project managers, clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams. In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in the essential functions outlined below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Perform civil engineering design and analysis for site planning, grading, drainage, roads, stormwater, erosion and sediment control, earthwork, utilities, permitting, and related project scopes.

• Develop and review civil calculations, models, specifications, reports, drawings, cost estimates, schedules, and design documentation for defined assignments.

• Use AutoCAD Civil 3D and related engineering tools to develop surfaces, grading, corridors, profiles, quantities, and design deliverables.

• Perform hydrology and stormwater analyses, basin design, SWPPPs, BMPs, and supporting documentation using established criteria.

• Research, interpret, and implement applicable codes, standards, agency requirements, client criteria, permits, and project specifications.

• Evaluate site constraints, renewable facility layouts, equipment technology inputs, constructability, and multidisciplinary design impacts.

Venues succeed when information moves quickly and accurately. jobs.title: Staff/Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Federal
jobs.location: Seattle, WA or McLean, VA (Preferred) or Remote (USA)
jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role

As a Staff/Senior Staff Technical Program Manager at Trase, you will own technical program execution dedicated to Red Cell Federal (RCF) and Red Cell Partners (RCP) incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt and operate Trase OS in their own environments. You will turn partner requirements into secure, reliable deployments and sustained operational support, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

You will work with a dedicated team of full-stack software engineers and DevOps/SRE engineers, partnering closely with Trase Platform Engineering, Product, GRC, and RCF/RCP technical leaders. Your scope spans partner onboarding, integrations, environment readiness, releases, and ongoing support for RCF and RCP portfolio companies.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will drive decisions, resolve dependencies, and hold delivery commitments accountable from initial request through validated customer acceptance.

Scope of Responsibilities

• Own RCF/RCP program delivery: translate ambiguous requests into scoped user stories, acceptance criteria, owners, dependencies, and small, testable milestones. Confirm feasibility with engineers before committing dates.

• Establish a single intake and prioritized backlog with Product and RCF/RCP counterparts. Distinguish production blockers, security obligations, and committed customer needs from exploratory requests; keep partner-facing plans aligned with engineering execution.

• Drive secure deployment readiness across customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Track infrastructure prerequisites, access, networking, secrets, model-provider integrations, and end-to-end workflow validation.

• Partner with GRC and security owners to incorporate applicable RMF/ATO, STIG, and impact-level requirements into delivery plans. Drive engineering remediation, evidence readiness, and approval dependencies while maintaining clear Trase/RCF/RCP responsibility boundaries.

• Coordinate release and image handoffs, including versioning, compatibility, vulnerability scan results, software bills of materials, release manifests, deployment guides, and rollback readiness. Verify readiness before partner delivery.

• Drive ongoing support for federal deployments, including Second Front where applicable: track patching, hardening, upgrades, security findings, and sustainment commitments with named engineering and GRC owners.

• Coordinate partner issue triage and technical escalations across the dedicated team and shared platform teams. Drive closure of integration, performance, reliability, and observability gaps against agreed acceptance criteria.

• Build repeatable onboarding and operational handoffs through runbooks, architecture and data-flow documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so partner teams can operate and repeat deployments.

• Run planning, grooming, delivery reviews, and risk escalation. Give technical and executive stakeholders clear visibility into commitments, capacity, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions; surface reusable partner needs for the core platform roadmap.

Staff / Sr. Staff Expectations

• Staff: independently lead complex RCF/RCP programs across engineering, security, operations, and partner teams; resolve ambiguity and drive measurable delivery and operational outcomes.

• Senior Staff: lead a portfolio of interdependent RCF/RCP programs; shape the engagement and delivery model, influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leaders, and establish practices that scale across partner deployments.

Required Qualifications

• U.S. citizenship is required. Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, as required by assigned programs.

• 8–10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or related technical delivery roles, with demonstrated Staff-level scope; broader multi-program leadership and organizational influence for Sr. Staff.

• Track record of delivering complex software, infrastructure, or platform programs to external customers, including secure or regulated environments.

• Strong technical judgment and experience leading cross-team execution, prioritization, risk management, and customer-facing escalations under ambiguity.

• Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, security specialists, partner teams, and executives, including the ability to challenge unclear requirements and negotiate realistic commitments.

Technical Depth

• Understand distributed systems, APIs, agent workflows, and integration boundaries well enough to inspect technical plans, challenge assumptions, and lead tradeoff discussions.

• Experience with cloud and/or on-premises deployments, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, networking, identity/access, and secrets management.

• Working familiarity with secure software delivery, vulnerability remediation, audit logging, observability, and operational readiness.

• Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into engineering deliverables and validation evidence in partnership with GRC.

Strongly Preferred

• Prior TPM experience supporting national security, defense, federal agencies, or other government programs, including work with government customers and delivery partners.

• An active U.S. government security clearance.

• Experience navigating RMF/ATO processes, STIG hardening, POA&M remediation tracking, or DoD IL4/IL5/IL6 environments.

• Experience with Second Front or comparable federal deployment platforms, government cloud environments, and ongoing support of authorized systems.

• Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, agent integrations, or developer tools across multiple partner organizations.

Working Style

• High ownership, sound judgment, and proactive follow-through.

• Comfortable moving between technical detail and executive decisions.

• Practical, collaborative, and focused on customer outcomes and repeatable delivery.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

jobs.title: Junior Accountant
jobs.description:
Who We Are & What We’re Building

At Goodwin, we build tech for companies that sell private charter flights. We work with charter brokers who manage client relationships, price trips, secure aircraft owned by operators, and keep complex itineraries moving under constant time pressure. Much of that work still depends on manual coordination across emails, spreadsheets, and phone calls, especially when matching client requests with the right aircraft.

Our tech gives brokers clearer visibility, faster workflows, and better control over their day-to-day work, so they can serve clients confidently as their businesses grow. In a detail-driven, high-responsibility industry where judgment matters and mistakes are costly, it helps reduce friction and brings clarity to complex charter workflows.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio with distributed talent across the US, Goodwin is on a fast-growth trajectory as we redefine private aviation technology from the ground up.

Why This Role Exists

Behind every successful finance team is someone who keeps the details organized, accurate, and moving forward.

As our Junior Accountant, you'll help maintain the financial records and day-to-day accounting operations that allow our business to run smoothly. You'll work closely with our Head of Finance to keep transactions organized, reconciliations current, company records accurate, and compliance activities on track. Your work will create the strong operational foundation that supports Goodwin's continued growth.

What You’ll Work On

• Record and categorize financial transactions accurately and in a timely manner.

• Organize and maintain accounting records, financial documentation, and company files

• Perform reconciliations and investigate discrepancies to help ensure accurate financial reporting
