• Requires ability to lift up to 50 lbs to torso level.

In accordance with any local and state compensation laws, the compensation listed is the current estimated range for the position. Final offer details and future compensation may be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to, geographic location, market compensation data, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this please discuss with your recruiter during the interview process.

Pay Range

$20—$20 USD

BENEFITS

Cresco Labs is proud to offer eligible employees a robust offering of benefits including, major medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(K)-match program, FSA/HSA programs, LTD/STD options, life insurance and AD&D.  We also offer eligible employees paid holidays and paid time off.  Other rewards may include annual discretionary bonuses, stock options as well as participation in our employee discount program. Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older to apply

• Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• The company does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:

Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com

Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.

We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.

If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Fire Protection - BESS
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

About the Position

Lead fire protection engineering, code compliance, hazard mitigation, and life safety design for utility-scale and commercial/industrial BESS projects from conceptual design and permitting through detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations support. Serve as technical lead and Engineer of Record, where applicable, and help develop internal BESS fire protection standards, tools, and best practices.

Coordinate with multi-disciplinary design teams, clients, owners, OEMs, AHJs, fire departments, insurers, contractors, and independent engineers.

Salary Range: $135,000 - $190,000 / year

The salary range above is based upon the Denver, Colorado labor market. Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated impact in similar executive support and operational coordination roles.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead BESS fire protection design, code reviews, hazard mitigation, and life safety evaluations.

• Serve as Fire Protection Engineer of Record, where required, for fire protection, life safety, hazard mitigation, and code compliance deliverables.

• Develop/review design criteria, basis of design documents, code analyses, Hazard Mitigation Analyses, fire protection narratives, specifications, permitting packages, and Emergency Response Plans.

• Evaluate BESS layouts for code compliance, fire department access, separation distances, exposure protection, deflagration hazards, ventilation, gas detection, egress, and water supply.

• Review UL 9540A reports, listings, manufacturer data, battery chemistry information, fire propagation data, gas generation data, and equipment fire safety documentation.

• Apply applicable NFPA standards, International Fire Code, International Building Code, UL standards, FM Global standards, and local AHJ requirements.

• Develop/review fire and gas detection, alarm, suppression, ventilation, fire water, hydrant/FDC, fire access, signage, and emergency shutdown requirements.

• Coordinate fire alarm, gas detection, shutdown, monitoring, and other interfaces with electrical and SCADA engineers.

• Review vendor submittals, contractor drawings, calculations, equipment data, and design packages for conformance with project requirements.

• Coordinate with AHJs, fire marshals, emergency responders, insurers, owner’s engineers, and independent engineers to resolve technical questions and support approvals.

• Provide field assistance, commissioning support, troubleshooting, site assessments, and incident response support, as required.

• Mentor technical staff; review junior work; support proposals, scopes, budgets, schedules, client presentations, and technical qualifications.

• Maintain current knowledge of BESS fire protection technology, incident history, codes, standards, and industry best practices.

• Demonstrates strong technical judgment, practical code-compliant design approach, attention to detail, responsiveness, client focus, clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and willingness to mentor others and improve internal standards

Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related engineering discipline; advanced degree in Fire Protection Engineering a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of relevant fire protection engineering experience, including at least 1 year of BESS experience.

• Active Professional Engineer license required; Fire Protection PE discipline, NCEES PE Fire Protection exam, or demonstrated ability to serve as responsible fire protection engineer for BESS projects. Ability to work in multiple states and jurisdictions.

• Experience applying fire/building codes and best practices to complex industrial, energy infrastructure, or high-hazard projects.

• Working knowledge of BESS hazards, lithium-ion failure modes, thermal runaway, flammable gas generation, explosion control, fire propagation, and emergency response considerations.

• Experience with NFPA 855, International Fire Code, International Building Code, UL 9540, and UL 9540A.

• Experience developing/reviewing fire protection design packages, detection/alarm concepts, suppression requirements, gas detection, ventilation/exhaust concepts, code analyses, and emergency response plans.

• Ability to coordinate with AHJs, fire marshals, clients, EPC contractors, OEMs, insurers, and multi-disciplinary design teams.

• Strong written/oral communication, technical writing, interpersonal, project management, and deadline management skills.

• Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Nice to Have

• Direct utility-scale BESS experience and/or Fire Protection Engineer of Record experience for BESS, renewable energy, power generation, industrial, or high-hazard facilities.

• Familiarity with fire, smoke, airflow, evacuation, gas dispersion, and consequence modeling tools such as FDS, PyroSim, Pathfinder, CONTAM, PHAST, FLACS, or similar software.

• Experience with fire water supply analysis, hydraulic calculations, fire pump sizing, hydrant layout, suppression design, large-scale fire tests, plume analysis, or other BESS fire analyses.

• Experience with FM Global data sheets, insurer requirements, owner’s engineer reviews, independent engineering reviews, or project financing due diligence.

• Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, Navisworks, Microsoft Office, and other standard design/review software.

Disclaimer

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.

Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

#LI-

Pay Range

$135,000—$190,000 USD

Atwell Benefits: To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.

Work/Life:

• Generous Paid Time Off

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible work schedules are available for some positions

• Tenure Awards — Travel Vouchers to see the world based on your travel preferences

Compensation:

• Competitive Compensation packages

• Annual bonuses, spot bonuses and peer recognition awards

• 401K match - 1:1 up to 4% of compensation

• Tuition Assistance

• Student Loan Repayment

• Paid Licensing / Certification Fees and Renewals

• Financial Rewards for Obtaining Licensure

• Employee Referrals

• Annual Wellness Reimbursement for anything wellness related (Gym memberships, fitness tracker, home gym equipment, etc.)

• Dependent Care Match

‘Atwell’ness:

• Medical (BC/BS), Dental (Delta), and Vision (VSP)

• Family Planning & IVF Benefits

• Pet Insurance

• Employer paid LTD, STD, and life insurance

• Metlife Supplemental Benefits covering accident, hospitalization, and critical illness

• Member Assistance Program (MAP) with complimentary counseling sessions, legal benefits, financial consultations, and work/life referral services

jobs.title: Founding Product Marketer
jobs.description:
We’re building Reflow, a workforce and workflow intelligence platform that helps teams understand and improve how work gets done. We’re a U.S.-based tech company with a high bar for talent, ownership, and execution, and we’re intentional about building a strong, globally distributed team from the start.



We’re looking for a Founding Product Marketer to own how Reflow shows up in the market, from positioning and messaging to sales enablement, case studies, and content that reaches the right buyers. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll shadow our founders on demos, learn the product deeply, define who each use case is for, and turn that into messaging, landing pages, and stories that help sales win. As a founding team member, you’ll set the strategy and execute it yourself.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Product Marketing Strategy: Gain a deep understanding of our audience, develop our positioning and messaging, and communicate about the product and its benefits to our audience.

 - Positioning & messaging: Own our product positioning and messaging, and develop copy and content messages across marketing channels (emails, web, etc).

 - Launches: Plan and execute product launches from strategy to messaging, channel strategy, and measurement, collaborating with product, sales, and CS.

 - Campaign management: Plan and run integrated campaigns yourself, partnering with the founders and sales. There is no existing marketing team yet, so you’ll build this from scratch.

 - Lifecycle marketing: Create content and messaging for email drip campaigns throughout the customer lifecycle.

 - Content strategy: Own our content strategy end to end and create the content yourself, from thought leadership and benchmarks to case studies and landing pages.

 - Customer marketing: Ensure customers are a key part of all of our content, and create customer-specific content to support sales. Own our case studies and the landing pages that showcase them.

 - Modern tooling: Implement modern tools, AI, and workflows for product, ecosystem, campaign, and content marketing, including demos, videos, resources, etc.

 - Sales enablement & demos: Shadow the founder on demos, then own demo flows, pitch materials, battlecards, and use case stories that help sales win.

 - ICP & use cases: Define who each use case is for and keep our ICP sharp with real customer and market data.

 - Competitive intelligence: Map the competitive landscape and turn it into clear differentiation for sales and marketing.

 - Distribution: For everything you create, own the plan to get it in front of the right buyers, including benchmarks, thought leadership, and review sites like G2.

 - Founder voice: Ghostwrite thought leadership for our founders.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Marketing experience: 2+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on product marketing.

 - 0-1 Build: Hands-on experience in the 0-1 build

 - Industry or business model experience: Experience in saas ideally in a sales-led motion.

 - Product marketing depth: With core competencies in positioning, messaging, and launch management.

 - Marketing breadth: You understand campaign, channel, content, and comms strategy in addition to product marketing strategy.

 - Writing ability: You’ve written short-form and long-form content, and can point to examples of your writing.

 - Goal setting & prioritization: You know how to set both short-term goals and long-term goals that are used for prioritization and focused on impact.

 - Modern tools & AI: Comfort with and/or ability to quickly learn these tools for competitive intelligence, content creation/video, sales enablement, design, etc.

 - Not just a thinker: You should be able to come up with strategy and execute at the same time

jobs.title: Solar Technician
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the Solar Technician is responsible for troubleshooting, maintaining, servicing, and repairing solar PV systems and associated equipment. The primary objective is to maintain safe, effective, efficient, and profitable solar PV operation.

If you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume.

Pay Ranges by Job Level:

Technician Trainee ($50,000 - $60,000)

Solar Technician I ($54,000 - $77,000)

Solar Technician II ($62,000 - $88,000)

Solar Technician III ($88,000 - $107,000)

What You'll Be Doing

Trainee

• Follow safety procedures, observe safe working practices, and maintain a safe working environment under direct supervision.

• Shadow and assist experienced technicians in the performance of PV systems and electrical component maintenance.

• Maintain hand tools in good working order and well organized.

• Operate and maintain a service vehicle.

• Work a flexible on-call schedule when needed. This may include weeknights, weekends, and holidays.

• Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and accept guidance from supervising technicians and site leadership.

• Must pass an advancement exam and oral board upon training program completion within six (6) months from hire.

• Other duties as assigned within the Trainee scope.

Level I

• Assists higher level Technicians in performing troubleshooting, maintaining, servicing, and repairing solar PV systems and associated equipment.

• Performs other technical and administrative duties associated with operating and maintaining a power facility.

• Willingness to progress as a technician and take guidance from superiors.

• Help in all areas of site operations as directed by Site Lead and Site Manager with minimal supervision

• Ensures work is performed in accordance with Environmental and Safety requirements.

• Must pass an advancement exam and oral board upon training program completion within six (6) months from hire.

• Performs other duties as assigned within the level I scope

Level II (Additions)

• Performs corrective, preventive, and emergency maintenance and operations for which they are qualified to safely and efficiently perform

• Performs work independently and/or in work crews

• Must pass an advancement exam and oral board upon training program completion within six (6) months from hire.

• Travel required as needed

• Performs other duties as assigned within the level II scope

Level III (Additions)

• Executes routine electrical troubleshooting and repair, instrumentation calibration and troubleshooting

• Performs complex maintenance work such as distributed control systems and inverter troubleshooting as assigned by supervisor based on level of skill and ability

• Complete work orders for the preventive maintenance management system

• Performs corrective, preventive, and emergency maintenance on all PV Solar equipment

• Prepares and implements switching and clearance orders, while working with Operations Center

• Operates all electrical and mechanical PV Solar power plant systems

• Participates in training as required, JHA, PJB, LOTO documentation

• Writes Plant Orders, Plant Procedures, Operating Instructions and other documents as assigned by supervisor

• Ensures work is performed in accordance with Environmental and Safety requirements

• Must pass an exam and oral board upon training program completion within six (6) months from hire.

• Performs other duties as assigned within the level III scope

What You'll Bring

Trainee

• A high school diploma or GED required, or willing to obtain within the first 6 months of employment.

• Must possess a valid driver’s license and good driving record.

• Demonstrable mechanical aptitude; no prior electrical experience required.

• Able to safely work in a wide range of adverse climates and environments.

• Able to travel as required.

• Knowledge of and the ability to use various hand tools.

• Able to communicate verbally and in writing.

• Able to create, edit, or modify Microsoft Word and Excel documents.

• Ability to work overtime and non-standard working hours (nights, holidays, weekends), when needed.

• Professionalism and excellent communication skills.

Level I

• Possess demonstrable mechanical aptitude and basic electrical knowledge gained through direct work experience. Qualifying backgrounds include: electrical work in a construction trade, employment in a power generation or utility environment, or experience as a licensed or apprentice electrician. Able to work with electrical wires and differentiate between color-coded wires.

• Understanding of general workplace safety and the ability to follow safety standards, as well as help the company improve upon the standards in place.

• Ability to read schematics and wiring diagrams is preferred.

• Able to communicate verbally and in writing and able to work without direct supervision during performance of work.

• Able to meet the requirements of Clearway Energy Group’s Qualified Electrical Worker program.

• Knowledge of applicable safety and environmental regulations.

• Able to work both independently and as part of a multi-tasking team.

Level II (Additions)

• 1+ years of experience in a power plant or PV Solar O&M/EPC experience

• 2+ years of field experience with significant I&E, I&C and/or C&I Electrician experience will be considered in lieu of applicable solar experience

• Demonstrated knowledge of electrical or mechanical fundamentals (single craft journeyman skills) such as electrical measurements, control circuits, and solid state theory application

• Basic knowledge of operational characteristics of equipment and associated control devices installed in power facilities

• Possess demonstrable mechanical aptitude and basic electrical knowledge

Level III (Additions)

• 4+ years of PV solar experience is required. I&E, I&C and/or C&I Electrician experience will be considered in lieu of applicable experience.

• Proven experience with a multitude of electrical/construction projects

• Demonstrated knowledge of electrical or mechanical fundamentals (Journeyman skills) such as electrical measurements, control circuits, and solid state theory application

• Knowledge of complex analog and digital instrumentation and control systems

• Proper methods for troubleshooting, repairing, and adjusting instruments and control systems

• Experience administering safe methods to clear equipment, use of tools and plant safety rules

• Understanding reporting procedures and practices and maintenance procedures and practices

• Knowledge of electrical and mechanical prints

• Familiarity with PV Solar plant terminology and nomenclature

• Qualified to perform routine and emergency operations at a solar generation facility and Switchyard

• Able to communicate verbally and in writing and able to work without direct supervision during performance of work

• Able to travel (approximately 5%)

What Would Be Nice

• 2-year technical degree or equivalent Journeyman certification/qualifications is preferred

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

#LI-Onsite

The pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, relevant and demonstrated experience, education, training and certifications, and other factors permitted by law. This role is eligible to earn an annual cash bonus, subject to personal and company performance goals.

Salary Range Across all U.S. Locations

$50,000—$107,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success LATAM
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll help customers get real, measurable value from GitLab after the sale by providing technical product expertise and best practice guidance. You'll be part of the Customer Success Engineer team that delivers GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements.

This is a pooled model, so you won't be dedicated to a specific set of accounts. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, and Renewals Managers to support implementation, architecture, and use case adoption across GitLab's key workflows, including source code management, continuous integration and delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning. You'll report to the Customer Success Engineer Team Manager. Your first-year outcomes will focus on building trusted advisor relationships, enabling successful customer implementations, and creating reusable workshops and technical content that helps customers adopt GitLab at scale.

What you'll do

• Engage with customers through Zoom calls and email as a technical consultant during the post-sales journey, providing product, solution, and best practice guidance.

• Partner with Customer Success Managers to provide in-depth guidance on GitLab use case implementation, including source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning.

• Deliver practical, customer-specific enablement through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements in a pooled support model that isn't dedicated to a single account.

• Provide technical and architectural guidance that helps customers adopt GitLab capabilities and connect technical decisions to the outcomes they care about.

• Align with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to share customer-facing subject matter expertise that supports customer business objectives.

• Develop and deliver workshops, demos, and other reusable enablement content in collaboration with cross-functional partners.

• Build and maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies aligned with GitLab's market focus through training, certification, and working examples for internal and customer use.

• Contribute to customer-facing learning resources, including GitLab documentation, YouTube content, and enablement programs such as the Digital Journey.

What you'll bring

• Fluency in English and Spanish. Trilingual candidates who speak English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portugese is a strong plus.

• Located in the United States, Mexico, and Brazil.

• Experience supporting one or more GitLab use cases, such as source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, or Agile Planning, and enabling customers with practical, in-depth guidance.

• Proficiency with DevSecOps tools or adjacent technical tooling, with the ability to translate tool capabilities into customer outcomes.

• A technical background in software development or systems engineering, including comfort discussing architecture, workflows, and implementation tradeoffs.

• The ability to communicate complex technical and organizational topics clearly in writing and live settings, including Zoom calls, workshops, and presentations.

• Experience operating as a trusted technical advisor to customer and business stakeholders in a post-sales environment.

• Strong time management and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional requests in a pooled model.

• A continuous learning mindset, including maintaining specialty competency through training, certification, documentation, or reusable examples. We welcome transferable experience from related roles and backgrounds.

About the team

We're a globally distributed Customer Success Engineer team supporting customers in GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier. We collaborate asynchronously and stay aligned through clear documentation and shared enablement assets. We continuously improve our content and delivery based on what we learn from customer engagements.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist- Robotics AI
jobs.description:
As a Senior Research Scientist- Robotics AI, you contribute to research projects at the forefront of the Embodied and Cyber-physical AI industry. Key responsibilities include:

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct research and engineering in core AI and machine learning fields to enable industrial embodied AI—including computer vision, autonomous navigation, and adaptive manipulation—specifically for manufacturing, shop-floor automation, logistics, and material handling domains.
• Push the boundaries in industrial robotics by incorporating advancements in large vision-language-action models to enhance real-time factory reasoning, multi-robot coordination, and operational safety.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with global manufacturing engineering, plant operations, and product development teams to ensure seamless technology transfer from simulation to physical shop-floor hardware and systems integration.
• Implement research results to solve complex, real-world industrial challenges, ensuring high-reliability system integration within Bosch’s smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 platforms (such as APAS and active production environments).
• Stay at the forefront of industrial innovation by actively engaging with manufacturing technology consortia, automation communities, and specialized conferences focused on industrial robotics and factory automation.

Basic Qualifications

jobs.title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Hardware Test Engineer

As a Hardware Test Engineer, you'll work across engineering disciplines to make sure our hardware meets the highest bar for quality and reliability. You'll own testing from concept through high-rate production. That means building the test plans and systems that prove out designs, running the labs that generate the evidence, presenting results that drive key decisions, and following failures through to corrective action. The ideal candidate is self-driven and has built test systems and software from the ground up.

Role

• Work cross-functionally to define test requirements and choose test methods that cover the stresses hardware sees in its operating environment.

• Write and run qualification and validation test plans, including functional, thermal cycling, vibration, shock, TVAC, accelerated life, and HALT/HASS testing.

• Design, build, and automate test equipment, fixtures, and instrumentation end to end in Python, maximizing throughput to keep up with fast design cycles.

• Select, operate, and maintain environmental chambers, data acquisition systems, custom test racks, and measurement equipment.

• Write test procedures and reports, and present results clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

• Lead failure investigations and see corrective actions through to closure.

Requirements

• B.S. in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

• 2+ years testing power electronics, avionics, or other high-reliability electronic hardware.

• A passion for hardware development, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development

• Comfort with ambiguity and turning high-level requirements into clear design/test objectives

• Experience with environmental chambers, automated test equipment, and test fixtures.

• Strong ability to read schematics and understand circuits.

• Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, DMMs, DAQs, power supplies, electronic loads, and SMUs.

• Experience with digital interfaces and protocols, such as CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, and Ethernet.

• Proficiency in Python for test automation and data analysis.

• Strong technical writing, including test plans, reports, requirements, and specifications.

Bonus

• High voltage testing experience.

• Vacuum or TVAC testing experience.

• Knowledge of electronics reliability and failure mechanisms.

• Familiarity with ASTM, JEDEC, IEEE, ISO, and MIL test standards.

• Familiarity with HITL/SITL testing, Linux, and SQL.

What we offer:

All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.

Base Salary

$110,000—$176,000 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

Astranis SMS Terms of Service

As part of our team, you’ll embody our "Shark" mindset: bold, ambitious, and scrappy. You'll lead with a bias for action and take true ownership of our products, customer success, and team culture.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
ABOUT PARSPEC

Founded in 2021, Parspec is revolutionizing the materials supply chain for the $13 trillion USD construction industry by digitizing and organizing the industry's product data. Our proprietary AI technology maintains a current and comprehensive catalogue of millions of products, enabling our customers to identify products that best meet their needs–instantly. Trusted by top designers, builders, distributors, manufacturers, and sales agents, and backed by leading venture investors, Parspec is paving the way for a more innovative, connected, and sustainable future in construction.

Join us in building transformative technology that reshapes one of the world’s oldest and largest industries.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re seeking an Applied AI Engineer Intern to join Parspec. This role is part of the AI team and works closely with Product and Engineering on fast-moving, real-world applications of AI.

As an intern, you’ll apply modern AI and machine learning techniques to concrete product problems, such as understanding product specifications, improving product recommendations, and exploring early agentic AI workflows, while learning how AI systems are designed, built, evaluated, and shipped in the real world.

This is an ideal role for a student who wants hands-on experience applying AI to complex, messy industry data and customer-facing product workflows.




WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Contribute to AI-driven initiatives, from problem framing through experimentation and implementation

 - Build, prototype, evaluate, and iterate on models and AI-powered workflows used in customer-facing product features

 - Partner with Senior Applied AI Engineers and Product Managers to translate real customer problems into clear technical approaches and tradeoffs

 - Analyze structured and unstructured data (e.g., product specifications, documents, metadata) to improve model performance

 - Document assumptions, results, and learnings to support cross-functional alignment and decision-making


WHY THIS MATTERS

Construction remains one of the world’s largest and least digitized industries. Construction teams rely on manual workflows to interpret product specifications, identify suitable materials, compare options, and make procurement decisions. Parspec applies AI to power workflows that help stakeholders evaluate products, surface better options, and act with confidence. As an Applied AI Engineer Intern, your work will directly support these capabilities and the decisions they enable.




WHO YOU ARE

You’re excited about applying AI to real-world problems that don’t come neatly packaged. You enjoy breaking down complex systems, working with imperfect data, and experimenting to find practical solutions. You’re curious, technically grounded, and comfortable collaborating with Product and Engineering partners to balance model performance, system constraints, and customer impact.

Qualifications

 - Currently enrolled in a US-based, degree-seeking program (Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD) in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields

 - Strong familiarity with core ML/AI concepts and tooling, such as model training(LoRA/QLoRA) and evaluation, embeddings, RAG systems, agentic frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI or related techniques.

 - Strong familiarity with ranking and recommendations techniques.

 - Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning to real-world projects, including working with imperfect data, making tradeoffs, and iterating based on results

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to work effectively in ambiguous problem spaces with guidance and mentorship

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to B2B SaaS products, especially workflow-heavy or operations-focused software

 - Interest in or exposure to construction industry workflows, including materials procurement




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive stipend for the duration of the internship

 - Hands-on ownership of meaningful product work that directly impacts customers

 - Mentorship from experienced Product, Design, and Engineering leaders

 - Flexible hybrid work environment to support both in-office collaboration and focused remote work

 - Exposure to a fast-growing AI-powered B2B SaaS company and real-world product decision-making

 - Opportunities for learning and professional development through regular feedback and collaboration


JOIN US AND LEAD THE TRANSFORMATION!

At Parspec, we recognize that traditional job descriptions don’t always capture the full range of your unique abilities—and that’s perfectly okay. You may not meet every requirement, but if you bring a mix of experiences, fresh perspectives, and a passion that aligns with our mission, we want to hear from you!

The Parspec team believes that varied backgrounds drive better outcomes and fuel innovation. We are a team of self-starters who lead from every seat. We think big, set a standard of excellence, and are committed to diversity and a discrimination-free workplace. We welcome applicants from all walks of life to join us and help shape the future of our industry.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Manager, Product Reliability Engineering is responsible for driving build quality and mission success across Divergent’s products by leading a team of engineers focused on reliability, validation, and risk management. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams to ensure products meet performance, reliability, and program requirements. You will help translate customer needs into actionable quality and reliability plans, support program execution, and drive structured problem-solving for failures and system issues. As a people leader and technical contributor, you will reinforce a reliability-first mindset, ensure consistent execution of product quality processes, and support the scaling of reliable outcomes across Divergent’s technologies and operations.

The Role

Team Leadership & Execution

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of product reliability engineers, fostering strong technical execution and accountability

• Provide day-to-day guidance, prioritization, and performance management for the team

• Support hiring and onboarding engineers as the team scales

• Reinforce best practices in reliability engineering, risk management, and problem-solving

Program & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Act as the primary reliability partner to Program Management and Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) at the program level

• Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure alignment between requirements, design intent, and production capability

• Support interpretation of customer and regulatory requirements and ensure they are translated into clear, verifiable product quality objectives

• Escalate risks, tradeoffs, and constraints to senior leadership as needed F-33

Product Quality & Reliability Execution

• Own execution of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) deliverables, including FMEA, control plans, and validation activities

• Ensure product and process risks are identified, documented, and actively managed within programs

• Support development and refinement of quality control plans and validation strategies

• Track and report on reliability metrics, risks, and readiness at the program level

Risk Management & Problem Resolution

• Lead structured root cause investigations and corrective action efforts for product and process failures

• Facilitate cross-functional issue resolution and nonconformance reviews

• Drive accountability for containment, corrective actions, and verification of effectiveness

• Promote the use of structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys, FMEA) Process Improvement & Scaling

• Contribute to the development and improvement of reliability, risk, and quality processes Help standardize tools, templates, and best practices across programs

• Support implementation of scalable systems to manage increasing product complexity and production volume

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology subject to U.S. export controls

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline

• 5+ years of experience in product reliability, quality, manufacturing, design, systems, or test/validation engineering

• 1+ years of experience leading projects, initiatives, or direct management of engineers

• Experience solving complex, cross-functional engineering problems using structured methodologies

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience directly managing engineers in a production or product development environment

• Experience executing APQP methodologies (FMEA, control plans, validation planning)

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and competing priorities

• Experience with structured problem-solving and failure analysis tools (e.g., Six Sigma, 8D, DOE, Fault Tree Analysis)

• Experience supporting product launches from development through production

• Familiarity with additive manufacturing, machining, and adhesive bonding

• Familiarity with automotive and/or aerospace standards and requirements

• Experience with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Jira, SQL, PowerBI)

• Familiarity with NX/Teamcenter or similar CAD/design platforms

Work Environment

• Office and manufacturing floor environment

• Occasional travel to supplier sites, testing events, and company facilities as required

• Fast-paced, hands-on environment focused on scaling advanced manufacturing while ensuring reliability and risk mitigation

Pay Range

$150,020—$206,280 USD

What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

• Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

jobs.title: Mechanical/Structural Engineer II
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.

To help achieve these efforts, Stratolaunch is seeking a Mechanical/Structural Engineer II to support the development of an air-launched hypersonic flight vehicle development program. This position will include conceptualizing components, sizing and analyzing components, generating CAD model parts and assemblies, creating margin reports, detailed design, and supporting the manufacturing effort. In addition, this position will support the Talon-A structures lead with team guidance and mentorship.  You are responsible for contributing to the vehicle’s structural technical performance, including meeting design and mission requirements, resolving technical challenges, and implementing technology upgrades that improve the competitive basis of the Talon-A hypersonic vehicle architecture.

Essential Responsibilities

• Participate in aerospace structural and mechanical design efforts.

• Perform detailed design of various structural components, leading to the release of engineering work orders.

• Select material systems and construction techniques that meet project objectives.

• Create 3D CAD models of parts and assemblies.

• Work with engineering technicians and the shop to fabricate and assemble your designs.

• Communicate regularly and comprehensively with project leads.

• Contribute to the integration of complex aerospace systems.

• Travel, as needed, to support the company.

• Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity, and fulfillment of commitments.

Qualifications & Skills

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience with 3D CAD modeling and preliminary sizing of parts and assemblies.

• Experience with drafting and GD&T.

• Ability to communicate technical challenges and guidance to varied audiences to explain rationale and/or resolve concerns.

• Ability to take ownership and work independently to prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals.

• Demonstrated engineering judgment.

• Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities.

• Willingness and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with aerospace design.

• Experience with the rapid development of prototype or experimental flight vehicles.

• Experience working directly with the shop to optimize your design for manufacturing and assembly.

• Ability to analyze your designs using hand calculations and FEM.

• Experience with metallic and composite design and fabrication.

• Active security clearance.

Required Computer Skills

• Computer-aided design tools.

• MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Preferred Computer Skills

• NX.

• Configuration management systems, such as Jira.

Education and Experience

• Level II ($94,000-$119,300): Bachelor’s degree or higher from accredited institution and 2-5 years of engineering experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• Position on-site based in Mojave, CA

• Travel, as needed, to support the department. Travel estimated to be <5%

• 9/80 schedule

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

Stratolaunch is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at our company. We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our management team does not tolerate discrimination or harassment at any point during our employees’ and applicants’ time with us, especially with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.  For purposes of transparency, U.S. Citizenship may be required for some positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

jobs.title: B2B Communications Manager
jobs.description:
This role will be based in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Mountain View, and New York.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. This means you can work from home and commute to a LinkedIn office, depending on what’s best for you and when it is important for your team to be together, or you can work remotely from most locations within the country listed for this role.

The dream candidate for this role is someone who is interested in b2b and product communications, a creative storyteller and energized by creator and media relations.

In this fast-paced and high-visibility role, you will help support communications for LinkedIn Talent Solutions, LinkedIn's largest business line. You’ll shape and execute communications strategies that elevate LinkedIn as the leader in agentic hiring, reaching a primary audience of Chief People Officers, Talent Leaders and recruiters.

The communications manager will support the communications team on both strategic campaigns and day-to-day executional support, including media relations, creator engagements, messaging development, thought leadership campaigns, creative storytelling, and measurement.

• Support global communications campaigns, helping the team with narrative and message development and telling stories to reach talent leaders and recruiters
• Pitch stories and secure earned media and creator coverage that help our hiring customers understand the value LinkedIn provides
• Develop innovative approaches to elevate stories across earned, owned, and social channels

• Remain current on HR industry trends to keep business leaders informed about topics driving conversations with external audiences

• Experience with tools like Canva to build content
• Experience with applying AI tools to daily work

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer (Starlink Development)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

As a Manufacturing Engineer on the Development Operations team, you will own how Starlink hardware gets built. You will lead the factory projects that put new tooling and automation on the floor, write the standard of work, and design fabrication and integration processes that raise throughput, quality, and safety inside our shop, for internal customers, and with local tooling and fabrication vendors.

You will work closely with Starlink product engineering, automation, supply chain, and shop leadership. You are the manufacturing voice across those teams, and you will drive the changes to process, tooling, planning, and shop organization that make fabrication and integration flow. You will take extreme ownership of deliverables, schedule adherence, and alignment with overall program milestones.

MANUFACTURING ENGINEER (STARLINK DEVELOPMENT)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as the primary liaison between automation, supply chain, production, and development operations so factory tooling and automation are built and deployed to meet program milestones

• Develop and implement manufacturing processes and shop workflows that increase throughput, efficiency, and personnel safety

• Manage the build, configuration, and installation of all modular automation assets in the team’s catalog, from raw-material purchase through cell build, integration and handoff to automation and production

• Work with peer engineering and support teams to drive design updates in response to manufacturing issues, tooling constraints, part obsolescence, and requirement changes

• Prepare the engineering documentation required to move hardware from development to production, including assembly and integration work instructions and manufacturing bills of materials

• Work with internal and external suppliers to fabricate piece parts and subassemblies at rate, or to supplement internal capacity

• Contribute to design reviews as the manufacturing expert on design for manufacturability, design for reliability, design for maintenance, shop capability, and quality control

• Spearhead manufacturing strategy, including cycle time and make-versus-buy to meet or exceed departmental objectives without compromising quality

• Design, develop, validate, and implement production tooling so the process is repeatable and efficient

• Serve as the primary point of contact for nonconforming product on cells, panels, and tooling, and lead troubleshooting, root-cause investigation, and corrective action

• Develop training requirements for technicians and specialists to increase the team’s capability, productivity and safety

• Spearhead machine tool purchases to increase development shop capability including machine selection, proposal creation, ROI calculation and align with shop supervisors to meet program need

• Work creatively and innovate to support SpaceX's goals by always being prepared to challenge requirements, remove blockers and accelerate program schedule

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, mechanical, industrial, or a related engineering discipline

• 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, tooling design, automation cell build, and/or production of mechanical or electrical hardware systems (internship and collegiate extracurricular engineering project experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 2+ years of experience leading manufacturing projects and implementing design for manufacture and design for assembly on electromechanical systems

• Experience commissioning automated cells or other production equipment and completing buyoff with production or project stakeholders

• Experience in the tooling or factory automation industry, such as a tooling supplier, automation integrator, equipment OEM, or an in-house tooling and automation teams

• Experience transitioning products from design to manufacturing (new product introduction) as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced, iterative design environment

• SPC (Statistical Process Control) knowledge and experience applying statistical methods to track process capability

• Competency with SQL databases and usage of AI tolls to compile data and make engineering decisions

• Design and release of production tooling, including fixtures, workholding, gauges, and poke-yoke features

• Hands-on engineer with a passion for continuous improvement

• Capable of solving complex problems with little to no supervision on schedule as an individual or as a member of an integrated team

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and/or overtime as needed

• Some travel to outside vendors may be required (up to 10%)

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Please Note:

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

Memory sits at the heart of AI, cloud and datacenter growth, and Samsung is the industry’s volume and technology leader in DRAM. As a Product Marketing Manager on our DRAM team, you will be the market expert who shapes how Samsung leads with some of the world’s leading technology customers.

You’ll work at the center of the business: analyzing demand and pricing, informing supply and production plans, and equipping Sales with the insight to negotiate. It’s a strong role for someone with a few years of product or strategic marketing experience who wants broader scope, exposure and real influence on business decisions.

Location: Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA office in alignment with our Flexible Work policy

Reports to: Sr Dr Product Marketing

• Read the market. Track customer and market trends, identify gaps and opportunities, and analyze segment demand and TAM. Shape pricing. Develop pricing strategies by customer and segment, using feedback from the field to finalize decisions. Influence supply. Understand customer demand, forecasts and supply in detail to inform allocation and production build plans. Set strategy. Lead strategic analysis, marketing strategy and competitive analysis. Model the landscape. Distill analyst reports into key messages and model competitive TAM, SAM and market share. Arm Sales to win. Partner with technical teams to build positioning and data-backed analysis that sharpens our competitive edge. Be the voice of Samsung DRAM. Create and deliver customer and sales presentations, represent Samsung in customer meetings as the expert on market conditions, and support company and customer tech events. Build industry presence. Collaborate across the industry and evangelize Samsung DRAM products.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree (EE or CS preferred; MBA a plus).

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Midwest
jobs.description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.


Role Summary:
 
Here's the honest pitch: field sales is a brand-new motion at Filevine, and we're looking for the person who builds it. Not runs a proven playbook — writes it. You'll be the first Filevine salesperson to plant a flag in your territory, and everything you learn on the ground becomes the blueprint for the reps who come after you. If "figure it out and build it from scratch" makes you lean in rather than flinch, keep reading.

This is a true outside sales role. You'll be in the field at least four days a week — walking into law firms, meeting paralegals and attorneys face-to-face, working bar association events, and becoming the most familiar name in your territory for deposition services.

This isn't an email job. It's not a Zoom job. You win by showing up — consistently, professionally, and with something useful to say every time. You'll also need range: the ability to build rapport in the reception area and get your foot in the door with a paralegal, and the sophistication to sit across from a managing partner and hold your own on price, value, and strategy. This is a premium-priced product in a market full of commodity providers — so you have to be able to sell the difference, not just the service. If you love the rhythm of door-to-door selling, can navigate a downtown legal corridor, and have the discipline to run a territory like your own small business, you'll thrive here. There is no ceiling on your earnings

jobs.title: IT Network Infrastructure Engineer, Launch
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, LAUNCH

As a Network Infrastructure Engineer at SpaceX, you will work in a complex environment designing and supporting a variety of IT systems critical for Starship launch pads. This position will require you to design, install, and maintain the physical cabling, network hardware, on-premises compute, electrical enclosures, and data center environments that together make up our mission critical control networks. You will work directly with the launch automations & controls teams to provide reliable and robust connectivity to their critical control systems. The fiber and copper data network cabling that you will design must survive extreme launch environments to carry operational voice, video, vehicle/payload commanding, ground support equipment telemetry, and the rest of the data needed to launch Starship in high-cadence, airport-like operations to enable life beyond Earth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Be an extreme owner of network infrastructure including product selection, procurement, configuration, install, and troubleshooting

• Monitor network health, troubleshooting, and determining root cause of system issues as they arise

• Perform job walks with customers, vendors, and contractors to gather requirements and create project implementation plans

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and engineers across programs to create highly operable, scalable, and maintainable products

• Continuously create and innovate to build solutions for unique layer1 challenges

• Participate in the day-to-day operation of IT systems, ensuring seamless functionality and reliability during critical launch windows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other STEM discipline and 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining system-level communication architectures, OR 7+ years of experience designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining system-level communication architectures in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent competing projects effectively and incorporate significant design changes quickly

• Project management skills including schedule development, writing scopes of work, reading construction drawings, and creating specification documents

• Experience supervising crews of technicians/contractors to execute implementation of your designs

• Experience with configuration and operation of TCP/IP based communication equipment

• Knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA), fiber optic cabling types (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage, copper ethernet cabling types (CAT5, CAT6, CAT6A)

• Understanding of code requirements and fire protection specifications for cable pathways such as tray and conduit, especially in hazardous rated locations

• Motivation to oversee projects from early design through build and closeout

• Keen attention to detail and dedication to thorough documentation

• Proficient with CAD and/or electrical schematics software

• Confidence to present designs and clearly articulate project goals for review by internal and external stakeholders

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work in tight quarters and at height

• Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when necessary to support launches and critical path project timelines. Flexibility is required

• Availability for occasional travel to other launch sites

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth PACE helps seniors stay in their homes and communities by providing medical care and community-based services. Our values and participant focus lead the way no matter what.

The Medical Assistant focuses on assisting the medical staff (providers, nurses, and on-site specialty care providers) in the provision of safe and efficient delivery of medical services at the WelbeHealth clinic. The Medical Assistant performs routine administrative and clinical duties such as scheduling medical appointments, greeting participants, filing medical records, taking and recording vital signs, preparing exam rooms, and maintaining equipment and supplies.

This role is different because Medical Assistants at WelbeHealth:

• Engage in both clinical care and front-office interactions, fostering meaningful participant relationships while maintaining hands-on medical responsibilities, unlike traditional Medical Assistant positions focused solely on back-office or clinical work

• Have the time and support to provide quality care and build trust, balancing efficiency with connection, rather than rushing through high patient volumes

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• 401K savings + match

• Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

• And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

• Prepare participants for appointments, including but not limited to setting up exam rooms, checking participants in and out, and obtaining an accurate history of illness

• Perform required pre-exam physical tests, such as measuring and documenting participants’ vital signs

• Perform general medical procedures, such as dressing changes and suture removals, as directed and under specific authorization and supervision of a physician

• Collect and prepare laboratory specimens as ordered, and perform routine sterilization procedures of medical and dental equipment

• Maintain clinic logs and ensure exam rooms are properly stocked, sanitized, and re-prepped at all times

Job requirements include:

• Certification by a medical assistant certifying organization approved by the state medical board

• Two (2) years of experience working as a Medical Assistant in a clinical setting with a frail or elderly population

• Two (2)-year degree program in medical assistance

• Phlebotomy experience required

• Reliable means of transportation

• Must obtain CPR and First Aid certification within 180 days of hire and maintain certification thereafter; CPR and First Aid certification upon hire preferred

We are seeking Medical Assistants that have phlebotomy experience. If you’re ready to join a holistic care team that values both its participants and providers, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.
