jobs.title: Senior Host Operations Associate II, Posh Live
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSHMARK


Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection. Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

 

About the role

We’re looking for a Host Operations Specialist to help our hosts run their day-to-day businesses smoothly and support the growth of Posh Live.

In this role, you’ll own day-to-day host support and coordinate technical issues from initial report through resolution. You’ll work closely with the Account Manager, Product, Engineering, and Customer Support to troubleshoot problems, keep hosts informed, and identify opportunities to improve the host experience.

As Posh Live grows, you’ll help build the processes and resources that allow us to support more hosts effectively.

What you’ll do

 - Support hosts with everyday questions and issues. Help hosts navigate product features, show operations, and order-related questions. Resolve issues directly where possible and coordinate with the appropriate teams when additional support is needed.

 - Own bug tracking and follow-up. Gather details, reproduce issues where possible, and document clear bug reports, including the impact on hosts’ businesses. Track progress with Product and Engineering and follow through until issues are resolved or a clear next step is established.

 - Keep hosts informed. Provide timely updates, explain available workarounds, and close the loop when an issue is resolved.

 - Identify recurring problems. Look for patterns across host feedback and support requests, and bring actionable recommendations to the team.

 - Improve how we support hosts. Maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and escalation processes to make support faster and more consistent.

 - Partner with the Account Manager. Coordinate on host needs and escalations, bringing in account context when needed and ensuring clear ownership of next steps.

 - Contribute to business improvements. Work closely with the Posh Live team to identify operational friction that affects hosts’ ability to run shows, fulfill orders, and grow their businesses.

What you’ll bring

 - Experience in customer support, account operations, marketplace operations, or a similar role.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and comfort troubleshooting product and operational issues.

 - Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple open issues.

 - Clear, empathetic communication with hosts and internal partners.

 - Good judgment about urgency, business impact, and when to escalate.

 - A proactive mindset and willingness to adapt as the business evolves.

 - Familiarity with Poshmark; experience supporting or using Posh Shows is a plus.

What success looks like

 - Hosts receive timely, clear, and helpful support.

 - Issues are documented accurately, with clear ownership and consistent follow-up.

 - Hosts and internal teams have visibility into open issues and next steps.

 - Recurring problems lead to actionable recommendations and improvements.

 - Support processes become more efficient as the host community grows.

jobs.title: Event Project Manager, Corporate Meetings & Events
jobs.description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!


The Opportunity
The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing the complex lifecycle of AV production and creative design projects for our clients' most important events.
This person will work with clients across the Tech, Finance, Pharma, and Non-Profit spaces, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You aren't just managing tasks; you are a consultant and a brand steward for our clients’ most vital internal and client-facing events, leading the information flow across all parties. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the executive presence to guide stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients' vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.
This role requires frequent to moderate onsite travel (approximately 20-30%, or 4-5 days per month).
What You'll Own
Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll lead numerous events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV Production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, while expertly preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 20-30%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while maintaining high energy in fast-paced event environments.
What We Need
4-7+ Years of Event Industry Experience: You’ve navigated the agency or white-glove event world and have a customer-focused mindset.
Organization & Speed: You’re a fast-paced multitasker who is accountable to deadlines and finds joy in the details.
Great Communicator. You’re able to communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing.
People person. You’re able to build relationships and cater your approach depending on the person you’re talking to. You’re experienced in working with different personalities and professional levels.
Technical & Creative Curiosity: You’re ready to dive into AV production and creative service logistics.
Adaptability. You can confidently work and make decisions in gray, unpredictable spaces with shifting priorities. When faced with unforeseen challenges, you adjust to keep the project (and everybody) on track.
Values Alignment: You demonstrate kindness, commitment, and humility in everything you do.
The Impact
Within 1 month, you’ll:
Learn about MT’s services - the value we offer, the types of events that we service and our customer-service mentality.
Have opportunities for training to expand your exposure and understanding of how we manage events at Meeting Tomorrow
Meet with current members of the Project Management, Production, Creative, and Sales teams to understand best practices for supporting our clients and their diverse needs.
Within 3 months, you’ll:
Build strong and lasting relationships with clients and internal team members, ensuring a strong client retention rate.
Begin to create your own processes for working with your clients and identify opportunities for efficiency/improvement. 
Become proficient in our CRM, Netsuite and Project Planning tool, Backstage.
Work with members of our internal support teams to effectively manage a large-scale event or event series for premier clients. These clients include Fortune-5000 companies in many sectors including pharmaceutical, wealth management, and production service agencies.
Within 6 months you’ll:
Have proficiency in the role and be managing accounts with autonomy.
Complete projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
Demonstrate an aptitude for problem solving and contingency planning; striving to consistently exceed client expectations.
Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision plan options
Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
401k with employer matching up to 4%
16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
Annual profit-sharing bonus
12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
$50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
Regular social events and learning opportunities

jobs.title: Clinical Review Pharmacist Supervisor
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

Mission:

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

Position Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday - Friday, between the hours of 7:00am - 6:00pm (will be 5 - 8 hour shifts).

Position Overview:

The Clinical Review Pharmacist Supervisor leads and oversees the clinical review pharmacist team, ensuring consistent, accurate, first-pass verification of prescriptions across the site while directly supervising staff performance, workflow, and training. This role owns trend analysis and quality outcomes for order entry, translating findings into process improvements, technician education, and staffing decisions. The Clinical Review Pharmacist Supervisor also performs verification duties as needed to support volume and maintains escalation authority for complex clinical, staffing, or compliance issues, according to Strive Pharmacy standard operating procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

Join the forefront of healthcare excellence, where you'll be:

• Supervising and supporting the day-to-day performance of the clinical review pharmacist team, including workload distribution, coverage, and schedule oversight

• Performing first pharmacist verification of prescriptions as needed to support team volume and coverage

• Reviewing, interpreting, and accurately approving prescriptions to ensure safety, accuracy, appropriate dosing, and legal compliance before orders move forward for fulfillment

• Owning trend analysis on order entry and verification accuracy across all sites, and translating findings into targeted process, template, and training improvements

• Identifying educational and competency gaps among technicians and pharmacists, and coordinating with training/QA teams to close them

• Setting, monitoring, and holding the team accountable to verification speed and throughput standards without compromising accuracy

• Conducting quality reviews and audits of verification decisions, providing coaching and feedback to individual pharmacists

• Serving as the escalation point for complex clinical, staffing, or compliance issues that exceed individual pharmacist authority

• Consulting with clinics and prescribing providers to resolve clinical discrepancies, clarify orders, and guide appropriate therapy and dosing for optimal individualized care

• Managing inbound and outbound phone communications with patients and providers as needed, and supporting staff on complex patient or provider concerns

• Counseling patients as needed

• Leading onboarding, training, and ongoing competency development for clinical review pharmacists

• Participating in hiring, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions for the clinical review pharmacist team

• Reporting quality metrics, trend data, and team performance to pharmacy leadership on a regular cadence

• Maintaining strict adherence to state and federal laws, including DEA regulations for controlled substances and HIPAA privacy guidelines, and ensuring the team does the same

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum of Bachelor of Science (BS) in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited institution

• Pharmacist license active and in good standing (Arizona license at minimum)

• Prior experience in prescription verification or order processing

• Experience leading, training, or mentoring pharmacy staff

Preferred Qualifications:

• 2+ years of supervisory or management experience in a pharmacy setting

• Experience in compounding

• Understanding of aseptic technique and familiarity with USP guidelines

• Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated experience identifying trends in operational or quality data and driving process improvement

• Strong understanding of pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and state/federal pharmacy regulations

• Experience developing or delivering technician/pharmacist training programs

• Experience with quality audit or corrective and preventive action processes

• High attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and efficient navigation of pharmacy management software

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills

• Experience with call center software

Work Environment:

This position is primarily based in an onsite work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Annual Salary

$135,000—$140,000 USD

Join Us in Making an Impact:

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

Benefits/ Perks:

Strive Pharmacy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Employer-paid healthcare coverage, effective the 1st day of the following month of your hire date

• Free Strive compounded medications for employees based on a valid patient-specific prescription from a licensed healthcare provider

• Paid time off

• Life insurance

Culture:

Culture isn't an afterthought at Strive. It's something we actively build. We foster a collaborative, engaging workplace where employees have opportunities to connect, celebrate, and build meaningful relationships with their colleagues. We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, both inside and outside the workplace.

EEO:

Strive Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations. You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

 - Build and evolve the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

 - Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

 - Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

 - Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

 - Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

 - Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

 - Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

 

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

 - Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

 - Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

 - Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

 - Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

 - Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

 - Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

 - Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

 - Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

 - Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

 - Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

 - Experience with model routing, AI gateways, or inference optimization.

jobs.title: Strategic Partner Development, Product Partnerships
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Partner Development, Product Partnerships, to manage our product partnerships and integrations with a wide range of content providers, improving Anthropic’s products.  In this role, you will be responsible for prospecting, researching, negotiating, and closing deals with a wide variety of content providers necessary to build and maintain Anthropic’s product portfolio.  A background in product partnerships at a major tech company will be very beneficial in this role, as is comfort in working at a fast-paced start-up environment.

Responsibilities

Product Partnerships Deal Pipeline Management:

• Working closely with Product & Research teams, proactively identify and pursue potential product partnership opportunities through product and customer insights, market research, industry networking, and strategic outreach.

• Build and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective product partnerships, tracking leads, and managing the deal flow process from initial contact to closure.

• Conduct thorough due diligence on potential partners, assessing their strategic fit, content offerings, and potential value to Anthropic.

Deal Negotiation and Structuring:

• Lead negotiations with product partners, crafting mutually beneficial agreements that align with Anthropic's business objectives and legal requirements.

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Research, and Finance teams to structure deals that balance risk, product impact, and operational feasibility.

• Develop comprehensive deal models, product ROI, and cost structures to support effective decision-making.

Partner Management and Relationship Building:

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing product partners, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring ongoing satisfaction and alignment with partnership goals.

• Manage partner communications, addressing concerns, and facilitating seamless collaboration between partners and cross-functional teams at Anthropic.

• Continuously explore opportunities to expand and deepen partnerships, identifying new opportunities for collaboration areas that create value for both parties.

You may be a good fit if you

• Contribute to the development of product strategies involving third parties, ensuring that partners align with Anthropic's overall product roadmap and long-term vision

• Provide strategic guidance on specific kinds of product partnerships to enhance the value proposition of Anthropic's products and services

• Conduct ongoing market research and competitive analyses to stay ahead of industry trends, including emerging product partnership models.

• Prepare regular reports and presentations for executive leadership, highlighting partnership performance, challenges, and recommendations for improvement or expansion.

• Foster strong working relationships with Legal, Product, Engineering, Research, and Finance teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and collaboration throughout the partnership lifecycle.

Strong candidates may also

• Represent the Product Partnerships unit in cross-functional meetings and discussions, advocating for partnership interests and ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.

• Leverage data and insights to inform product partnership strategies, continually optimizing approaches to maximize value and impact.

• Leverage the expertise and support of cross-functional teams to navigate complex partnerships, address challenges, and drive successful outcomes.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$205,000—$240,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in the essential functions outlined below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead, manage, mentor, and develop engineers, designers, and other technical professionals supporting the assigned specialty.

• Maintain accountability for the accurate, timely, and quality completion of engineering and design scopes assigned to the team.

• Establish clear expectations and support employee development through coaching, feedback, training, performance management, individualized development planning, and succession planning.

• Assess team strengths, development needs, and technical capabilities and coordinate appropriate training, mentoring, and work assignments.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and high-performing team environment focused on quality, safety, professional growth, and continuous improvement.

• Lead workload forecasting, resource planning, staffing decisions, team scheduling, and project performance monitoring to maintain appropriate project coverage.

• Maintain visibility into active projects, milestone dates, resource assignments, estimate-to-complete information, and workload constraints.

• Coordinate project assignments and team priorities with Project Managers, technical leaders, operations, and organizational leadership.

• Monitor team-level project budgets, estimate-to-complete information, and financial performance in coordination with Project Managers and organizational leadership.

• Identify and address workload, resource, schedule, quality, safety, and project-delivery risks before they affect project continuity or client commitments.

• Drive improvements in standards, workflows, tools, and team practices that enhance quality, consistency, efficiency, predictability, and project performance.

• Oversee electrical engineering and design for data centers and mission-critical infrastructure projects, including one-line and three-line diagrams, protection and control systems, control and relaying schematics, wiring diagrams, SCADA and communications systems, conduit and cable sizing and routing, grounding systems, equipment selection, equipment specifications, and construction documentation.

• Provide or coordinate QA/QC reviews of electrical designs, calculations, studies, models, specifications, submittals, drawings, and field-service work for overall quality and accuracy.

• Oversee or support power system studies and analyses, including short circuit, load flow, relay coordination, arc flash, power factor, harmonics, grounding, power quality, and other related studies.

• Oversee or support development and review of protective relay settings, technical documentation, equipment evaluations, and practical checks of computer-based models and study results.

• Apply and reinforce applicable codes, standards, client requirements, company procedures, engineering standards, and best practices.

• Provide technical leadership and engineering judgment for complex challenges, design alternatives, constructability concerns, troubleshooting, construction support, and commissioning activities.

• Support project planning and scheduling, cost estimates, budget reports, proposals, studies, technical scopes, change management, and multidisciplinary coordination.

• Support project planning and execution to help ensure assigned work is delivered within established scope, schedule, budget, technical, safety, and quality requirements.

• Support development of technical scopes, assumptions, estimates, schedules, proposals, and documentation for new work and project changes in coordination with Project Managers.

• Partner with Project Managers and technical leaders to coordinate multidisciplinary work and maintain appropriate coverage across project scopes.

• Support proposal development, marketing activities, client pursuits, and business development through technical input and resource-planning support.

• Support client relationships by helping resolve technical and delivery concerns and promoting consistent, responsive service.

• Perform other job-related responsibilities as assigned.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Ability to maintain accountability for team deliverable quality, schedule performance, work efficiency, and adherence to established processes.

• Strong workload-planning and resource-forecasting skills, including team assignments, project coverage, milestones, and estimate-to-complete information.

• Working knowledge of project budgets, financial performance, estimates, project controls, change management, and operational performance measures.

• Strong technical-review and QA/QC capabilities with the ability to identify quality, constructability, compliance, coordination, and execution concerns.

• Advanced knowledge of electrical power systems, substation engineering, protection and control, grounding, SCADA and communications, and data centers infrastructure.

• Strong understanding of electrical studies and applicable industry codes and standards, including NEC, NESC, IEEE, ANSI, NFPA, and client or utility requirements.

• Ability to investigate and resolve technical, workload, resource, safety, and project-delivery concerns and escalate issues appropriately.

• Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, coaching, conflict-resolution, client, and stakeholder-communication skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with Project Managers, Technical Advisors, leaders, clients, contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.

• Proficiency with engineering and business productivity tools applicable to the assigned specialty, including AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and power system modeling or study software.

• Demonstrates commitment to Atwell quality and safety standards, employee development, ethical conduct, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology from an accredited institution.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent operational experience required.

• 6-10 years of experience in electrical engineering or related field experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, power systems, substations, power delivery, industrial, or related infrastructure environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, designers, drafters, technicians, or other technical professionals.

• Experience supporting electrical design, power system studies, protection and control, QA/QC, project planning, budgets, proposals, client relationships, field support, construction support, and operational improvement.

Additional Position Details

• Work is performed in a professional work environment, with work location and reporting expectations determined by business needs and position requirements. Some field work may be required.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and operate a computer and other office productivity equipment.

• Frequently communicates and collaborates with clients, engineers, designers, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.

• Must be able to move around project sites and work in indoor or outdoor environments as required.

• Travel may be required based on client and project needs.

Cultural Fit

• Independent yet Collaborative

• Dependable

• Creative Problem Solver

• Natural Communicator

• Flexible

• Results Oriented

• Client Focused

• Enthusiastic

Fair Labor Standards Act

• Exempt | Overtime pay is not required.

Disclaimer

• The information contained herein is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to perform the job.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the USA.

• If current job responsibilities differ from assigned duties, please contact Human Resources.

Pay Range

$100,000—$165,000 USD

Atwell Benefits: To attract and retain the best professionals in the industry, we aim to provide an excellent working environment and a progressive benefits program designed to support your personal and professional needs.

Work/Life:

• Generous Paid Time Off

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible work schedules are available for some positions

• Tenure Awards — Travel Vouchers to see the world based on your travel preferences

Compensation:

• Competitive Compensation packages

• Annual bonuses, spot bonuses and peer recognition awards

• 401K match - 1:1 up to 4% of compensation

• Tuition Assistance

• Student Loan Repayment

• Financial Rewards for Obtaining Licensure

• Employee Referrals

• Annual Wellness Reimbursement for anything wellness related (Gym memberships, fitness tracker, home gym equipment, etc.)

• Dependent Care Match

‘Atwell’ness:

• Medical (BC/BS), Dental (Delta), and Vision (VSP)

• Family Planning & IVF Benefits

• Pet Insurance

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise - EDU
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations including universities and other educational institutions, helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes.

 - Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria.

 - Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution.

 - Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Experience navigating education or research environments, including institutional data, privacy, access controls and complex integrations, is valuable.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives.

 - Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. Experience working with education institutions, particularly universities, is preferred but not required. Prior OpenAI product experience is not required.





About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: GTM, Strategic Planning
jobs.description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search — all deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're building the best developer platform to power the next generation of software companies, and our go-to-market team is scaling fast to match.



We're looking for a lead in Go-To-Market Strategic Planning, to shape how Supabase's GTM engine runs. This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution. You'll work directly with Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Partnerships and Product to build the systems, processes, and insights that help our go-to-market teams move faster and smarter.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end GTM Strategic Planning, covering territory design, segmentation design, target planning and GTM capacity planning.

 - Build and maintain a single source of truth for planning data across HubSpot, BigQuery and Hex.

 - Translate company priorities into field actions through designing the planning strategy and seeing it through to execution.

 - Partner with Sales Leadership to design and iterate on coverage models, segmentation, and team structures that reflect how developers actually buy.

 - Define and track the metrics that matter, and surface insights that drive action, not just reporting.

 - Lead the Strategic Planning roadmap: guide and lead in tooling investments and evaluate new systems and processes against real business needs.

 - Work cross-functionally with talent acquisition, ensuring GTM and territory models stay aligned.

 - Collaborate with GTM Engineering on automations and data pipelines so that your strategy translates into working systems, not just slide decks.


WE'LL EXPECT YOU TO

 - Operate with high ownership. You set your own agenda, escalate when needed, and don't wait to be asked.

 - Work asynchronously and document clearly. We're a globally distributed team and writing is how we think.

 - Bridge strategy and execution. From drafting segmentation approaches in Google Docs to using SQL to monitor its effectiveness.

 - Build for scale without over-engineering. Simple systems that work beat perfect systems that don't ship.

 - Stay close to the customer. Developers are our buyers, and understanding how they discover, adopt, and expand is core to everything you'll do.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

 - Have 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Strategy Consulting, GTM Strategy, or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company.

 - Are fluent in the GTM stack: HubSpot, BigQuery, and Hightouch.

 - Can write SQL comfortably and aren't afraid to get into the data yourself before asking an analyst.

 - Have experience designing or overhauling sales processes, forecasting cadences, or territory models in a high-growth environment.

 - Understand product-led growth motions: PLS, usage-based triggers, and how PLG data flows into commercial pipelines.

 - Thrive with autonomy and are energized by building things that didn't exist before you joined.

 - Communicate with clarity across Finance, Sales, Success, Partnerships, Engineering, and Marketing without losing nuance.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:

Further, you will define the reporting, measurement, and orchestration of these programs and report their pipeline impact to marketing and sales leadership.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Create, optimize, and analyze end to end integrated campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels, including webinars, paid social and search, email and nurture, content syndication, and events

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (Federal & SLED) - North America
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist, Public Sector, you’ll work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, across US federal agencies and state, local and education (SLED) organizations. Your mission is to turn mission needs, legacy workflows and complex stakeholder dynamics into a clear picture of the most important problem, what the product needs, and where the impact is.

 

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

 - Work with agency leaders, program offices, prime contractors, state and municipal departments, and school and university systems to find the highest-impact opportunities for AI agents in citizen- and student-facing and operational workflows (e.g. benefits and licensing, 311 and contact centers, case management, admissions and student services, internal service desks).

 - Own flagship deals end-to-end: identify the use case, shape the commercial structure alongside GTM and contracts partners, and navigate public sector procurement paths (federal contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, RFPs) through to close.

 - Embed with customer teams, including time onsite (in secure facilities for federal work), and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

 - Guide customers on agent design, orchestration, and production readiness, including the security, privacy and compliance requirements specific to each segment, to get agents live and adopted.

 - Partner with Forward Deployed Software Engineers and Solution Engineers to build and demo solutions, present to audiences from technical teams to agency heads and elected or appointed officials, and feed field insights back to Product and Research.

 

Requirements

 - U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. government security clearance for federal engagements.

 - 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role with government agencies, a public sector systems integrator, or a government-focused technology company.

 - Familiarity with public sector buying and compliance (e.g. GSA schedules, OTAs, FedRAMP and ATO processes, state cooperative contracts, state-level security frameworks, FERPA/CJIS/HIPAA where relevant) and comfort in deal conversations and long enterprise sales cycles with GTM partners.

 - Basic Python and API integration skills, enough to prototype, demo and talk credibly with engineering teams, plus familiarity with LLM and AI agent frameworks.

 - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a track record of owning ambiguous, complex projects through to delivery.
   
    


LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States. There is a preference for candidates to be based in Washington, DC. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.



#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Associate - CPA
jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Lead with Relationships. Close with confidence.

Channel Sales is where growth happens fastest—for our clients and our people. You’ll work with businesses of 1–99 employees—the entrepreneurs powering local economies—helping them succeed with essential HR, payroll, and compliance solutions.

Through trusted partners like CPAs and client referrals, you won’t just sell—you’ll build relationships, unlock opportunities, and make a real impact. Every conversation matters, every referral opens a door, and every win accelerates your career.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

• Generate new business through referral partners and outbound outreach
• Build relationships with CPAs and existing clients to drive new logos
• Execute high-volume daily activity (calls, follow-ups, and partner touchpoints) to build pipeline
• Sell a full suite of solutions: payroll, HR, benefits, retirement, and compliance
• Manage a fast-paced sales cycle (1–2 weeks) with small business owners
• Own the full process—from prospecting to closing deals

What It Takes to Win

• Early-career sales professionals with 1-5 years of relevant experience.
• Comfort with high activity, fast cycles, and transactional deal sizes
• Resilience, drive, and competitive motivation
• Coachability and ability to quickly apply feedback
• Experience working toward goals or quotas (sales or similar environments) and demonstrated leadership experience—whether through work, school, nonprofits, fraternities/sororities, clubs, or other organizations (for example, serving as a treasurer, team lead, or project lead)

Why This Role

• Uncapped earning potential + performance incentives and award trips
• Rapid skill development in a high-volume, high-growth sales environment
• Strong access to opportunities through referral-based selling
• Real impact helping small businesses grow and stay compliant

If you’re driven, coachable, and ready to build a high-growth sales career—this is your starting point.

Qualifications

• H.S. Diploma - Required
• Bachelor's Degree - Preferred
• 1 year of experience in relevant sales/marketing role.
• Valid Drivers License - Required

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share that the compensation range for this position is typically between $57,000 - $110,000. This range includes base pay plus commissions but does not consider other components that make up the total rewards package for the position. If you are hired at Paychex, your overall compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience which may result in total compensation outside of this range.

Live the Paychex Values

• Act with uncompromising integrity.
• Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.
• Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.
• Work in partnership and support each other.
• Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.
• Treat each other with respect and dignity.

What's in it for you?

• We value your well-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) + employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
• We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
• We value your development: Our award-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
