jobs.title: Senior Manager, Counter Intrusion
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Counter-Intrusion Business Line works on products that enable operators to protect their people and assets from threats on land and sea. We are deployed in every major global operating theater and support a diversity of mission sets across both U.S. Government and allied partners.
The Mission Operations team is responsible for managing the execution, growth, and success of our customer accounts. Working across product, engineering, sales, and logistics teams, our Mission Operations Engineers own the customer relationships and develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side-by-side with customers to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril’s offerings alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations Engineers naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Orchestrate the deployment of Anduril products. Lead the planning and deployment of Anduril’s flagship hardware and software products in support of customer missions. Through collaboration with our engineering, logistics, and technical operations teams, Mission Operators are in charge of deploying our products to the field, training end users, and ensuring the high performance of our products. We are obsessed about engagement and keeping our finger on the pulse of how customers interact with our products. This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn’t quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer.

• Grow your business through customer success. In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. This requires establishing committed and trust-based partnerships with our customers to not only help them solve their immediate problems, but also to foresee future opportunities where Anduril’s technology can make them more effective. Understanding Anduril’s value proposition and articulating how we can have an impact on a customer’s problem set, from the executive level to the end user, is critical to positioning Anduril for the future.

• Shape our products to meet mission needs. Work side-by-side with our customers to understand their specific mission challenges and represent the customer as you work with Anduril engineers to shape products that solve critical national and international security challenges. Anduril engineers rely on Mission Operators to understand the lay of the land and bring a perspective that informs the product development process.

• Collaborate across nearly every Anduril team. Successfully deploying our complex hardware and software products requires collaborating with nearly every internal Anduril team - business development, engineering, product, logistics, finance, legal, contracting, technical operations, and many more. You’ll be responsible for ensuring each party is engaged and informed, and will therefore become well-versed in what it takes to really bring the best of Anduril to our customers.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Mission First Mindset. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers’ mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.

• Ownership Mentality. We’re looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.

• Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity. We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi-modal sensor fusion. Do you have a natural desire to see beyond simple cause and effect relationships to really understand how complex systems operate? Do you actively seek out opportunities to educate yourself? These capabilities form the foundation of our product offerings, so we are looking for those who are comfortable communicating technical concepts and can articulate them in the context of the customer’s mission.

• Structured Thinker and Problem Solver. Leading technical programs requires clear communication and well thought-out plans. We are looking for assertive communicators who bring a thoughtful perspective and honest dialogue. A solution-driven approach, the ability to distill complexity into its essential, digestible components, and the ability to supervise execution are critical to ensure mission success.

• High Value Team Member. Do you enjoy working as part of a team? At Anduril, the path to success weaves through the organization - account teams, engineering, logistics, technical operations, and more. It requires humility, an eagerness to learn, and empathy toward your fellow team member. We assume best intentions and empathize with customers just as we do with our colleagues. Can you develop rapport at both the user and executive levels? Do you enjoy sharing successes? We are a low ego group that promotes teamwork and collaboration to bring about success.

• 360 Degree Leader. We are a flat, non-hierarchical organization with a matrix structure that is dynamic and evolving. We expect you to be self-aware enough to recognize your position of unstated leadership within the company. You should have a demonstrated ability to lead and influence people through both formal and informal constructs and in situations where there is lack of clarity across teams. Finally, we need people who identify gaps and breakdowns and solve them immediately, rather than point them out and step back. You should also seek 360 feedback to help inform your growth trajectory as a leader.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• This role is directly tied to an ongoing, funded program within Anduril's Counter-Intrusion Business line.

• Candidates should be comfortable interacting and briefing all levels of government personnel from front line operators to GOFOs/SES on system capabilities and operational updates.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

• Willingness to travel up to 50%.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• PMP or similar certifications a plus.

• Border Security experience a plus.

• Prior military or contracting experience can be helpful.

• Experience with programming, scripting, or networking a plus.

Position is full-time from Anduril HQ but requires travel to support customer delivery and training events.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Support - Brand Onboarding
jobs.description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Associate, Brand Onboarding to join our Product Support team. This is a hands-on, in-the-queue role: you'll own your own Shopify onboarding queue, work directly with brands every day, and get them live fast. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Brand Onboarding.

You'll spend roughly 80% of your time onboarding brands and 20% on projects that make onboarding smoother for brands and the team. This role is remote and works Pacific Time business hours, giving our West Coast brands same-day coverage, with flexibility to support launches as needed.

Your Impact In The Role

• Own a dedicated queue of Shopify brands from kickoff through go-live, getting every brand live quickly with clear next steps, proactive updates, and no surprises

• Walk brands hands-on through setup (Shopify integration, tracking, catalog, and payment configuration), resolving blockers yourself within onboarding before they delay launch or become support tickets

• Take on at least one non-Shopify onboarding a month to build range and grow toward a mixed queue

• Proactively drive stalled and unresponsive brands forward, keeping account notes current so status is always clear

• Provide OOO coverage for Shopify and low-maintenance accounts so no brand stalls

• Handle complex onboarding questions through resolution, applying judgment beyond macros and escalating to the Manager when needed

• Keep onboarding docs and checklists up to date without being asked, flagging gaps, root causes, and repeat issues you see in the queue

• Help newer Associates during active onboardings and share what you learn with the team

You Are Energized By

• Being on the front line with brands and getting them to launch

• Juggling a full queue and keeping every account moving

• Figuring out why something broke, not just patching it

• Owning a problem from first flag to final fix, and bringing a proposed solution, not just the issue

• Direct feedback and evolving processes; you own mistakes openly and adjust quickly

• Fast-moving, high-growth environments where priorities shift and adaptability is a strength

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• 2 to 3 years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, customer support, or a related role

• Hands-on Shopify experience strongly preferred; e-commerce, creator, or affiliate platform experience a plus

• Proven ability to manage many accounts at once, balancing urgency, quality, and relationships

• Strong troubleshooting skills: you isolate issues and go beyond the script

• Accurately assesses brand impact and urgency to prioritize your queue

• Clear, complete written communication: brands, teammates, and Engineering can act on your updates without follow-up questions

• Strong written and verbal communication with brands and internal teams

• Precision in technical guidance: you confirm before you advise, especially on high-stakes launches

• Highly organized and reliable; you follow through on every account

Bonus Points

• Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment

• Familiarity with Intercom, Salesforce, or similar support and CRM tooling

• Knowledge of the creator economy, influencer marketing, or affiliate platforms

• Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Fin AI, Claude, or similar) to work faster and spot gaps

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission, and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!

Benefits & Perks

ShopMy invests in more than compensation. We support your health, your growth, and your life outside of work.

• Equity in ShopMy - Every employee is an owner; all roles receive equity

• Monetize Your Influence - Every employee builds and grows their own ShopMy page

• 401(k) with Company Match - 3% employer contribution, fully vested

• Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental & vision benefits, including a 100% employer-paid medical option and dependent coverage

• Mental Health Support and More - We offer employees and their dependents virtual mental health support, urgent care, and primary care visits at no cost

• Flexible PTO - Take the time you need, including your birthday off

• 13 Company Holidays

• 14 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

• Remote-First Culture with an NYC HQ - Some teams may have different location requirements

• Workplace & Wellness Stipends - Support for wellness, home office needs, and a Wellhub membership

• Disability & Life Insurance - 100% employer-paid

• Health Care FSA/HSA

• Annual Company Offsite

• Quarterly Team Co-Locations

ShopMy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm work authorization upon hire.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Job Title: Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Own the results of our Enterprise Account Executive team, from quota and booking attainment to net new enterprise customers.

As our Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales, you’ll lead a team of high-performing Account Executives winning net new business with enterprise customers. You’ll help those buyers see the value of Salesloft’s Predictive Revenue System and the Revenue Context behind it, and you’ll be accountable for delivering against budgeted revenue and KPI goals. In your first six months you will:

• Lead, develop and manage your team of Enterprise Account Executives to quota and booking targets.

• Work with Marketing, Sales Operations and Product to deliver against budgeted revenue and KPI goals.

• Raise team productivity and efficiency through innovation, new technologies, skill set training and process improvement.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE

• Move as One: You’ll partner with Marketing, Sales Operations and Product to hit revenue and KPI goals, and rally direct and indirect teams around shared results.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll run pipeline reviews and forecast from real signals, and say so when the data changes your mind.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll become a product expert who can demo and help close deals, and coach each Account Executive toward quota and their own career path.

• Customer-Inspired: You’ll help your team educate the market on the power of Salesloft and turn what enterprise buyers tell you into sharper deals and coaching.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a results-oriented, strategic leader who builds and coaches enterprise Account Executive teams to win net new business, and who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

• Led new logo enterprise sales teams in a SaaS environment for 5+ years.

• Built and motivated enterprise sales teams that grew pipeline and hit revenue targets.

• Achieved and exceeded revenue targets, and guided teams through complex, evangelical sales cycles.

• Brought urgency and an execution focus, with a belief in Salesloft’s mission and an approach that goes beyond relationship management.

• Worked self-directed and resourcefully, with a strong work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile.

• Rallied direct and indirect staff behind shared results as a team-building leader.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience hiring, developing and coaching Account Executives to consistent month-to-month results.

• In-depth knowledge of competitors and unified communications and collaboration industry trends.

• Experience mentoring or coaching peer leaders on a growing team.

THE TEAM
Salesloft’s Sales Leadership team is tight-knit and collaborative, and works closely together to achieve success. We are experienced salespeople who are passionate about the teams we lead, our product and, above all, our customers. We stay in the weeds with our teams, making sure each member gets the training, coaching, tools and mentorship they need to grow and be successful.

BENEFITS:

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at  https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:

• Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.

• Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.

• Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.

• Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.

• Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for the role:

We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:

• 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.

• Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.

• A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.

• High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.

• First-principles systems thinking that stays oriented to outcomes. You make clear decisions that drive toward results instead of getting stuck in open questions.

• Strong product taste, and an instinct for leverage: the change that makes many teams better, not the one component polished in isolation.

• Hands-on fluency at the intersection of AI and software development: a real command of how emerging AI paradigms are changing the way software gets built, and the ability to turn that into practical leverage, both for the design system itself and for the people who build on it.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com.

jobs.title: Director, CMC Product Development - Late Stage, Operations
jobs.description:
Purpose

The Product Development Director (PDD) will be a member of the Operations Strategy & Pipeline Leadership (OSPL) team within the Product Development, Science & Technology (PDS&T) organization. Reporting to one of the Therapeutic Area Leads, the PDD will be responsible for pipeline programs from a Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) perspective. They will lead the Product Presentation and Device Strategy Team (PPDST) and build the CMC development strategy for the late-stage assets, aligning with the clinical and regulatory development strategy from the Asset Strategy Team (AST). The programs can span modalities and presentations. Modalities can include small molecules, biologics (protein, gene therapy, toxin etc.) and antibody drug conjugates.  Product presentations can include oral dose, parenteral and devices (therapeutics and aesthetic).

The PDD is accountable for creating a CMC development plan in collaboration with line functions and ensures strategic alignment with the enterprise functions (Clinical, Regulatory and Commercial) cross-functionally at the AST. The PDD is the spokesperson for CMC-related aspects at asset-level governances and represents the assets within Operations to ensure support of late-stage development activities and readiness for launch. They are responsible for communicating development and regulatory risks and seeking feedback from CMC leadership.

Responsibilities

• Represents all CMC areas on the AST serving as spokesperson for the CMC project team and ensures information flow among the AST and all line functions. Ensures high quality science, technology, deliverables, and collaborates to ensure compliance with global regulatory and quality requirements. Participates in interactions with Regulatory and Health Authorities.
• Critically evaluates and integrates drug substance, drug product, and device inputs to CMC team strategies and plans that align with corporate business objectives. Decision-making will often require assessment and integration of physical chemical properties, formulation science, engineering, analytical, and device technical information in conjunction with the project strategy, with full consideration of current regulatory and compliance requirements.
• Manages multiple projects and contributes to project prioritization. Negotiates for additional resources when required, influences project timelines to ensure proper completion of required activities. Implements creative approaches to conserve resources, and achieve efficiency with respect to time, and budget. Provides feedback to CMC management on resource and talent opportunities.
• Reviews contracts with external partners and consultants. Develops a budget in collaboration with AST and obtains resources from functional areas. Accountable for the success and overall CMC quality of a given project. Ensures timely execution of project plan to deliver high quality with respect to science, technology, compliance and cost effectiveness.
• Represents AbbVie on high profile partnerships and collaborations with other pharma/biotech companies and at the Joint Development Committee level driving decisions for the development programs.
• Promotes scientific and entrepreneurial thinking, encourage creativity and manage quality and results with respect to science, time, budget and resources.
• Ensures compliance with regulatory, health, safety and environmental requirements. Stay abreast of developments in global technical, regulatory and compliance arena and industry practice.
• Apprises CMC Management of plans and risks through regular communications and periodic reviews throughout development and in support of global filings, approvals and launches.
• Ensures high level of morale in the CMC team.

• Bachelor’s Degree with at least 18 years of experience in CMC functions required; Master’s Degree with at least 16 years of relevant CMC experience required; or PhD with at least 10 years of relevant CMC experience required to effectively manage global teams and all CMC activities with respect to science, technology, quality, regulatory/compliance requirements, budget and resources.
• Multiple product development experiences of leading a CMC team through regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/PMA/510K preferred).
• Must possess good scientific writing skills and good verbal skills.
• Must have a good working knowledge of regulatory requirements and familiarity with relevant CMC development approaches. (Device regulatory requirements preferred.)

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Public Sector - West
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Public Sector Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the West timezone.  This position requires travel up to 50% of the time and proximity to an international airport is preferred.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

• You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

• Conduct product demonstrations and facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers, and ensure these prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.

• Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.

• Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.

• Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

• Have the ability to be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.

• Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.

• Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.

• Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor’s of Science degree from a 4-year accredited university

• 5+ years of experience working with customers in a pre-sales technical role, customer success, or customer/product support capacity (Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, etc.)

• Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

• Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations

• Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems

• Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation and control systems

• Working knowledge of various integration standards and transports (XML, REST, SOAP, EDI, etc.)

• Experience integrating with RESTful APIs between SaaS applications

• Exposure to various SaaS-based integrations

• Must be located within and authorized to work in the United States

An ideal candidate also has:

• Bachelor’s of Science degree or advanced education in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline

• Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent languageWork experience building solutions leveraging open API’s

• Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications

• Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with raspberry pi, arduino, etc.)

• Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that OTE pay may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$198,050—$233,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations within the Healthcare and Life Sciences segment (HLS), helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness.  You will work across clinical, operational, administrative and research workflows, translating security, privacy and governance requirements into practical deployment decisions. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes.

 - Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria.

 - Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution.

 - Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback.

 - Partner with customer security, privacy, clinical and business teams to design responsible AI deployments, including data handling, access controls, evaluation, human oversight and monitoring.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Have experience delivering AI or software in healthcare, life sciences or similarly complex regulated enterprises, with measurable outcomes beyond a proof of concept and familiarity with sensitive data, legacy systems and interoperability.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives.

 - Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity.

 - Healthcare or life sciences experience is strongly preferred; strong candidates from other regulated enterprise environments are also encouraged to apply.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. Prior OpenAI product experience is not required.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

Mission:

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

Position Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday - Friday, between the hours of 7:00am - 6:00pm (will be 5 - 8 hour shifts).

Position Overview:

The Clinical Review Pharmacist performs the first pharmacist verification of prescriptions, ensuring accuracy, appropriate dosing, and legal compliance before orders move forward for fulfillment. This role also supports patient and provider/clinic communications and plays a key part in identifying and communicating trends in order entry to continuously improve quality, efficiency, and technician training, according to Strive Pharmacy standard operating procedures.

Key Responsibilities:

Join the forefront of healthcare excellence, where you'll be:

• Performing the first pharmacist verification of prescriptions

• Reviewing, interpreting, and accurately approving prescriptions to ensure safety, accuracy, appropriate dosing, and legal compliance before orders move forward for fulfillment

• Identifying and communicating trends in order entry accuracy to strengthen data entry quality and technician training across all sites

• Maintaining verification speed and throughput standards without compromising accuracy

• Consulting with clinics and prescribing providers to resolve clinical discrepancies, clarify orders, and guide appropriate therapy and dosing for optimal individualized care

• Managing inbound and outbound phone communications with patients and providers, serving as the clinical escalation point for complex patient or provider concerns

• Counseling patients

• Maintain strict adherence to state and federal laws, including DEA regulations for controlled substances and HIPAA privacy guidelines

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum of Bachelor of Science (BS) in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited institution

• Pharmacist license active and in good standing (Arizona license at minimum)

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in compounding

• Understanding of aseptic technique and familiarity with USP guidelines

• Experience with order verification

• Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying trends in operational or quality data

• Strong understanding of pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and state/federal pharmacy regulations

• High attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and efficient computer navigation skills for pharmacy management software

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Experience with call center software

Work Environment:

This position is primarily based in an onsite work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Annual Salary

$125,000—$130,000 USD

Join Us in Making an Impact:

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

Benefits/ Perks:

Strive Pharmacy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Employer-paid healthcare coverage, effective the 1st day of the following month of your hire date

• Free Strive compounded medications for employees based on a valid patient-specific prescription from a licensed healthcare provider

• Paid time off

• Sick time

• FSA and HSA options

• Parental leave

• 401(k) with employer matching

• Life insurance

• Vision and dental insurance

• Veterinary insurance

Culture:

Culture isn't an afterthought at Strive. It's something we actively build. We foster a collaborative, engaging workplace where employees have opportunities to connect, celebrate, and build meaningful relationships with their colleagues. We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, both inside and outside the workplace.

EEO:

Strive Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

Position Summary

The Director, Utilities & Electrical owns strategic discipline leadership, people leadership, technical governance and project enablement for electrical power systems, clean utilities, black utilities, energy infrastructure, reliability, maintainability, electrical safety and operational readiness within AbbVie Global Engineering.

The role provides senior technical and organizational leadership for AbbVie’s global manufacturing network and strategic capital investments through standards ownership, front-end engineering support, technical decision-making, project risk management and disciplined execution across priority investment programs, manufacturing sites and technology platforms.

The Director leads and develops a global team of electrical and utilities technical experts, establishes clear priorities and accountabilities, and ensures the organization has the capability and capacity required to support brownfield expansions, modernization programs, debottlenecking, infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle asset replacement and greenfield manufacturing investments.

The role serves as the senior Global Engineering authority for electrical and utilities strategy, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, resilient, energy efficient, maintainable and capable of supporting current and future manufacturing requirements.

The Director partners with Strategic Investments, project delivery teams, operations, quality, EHS, validation/CQV, site engineering, sustainability, digital/automation and external engineering partners to deliver technically robust, scalable and business-aligned engineering solutions.

Global Engineering Governance and Standards

• Establish, own and deploy global engineering standards, design criteria, specifications, technical practices and governance expectations for electrical power systems, clean utilities, black utilities, energy infrastructure, reliability, maintainability and electrical safety.

• Act as the senior discipline authority for material electrical and utilities decisions affecting safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability, resilience or lifecycle value.

• Define discipline strategy and multiyear capability roadmaps aligned with AbbVie’s manufacturing network strategy, sustainability objectives and strategic investment priorities.

• Govern consistent application of standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.

• Establish assurance and review processes that verify technical quality at key project stage gates.

• Lead resolution and escalation of significant discipline risks, deviations from standards and cross-project technical issues.

• Represent Global Engineering in enterprise technical governance forums and communicate clear, executive-ready recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Strategic Capital Investment Leadership

• Lead discipline input to front-end engineering, facility concepts, site master planning, investment option evaluation, business cases and technology selection.

• Define electrical and utilities design strategies for strategic projects, including power architecture, utility generation and distribution, redundancy philosophy, capacity planning, energy performance, maintainability, monitoring and operational readiness.

• Ensure discipline assumptions, deliverables, risks, interfaces, resources and decisions are incorporated into program plans, cost estimates and execution strategies.

• Establish project assurance priorities and direct senior technical reviews at concept, basic design, detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover stages.

• Balance safety, quality, compliance, reliability, sustainability, cost and schedule when making or recommending investment decisions.

• Apply global lessons learned and network standards to improve project quality, speed, predictability and readiness across the portfolio.

Electrical and Utilities Technical Leadership

• Lead technical decision-making for medium- and low-voltage power distribution, substations, transformers, switchgear, motor control, emergency and standby power, uninterruptible power supplies, grounding, lightning protection and electrical protection systems.

• Provide governance for electrical safety, arc-flash risk, hazardous-area classification interfaces, protection coordination, power quality, system studies and safe equipment lifecycle management.

• Direct strategies for clean utilities, including purified water, water for injection, clean steam, process gases and associated generation, storage, distribution, monitoring and sanitization systems.

• Direct strategies for black utilities, including plant steam, chilled water, cooling water, compressed air, nitrogen, natural gas, wastewater and other supporting infrastructure.

• Set expectations for system capacity, redundancy, resilience, reliability, maintainability, energy efficiency and future expansion.

• Ensure electrical and utilities systems are appropriately integrated with process, HVAC, mechanical, civil, structural, automation, instrumentation and building-management systems.

• Oversee technical reviews of load lists, single-line diagrams, utility balances, capacity models, equipment specifications, vendor packages, design calculations and commissioning strategies.

• Ensure engineering deliverables support GMP compliance, validation/CQV, safe operation, maintainability, sustainability and effective site handover.

• Drive timely resolution of complex technical issues and ensure decisions are documented, risk assessed and communicated.

People Leadership and Organizational Capability

• Lead, develop and retain a high-performing global team of electrical, clean-utilities and black-utilities technical experts.

• Set clear direction, priorities, objectives and performance expectations aligned with Global Engineering and Strategic Investments priorities.

• Allocate technical resources across programs and sites based on business criticality, project risk, specialist capability and portfolio demand.

• Coach and mentor technical leaders and subject-matter experts, strengthening technical judgment, leadership capability and succession readiness.

• Establish structured development plans, knowledge-transfer mechanisms and succession plans for critical electrical and utilities capabilities.

• Build an inclusive, accountable and collaborative culture focused on engineering excellence, safety, quality and reliable delivery.

• Clarify decision rights and interfaces between Global Engineering, site engineering, project teams and external partners.

• Use external engineering partners and specialist resources strategically while retaining effective owner-side knowledge and governance.

Portfolio, Delivery and Partner Governance

• Provide discipline oversight across multiple concurrent projects, manufacturing sites and technology platforms.

• Establish portfolio-level visibility of significant technical decisions, design maturity, risks, resource constraints and assurance findings.

• Work with project leadership to define discipline deliverables, review schedules, staffing needs and escalation routes.

Cross-Functional and Enterprise Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Corporate
jobs.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The accounting team provides in-depth guidance to the rest of the organization on financial results and solves complex financial questions in an environment of new regulations, technologies and products. Within it, the Expenses and Corporate Balance Sheet team owns general accounting outside of revenue: operating expenses, bonus and other accruals, prepaids and amortization, share-based compensation and equity reporting, related party transactions, and Paxos’ corporate balance sheet, including digital assets, DeFi, platform cash, corporate bank accounts and intercompany eliminations. We work closely with the revenue, reporting and international entities teams, and we run much of our work through AI agents and automation we have built ourselves.

About the role

As a Senior Accountant, you will own a broad set of close areas across expenses and the corporate balance sheet. You will book and support accruals, prepaids and share-based compensation, reconcile corporate cash and digital asset balances, and account for related party and intercompany activity. Digital assets are what set this role apart from a traditional general accounting role: you will trace transactions on-chain and through to our platform, turn what you find into correct entries, and take over reconciliation processes that run on AI agents today. This role suits someone with strong general accounting fundamentals who is also crypto-native and reaches for AI tools to work faster and automate what can be automated.

What you'll do

 - Own expense accounting and month-end close tasks outside of revenue, including balance sheet reconciliations and P&L flux analysis.

 - Book and support bonus and other accruals, and maintain prepaid schedules and amortization.

 - Account for share-based compensation and support equity-related financial reporting.

 - Reconcile the corporate balance sheet: corporate bank accounts, platform cash held by Paxos entities, and digital asset and DeFi positions, tying the GL and subledger to bank, custodian and on-chain balances.

 - Review and trace transactions on-chain using block explorers such as Arkham, Etherscan and BscScan, follow activity from the chain through to our platform, and act as the go-to resource for the revenue accounting team when on-chain activity needs to be traced.

 - Book realized and unrealized gains and losses correctly, and maintain the rollforwards and support behind them.

 - Account for related party transactions, including AP and loans, and prepare intercompany elimination entries.

 - Take ownership of our AI agents built with Claude, including the agent that pulls data directly from on-chain sources, and extend them when we add a new chain or a new type of activity.

 - Run the monthly Snowflake queries and Google Apps Scripts that feed the close, and use AI to update or troubleshoot them when needed.

 - Find manual steps in the close and automate them, with review controls in place.

 - Immerse yourself in blockchain technology, cryptocurrency for enterprises and investors, our regulation-first approach, and more!

 - For folks with fewer than 4 years of relevant work experience, this is a hybrid role based in our New York City Midtown office, with in-office attendance required.

About you

 - 3+ years of accounting experience, ideally including public accounting or audit and time in-house.

 - Bachelor’s degree in accounting; CPA (or equivalent) preferred. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP.

 - Experience owning close areas with minimal oversight: expense accruals, prepaids and amortization, balance sheet and bank reconciliations, and flux analysis.

 - Working knowledge of share-based compensation accounting (ASC 718) and related party transactions.

 - Crypto-native: hands-on experience reviewing transactions on-chain, with a working understanding of wallets and addresses, tokens, gas fees and stablecoin mint and burn. You can trace a transaction across multiple hops and explain what happened without being taught the basics.

 - A clear understanding of realized versus unrealized gains and losses, including when an unrealized gain or loss becomes realized and how to book each (e.g., ASC 350-60 for in-scope crypto assets).

 - Understanding of intercompany eliminations and consolidation. Hands-on experience is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp (for example, from audit) is enough.

 - AI-forward: you use tools like Claude in your daily work, and you are either eager to learn how to run and maintain AI agents or already building them.

 - Comfortable running existing SQL queries in Snowflake and using AI to modify them. You don’t need to be a SQL expert.

 - Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, and the ability to run and troubleshoot Google Apps Scripts, using AI to figure things out when needed.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with colleagues across APAC and European time zones.

 - Nice to have: experience with DeFi activity (e.g., staking, lending, liquidity pools), building AI agents or automated workflows used in a close, pulling in data for a new blockchain, using a digital asset subledger, NetSuite or an equity platform such as Carta, and prior experience in crypto or financial services.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Space
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Space team in Costa Mesa, CA someone who brings deep technical credibility and the leadership presence to match. This is not a management role, but it is a senior one: you'll be a technical anchor on a tight-knit team, the kind of engineer others look to when something breaks, when architecture decisions need to be made, and when the room needs someone who can cut through noise and drive clarity.

You will operate, maintain, harden, and evolve a classified networking capability that delivers operational Space Domain Awareness data for the United States Space Force. You'll own the reliability and security posture of globally distributed infrastructure in air-gapped environments standing up new sites, hardening systems to STIG compliance, building and maintaining infrastructure as code, and ensuring observability across the stack.

You'll work hand in hand with Mission Software Engineers, Product Operations teammates, Mission Operations Engineers, and Technical Program Managers to deploy new capabilities on operationally relevant timelines. You'll also be the connective tissue between engineering and the end-users at customer sites worldwide providing clear documentation, training remote staff, and serving as a first point of contact when issues arise.

This role is directly tied to an ongoing, funded program within Anduril’s Space Business Line. The program requires building and fielding a resilient, software-defined, distributed mesh networking layer for critical Space Domain Awareness data. We work with mission partners and operators to deploy reliable and robust capabilities on operationally-relevant fielding timelines to meet complex challenges across the DOD and IC.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as a senior technical subject matter expert on a growing Product Operations team supporting a live, operational DoD system, helping set the standard for how the team operates, communicates, and solves problems

• Stand up, harden, and maintain classified Linux-based infrastructure across globally distributed sites in air-gapped environments

• Apply and enforce STIG compliance and system hardening standards across all deployed environments this is not checkbox work, you will own the security posture

• Build, maintain, and evolve infrastructure as code using Ansible/Puppet automating provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines

• Write and maintain operational tooling, automation scripts, and workflow optimizations in Bash and Python

• Architect and maintain comprehensive observability across the stack using Splunk/ELK/Open Search logging, alerting, and tracing for distributed systems

• Manage and operate containerized workloads in Kubernetes at scale in production, classified environments

• Provide real-time incident response, rapid root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex issues spanning application code and backing infrastructure

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Software Engineering, Mission Ops, and TPMs to validate operational readiness of new deployments, features, and integrations

• Provide 24x7 on-call support as part of a team supporting the Space Domain Awareness mission on behalf of the United States Space Force

• Drive continuous improvement proactive automation, system optimization, and process refinement with minimal supervision and strong judgment on when to escalate

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active U.S. Secret security clearance (non-negotiable must currently hold and be able to maintain- preferred TS/SCI clearance)

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments deploying, scaling, debugging, and managing containerized workloads. This is core to the role, not adjacent.

• Expert-level Linux proficiency you live in the terminal, you understand the OS deeply (networking, filesystems, systemd, SELinux, kernel tuning) but this is an engineering and operations role, not a sysadmin role. You build and automate, not just maintain.

• Proven experience with STIG compliance and system hardening you've applied STIGs, remediated findings, and understand the "why" behind the controls, not just the checklist

• Strong experience standing up infrastructure in air-gapped/classified environments you understand the unique constraints and have operated in them

• Proficiency with Ansible Puppet and Terraform for building, managing, and versioning infrastructure as code at scale

• Strong scripting ability in Bash and Python writing production-grade automation, tooling, and operational scripts

• Hands-on experience with observability tooling Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing distributed systems

• Leadership presence without the title you command respect through competence, directness, and reliability. You can walk into a room, align a group of strong engineers, and drive decisions. You are not a manager, but people follow your lead because you've earned it.

• Strong communication and documentation skills you can translate complex technical problems into clear, actionable language across audiences

• Strong initiative and self-direction in isolated, secure environments

• Understanding of software development practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, and agile methodologies

• Enthusiasm for transforming U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology in space environments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Military background particularly veterans who understand the operational environment, the mission, and how to work within DoD culture. This carries real weight for this role.

• Experience with COMSEC and HAIPE-compliant inline Type-1 network encryptors

• Networking certifications (CCNA or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Space Domain Awareness data and systems

• Knowledge of Anduril's Lattice OS and its capabilities

• Proficiency in additional languages (Go, Rust, Java) and contributions to open-source projects

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

This role partners closely with the Associate Director and Director of Consumer Marketing and with cross-functional stakeholders—including Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Patient Services, Sales, Analytics and Performance Excellence (APEX), and agency partners—to deliver aligned, compliant, and impactful consumer marketing programs.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, execution-oriented marketer who brings strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and executional discipline, and who can work effectively in a highly matrixed, regulated environment. This role offers hands-on experience across a multifaceted consumer omnichannel ecosystem and the opportunity to build deep experience across a broad range of marketing disciplines.

Key Responsibilities:

Consumer Strategy & Execution

• Lead the development and management of DTC tactics designed to drive awareness, consideration, and conversion, with a strong emphasis on digital communications (e.g., website, CRM, social, paid media, video/audio, and direct mail).
• Support the development and execution of consumer marketing plans aligned to brand and business objectives, ensuring consistent pull-through of brand strategy across all consumer channels and touchpoints.
• Apply market trends, competitive dynamics, consumer insights, and data-driven analysis to inform and refine marketing strategy and patient segmentation.

Media, Research & Measurement
