jobs.title: Software Engineer III | Security
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

An ideal candidate will have strong software engineering, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals. This position works with security researchers and developers, developing systems to make them more efficient and effective. You'll deliver impactful solutions that empower research and development, as well as working directly with network data to emulate adversary behavior.

ExtraHop offers an exciting, high-energy, and versatile environment in which people are encouraged and supported to collaborate on industry-leading technology and create a world-class engineering team while they develop and enrich their individual growth. And we're doing it with creativity, intellectual curiosity, and deep critical thinking.

ExtraHop R&D supports fully-flexible work options that include full-time onsite, hybrid, and fully remote working arrangements. Except for a few roles that require physical access, we believe in supporting you in making the choice that works best for you and makes the team successful.

Key Responsibilities

• Support Threat Research and Detection Engineering teams by providing tools and automation to accelerate Research & Development.

• Develop and support internal systems, including:

• Software deployment pipelines supporting continuous delivery

• Pipelines for ingestion of new network identifiers to enable fingerprinting of device, software, and cloud services

• Threat Intelligence acquisition and sharing

• On-demand threat research labs using modern Infrastructure-as-Code and Cloud-based technologies

• Continuous Testing and Validation pipelines

• Work with a collaborative, dedicated and seasoned team of engineers

• Actively participate in code review to ensure quality and uplevel other engineers

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering

• Excellent engineering chops

• Solid knowledge of Python

• Experience developing and deploying code for enterprise software applications with emphasis on code quality and maintainability

• In-depth knowledge of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model and excellent working knowledge of the key protocols from Layer 2 through Layer 7

• Self-starter with a strong problem-solving track record and ability to grow and learn

• Excellent teammate and collaborator who can iterate on problems quickly.

• Proficient at communication in both spoken and written forms, including documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with network packet-level data using tools like tshark, tcpdump, tcprewrite, and Scapy to directly interact with this data.

• Strong understanding of TCP/IP and Layer 7 protocols

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

• Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

• FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

• Educational Reimbursement

• 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Engineer, Space
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Product Operations Engineer to join our Space team in Costa Mesa, CA someone who brings deep technical credibility and the leadership presence to match. This is not a management role, but it is a senior one: you'll be a technical anchor on a tight-knit team, the kind of engineer others look to when something breaks, when architecture decisions need to be made, and when the room needs someone who can cut through noise and drive clarity.

You will operate, maintain, harden, and evolve a classified networking capability that delivers operational Space Domain Awareness data for the United States Space Force. You'll own the reliability and security posture of globally distributed infrastructure in air-gapped environments standing up new sites, hardening systems to STIG compliance, building and maintaining infrastructure as code, and ensuring observability across the stack.

You'll work hand in hand with Mission Software Engineers, Product Operations teammates, Mission Operations Engineers, and Technical Program Managers to deploy new capabilities on operationally relevant timelines. You'll also be the connective tissue between engineering and the end-users at customer sites worldwide providing clear documentation, training remote staff, and serving as a first point of contact when issues arise.

This role is directly tied to an ongoing, funded program within Anduril’s Space Business Line. The program requires building and fielding a resilient, software-defined, distributed mesh networking layer for critical Space Domain Awareness data. We work with mission partners and operators to deploy reliable and robust capabilities on operationally-relevant fielding timelines to meet complex challenges across the DOD and IC.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as a senior technical subject matter expert on a growing Product Operations team supporting a live, operational DoD system, helping set the standard for how the team operates, communicates, and solves problems

• Stand up, harden, and maintain classified Linux-based infrastructure across globally distributed sites in air-gapped environments

• Apply and enforce STIG compliance and system hardening standards across all deployed environments this is not checkbox work, you will own the security posture

• Build, maintain, and evolve infrastructure as code using Ansible/Puppet automating provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines

• Write and maintain operational tooling, automation scripts, and workflow optimizations in Bash and Python

• Architect and maintain comprehensive observability across the stack using Splunk/ELK/Open Search logging, alerting, and tracing for distributed systems

• Manage and operate containerized workloads in Kubernetes at scale in production, classified environments

• Provide real-time incident response, rapid root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex issues spanning application code and backing infrastructure

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Software Engineering, Mission Ops, and TPMs to validate operational readiness of new deployments, features, and integrations

• Provide 24x7 on-call support as part of a team supporting the Space Domain Awareness mission on behalf of the United States Space Force

• Drive continuous improvement proactive automation, system optimization, and process refinement with minimal supervision and strong judgment on when to escalate

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active U.S. Secret security clearance (non-negotiable must currently hold and be able to maintain- preferred TS/SCI clearance)

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments deploying, scaling, debugging, and managing containerized workloads. This is core to the role, not adjacent.

• Expert-level Linux proficiency you live in the terminal, you understand the OS deeply (networking, filesystems, systemd, SELinux, kernel tuning) but this is an engineering and operations role, not a sysadmin role. You build and automate, not just maintain.

• Proven experience with STIG compliance and system hardening you've applied STIGs, remediated findings, and understand the "why" behind the controls, not just the checklist

• Strong experience standing up infrastructure in air-gapped/classified environments you understand the unique constraints and have operated in them

• Proficiency with Ansible Puppet and Terraform for building, managing, and versioning infrastructure as code at scale

• Strong scripting ability in Bash and Python writing production-grade automation, tooling, and operational scripts

• Hands-on experience with observability tooling Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing distributed systems

• Leadership presence without the title you command respect through competence, directness, and reliability. You can walk into a room, align a group of strong engineers, and drive decisions. You are not a manager, but people follow your lead because you've earned it.

• Strong communication and documentation skills you can translate complex technical problems into clear, actionable language across audiences

• Strong initiative and self-direction in isolated, secure environments

• Understanding of software development practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, and agile methodologies

• Enthusiasm for transforming U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology in space environments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Military background particularly veterans who understand the operational environment, the mission, and how to work within DoD culture. This carries real weight for this role.

• Experience with COMSEC and HAIPE-compliant inline Type-1 network encryptors

• Networking certifications (CCNA or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Space Domain Awareness data and systems

• Knowledge of Anduril's Lattice OS and its capabilities

• Proficiency in additional languages (Go, Rust, Java) and contributions to open-source projects

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Business Development – Energy & Commander
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Luxor is a full-stack platform for the Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure industries. We build software, hardware, financial, and energy solutions that help mining operators improve performance, manage risk, optimize costs, and scale their operations.

Location: Miami, FL, in office. Our Miami office opens in Q1 2027; until then you'll work from our SF office or remotely with regular customer travel.
Start: Immediately
Reports to: SVP, Business Development




ABOUT THE ROLE

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods, and one person owns each pod's revenue. We're hiring the person who will own Energy & Commander, our fastest-growing product surface and our biggest untapped opportunity.

 - Luxor Energy is a Bitcoin-native retail electric provider (REP) in ERCOT and a QSE expanding into SPP. We help large flexible loads cut power costs and earn from their flexibility through competitive retail supply, demand response (ERS), ancillary services, 4CP avoidance and CRR credit maximization. Miners can post collateral in BTC or settle power bills directly from pool earnings.

 - Luxor Commander is our fleet management platform, already running on roughly 500 MW of mining infrastructure. It gives operators real-time monitoring, remote control and automated curtailment that responds to hashprice and energy prices.

Texas and SPP are full of miners and other large loads heading into supply renewals. Your job is to turn that footprint into revenue.

This is a hunter-closer seat. Our energy, operations and product teams will support you, but you own the pipeline, the number and the close.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Energy & Commander revenue and the quarterly targets you agree with leadership.

 - Source and close new REP, QSE and demand-response business with Bitcoin miners, data centers and other large flexible loads in ERCOT and SPP.

 - Convert Commander's free and trial users to paid, and pair Commander with energy contracts so they sell as one deal.

 - Get ahead of the renewal calendar: know when every target site's power contract renews, and be in the room 6+ months out.

 - Build and work broker and channel relationships, while growing a direct RFP flow.

 - Run the full cycle: outbound, discovery, pricing (adders, DR revenue shares, term structures), proposals, negotiation and close.

 - Spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers and partners, including on-site visits and industry events.

 - Bring what you learn in the market back to product: what customers want, what competitors charge and where the openings are.

 - Help hand off to other key decision makers or cross-sell the rest of the Luxor stack (Pool, LuxOS, derivatives, hardware) when the account calls for it.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in B2B sales or business development, with a record of deals you personally sourced and closed. Bring numbers.

 - A working understanding of US power markets: retail supply, adders, index vs. fixed pricing, demand response and ancillary services. ERCOT and/or SPP experience is a strong plus.

 - Comfort selling technical, consultative products to senior operators, CFOs and energy managers.

 - A network among miners, data center operators, brokers or energy market participants is a plus.

 - Exposure to Bitcoin mining, ASICs or mining management software is a plus.

 - Willingness to work in office in Miami and travel regularly to customer sites and events.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

 - You'd rather own a number than a strategy deck.

 - You get energy from connecting with a net new site and turning it into a signed contract.

 - You learn markets fast and can explain energy economics in plain English.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You prefer to set strategy and hand deals to someone else to close.

 - You need someone else to schedule your follow-ups.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base plus uncapped, gross-profit-based commission.

 - Real ownership: you are accountable for two product lines.

 - A full ecosystem to sell (pool, firmware, derivatives, hardware, energy, software), so you can build deals no single-product competitor can match.

 - Health, dental and vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO.



At Luxor we believe that meaningful contributions can be made by anyone. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Luxor welcomes all!


HOW WE USE AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use AI tools to support certain parts of our hiring process, and we believe in being transparent about how they’re used.

During your application, AI may assist in reviewing CVs, qualifications, and assignments by providing additional insights, but it does not make decisions, every application is evaluated at each step by a member of our hiring team.

We also use AI to transcribe interviews so our team can stay focused on the conversation rather than note-taking. Any voice recordings are automatically deleted within 15 days.

In addition, AI helps us keep candidates informed about their application status and helps us understand how our process is working so we can improve it over time.

In all cases, AI is used to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. If you have any questions about how we use these tools or your data, or if you would prefer to opt out of any of these features, please include them in the dedicated section of the application form, and we’ll follow up accordingly.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, ClinicalAI Real-World Data (RWD)
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera's Real-World Data (RWD) ClinicalAI team turns clinical documents into structured data. The team has developed a platform that is now integral to Natera’s key initiatives leveraging RWD.  In this role, you will own the experience of the people who work in the platform for their day to day operations. You will also own agentic workflows end to end: translating a stakeholder team's process into reliable, repeatable automation, deciding where AI agents act and where people interact, and making sure the final output is something the team can actually use.

This is an individual-contributor PM role: you'll shadow users, dig into the data yourself, write the requirements, and drive changes from idea to rollout, continuously focused on efficiency and innovation for your users. You will partner closely with engineering, software quality, and clinical teams that consume the data.

If you like making complex, high-volume workflows simple for expert users, turning AI agents into outputs people trust and act on, and seeing the improvement show up in the numbers, you will enjoy this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the user-experience backlog and priorities for the user-facing application, including case review and editing, document navigation and evidence, work queues, and administrative review, in line with the overall platform roadmap.

• Increase efficiencies without tradeoffs to accuracy: shadow end users, measure where the time goes, and validate problems before they become backlog commitments.

• Turn intricate, multi-step review workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces.

• Own how new AI capabilities appear to end users; define the experience, pilot with leads, and roll out without disrupting live production work.

• Own agentic workflows end to end, from discovery through launch, validation, and iteration: translate a stakeholder team's needs into a phased workflow, decide where AI agents act and where people stay in the loop, and make sure the result is accurate, auditable, and efficient at scale.

• Deliver usable outputs to stakeholder teams across the business: agree on what a finished output looks like and how success is measured, confirm it is used in their work, and close the loop when it is not.

• Partner with the AI scientists and engineers to take agent prototypes to production: weigh evaluation results for user and stakeholder impact, decide how much autonomy a workflow is ready for, and own the pilot, rollout, and success metric.

• Own the onboarding playbook for new user groups, including internal teams and vendor partners: access and roles, training cases in the test environment, team-lead setup, and support materials.

• Plan user-facing releases so changes are tested, communicated, and adopted, with documentation and training built alongside clinical leads.

• Replace manual work with self-service: own the user experience and rollout of an in-platform workflows and drive adoption of self-service project setup by delivery teams.

• Define and track KPIs; use those metrics to guide priorities.

• Own what happens after launch: measure adoption, iterate, and retire workarounds and manual processes once the product replaces them.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of product management experience, including launching two or more user-facing software products or major releases.

• Experience owning workflow software that expert users rely on all day, such as data abstraction or curation, annotation or labeling tools, clinical operations, or case management, where user productivity and data quality are the core metrics.

• Strong, hands-on experience with agentic AI: you have defined and shipped products built on LLM-based agents or agentic workflows, and you understand evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design well enough to make tradeoffs with engineers and AI scientists.

• AI-native working style: you use AI tools every day to accelerate product discovery, synthesize user research, analyze data, draft requirements, prototype workflows, and pressure test ideas.

• A track record of taking AI workflows from prototype to production, not just proofs of concept, and delivering them end to end to a business stakeholder with clear acceptance criteria and measured adoption.

• A keen UX sensibility and a high bar for product craft: you have shaped complex, multi-step workflows into intuitive interfaces, working closely with designers and engineers.

• Hands-on user research and continuous product-improvement curiosity: you shadow users, run usability tests, ask why users work around the product, and turn observations into prioritized changes.

• Experience bringing order to high-volume request streams and rolling out changes to large or distributed user groups, including vendor teams, with severity rules, response targets, training, and change management.

• Hands-on with data: comfortable writing SQL or using equivalent tools to check status, investigate issues, and measure outcomes.

• Backlog ownership in an Agile team: writing user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira and working through sprint planning with engineering and QA.

• Clear written and verbal communication with end users, engineers, and operations leads, including documentation and training material people actually use.

PREFERRED:

• Experience with real-world data, clinical chart abstraction, or human-in-the-loop data-quality programs.

• Fluency in oncology or clinical concepts, such as diagnoses, lines of therapy, biomarkers, and staging, or the ability to ramp quickly alongside clinical partners.

• Experience shipping AI-assisted workflows where people review model output, such as pre-filled values, confidence cues, or recommendations.

• Experience in regulated healthcare, including HIPAA and PHI handling.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$165,800—$207,300 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer V/VI - EWIS
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

The EWIS Engineer V/VI is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for leading the design, development, and production support of Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (EWIS) for Zone 5 UAS and air-launched weapon platforms. This position owns the harness architecture from schematic through installation - ensuring wiring systems are safe, reliable, manufacturable, and compliant with aerospace and military standards. Engineers in this role will work closely with production to resolve build issues quickly and will mentor other engineers in EWIS best practices.

Responsibilities:

• EWIS Architecture: Define and own wiring interconnect architecture, including wire and connector selection, routing, separation, segregation, shielding, and bonding/grounding schemes.

• Harness Design: Create and maintain wire lists, pin-outs, schematics, harness drawings, and formboard layouts using electrical CAD tools.

• 3D Integration: Collaborate with Mechanical Engineering to route harnesses in 3D models, define clamping and support, and ensure installation clearance and maintainability.

• Standards Compliance: Ensure designs meet SAE AS50881 and applicable military specifications for wire, cable, connectors, and protective materials.

• Production Support: Serve as the primary engineering interface to harness manufacturing; resolve build issues, disposition nonconformances, and support Material Review Board (MRB) activities.

• Design for Manufacturability: Drive harness designs that reduce build time, rework, and cost while maintaining reliability.

• Verification & Test: Define harness acceptance test requirements (continuity, hi-pot, insulation resistance) and support integration and qualification testing.

• EMI/EMC Coordination: Partner with EMI/EMC engineering to implement shielding, filtering, and grounding approaches that meet MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 requirements.

• Configuration Control: Maintain EWIS documentation and drawing packages under configuration control and drive engineering change orders through implementation.

• Mentorship: Train and mentor junior engineers and technicians in EWIS design and harness fabrication practices.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager- SLED (GA or FL)
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

REMOTE- Georgia or Florida

Position Summary

ExtraHop is redefining cyber defense and network operations for the AI era. As an innovator and leader in Network Detection and Response (NDR) and Network Performance Management (NPM), we help State, Local, and Education (SLED) institutions secure their transition to the "Agentic Enterprise" by defending against AI-powered threats, streamlining operations, and delivering full visibility across their network and AI estate. We turn wire data into "Decision-Grade Intelligence"—the high-fidelity context that enables SOC and NOC teams to detect threats, optimize performance, investigate faster, and respond at machine speed. If you are an experienced sales professional who thrives in the security and networking markets and can help SLED customers navigate the transition toward an Agentic SOC and Agentic NOC, we want to hear from you.

This key position requires an individual who can rapidly acquire and maintain in-depth knowledge of ExtraHop’s vision, products, technologies, competitive offerings, and prevailing industry trends relevant to the public sector. Your primary responsibility will be to significantly increase revenue across Central US SLED accounts by identifying, recruiting, and developing net-new opportunities with channel partners, SLED-focused resellers, and integrators.

Key Responsibilities

• Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets by securing new SLED accounts (State Agencies, Local Government, K-12, and Higher Education) and expanding revenue within existing public sector customer installations.

• Proactively identify and qualify prospects through targeted outreach, lead follow-up, and in-person meetings with SLED decision-makers (e.g., State CIOs/CISOs, Network/IT Directors, University IT Leaders, Municipal Managers).

• Align with senior SLED executives to understand their mission-critical business requirements, decision-making processes, unique budget cycles, and funding mechanisms.

• Articulate how AI Modernization requires decision-grade intelligence to drive security and operational resilience across public sector networks.

• Help SLED customers transition from reactive, disconnected alerts to proactive, autonomous workflows within their SOC and NOC environments.

• Sell the platform's unique ability to provide comprehensive visibility and health monitoring across the entire AI and network estate, including traffic patterns and AI-model interactions.

• Demonstrate how ExtraHop serves as the foundational "source of truth" for packet-level insights, network performance, and threat intelligence for both human teams and autonomous AI agents.

• Identify opportunities to solve modern operational and security challenges, including network blind spots, AI-powered attacks, identity-based threats, and shadow AI usage.

• Prepare and rigorously implement strategic territory plans, leveraging key SLED contract vehicles and identifying business growth opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with SLED-focused resellers, system integrators, field sales engineers, and management throughout the sales cycle, including opportunity registration and accurate revenue forecasting.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum of five years’ experience in technology sales with a consistent track record of exceeding quotas, including a minimum of three years dedicated specifically to SLED security and network solutions sales.

• Deep understanding of the modern SOC and NOC landscape, specifically the shift toward Agentic SOC/NOC workflows and runtime asset/network visibility.

• Proven ability to sell NDR, NPM, or complex network and security solutions that integrate across existing IT infrastructure.

• Ability to articulate the operational risks and performance impact associated with AI adoption, as well as the importance of network visibility across the AI estate.

• Demonstrated technical acumen to articulate ExtraHop's combined security and network performance value proposition in a differentiated and compelling manner to SLED audiences.

• Existing senior-level relationships across SLED accounts within the Central US territory.

• Exceptional communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills essential for navigating the SLED procurement landscape.

• Solid understanding of enterprise networking technologies (switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAN optimization) as applied in SLED environments.

• Ability to travel up to 50% to support SLED customer engagements and regional public sector events.

• Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-stress environments with predictable, reliable attendance.

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $145,000 – $157,000 per year, plus eligibility for sales commissions and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

• Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

• FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

• Educational Reimbursement

• 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

• Pet Insurance (US Only)

• Parental Leave (US Only)

• Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Support - Brand Onboarding
jobs.description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're hiring a Manager, Brand Onboarding to join our Product Support team. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll run your own mixed Shopify and non-Shopify onboarding queue, take point on our most complex and escalated brands, and make the onboarding playbook sharper every month. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Brand Onboarding.

You'll own a defined slice of the onboarding experience end-to-end, from post-sale through go-live. Expect roughly 70% of your time in the queue and 30% on projects that reduce friction for brands and for the team. This role is remote and works Eastern Time business hours, with flexibility to support brand launches as needed.

Your Impact In The Role

• Manage a mixed Shopify and non-Shopify onboarding queue, getting every brand live quickly with clear kickoffs, proactive updates, and no surprises

• Guide brands through technical setup (integrations, tracking, catalog, and payment configuration), resolving blockers within onboarding before they delay launch or become support tickets

• Proactively drive stalled and unresponsive brands forward, keeping account notes current so status is always clear

• Act as the escalation point for Senior Associates and set the quality bar for troubleshooting and brand communication

• Own onboarding initiatives end-to-end, using data and trends to reduce friction, time-to-go-live, and repeat escalations

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS on known issues and platform improvements that affect brand launches

• Build and continuously improve the checklists, docs, and workflows the team relies on, using AI tools to cut manual lift

You Are Energized By

• Rolling up your sleeves on a tricky onboarding and seeing it through to launch

• Finding the root cause, not just the fix, and making sure it doesn't happen again

• Turning messy processes into clean checklists and docs your teammates actually use

• Direct feedback and evolving processes; you own mistakes openly and adjust quickly

• Being the person peers and cross-functional partners trust to get it done

• Fast-moving, high-growth environments where priorities shift and adaptability is a strength

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• 3 to 5 years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, client success, or a related role

• Experience in e-commerce and/or affiliate marketing; hands-on Shopify experience strongly preferred

• Proven ability to manage a portfolio of accounts at once, balancing urgency, quality, and relationships

• Experience handling escalated or high-touch accounts, ideally Enterprise or Premium brands

• Root-cause and systems thinking: you ask why, not just what

• Communicates credibly with Product and Engineering on technical issues

• Comfortable using data and trends to make the case for process changes

• Strong written and verbal communication with brands and internal teams

• Sound judgment balancing speed, accuracy, and risk on high-stakes accounts

Bonus Points

• Experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment

• Familiarity with Intercom, Salesforce, or similar support and CRM tooling

• Knowledge of the creator economy, influencer marketing, or affiliate platforms

• Experience working with AI tools (e.g., Fin AI, Claude, or similar) and shaping how they're used in a workflow

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission, and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!

Benefits & Perks

ShopMy invests in more than compensation. We support your health, your growth, and your life outside of work.

• Equity in ShopMy - Every employee is an owner; all roles receive equity

• Monetize Your Influence - Every employee builds and grows their own ShopMy page

• 401(k) with Company Match - 3% employer contribution, fully vested

• Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental & vision benefits, including a 100% employer-paid medical option and dependent coverage

• Mental Health Support and More - We offer employees and their dependents virtual mental health support, urgent care, and primary care visits at no cost

• Flexible PTO - Take the time you need, including your birthday off

• 13 Company Holidays

• 14 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

• Remote-First Culture with an NYC HQ - Some teams may have different location requirements

• Workplace & Wellness Stipends - Support for wellness, home office needs, and a Wellhub membership

• Disability & Life Insurance - 100% employer-paid

• Health Care FSA/HSA

• Annual Company Offsite

• Quarterly Team Co-Locations

ShopMy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm work authorization upon hire.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Samsara Tax Department strives to be a best-in-class tax function that manages core tax processes efficiently while continuously adding value across the business. We are looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to join our Indirect Tax team and own day-to-day indirect tax compliance for North America (United States, Canada, and Mexico), manage relationships with our indirect tax advisors, and assist with indirect tax planning.

This role is the first contact for point-of-sale tax questions from across Samsara’s sales organization. You will own our internal tax ticket queue ensuring Account Executives, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and other business partners get clear, accurate, and timely answers to point-of-sale tax questions. The ideal candidate is customer service oriented, has a strong work ethic, is eager to learn, and can turn complex tax rules into concise, easy-to-understand guidance for non-tax audiences.

You will work closely with our Tax Technology and Operations team, external tax advisors, and Finance partners.  This is a great opportunity to help shape how we scale and automate indirect tax at Samsara! This role reports to the Manager II, Tax Accounting

This is remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Own the tax ticket queue end to end: triage, research, resolve, and document indirect tax questions from Sales, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and other internal teams.

• Deliver responsive, high-quality service to business partners, especially Account Executives, with clear and concise answers that keep deals and transactions moving.

• Escalate deal-specific questions to the Tax Technology and Operations team and policy questions to the Tax Accounting Manager, with well-organized research and a recommended position.

• Track ticket volume, recurring themes, and turnaround times, and share insights that guide FAQs, self-service content, and automation.

• Manage US sales and use tax compliance, including data gathering, return preparation and review, and timely filing and payment, in partnership with external compliance providers.

• Support Canada GST/HST/PST/QST and Mexico IVA compliance, including data gathering and coordination with external advisors.

• Prepare recurring filings and accruals such as California use tax, Ohio Commercial Activity Tax, and state retail delivery fees (e.g., Colorado and Minnesota).

• Reconcile indirect tax general ledger accounts monthly and support month-end and quarter-end close.

• Monitor and resolve tax calculation errors across Vertex, NetSuite, and Salesforce, and partner with systems teams to test product taxability and process changes.

• Maintain customer exemption certificates and perform the annual exemption certificate review.

• Support sales and use tax audits and notices: gather documentation, prepare workpapers, and respond to taxing authorities.

• Support cash tax forecasting and other Tax Department projects as capacity allows, including direct tax projects.

• Work closely with external tax advisors on research, compliance, and special projects.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 3+ years of indirect tax experience in public accounting, in-house at a company, or a combination of both.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Working knowledge of US sales and use tax compliance, including return preparation and multistate filings.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with the ability to work with large data sets.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain tax concepts to non-tax business partners.

• Customer service mindset and a strong work ethic: responsive, organized, and accountable for follow-through.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Big 4 experience in a tax compliance or return preparation team.

• CPA license or active progress toward it.

• Hands-on experience with Vertex, NetSuite, Salesforce, and Zendesk (or similar ticketing tools).

• Exposure to Canadian GST/HST/PST/QST and/or Mexican IVA and CFDI requirements.

• Working knowledge of direct tax concepts.

• Experience in SaaS, technology, or IoT hardware companies.

• Professional proficiency in Spanish.

• Interest in using automation and AI tools to improve tax processes.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$83,597—$112,400 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Business Development – Mining Pool & Firmware
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Luxor is a full-stack platform for the Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure industries. We build software, hardware, financial, and energy solutions that help mining operators improve performance, manage risk, optimize costs, and scale their operations.

Location: Miami, FL or San Francisco, CA, in office. Our Miami office opens in Q1 2027; until then, Miami-based hires work remotely with regular customer travel.
Start: Immediately
Reports to: SVP, Business Development




ABOUT THE ROLE

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods, and one person owns each pod's revenue. We're hiring the person who will own Mining Pool & Firmware, the core of Luxor's Bitcoin mining business.

 - Luxor Mining Pool has operated since 2017 and serves institutional miners with >50 EH/s across BTC, LTC, DOGE and ZEC. It offers FPPS payouts, fixed and upfront payout options, and SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II controls, and it has paid 35,000+ BTC to miners in 113 countries.

 - LuxOS is our custom ASIC firmware for Antminer and WhatsMiner fleets. Per-domain autotuning, power targeting and fast curtailment help operators get more hashrate per joule and respond to the grid. Paired with Luxor Pool, it gives miners one integrated stack.

This is a mature, competitive market. Winning here means displacing incumbents at a fee that makes money and respects the quality of our product. We care about profitable market share, not market share at any price.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Pool & Firmware revenue and the quarterly targets you agree with leadership.

 - Hunt and close new hashrate: public miners, large private operators, hosting providers and international fleets.

 - Lead commercial negotiations on pool fees, firmware fee tiers, payout structures and referral partnerships, while protecting margin.

 - Run firmware pilots end to end with our customer success and firmware engineering teams, and turn test results into signed fleet-wide deployments.

 - Build the partner channel: hosting providers, repair shops, resellers and referral partners who bring hashrate with them.

 - Bundle across the stack (Pool, LuxOS, Commander, hashrate derivatives) to win deals that single-product competitors can't.

 - Spend 80%+ of your time external: customer sites, industry events, in-person meetings.

 - Keep a clean pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, and bring competitive intelligence back to product.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in B2B sales, business development or commercial roles, with a record of deals you personally sourced and closed.

 - Bitcoin mining industry experience: you understand pools (FPPS vs. PPS vs. PPLNS), ASICs, hashprice and fleet economics, and you know the major players.

 - An existing network among mining operators is a strong plus.

 - Experience with firmware, mining infrastructure or hosting is a plus.

 - A strong negotiator who can hold a price and walk away from a bad deal.

 - Willingness to work in office in Miami or SF and travel regularly to customer sites and industry events.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

 - You've won business against entrenched incumbents and know how to make switching feel low-risk.

 - You want to own a product line, not just a territory.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You prefer to set strategy and hand deals to someone else to close.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base plus uncapped, gross-profit-based commission.

 - Ownership of Luxor's core business line, with direct access to leadership.

 - The broadest product stack in mining to build deals with.

 - Health, dental and vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO.



At Luxor we believe that meaningful contributions can be made by anyone. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Luxor welcomes all!


HOW WE USE AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use AI tools to support certain parts of our hiring process, and we believe in being transparent about how they’re used.

During your application, AI may assist in reviewing CVs, qualifications, and assignments by providing additional insights, but it does not make decisions, every application is evaluated at each step by a member of our hiring team.

We also use AI to transcribe interviews so our team can stay focused on the conversation rather than note-taking. Any voice recordings are automatically deleted within 15 days.

In addition, AI helps us keep candidates informed about their application status and helps us understand how our process is working so we can improve it over time.

In all cases, AI is used to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. If you have any questions about how we use these tools or your data, or if you would prefer to opt out of any of these features, please include them in the dedicated section of the application form, and we’ll follow up accordingly.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Payouts
jobs.description:
Wise Platform powers cross-border payments for banks, enterprise corporations, and global tech platforms. The Payouts team specifically serves high-volume enterprise clients—such as creator economy platforms, content licensing firms, and gig-economy businesses—that rely on Wise’s API infrastructure to send funds globally at scale.

As one of the first three hires on this newly formed team, you will own the entire post-sale lifecycle for North American enterprise accounts. You will be responsible for driving partner onboarding, ensuring smooth API integrations, maintaining account health, and proactively driving net revenue expansion through corridor, currency, and volume growth. In addition to client-facing duties, you will build the foundational account management playbook, escalation paths, and partner health frameworks for this business line.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Onboarding & Go-Live (30%)

• Partner with Pre-Sales and Implementation teams to project-manage newly signed enterprise accounts from contract execution to first successful payout run.
• Ensure flawless technical go-lives to rapidly transition signed contract value into active processing volume.

2. Account Expansion & Revenue Growth (30%)

• Own net revenue retention and expansion targets across your portfolio, driving adoption of new payment corridors, currencies, payout flows, and additional business units.
• Translate pre-sale business cases into post-sale operational reality, actively growing volume month-over-month.

3. Technical Relationship Management & Portfolio Health (20%)

• Serve as the primary, hands-on point of contact for live enterprise partners (e.g., creator platforms, marketplaces, gig-economy firms).
• Act as a first-line technical resource to triage API batch failures, webhook errors, and settlement discrepancies directly with partner engineering teams before escalating to internal engineering.
• Monitor transaction volume metrics continuously to identify usage anomalies, operational risks, or drop-offs ahead of formal account reviews.

4. Function Building & Operational Excellence (10%)

• Design, test, and implement foundational post-sale processes, including client onboarding playbooks, account health scoring models, QBR formats, and internal escalation paths.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Global Wise Platform teams across Technical Support, Compliance, Pricing, and Product to optimize client experience and workflow efficiency.

5. Risk & Compliance Monitoring (10%)

• Monitor evolving partner business models and payment flows to identify potential regulatory or compliance shifts, partnering with internal Compliance teams to adjust operational setups as needed.

• Experience: 4+ years of post-sale account management, customer success, or partner management experience in payments, fintech, or technical API infrastructure.
• Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience meeting or exceeding quantified expansion and net revenue growth metrics (not solely customer satisfaction/NPS scores).
• Technical Aptitude: Clear understanding of API and payment infrastructure concepts; able to accurately scope and diagnose client technical issues to drive quick resolution with internal engineering and product teams.
• Builder Mindset: Strong comfort level with ambiguity, unstructured environments, and building operational playbooks from scratch.
• Data Fluency: Proven capability using transactional data and client usage metrics to assess portfolio health and surface expansion opportunities.

The book is small today, and it's yours to grow. You're not inheriting a mature portfolio with a renewal calendar. Early on, more of your time goes to go-lives and to building the function than to managing a steady book. That flips as the sellers land accounts, and the partners you take live in year one are the ones you'll grow for the next three.

Expansion is the number, not renewals. In this market, new corridors, currencies, payout flows and business units inside an existing partner are worth more than most new logos. Growing what we've won is the job, not something that happens once a year.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Axonius

Axonius is the asset intelligence platform. We give Security and IT teams a complete, trusted view of every asset across their environment: the foundation they need to adopt AI-first cybersecurity with confidence. As AI changes how security gets done, we’re building on that foundation to deliver AI-first exposure management and to help customers secure their AI assets.

About our team

You’ll join a team of experienced cybersecurity marketers who have worked at companies of every size and stage. Some of us have taken companies out of stealth, and others have joined at a growth stage and seen them through to IPO. You’ll learn from people with deep cyber and marketing experience, and you’ll own your product area from day one.

About the role

As Axonius enters an AI-first era, the story we tell must keep pace. As our Product Marketing Manager, you’ll shape how we talk about the product and the role of AI in cybersecurity. You’ll also help ensure our field teams across sales, sales engineering, and customer success can tell that story with confidence. This is a hands-on role. You’ll write the words, build the assets, and spend time with the people who use them: our field, customers, and partners.

What you’ll do

• Positioning and messaging: Craft new positioning and messaging as we enter an AI-first era. Turn product capabilities into clear value propositions across web copy, product collateral, and narratives that resonate with our buyers.

• Product partnership: Work closely with Product to understand what’s being built and why. Turn the roadmap and launches into clear messaging, and bring customer and field feedback to the product team.

• Sales enablement: Help sales understand both the Axonius product and the role of AI in cybersecurity. Build the collateral, talk tracks, and training that sellers use.

• Demand generation support: Partner with demand gen and regional marketing on campaigns, ensuring messaging and content land with the right audiences in each segment.

• Product differentiation: Raise awareness of what sets Axonius apart, in the market and inside deals.

• Customer conversations: Talk directly with customers, including roadmap discussions, and bring what you learn back into product positioning.

What you’ll bring

• 3+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity. B2B experience in adjacent fields is also welcome.

• Strong writing and communication skills, with experience crafting product descriptions, web copy, sales collateral, and demos.

• Comfort enabling field teams across the organization, including sales, sales engineering, and customer success.

• Confidence leading customer conversations, including roadmap discussions.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, marketing, or communications preferred.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

• You understand the Axonius platform, our buyers, and where AI fits in our story.

• You’ve listened to sales calls and spoken with customers, and you know the questions that come up most.

• You’ve shipped your first piece of messaging or collateral, and sellers are using it.

In your first year

• New AI-first messaging is live across the website, sales collateral, and campaigns, and it reads as one consistent story.

• Sellers choose your material over building their own.

• Regional and demand gen campaigns related to your area of ownership launch with clear, differentiated messaging.

• Our differentiators come up more often in deals and in how prospects describe us.

• Product hears customer and field feedback from you, and it shapes positioning and roadmap conversations.

#LI-REMOTE  #LI-HYBRI#LI-BH1

Axonius is committed to fair and equitable compensation. Base salary is determined by a candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and skills. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes an annual bonus, stock options, and a comprehensive benefits package.

These ranges reflect the base salary Axonius in good faith expects to pay for this role in each location. Bonus and equity are in addition to base salary and are not included in these ranges.

Annual Base Salary Range

$132,500—$147,200 USD

About Axonius:

Axonius transforms cyber asset intelligence into actionability. With the Axonius Asset Cloud, customers preemptively tackle high-risk and hard-to-spot threat exposures, misconfigurations, and overspending. The integrated platform brings together data from every system in an organization’s IT infrastructure to optimize mission-critical risk, performance, and cost measures via actionable intelligence.

Covering cyber assets, software, SaaS applications, identities, vulnerabilities, infrastructure, and more, Axonius is the one place to go for Security, IT, and GRC teams to continuously drive actionability across the organization. Cited as one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity startups, with accolades from CNBC, Forbes, and Fortune, Axonius supports millions of assets for leading customers across industries and around the world.

Axonius makes it a priority to invest in our people with competitive compensation and benefits, growth opportunities, community-building, and so much more. Learn more about benefits at Axonius.

At Axonius we support a diverse and inclusive workplace and believe in equal employment opportunity. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

Axonius participates in E-Verify. To learn more, please review the E-Verify Participation Poster (PDF) and the Right to Work Poster (PDF). By submitting your application to us, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Global Job Candidate Privacy Notice.
