This is a hands-on role for someone with strong visual instincts, a clear point of view, and the range to move between creative development and execution. They can define how something should look and feel, then step behind the camera and make it happen.

The Lead DP partners closely with designers, art directors, writers, producers, editors, motion designers, and, as needed, strategy and social teams. They contribute as a creative peer to senior creative talent and executive creative leadership, confidently advocating for ideas while remaining curious, adaptable, and open to feedback from anyone.

Moving image is central to the role. The Lead DP also leads the development of Studio’s photography practice, creating high-end photography on select projects and elevating standards, practices, and output across the team. This responsibility does not include direct management of photographers.

We’re looking for someone who loves making things, brings fresh thinking, shares knowledge generously, and is as willing to do the heavy lifting as they are to lead the room.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve our visual language

• Advance Studio’s approach to moving image, motion, and photography in close partnership with Creative.
• Contribute from the earliest stages of development, translating ideas, stories, and brand objectives into distinct visual approaches.
• Bring production craft into the development of ideas, helping shape what we make and how we make it.
• Explore new approaches to shooting, editing, lighting, composition, and motion that strengthen storytelling and help evolve the brand’s look and feel.

Lead cinematography and filmmaking

• Serve as lead DP across Studio productions, owning the approach to camera, lighting, lenses, composition, movement, coverage, and image capture.
• Develop treatments, visual references, shot lists, and storyboards, including rough sketches when useful.
• Direct projects, talent, interviews, or scenes when the assignment calls for it.
• Lead camera and lighting crews with clear direction, thoughtful preparation, and sound creative and technical judgment.
• Adapt to changing conditions while protecting the story, creative intent, and quality of the work.

Elevate the photography practice

• Shoot high-end photography on select assignments that benefit from your expertise.
• Establish and continually raise standards for lighting, composition, technique, and execution across photography produced by Studio and its partners.
• Improve photography workflows, equipment practices, and quality standards.
• Guide and mentor teammates and external partners through constructive feedback and shared expertise.

Shape the story through post

• Partner with editors and motion designers to develop new approaches to structure, pacing, rhythm, movement, and sound.
• Bring ideas and constructive creative challenge that help teammates expand how they tell stories.
• Contribute hands-on editing support when needed.
• On larger projects, contribute to casting, music, editorial, color, and finishing, staying engaged through final delivery.

Work independently and collaboratively

• Independently plan and execute smaller shoots, including assignments without a dedicated producer.
• Collaborate effectively within larger teams of creatives, producers, directors, agencies, production partners, and specialized crews.
• Recommend an approach and production scale appropriate to the idea, budget, schedule, and intended result.
• Prepare thoroughly, solve problems resourcefully, and follow through on commitments.

Strengthen the team

• Lead through the quality of your work, the clarity of your ideas, and how you treat people.
• Share knowledge and mentor teammates through the work, helping develop their craft, judgment, and confidence.
• Give useful feedback, welcome different perspectives, and share credit.
• Contribute beyond your own assignments to improve the work and capabilities of Studio and Brand & Creative.

What You Bring

• A strong body of work demonstrating accomplished cinematography, high-quality photography, and thoughtful visual storytelling. Please identify your contribution to each project.
• Deep practical knowledge of cameras, lenses, lighting, composition, movement, exposure, and image capture.
• The ability to connect visual decisions to a story, audience, and creative idea.
• The confidence and judgment to present ideas, lead a shoot, and collaborate as a peer with senior creative partners.
• The ability to communicate visually through references, treatments, shot lists, storyboards, or sketches.
• Working editing proficiency and an understanding of editorial, motion, music, color, and finishing.
• Resourcefulness across small independent assignments and larger productions.
• Curiosity, initiative, reliability, and a commitment to developing both your own work and the people around you.

How You Work Matters

Low ego is essential. You bring conviction without defensiveness, take feedback seriously regardless of its source, and treat everyone with respect. You remain willing to execute the details and do the heavy lifting, regardless of experience or seniority.

We welcome both emerging creative leaders ready for broader responsibility and experienced practitioners eager to contribute and mentor. Your work, judgment, and approach to collaboration matter.

Travel: Approximately 20% travel is expected, depending on production needs.

Required Skills, Experience, and Training

• 12+ years of experience
• Experience working in or closely with Brand & Creative teams.
• A bachelor's degree in film, design, media arts, communications, or adjacent fields; equivalent professional experience is also acceptable.

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Program Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

The Senior Supplier Program Manager is responsible for leading supplier performance and execution across assigned complex and high impact programs, leading supplier strategy, integration, and delivery outcomes. This role acts as the primary integrator between the Program Management Office (PMO) and supply chain ensuring alignment to program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.

The focus is on proactive risk management, recovery execution, and cross-functional alignment, working closely with Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Quality to ensure supplier performance supports program readiness. Operating in a program-based, design-to-order environment, this role drives and leads supplier accountability, resolves complex issues, and ensures execution across multiple programs and stakeholders.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Leads supplier integration for complex or high-risk suppliers - Drives alignment between suppliers and internal teams to ensure execution against program requirements, schedules, and technical expectations.

• Owns and executes supplier strategies – including supplier engagement, execution approach, and performance expectations aligned to program goals.

• Monitor delivery schedules, commitments, and execution status; identify risks, variances, and associated budget impacts.

• Owns and drives the supplier risk register for assigned complex suppliers - Ensure risks are identified, assessed, and actively managed with clear mitigation plans and follow-through.

• Leads supplier readiness assessments at key milestones - Evaluate readiness for design release, production, and delivery; clearly communicate risks, gaps, and required actions.

• Leads supplier escalation and recovery execution - corrective actions and coordinate cross-functional recovery efforts for at-risk suppliers, including escalation support as needed.

• Drive alignment between supplier plans and program schedules - Ensure supplier commitments, development plans, and execution timelines are realistic and synchronized with program needs.

• Identify and influence early supplier-related risks - Surface constraints related to capacity, design maturity, sub-tier dependencies, and execution gaps to inform program decisions.

• Serve as primary supplier execution interface for suppliers - Provide clear, consistent communication of supplier status, risks, and recovery actions to internal stakeholders.

• Ensure supplier delivery of product and required technical/certification data - Monitor execution of hardware and associated documentation to meet program and regulatory requirements.

• Coordinate supplier execution across multiple programs - Balance priorities, commitments, and risks where suppliers support multiple GTI programs.

• Drive targeted supplier improvement initiatives - Lead efforts to improve schedule reliability, cycle time, and execution performance.

• Provides mentorship and guidance to Specialists and Senior Specialists - Supports development of team capability and consistency in supplier integration practices.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

• Cooperation – Establishes and maintains effective relations, exhibits tact and consideration, displays positive outlook and pleasant manner, offers assistance and support to co-workers, works cooperatively in group situations and works actively to resolve conflicts.

• Written Communications - Writes clearly and informatively, edits work for spelling and grammar, varies writing style to meet needs, and presents numerical data effectively.

• Planning & Organization – You prioritize and plan work activities, you use time efficiently, you plan for additional resources, you integrate changes smoothly, you set goals and objectives, and you work in an organized manner.

• Oral Communications – You speak clearly and persuasively, you listen and get clarification, you respond well to questions, you demonstrate group presentation skills, and you participate in meetings.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field required. Advanced degree is a plus.

Experience:

• 6-8 years of experience in supply chain, supplier management, operations, or program execution within aerospace or complex manufacturing environments

• Experience managing complex suppliers, assemblies, or systems (e.g., CMS/IFE, seating, or similar integrated products)

• Demonstrated ability to lead supplier performance, risk management, and recovery efforts

• Experience driving cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Program Management

• Experience influencing supplier selection, planning decisions, or execution strategies

• Experience working directly with supplier leadership and supporting escalation scenarios

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in aircraft interiors, completions, or highly customized aerospace products

• Familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and data-driven tools (Excel, Power BI)

• Experience with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis)

• Experience working in regulated environments (FAA, aerospace quality systems)

Certifications (Preferred):

• PMP or equivalent project/program management certification

• APICS (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent supply chain certification

• Lean / Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong understanding of supplier performance, risk management, and execution in complex manufacturing environments

• Ability to lead cross-functional coordination and influence stakeholders without direct authority

• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to drive supplier recovery and corrective actions

• Effective communication skills, including engagement with internal leadership and suppliers

• Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights (ERP, Excel, Power BI)

• Working knowledge of engineering release, production readiness, and regulatory requirements (ITAR/EAR)

The expected WA salary range for this position is between $120,000.00 - $166,000.00 USD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law. Our suite of comprehensive benefits include healthcare (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) savings plan with company match.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

• Big jobs and stretch assignments.

• High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.

• Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

jobs.title: Senior IT & Network Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Discover what it's like to help build the fueling network of the future — check out our Engineering Blog

Reports To

Manager, IT & Network

What You Will Be Doing

As a Senior IT and Network Engineer, you will engineer, automate, and scale ChargePoint's global workforce systems and campus network infrastructure from our Campbell, California headquarters. You will operate at the intersection of modern systems engineering and enterprise networking—architecting automated endpoint management pipelines, engineering enterprise identity and access platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), and designing high-performance, resilient campus network and firewall fabrics.

In this hands-on engineering role, you will replace manual administrative overhead with scalable code and automated workflows. You will build zero-touch provisioning pipelines across macOS and Windows fleets (Kandji, Intune, Autopilot), leverage APIs (Microsoft Graph, Okta Workflows/APIs) to automate lifecycle and access flows, and engineer robust zero-trust conditional access policies. In parallel, you will engineer campus network environments, MDF/IDF infrastructure, and partner with other department teams to design dedicated, secure network fabrics for charging station testing and validation.

Operating 100% on-site at Campbell HQ, you will serve as the principal technical escalation and engineering authority for critical identity, endpoint, and network infrastructure. You will bridge software-defined systems automation with physical hardware and campus networking, ensuring ChargePoint's enterprise infrastructure is secure, observable, and built for rapid global scale.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

• Design, configure, and maintain enterprise campus network infrastructure, including core routing, multi-layer switching, and high-density 802.1X wireless (Cisco, Meraki, Aruba) across Campbell HQ and engineering test facilities.

• Engineer and harden Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet), architecting micro-segmentation, zone-based security policies, IPsec site-to-site tunnels, and client VPN solutions.

• Partner with software, hardware, and embedded engineering teams to deploy isolated network segments, test racks, and IoT fabrics for EV charging station hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation.

• Oversee campus physical and core network infrastructure, including MDF/IDF room architecture, structured cabling, UPS power systems, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, and 802.1X NAC.

• Engineer and automate enterprise identity platforms, configuring Okta and Microsoft Entra ID for SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM provisioning, dynamic groups, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).

• Engineer modern MDM and endpoint architectures across macOS (Kandji) and Windows (Microsoft Intune), building automated zero-touch deployment pipelines (Autopilot, Apple Business Manager), custom profiles, and compliance baselines.

• Build custom automations and API integrations using PowerShell, Python, Bash, and the Microsoft Graph and Okta REST APIs to automate workforce lifecycles, configuration drift detection, and reporting.

• Architect and manage the Microsoft 365 cloud ecosystem, engineering collaboration services, data governance, advanced threat protection (Defender for Endpoint/Office 365), and telemetry.

• Instrument observability across systems and network infrastructure (Datadog, Google SecOps), engineering proactive telemetry, and serving as Tier-3 escalation authority for complex systems and network incidents.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Engineering, or equivalent practical engineering experience.

• 5-8 years of hands-on experience in IT systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise network engineering.

• Solid hands-on network engineering experience: enterprise routing and switching (Cisco, Meraki, Arista), 802.1X enterprise wireless (WPA-Enterprise, RADIUS/EAP-TLS), and VLAN micro-segmentation.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and maintaining Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS, Fortinet FortiOS) and high-throughput IPsec/SSL VPN tunnels.

• Advanced engineering expertise with enterprise identity architectures: Okta (SSO, MFA, LCM, Workflows, APIs) and Microsoft Entra ID (Conditional Access, PIM, hybrid directory sync).

• Proven track record architecting modern MDM/UEM solutions: Microsoft Intune (Windows Autopilot, custom ADMX, compliance policies) and Kandji(macOS scripting, custom profiles, zero-touch deployment).

• Proficiency in scripting, automation, and diagnostics using PowerShell, Python, or Bash, Microsoft Graph/REST APIs, and packet analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump).

• Must be available and committed to working full-time on-site (5 days per week) at ChargePoint’s Campbell, CA headquarters.

• Relevant engineering certifications such as Okta Certified Consultant/Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, CCNP, or PCNSE (good to have).

• Experience with cloud networking (AWS/Azure), IoT/lab testbeds, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001 (good to have).

Location

Campbell, CA

The base salary range for this role is $135,000 – $178,250 per year. In addition, this position is eligible for annual merit-based RSU grants. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off; parental leave; life and disability insurance; and wellness resources.

Compensation may be adjusted based on work location.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at accommodations@chargepoint.com.

You’ll work closely with the Product, Revenue, Solutions Engineering, Corporate Communications, Demand Generation, and Enablement teams to ensure that we meet every audience with the right content. The core content you build will be the foundation that supports our story across programs, campaigns, and sales conversations.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Quality and Consistency

Reports to: SVP, Business Development




ABOUT THE ROLE

This posting is always open: we hire strong hunters whenever we meet them.

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods:

 - Hardware & Logistics: ASIC procurement, brokerage and global logistics.

 - Hashrate Derivatives: hashprice hedges, fixed payouts and financing.

 - Mining Pool & Firmware: institutional Bitcoin mining pool and LuxOS firmware.

 - Energy & Commander: power supply and demand response in ERCOT and SPP, plus fleet management software.

You'll join the pod that best fits your background, interest and where the opportunity is biggest. You'll be trained across the full stack and expected to cross-sell where possible.

This is a closing role, not a meeting-booking role. You'll own your pipeline from first outreach to signed contract.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prospect and close new business with mining operators, hosting providers, institutional clients and hardware counterparties.

 - Run the full cycle: outreach, discovery, proposals, negotiation, close and handoff to onboarding.

 - Grow your accounts across Luxor's product lines.

 - Spend most of your week in front of customers: on the phone, at their sites and at industry events.

 - Keep HubSpot accurate so your pipeline speaks for itself.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years in B2B sales, business development or another revenue-generating role, with deals you sourced and closed yourself.

 - Comfort with outbound: cold calls, cold emails, working a room at a conference.

 - Genuine interest in Bitcoin mining. You don't need to be an expert, but you should already know what a mining pool does and what an ASIC is, and be eager to go deep fast.

 - Ability to learn technical products and explain them in business terms.

 - Willingness to work in office in Miami or SF and travel for customers and events.

 - Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

 - You're competitive, self-directed and motivated by uncapped upside.

 - You want to learn an entire industry fast, with a sales team and onboarding program built to ramp you.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You want a structured SDR role with a manager running your day.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base plus uncapped, gross-profit-based commission.

 - Direct exposure to the biggest operators in Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure.

 - A path to owning a pod as Luxor grows.

 - Health, dental and vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO.



At Luxor we believe that meaningful contributions can be made by anyone. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Luxor welcomes all!


HOW WE USE AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use AI tools to support certain parts of our hiring process, and we believe in being transparent about how they’re used.

During your application, AI may assist in reviewing CVs, qualifications, and assignments by providing additional insights, but it does not make decisions, every application is evaluated at each step by a member of our hiring team.

We also use AI to transcribe interviews so our team can stay focused on the conversation rather than note-taking. Any voice recordings are automatically deleted within 15 days.

In addition, AI helps us keep candidates informed about their application status and helps us understand how our process is working so we can improve it over time.

In all cases, AI is used to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. If you have any questions about how we use these tools or your data, or if you would prefer to opt out of any of these features, please include them in the dedicated section of the application form, and we’ll follow up accordingly.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Commerical
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As an Account Executive, you’ll help expand Airwallex’s presence in the US SME market by building relationships with small and mid-sized businesses across ecommerce, SaaS, professional services, and other technology-enabled sectors.

 - Own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and discovery through solution design, negotiation, close, and early customer success.

 - Translate complex financial technology into clear business value, helping customers simplify cross-border payments, billing, spend management, and other financial operations.

 - Build strong customer outcomes by coordinating with internal teams, representing Airwallex at relevant industry events, and engaging technology partners.

 - Improve the efficiency and scalability of our sales motion by contributing to sales process refinement, new vertical development, and best-practice documentation.

You’ll work from our San Francisco or New York City office at least three days a week.



What we're looking for



Essentials

 - At least 3 years of outbound B2B sales experience in fintech, payments, or adjacent technologies, with proven success selling to small businesses.

 - A track record of exceeding sales targets in a technical or solution-based selling environment.

 - Experience selling to one or more of the following: ecommerce, SaaS or subscription businesses, spend management or finance teams, or other technology-enabled or professional services organizations.

 - A consistent record of pipeline generation and outbound prospecting.

 - Proficiency with CRM systems, such as Salesforce, and sales enablement tools.

 - Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.

 - A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.



Preferred

 - Experience in or strong exposure to the fintech ecosystem, including payments, FX, or related financial infrastructure.

 - A deep understanding of the challenges faced by SME and Growth companies operating or expanding internationally.

 - A customer-focused, consultative approach to sales.

 - The ability to engage in high-level partnership and commercial strategy discussions.

 - A solution-oriented approach to problem-solving and a “Figure It Out” mentality.

 - The ability to balance multiple priorities in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

 - Self-motivation and a strong sense of accountability for achieving key performance indicators.

 - A track record of contributing to new product launches, new vertical plays, or market expansions.



You'll thrive here if

 - You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

 - You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

 - You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.

 - You say what you mean. You’re direct, but you lead with respect.



Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Sales Compensation Manager Systems and Analytics
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a As the Manager of Sales Compensation Systems and Analytics, you’ll operate at the center of go-to-market execution —- owning the systems, data, and analytics that power how Fivetran + dbt labs pays its sellers and measures performance against quota. You’ll build and scale the compensation infrastructure, deliver accurate and timely commissions, and provide insights that inform plan design and executive decisions. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy, Revenue Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and Analytics.

This role reports to the Sr. Director, Global Sales Compensation and blends sales compensation administration, systems ownership, data analytics, and operational execution. You’ll drive the automation and accuracy of our commission processes, help scale our compensation platform for a hybrid pricing motion that includes both subscription contracts and usage-based (consumption) revenue, and support high-visibility initiatives across the function.

This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who is passionate about leveraging systems, data, and analytics to motivate sales performance and drive operational excellence in a high-growth, cross-functional environment.

This is a full-time role with opportunities to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

• Compensation Systems Ownership: Own the configuration, administration, and roadmap of our sales compensation platform (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or similar), including plan builds, crediting rules, quota and territory loads, and integrations with Salesforce, the data warehouse, and HRIS/Payroll. Partner with Systems and IT on releases, testing, and enhancements.

• Commission Operations: Oversee the end-to-end monthly and quarterly commission calculation, validation, and payout cycle, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with plan documents, including crediting for subscription and consumption-based bookings, overages, and renewals

• Plan Design Support: Partner with Sales Strategy, Finance, and GTM leadership to model, build, and launch annual and in-year compensation plans, quota structures, and SPIFs; quantify cost of sales and the financial impact of plan changes.

• Analytics & Insights: Deliver analysis on plan effectiveness, attainment distribution, pay-for-performance alignment, quota capacity, and comp cost as a percent of ARR/bookings to inform decisions by the CRO, CFO, and Sales Leadership.

• Accruals & Forecasting: Partner closely with Revenue Accounting and FP&A on commission accruals, ASC 340-40 capitalization, variance analysis, and forecast-to-actual tracking of variable compensation expense.

• Governance & Controls: Own SOX-compliant controls, audit readiness, plan documentation, and dispute resolution processes; ensure data integrity and reconciliation between source systems, the comp platform, and payroll.

• Automation & Reporting Infrastructure: Use AI tools, SQL (BigQuery), or Python to automate data pulls, build repeatable and auditable processes, and improve the accuracy, speed, and transparency of commission calculations; partner with Analytics, AI Transformation, and Systems on data quality and self-serve reporting.

• Seller Experience & Reporting: Create automated, executive-ready dashboards and statements (e.g., Looker, Tableau) that give sellers and managers clear, real-time visibility into attainment, earnings, and pipeline-to-pay, and that distill trends into actionable recommendations for GTM leadership.

• Team Leadership: Provide technical guidance, review work, and help raise the process and analytical standards of the Sales Compensation team

Skills We’re Looking For

• 5-7 years of experience in sales compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on administration of a compensation platform

• Expert-level analytical modeling: builds compensation models from scratch, including cost-of-program scenarios, pay-positioning analysis, attrition and retention-risk modeling, and sensitivity and tradeoff analysis

• Built with AI: has personally used AI tools (LLMs, assistants, or automation and agent platforms) to build compensation tools, models, or workflows others rely on, and can explain how they work and how outputs were checked for accuracy

• Technical aptitude: working proficiency in SQL, Python, or similar scripting; experience with Salesforce, BI tools (e.g., Looker), and data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) a plus

• Statistical judgment: knows when market data is credible or a sample is too small, and presents ranges without false precision

• Compensation expertise: job architecture, compensation frameworks, market pricing, pay cycles, global compensation practices, and pay-for-performance design, with knowledge of competitor compensation at high-growth tech companies

• Reasons from first principles: balances best practice with what the business needs and can rebuild a framework when the standard approach does not fit

• Trusted advisor to senior leaders on sensitive, high-stakes compensation decisions (offers, promotions, retention, org changes), influencing outcomes through data and judgment rather than authority

• Operational excellence: connects systems, stakeholders, and programs to deliver compensation end to end, accurately and on time

• Clear communicator: turns complex analysis into a crisp recommendation an executive can act on in one conversation

• Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models and the associated compensation design challenges strongly preferred

Bonus Skills​

• Experience with Tableau or other BI tools, or building dashboards for leaders

• Experience supporting GTM or sales organizations at a high-growth tech company

• Experience scaling compensation programs through hypergrowth, IPO, or major organizational change

• Background in a quantitative field (e.g., finance, statistics, engineering), or equivalent experience

Perks and Benefits

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

• RSU stock grants*

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

• Monthly cell phone stipend

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

About The Role:

We’ve built technology that changes how things get made, and now we need someone to help the world understand it. You’ll evolve the brand foundation we’ve established into a sharper identity and a stronger presence, establishing Atomic Machines as a recognized leader in Physical AI and the future of manufacturing.

This is a director-level role with genuine ownership and authority. You’ll set our marketing vision and lead its execution, working as fluently with the engineers behind the technology as with the audiences who need to understand it.

What You’ll Do:

• Brand identity and consistency. Develop our brand and ensure it comes through consistently across our website, presentations, content, events, and other external communications.

• Narrative and messaging. Sharpen how we describe Atomic Machines, our technology, and our ambitions. Establish a clear, consistent voice that makes complex technology compelling and credible.

• Digital presence. Own our website and social channels, developing content and experiences that expand our reach and deepen engagement with relevant audiences.

• Content and thought leadership. Drive blogs, white papers, presentations, and other written materials, working with technical experts and company leadership to communicate substantive ideas.

• Conferences, exhibitions, and speaking opportunities. Proactively identify and pursue the right industry engagements. Lead our presence at trade shows and conferences, secure speaking opportunities, and help prepare compelling talks.

• PR and media relations. Own public relations and media engagement end to end, including the direction and management of external agencies.

• Marketing priorities and execution. Set the plan, manage the marketing budget and external partners, and measure how our activities support brand recognition, audience engagement, and commercial conversations.

How You’ll Work:

You’ll initially deliver through agencies and freelancers, with no internal direct reports. This is a hands-on role: you should be comfortable writing, shaping content, directing creative work, and driving projects to completion.

You’ll have substantial scope to choose priorities, recommend investments, and hold external partners accountable for the quality and timeliness of their work. Over time, you’ll help determine where to build internal capability and grow the marketing function.

Product ownership sits elsewhere. You’ll partner closely with technical, product, and commercial leaders to ensure our external communications accurately reflect our technology, capabilities, and business priorities.

What You’ll Need:

• 15 + years of experience in brand, content, or communications, ideally in technology or deep tech.

• Demonstrated success in brand, content, and communications for a technology business.

• Strong writing skills and editorial judgment, with the ability to turn complex technical ideas into stories people understand and remember.

• Experience developing a consistent brand across digital channels, presentations, content, and industry events.

• The ability to direct agencies, freelancers, and creative partners while remaining personally involved in the work.

• Sound judgment about which audiences, messages, and opportunities deserve attention.

• The initiative and organization to set priorities, work independently, and deliver in a growing company.

• Curiosity about Physical AI, advanced manufacturing, and the technology behind Atomic Machines.

• Proven ability to lead through hands-on execution, sound judgment, and ownership of outcomes rather than relying on a large team or established infrastructure.

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• A technical background or experience working closely with engineering teams is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

A sharper, more consistent brand. Stronger digital and industry presence. A steady flow of credible, compelling content. And growing recognition of Atomic Machines and its potential to transform manufacturing.

The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits.

Salary Range

$210,000—$250,000 USD

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

jobs.title: Operational Risk, Senior Associate
jobs.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Operational Risk team is part of Paxos Risk Management. We set and run the framework Paxos uses to identify, assess and monitor operational risk across a business supervised by financial regulators in the US and abroad. We work with product, engineering, compliance and operations teams on new products, vendors and blockchain integrations, and we support the firm’s audits and regulatory exams.

About the role

As an Operational Risk, Senior Associate, you’ll own core parts of our risk and control framework: running Risk and Control Self-Assessments, keeping the risk register current and helping teams close control gaps. You’ll prepare evidence for audits and regulatory exams, assess the risk in new products, vendors and blockchains before launch, and bring risk themes to senior leadership.

What you'll do

 - Run Risk and Control Self-Assessments with first-line business and engineering owners, and rate risks consistently using Paxos’s severity and likelihood methodology

 - Maintain the enterprise process, risk, and control inventory and the firm’s process, risk and control inventories

 - Oversee the implementation of an issues management program. Identify control gaps, document them with owners and remediation dates, and track them to closure

 - Assess operational risk in new products, vendors, blockchains and regulatory changes before they reach production

 - Prepare evidence for internal audits, external audits and regulatory exams, and respond to examiner requests

 - Design and run independent monitoring and testing of key controls

 - Report risk themes and key risk indicators to senior leadership and risk committees

About you

 - 5-7 years in operational risk at a financial services institution, a financially regulated company, or a consultancy or regulator that built or enforced operational risk requirements

 - Hands-on experience running Risk and Control Self-Assessments, maintaining a risk register and rating risks with a defined severity and likelihood methodology

 - Working knowledge of OCC expectations, Basel operational risk principles, SOC 2 and third-party risk guidance

 - Experience preparing audit and regulatory exam evidence and answering examiner questions directly

 - Clear, concise writing and a track record of getting business and engineering owners to agree on ratings and remediation plans

 - Comfort using AI tools to speed up research, drafting and analysis

 - Bonus: experience building independent monitoring and testing programs, building process, risk and control inventories, or working in blockchain or crypto

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

jobs.title: Admissions Representative
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Admissions Representative to join our team.  This will be a HYBRID position.  Some work will occur on campus and some work can be done remotely.

Under direct supervision, this position will recruit qualified students for the college’s academic programs in a compliant, appropriate and professional manner. Provide basic information, routine guidance and assistance to potential students on matters related to enrollment and the admissions process.  Evaluate and resolve student inquiries, issues, and problems, and ensure appropriate action is taken to the satisfaction of the student, Unitek College, and/or relevant regulatory agencies. Uphold enrollment standards by complying with related governmental regulations and standards of accreditation, and by enrolling only students who meet eligibility requirements as published in the college’s catalog. Demonstrate positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, excellent time management skills and the work ethic to follow-through on commitment to students and the organization. Use Company approved Admissions materials during telephone calls, interviews and enrollment process. Observe and adhere to all company polices and best practices. Exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate course of action.

Building Relationships

• Take inquiry calls from all potential students interested in knowing or receiving information about the programs—including entrance requirements, curricula and academic standards—and encourage qualified prospects to schedule an appointment for an interview
• Return web inquiries and calls promptly to all potential students and give accurate information about the programs, including entrance requirements, curricula and academic standards
• Make outbound phone calls to potential students that have expressed interest in attending the institution. Outbound calling efforts are a key component of this role
• Participation in organized phone-a-thons and dialing campaigns according to company best practices is required and is an essential part of day-to-day activity
• Initiate unsolicited leads and generate new business when not responding to outstanding inquiries or working with current prospective students
• Follow up on all inquiries that fail to schedule or show for an interview
• Follow up with interviews that did not progress in the enrollment process and dropped/cancelled students to resolve any issues or address concerns

Interviews

• Schedule and conduct student interviews, wherein any reference to Financial Aid complies with the stated Company Policy
• Utilize only approved company materials during the interview process, and conduct interviews according to the stated policies and process at all times
• Meet with the potential students to explain the program offering and match the college’s benefits and advantages to the student’s needs. Discuss and advise suitable programs in accordance with the student’s desires, qualifications and objectives
• Make all efforts to ensure that admissions management meets with the potential student and is well informed about the student’s motivations and concerns about attending the college

Mentoring and Guidance

• Provide basic information and routine advice, guidance and assistance to students using established procedures and policies on available programs and eligibility requirements, including the application of policies, procedures and documentation regarding the admissions process

About Perelman Performing Arts Center (PAC NYC)

Following 9/11, the community and civic planning process that resulted in the World Trade Center master plan in 2003 envisioned a new performing arts center as one of the anchors of the site. The Perelman Performing Arts Center (PAC NYC) opened in the Fall of 2023. Within its three flexible and intimate performance spaces, PAC NYC produces and presents multiple projects in theatre, dance, music and chamber opera. Across each season, we seek to celebrate life and to affirm community in our location at the World Trade Center.

Our mission

PAC NYC’s mission is to create connections by cultivating bonds between extraordinary artists and communities, with exemplary performances in active dialogue across the arts, and in our flexible, intimate spaces, inviting conversation and new relationships. Our art and our audiences reflect the dynamic energy of all five boroughs of New York City. We invite everyone to join us as we celebrate creative expression from around the world. PAC NYC is where the world trades ideas.

The role

PAC NYC is looking for an organized, driven, and mission-oriented Development Coordinator to assist in the coordination and support of PAC NYC’s Development team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a start-up team who are cultivating a network of donors and partners, providing a world-class stakeholder experience, and directly supporting the mission of PAC NYC. The Development Coordinator should have experience supporting a fast-paced fundraising team, including providing data management support, assisting with donor communication and delivery of donor services, and general administration and calendar support to senior team members.

Your key responsibilities

• Development Data Management: Work with DevOps to ensure impeccable donor data integration into Spektrix, including but not limited to biographical data, research, activities, correspondence, invitations, event attendance and engagement. Ensure the timely completion of pledges, gift agreements, invoices and other official donor and partner documentation.

• Provide assistance in maintaining up to date records for donor recognition and crediting for printed programs, website listings, and additional collateral.

• Research donors and prospective donors and build executive briefs in advance of meetings and events.

• Organize departmental files in a simple, open-source format that fosters organizational transparency and information sharing.

• Donor Services: Work with Directors, as well as Audience Services and MSRG, to fulfill donor requests related to tickets, restaurant reservations, and other experiences. When required, provide front-facing, high-touch exceptional hospitality to support the execution of such requests (i.e. meeting a donor at the box office to hand off tickets).

• Coordinate and schedule group tours for Member program, providing support and occasionally leading tours as needed.

• Workflow Support: Attend all department meetings, taking notes and recording action items. Work within organizational software and processes to track progress and completion of tasks. When appropriate, handle follow-up independently.

• Donor Correspondence and Written Materials: Assist with drafting eloquent, personalized, clear donor communications: emails, memos, proposals, and decks. High proficiency in Word and PPT required; design aptitude a plus.

• Calendar Management: Manage the Donor Activities Calendar, working closely with Development leadership, the Events Coordinator, and across departments, to identify, schedule and track all donor events, opportunities, and communications in a cohesive, real-time format that integrates with institutional CRM (Spektrix). Additionally, provide scheduling support for the department.

• General Support: Be prepared to serve as “generalist” and pitch in on projects and initiatives as needed. Reconcile monthly credit card reports to ensure accurate record-keeping for the finance team and support departmental budget management.

This position will remain open until a diverse and qualified pool of finalists has been identified.

What it takes to be successful in the role:

• 2+ years in a coordinator role, ideally supporting a fundraising team.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• A team player who doesn't look at any task as too small.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Proficiency in using donor databases and CRM software, such as Spektrix.

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.

• Passion for the performing arts and a commitment to PAC NYC's mission.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary will range between $60,000 and $68,000 plus full benefits. Our benefits package includes health, dental, vision, life, accidental death and dismemberment and disability benefits, and self-insured dental, vision and health care and dependent day care flexible spending accounts. Full time employees are eligible for paid time off and 401K enrollment with employer match.

We encourage you to apply

At PAC NYC, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you’re excited by this role and the job description aligns with you and the work you are passionate about doing, please apply to the position. We encourage all applicants who are committed to contributing to an equitable and inclusive work environment to submit an application for a role with us without feeling like they need to meet every single qualification of the position, specifically people from traditionally excluded/marginalized groups. You might be the right candidate for this role, or for others that we’re adding to our team.

Our commitment to creating a diverse and equitable workplace

Equal employment opportunity and a commitment to a diverse staff are fundamental principles at PAC NYC, where employment opportunities are based upon individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic as established under law.

jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

The Reliability Engineer, EE Systems is an individual contributor role responsible for ensuring the reliability of Zone 5's electrical and electronic systems across the product lifecycle. This position performs reliability analysis on avionics, power, and electronic assemblies, influences design decisions through data-driven analysis, and produces the reliability deliverables our customers require.

Responsibilities:

• Reliability Predictions: Perform reliability predictions for electronic assemblies and systems using MIL-HDBK-217F, Telcordia SR-332, FIDES, or other customer-accepted methods.

• FMECA: Lead Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) for electrical and electronic hardware per MIL-STD-1629A or equivalent.

• Derating Analysis: Perform parts stress and derating analysis and work with designers to resolve overstressed components.

• Design Influence: Participate in design reviews and provide reliability recommendations on component selection, thermal management, and circuit design.

• Reliability Testing: Plan and support reliability testing including HALT, HASS, ESS, and reliability growth testing.

• FRACAS: Support the Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS), including failure analysis of returned or failed electronic hardware.

• Parts Management: Support parts selection, obsolescence management, and counterfeit parts prevention practices.

• Customer Deliverables: Author reliability reports and contract data deliverables and support customer reviews.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in reliability engineering for electronic hardware in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries.

• Skills:

• Strong working knowledge of reliability prediction methods, FMECA, and derating analysis.

• Understanding of electronic component failure mechanisms and physics of failure.

• Ability to read schematics and review designs in Altium.

• Experience with environmental and accelerated life testing.

• Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills.

• U.S. Person status required due to export control regulations.

Preferred Qualifications:

• ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE).

• Experience with reliability analysis software (e.g., Relyence, ReliaSoft, Windchill Quality).

• Experience with munitions or long-term dormant storage reliability.

• Familiarity with MIL-HDBK-338 and solder joint / thermal cycling reliability.

• Active U.S. security clearance or ability to obtain

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries.
