jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a talented and driven Recruiter to partner with our Go-To-Market teams. In this role, you'll help build the teams that bring safe, frontier AI to the organizations that depend on it, spanning Sales, Partnerships, Public Sector, and Beneficial Deployments.

GTM is one of the fastest-growing parts of Anthropic, and the market for this talent is competitive and fast-moving. The people we hire need an unusual combination of commercial ability and genuine domain depth. You'll own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of GTM roles, act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to hiring managers and leaders, and help shape how we assess commercial talent as we scale. You'll develop a real understanding of each hiring manager's goals, the markets they serve, and the profiles that succeed against them. Many of the roles you support will be new or evolving, and you'll have significant influence over interview loops, calibration practices, sourcing strategy, and how we talk about this work to candidates who have options. You'll also be one of the people candidates remember. For many, you'll be their first real window into what it's like to work here.

This is an individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy. We expect you to run your searches independently, make judgment calls without waiting for direction, and be the person your hiring managers turn to first on anything talent-related. It's a strong fit for someone who is energized by a high bar, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and genuinely interested in the mission our GTM teams are selling.

Key responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting for GTM roles, from intake through offer and close, with a strong emphasis on candidate experience and stakeholder partnership

• Build and maintain strategic relationships with hiring managers and leaders, serving as their primary partner on hiring and translating their goals into calibrated role requirements, must-have skills, and assessment criteria

• Become an expert in the markets our GTM teams serve, understanding where the talent sits, what motivates it, and what distinguishes a strong candidate from a plausible one

• Build and execute sourcing strategies for competitive, specialized commercial talent, including targeted outreach campaigns, market mapping, and cultivating talent pools that don't yet exist as pipelines

• Advise GTM leaders on talent market conditions, compensation dynamics, pipeline health, and realistic timelines, including when a search needs to be reframed

• Design and refine interview loops, intake practices, and assessment approaches for roles that are new or evolving, partnering with hiring managers to define what "good" looks like before the first candidate enters the process

• Maintain an inclusive and consistent process, using structured interviews and calibrated criteria that reduce the influence of bias on hiring decisions

• Partner with Recruiting Operations to use pipeline data and metrics to diagnose bottlenecks and inform resourcing decisions, process improvements, and candidate experience

• Serve as a thought partner to hiring managers on organizational design questions, including what a team actually needs, how roles should be scoped, and where a hire will and won't solve the problem

• Represent Anthropic's mission, culture, and approach to AI safety authentically to commercial candidates

You May Be a Good Fit If You

• Have 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, assessing, and closing candidates, ideally with time in a high-growth technology company

• Have recruited for commercial or Go-To-Market functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Partnerships, or Marketing

• Have a demonstrated ability to partner with and influence hiring managers and senior stakeholders, including pushing back when a search is mis-scoped

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills, including a knack for writing outreach that specialized candidates actually respond to

• Are able to use pipeline data to diagnose problems and inform decisions

• Are proficient with an applicant tracking system and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter

• Can manage competing priorities and operate with autonomy in a fast-changing environment

• Have a passion for AI's potential to positively impact the world, along with a realistic assessment of its risks and limitations

• Bring an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality and are a true team player

Strong Candidates May Also

• Have recruited in a market where the talent you need is scarce, expensive, and heavily courted, and have found creative ways to win

• Have experience with Greenhouse and with structured interviewing practices

• Be open to non-traditional talent strategies, and enjoy working with hiring managers who are willing to experiment

• Have supported technical GTM roles such as Solutions Architects or Forward Deployed Engineers, and can hold a credible conversation about technical scope

• Have experience building or scaling a recruiting function, process, or interview loop from an early stage

• Have a track record of building high-performing teams in a rapidly scaling environment

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$240,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About Taskrabbit:

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

Prior to applying please note:

• We are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position (including H-1B, OPT, F1, CPT or other employment-based visas). Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

• This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco hub every Tuesday & Wednesday (located at 130 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA).

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability Engineering team at Taskrabbit and help improve the reliability, scalability, and operational maturity of our engineering platform.

The SRE team sits within Engineering and partners closely with Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Productivity, Security, Architecture, and application engineering teams to keep our production systems reliable, scalable, and resilient.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex production challenges, building automation, and improving how systems operate at scale. You'll work across applications and infrastructure to investigate reliability issues, strengthen observability and incident response, and build tools and practices that make our systems easier and safer to run.

At the Senior level, we expect you to independently own complex technical problems, collaborate effectively across teams, and help drive lasting improvements to production reliability.

What You'll Do

• Improve production reliability. Partner with engineering teams to define and evolve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and availability, latency, and capacity targets. Identify reliability risks and implement improvements that make our production systems more resilient.

• Strengthen observability and incident response. Improve telemetry, alerting, dashboards, and on-call practices. Reduce noisy or unactionable alerts and turn incident learnings into lasting improvements.

• Investigate complex production issues. Troubleshoot problems spanning applications, infrastructure, data stores, networking, and deployment systems. Collaborate with engineering teams to identify root causes and implement durable solutions.

• Reduce operational toil through automation. Build automation, self-service tooling, and operational capabilities that reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and make day-to-day operations more efficient.

• Build AI-powered and agentic operational capabilities. Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows for incident triage, investigation, runbook execution, alert analysis, and remediation. Explore opportunities for autonomous operations with appropriate safety controls and human oversight.

• Collaborate on reliability improvements. Work with application engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Productivity, and other teams to improve system resilience, share operational learnings, and promote reliable engineering practices.

• Participate in on-call and incident response. Serve in the SRE on-call rotation, supporting complex incidents and escalations from engineering teams. As application teams take greater ownership of their on-call rotations, help improve escalation practices, operational readiness, and shared reliability standards.

On-call expectations: As a member of the Taskrabbit engineering organization, you'll participate in both primary and secondary on-call rotations, typically serving one week in each rotation approximately every 12–13 weeks.

What We're Looking For

• Strong Site Reliability Engineering background, with at least 3 years of experience in SRE or equivalent production reliability engineering roles, including hands-on ownership of production reliability and operational improvements.

• Strong understanding of SRE principles and practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, incident management, and postmortems.

• Proven production operations experience, including participation in on-call rotations, troubleshooting high-severity incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and driving corrective and preventive actions.

• Hands-on experience building and improving observability using platforms such as Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and dashboards.

• Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes in production environments, ideally Amazon EKS.

• Experience with infrastructure as code and deployment automation, using tools such as Terraform, GitOps, or ArgoCD.

• Strong software engineering skills in languages such as TypeScript or Ruby or Python, with experience building automation or internal platform tooling.

• Ability to independently own complex technical projects, make sound technical decisions, and collaborate across engineering teams to deliver reliable solutions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs to engineering partners and stakeholders.

Nice to Have

• Experience with distributed systems and technologies such as Kafka, Redis, or MySQL/RDS.

• Experience with performance engineering, capacity planning, or cloud cost optimization.

• Experience modernizing infrastructure or migrating production workloads.

• Experience building AI-powered operational automation, incident-response agents, or engineering productivity tooling.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is $135,000 - $185,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

You’ll love working here because:

• Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.

• The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!

• The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.

• The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.

Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.

AI-Assisted Prescreening Notice [US Based Candidates Only]: As part of our hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the initial prescreening of applications and responses. This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. If you would prefer not to have your application processed using this tool, you may opt out by selecting 'opt out' in the application form or by emailing talentacquisition@taskrabbit.com, and your application will be reviewed manually with no impact on your candidacy.

This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, position located at various Northwestern Medicine Cancer Centers including Delnor Hospital in Geneva, Kishwaukee Hospital in DeKalb and Huntley Hospital.

The CLA II reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with the main lab staff, other ancillary departments, departments, nurses and providers to ensure excellent patient care.
• Receives specimens into the laboratory information system.
• Inputs and retrieves lab results in laboratory or hospital computer system.
• Register specimen dropoffs (e.g. Home health) in LIS assuring accurate data entry.
• Properly processes specimens for transport to reference laboratories.
• Distributes specimens to the appropriate testing area.
• Identifies and solves problems utilizing appropriate resources with the assistance of a supervisor, manager, pathologist and/or coworkers when appropriate.

• Operate and maintain laboratory automation systems as appropriate.

• Communicates specimen rejections, critical/notifiable results to appropriate clinical personnel and completes required documentation.

• Adheres to lab procedures with following up on outstanding orders including time-sensitive draws/charges
• Answers phone calls to the laboratory and triages appropriate
• Coordinates courier pickups as needed.

Department Specific duties

• Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards as required.
• Completes biological transport training as required and maintain competency.
• Recognizes temperature dependent transport conditions and select correct packing list destination.
• Monitors and maintains specialty supplies, including kits, swab and collection containers and disperse to units
• Ensures supplies are available and stored at the appropriate temperatures
• Performs microbiology setups or other testing preparation duties.
• May assist with bone marrow and other biopsy processing.
• Pull AP slides for second opinion requests and log material back into Epic when material is returned.

Investigations

• Lead and manage internal workplace investigations involving policy violations, employee misconduct, harassment, discrimination, retaliation, ethics concerns, and other employee relations matters.

• Ensure investigations are conducted in a timely, thorough, objective, and confidential manner.

• Partner with HR leadership, the National Service Center, and business leaders on complex employee relations matters.

HR Compliance

• Lead Affirmative Action programs for locations that are a federal contractor.

Required

jobs.description:

At Vital Lyfe, we are on a mission to solve global water scarcity by creating innovative, desalination systems. This is an opportunity to join a passionate, multidisciplinary team tackling one of the world’s most critical challenges



Mission

Build the supplier network behind a field deployable water system. Architect quality and reliability into the supply chain from day one and help turn a prototype into a product that can scale anywhere.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead supplier qualification, onboarding, and technical assessments, including DFM reviews, process flow validation, and QMS audits

 - Partner with internal engineering teams to ensure suppliers fully understand and can meet tight part, assembly, and metrology requirements

 - Monitor supplier metrics and trend data to proactively mitigate risks and improve operational performance

 - Source and evaluate new suppliers with unique capabilities in materials, fabrication, and metrology

What We're Looking For

 - Required:
   
   - Bachelor’s in Engineering (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial or equivalent).
   
   - Hands on mindset: comfortable designing the process and also working with operators & equipment to validate and refine.
   
   - Strong problem solving skills, ability to operate in ambiguous/higher-growth environment, clear communicator across teams.
   
   - Experience in supplier quality, NPI, or manufacturing engineering in hardware, climate tech, or industrial systems
   
   - Familiarity with QMS tools and standards (e.g., ISO 9001, PPAP, FAI, Cpk, PFMEA)
   
   Preferred:
   
   - Excellent communication and problem solving skills in fast-paced, cross-functional environments
   
   - A track record of owning hard problems end-to-end and getting things done under real-world constraints
   
   - A builder’s mindset and a systems-level view of manufacturing

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS (WITH OR WITHOUT REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION)

Why Join Vital Lyfe?

 - Work on high impact problems with global relevance

 - Help scale breakthrough technology in water security and climate resilience

 - Early ownership in a high growth, engineering led startup

 - Join a tight knit, mission driven team in a fast paced environment

 - Build long term career equity as we grow

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.

 


OUR ETHOS

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Rain is looking for a Technical Recruiter. In this role, you’ll work closely with our Head of Talent to scale hiring across the entire company. You can be expected to own full-cycle hiring, running structured, data-driven processes, and closing top talent. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own full-cycle recruiting for all roles: kickoff/intake, outbound sourcing, screens, interview coordination, debriefs, offers, and closes

 - Build and maintain diverse, high-quality pipelines through targeted outreach, referrals, events, and talent communities; run ongoing market mapping for priority roles

 - Partner with hiring managers to define scorecards, structure interviews, calibrate bar/levels, and train interviewers to drive signal and reduce bias

 - Elevate employer brand and candidate experience—write compelling JDs, craft personalized outreach/nurture campaigns, communicate quickly, and negotiate/close top talent


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in technical recruiting

 - A proven track record of hiring for early-stage, high-growth startups—especially in fintech or technical environments

 - Expertise in sourcing strategies, interview best practices, and compensation planning

 - High EQ and communication skills—you can collaborate effectively across all levels of the company


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY

 - Familiarity with HR and ATS systems like Ashby and Sequoia.

 - Exposure to fast-moving sectors like fintech or crypto



Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Encore Boston Harbor – Casino Cage Cashier is responsible for chip, ticket, cash and check transactions in the casino cage.  Other responsibilities include balancing of various bank drawers within the Cage/Credit area, maintaining accuracy throughout all phases of the balancing process, and maintaining confidentiality of casino cage transactions.

Cage Cashier is responsible for issuing and cashing wagering tickets, as well as making sure appropriate materials (racing forms, scratch/odds sheets, and wagering guides) are fully stocked in their designated areas.

Cage Cashier is also responsible for supporting slot machine ticket redemption transactions and other currency and check transactions within the casino cashier's cage.

· Adheres to all Encore Boston Harbor core values and property and department standards.

· Participate in the execution of short-and long-term departmental goals, objectives, policies, and operating procedures; monitors and evaluates operational effectiveness; effects changes required for improvement.  Identifies key drivers of success.

· Actively contributes to departmental performance, and the accuracy, confidentiality, and thoroughness of departmental policies and procedures, records and reports.

· Follows all applicable internal policies, federal and state laws, rules, regulations and property-wide controls.

· Delivers and maintains a maximum level of service.

· Contributes to company-wide communication and best practices.

· Keeps informed of all new developments within the department.

· Balances assigned bank accurately.

· Cashes chips and gaming tokens into money for guests, in a courteous, timely manner.

· Cashes issue and cash wagering tickets for guests, in a courteous, timely manner.

· Cashes personal checks and travelers checks for currency.

· Redeems foreign currency, computing accurate exchange rates for the various currency received.

· Processes marker buy-back transactions, providing quality service to each guest.

· Follows proper procedures pertaining to sale and payout of tickets.

· Assists other cashiers as needed.

· Performs Front Window, Rolling Cage, VIP Cage, Team Member Bank, Chip Bank and/or Main Bank functions and duties.

· Redeem slot machine payout tickets, TITO, vouchers for cash, or cash equivalent.

· Performs patron account transactions (i.e., safe keeping, front money deposits, and withdrawals).

· Cheque cashing, cheque / marker issuance / redemptions and consolidations.

· Performs credit card, EFTPOS cash advances and rolling chip exchanges.

· Balances float and brings it back to the impress amount at completion of the shift.

· Prepares table fills and receives table credits.

· Handles chip transfers between front windows, chip banks and Main Bank.

· Maintains accurate and legible balance sheets.

· Works with safety as a priority, and follows department and company safety standards.

· Maintains relevant knowledge of industry through continuing education and training.

· Performs any other job-related duties as assigned.

21 years of age or above.

Education and/or Experience:

High school degree or equivalent required.  Casino or cash handling experience preferred.

Computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office, a plus.

Outstanding organizational and interpersonal skills, as well as excellent attention to detail.

Minimum 1 year Sports Book writing experience is preferred, but not required.

Language Skills:

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret documents, such as policy and procedure manuals, maintenance instructions, and other related documents.  Ability to respond to common inquiries from other employees or guests. Conversational English required.  Ability to write instructions.  Ability to effectively present information.

Ability to compute basic mathematical calculations. Ability to decipher various reports and maintain reports upon request.  Ability to decipher various reports and maintain reports upon request.

The employee is also regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms, and to sit, climb or balance, and stoop, stretch, bend, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

Work-life Balance

jobs.title: Senior Logistics Manager, Americas Retail Operations
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Logistics Manager, Americas Retail Operations to lead all retail logistics across the Americas. Oura is growing fast, with 100% YoY growth over the past three years, moving from zero retailers in 2023 to multiple major accounts today, with more launches planned this year. In this role, you will lead a team of two direct reports and own both sides of the business: sustaining and optimizing our current retail footprint, and executing flawless new retailer launches. You will own the retail logistics scorecard, drive cost-down strategy, and be the bridge between retail operations, our 3PL partners, and our internal Trade and Logistics teams.You will report to the Director of North Americas Logistics and work daily with Sales, Account Management, Planning, Finance, Trade Compliance, Global Logistics, and our 3PL and carrier partners.Sustaining & Launch Operations

What You Will Do:

• Act as the primary logistics lead for all Americas retail channels, optimizing existing accounts while onboarding new retailers in our pipeline.

• Evaluate new retailer routing guides and technical requirements, and set up our 3PL partners to execute error-free launches.

• Enforce compliance across routing guides, packaging and labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, and EDI readiness to protect brand reputation and OTIF performance.

• Drive operational efficiency to increase fulfillment speed and shorten PO-to-delivery time across the Americas.

• Serve as the escalation point for retail logistics issues, with clear root-cause analysis and corrective action.

• Financial Performance & Compliance Analysis

• Run cost analyses across Prepaid and Collect freight models to find the most profitable distribution path and map our true cost-to-serve by account.

• Create, implement, and own an end-to-end chargeback deduction and dispute process that protects company margins against retail penalties.

• Identify and deliver logistics cost-down initiatives that reduce total retail cost per unit.

• Own the retail logistics KPI scorecard, including OTIF, on-time delivery, PO-to-delivery cycle time, cost per unit, cost-to-serve by account, chargeback and recovery rates, EDI/ASN compliance, and 3PL performance, and run a regular business review that turns the data into supply chain improvements.

• AI & Process Automation

• Find manual, repetitive work across retail logistics, such as tracking, PO and ASN reconciliation, 3PL invoice audits, chargeback research, and partner updates, and build AI-assisted solutions that cut time and errors.

• Use AI tools to automate KPI reporting, data extraction, freight spend analysis, and status communication to retailers and internal teams.

• Translate operational requirements into structured prompts, automations, and workflows, serving as the bridge between what the business needs and what AI can do.

• Partner with IT and technical teams on larger automation and system work that improves real-time, end-to-end shipment visibility.

• Apply responsible AI practices: review outputs for accuracy, protect retailer and financial data, and know when AI is not the right tool.

• Evaluate new AI features and tools as they become available and recommend what to adopt.

• Cross-Functional & Network Collaboration

• Be the cross-functional voice for logistics, partnering with Sales and Account Management in commercial expansion discussions to ensure supply chain readiness.

• Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, and Weeks of Supply, and support CPFR conversations with key accounts.

• Work with Trade Compliance and Global Logistics to design the warehouse and distribution network for expansion into Canada and LATAM.

• Leadership & Team Development

• Manage, train, and mentor a team of two logistics professionals, supporting their growth.

• Build the team's AI capability: share what works, set standards for AI-assisted workflows, and help each team member automate their own recurring work.

• Define the long-term operating blueprint, scaling strategy, and structure for the Americas retail logistics team.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring

• 7+ years of experience in retail logistics, B2B wholesale distribution, or supply chain operations, including 2+ years of direct people management in a product-shipping industry (e.g., CPG, Consumer Electronics, Apparel).

• Deep expertise in retail compliance and chargeback management, with a track record of analyzing routing guides, managing EDI setups, and building systematic processes to audit and dispute retailer deductions.

• Strong financial and operational analysis skills, including freight cost-to-serve models, Prepaid vs. Collect evaluation, and PO-to-delivery cycle time optimization.

• Fluency with retail logistics KPIs such as OTIF, OTD, fill rate, cost per unit, and chargeback rate, and experience owning a scorecard against targets.

• Proven, hands-on AI proficiency. You already use AI tools to get work done. Be ready to show us automations you have built, reporting you have streamlined, or processes you have improved with AI, and the impact they had.

• Experience working with ERP, WMS, and/or TMS systems, plus advanced spreadsheet and reporting skills.

• Strong cross-functional communication and influence, with the ability to act as the voice of logistics to sales teams, leadership, retail partners, and 3PLs.

• Preferred qualifications

• Hands-on NetSuite experience, especially sales orders, item fulfillment, and retail/EDI order flows.

• Experience supporting distribution in Canada and/or LATAM alongside Trade Compliance and Global Logistics teams.

• Experience building workflows or automations on AI platforms (enterprise AI assistants, Google Workspace AI, scripting with AI help, or similar).

• Ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt and context engineering, agent workflows) and a habit of staying current with new tools.

• Experience with responsible AI practices such as accuracy reviews, risk assessment, and data protection.

• Exposure to CPFR, demand planning, or channel inventory management (Weeks of Supply, In-Stock %) in consumer electronics or retail.

• Multi-channel fulfillment experience across DTC, distributor, and retail partner networks.

• A track record of building or scaling a logistics team in a high-growth environment.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary and equity packages

• Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

• An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family

• 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off

• Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - EMI/EMC Design V/VI
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

The EMI/EMC Design Engineer V/VI is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for building electromagnetic compatibility into Zone 5 products from the start of design. This position leads EMI/EMC design practices across electronics, harnesses, and vehicle-level integration, ensuring our UAS and weapon systems meet customer electromagnetic environmental effects (E3) requirements and pass qualification the first time.

Responsibilities:

• Design for EMC: Lead EMI/EMC design across PCB layout, enclosure design, filtering, shielding, cable design, and bonding/grounding schemes.

• Requirements Definition: Interpret customer E3 requirements and flow down MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464 requirements to subsystems and suppliers.

• E3 Control Planning: Author and maintain E3 control plans, EMI test plans and procedures (EMITP), and EMI test reports.

• Analysis & Simulation: Perform EMI/EMC analysis and electromagnetic simulation to identify and mitigate coupling, emissions, and susceptibility risks early in design.

• Pre-Compliance Testing: Plan and conduct pre-compliance scans and troubleshooting in-house to reduce risk prior to formal qualification.

• Qualification Support: Support formal EMI/EMC qualification testing at internal and external labs and lead failure investigations and fixes.

• Design Reviews: Review schematics, layouts, and harness designs for EMC compliance and present E3 status at design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR).

• Customer Interface: Serve as the technical point of contact with customers on E3 requirements, test results, and waivers.

• Mentorship: Mentor electrical engineers in EMC design principles and best practices.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• Experience: 10+ years of experience in EMI/EMC design and test for aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability systems.

• Skills:

• Expert knowledge of MIL-STD-461 (CE102, CS101, CS114, CS116, RE102, RS103) and MIL-STD-464.

• Strong understanding of electromagnetic theory, shielding, filtering, grounding, and PCB layout for EMC, including reviewing layouts in Altium.

• Hands-on experience with EMI test equipment (spectrum analyzers, LISNs, current probes, antennas).

• Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve EMI/EMC failures.

• Excellent communication and technical writing skills.

• U.S. Person status required due to export control regulations.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.

• iNARTE or equivalent EMC certification.

• Experience with electromagnetic simulation tools (e.g., CST Studio Suite, Ansys HFSS, EMA3D).

• Experience with lightning, ESD, and HERO requirements for ordnance and weapon systems.

• Familiarity with DO-160 and MIL-STD-704.

• Experience with RF datalinks, antennas, and co-site interference.

• Active U.S. security clearance or ability to obtain.

Level VI: $210,000 - $251,000

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 40 hours of sick time

jobs.title: Field Service Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Opportunity: Field Service Controls Engineer with Fameccanica North America in West Chester, OH

Ready to launch your career in automation, controls, and robotics?

Fameccanica North America is seeking an entry-level Field Service Controls Engineer to join its growing team. This is an onsite, hands-on role focused on testing, validating, troubleshooting, and supporting automated manufacturing equipment.

In the beginning, this role will focus heavily on equipment testing and validation in Fameccanica’s West Chester facility. The work will be repetitive by design and will involve following test procedures, troubleshooting issues, documenting results, and helping ensure equipment is ready before shipment. As skills develop, this role may grow into customer-site support, installation, commissioning, and field service responsibilities.

If you enjoy hands-on technical work, solving problems, and learning how automated equipment works from the ground up, this could be a great opportunity to grow your career.

What You’ll Do:

• Test and validate automated equipment, including conveyors, sensors, electrical components, and controls.

• Follow checklists and test procedures to confirm equipment is operating properly.

• Troubleshoot basic PLC, HMI, electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical issues.

• Document testing results, service activity, and technical findings.

• Support equipment commissioning and customer requirements.

• Work alongside experienced engineers while learning Fameccanica systems.

• Eventually support customer sites as responsibilities grow.

What We’re Looking For:

• Associate degree, technical certification, or related training in Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a similar field.

• Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

• Interest in PLCs, controls, robotics, automation, or manufacturing equipment.

• Strong desire to learn, grow, and build a long-term career in automation and field service.

• Ability to follow processes, complete documentation, and troubleshoot problems.

• Professional, calm, and customer-focused communication style.

• Ability to work independently once trained while also being a strong team player.

Work Authorization & Travel Requirements:

• Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

• This is an onsite role based in West Chester, OH.

• Valid driver’s license required.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a valid U.S. passport.

• Travel may increase over time as skills develop and responsibilities grow, potentially up to approximately 70%.

Why Fameccanica?

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



Security at ClickUp

Security at ClickUp is engineering-focused. We partner with teams across the company to protect our platform, our internal systems and our customers through secure design, defensive controls, detection and response. We build tooling and automation, including AI-powered workflows, to turn what we learn into lasting improvements.

 

About the team

Infrastructure Security at ClickUp secures the cloud, compute, network and access layers underneath ClickUp: a multi-account AWS organization, a large Kubernetes fleet, infrastructure managed as code and the identity systems engineers use to reach production. We are a small team that works agentic first, using AI agents we build and maintain ourselves to multiply what a team our size can cover.

 

You will support this mission by thinking like a developer, breaking down a problem that we face, testing a method to approach it with automation, and implementing solutions that yield compounding value. Your skills to uncover threat indicators will be the foundation of this work.

 

The role

 - Architecture, proposals and reviews. Act as an initial reviewer on infrastructure proposals and designs from engineering and non-engineering teams such as business systems and go-to-market. Write our own security proposals and review the changes that follow. Translate security requirements and agent findings into clear guidance for less-technical partners, and bring their needs back into our designs.

 - Agentic security tooling and agent infrastructure. Build, evaluate and maintain the agents behind our reviews, triage and investigations, and help run the sandboxed, observable infrastructure they operate on.

 - Detection, investigation and response. Lead cloud and infrastructure alerts and incidents through to resolution and root cause, working alongside AppSec and incident response on incidents that span both.

 - Identity, access and least privilege. Move people, CI and services toward least privilege and just-in-time access across our cloud organization and the tooling engineers use to reach production. Deliver fixes as secure building blocks that teams adopt by default.

 - Compute, network and pipeline security. Harden our container, serverless and virtual machine workloads, our network perimeter and our CI/CD pipelines, and add checks so each class of issue is caught automatically next time.

 - Continuous review and audit evidence. Move vulnerability, access and attack-surface reviews from point-in-time checks to continuous monitoring that also produces evidence for our infrastructure controls.



Qualifications

 - 5+ years in security engineering, cloud infrastructure or SRE, with at least 2 years securing AWS at organization scale.

 - At least a year of agentic development experience: building agent skills and tools for real engineering work, and developing and maintaining the development harness they run in, from configuration and permissions to integrations, evaluations and cost controls. You can secure agents against prompt injection, over-privileged tools and unaudited actions, and explain how agents fall into the confused deputy problem and the lethal trifecta. You validate agent output against evidence and decide where human review is required.

 - Deep AWS IAM experience: IAM Identity Center or an equivalent SSO model, SCPs, permission boundaries, resource and key policies, cross-account trust, and the ability to prove a policy's effect with simulation rather than inference.

 - Production Kubernetes security on EKS or similar, covering RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control and container runtime hardening.

 - AWS networking for security: VPC design, endpoints and endpoint policies, network and DNS firewalls, egress control, and WAF.

 - Fluency with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, including reusable patterns, multi-environment rollouts and reading plans for security impact.

 - Experience with CNAPP, SIEM or runtime security tooling and the cloud detection sources around it, such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Access Analyzer.

 - Experience investigating cloud and infrastructure security events: correlating cloud audit, Kubernetes, identity and network logs to establish what happened, its blast radius and its root cause.

 - A track record of reviewing architecture and writing design proposals, guiding teams toward secure designs through conversation rather than mandate, mentoring others through reviews, and turning a review into a change another team is glad to make.

 - Python, Go or TypeScript for security automation.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical risk to non-technical partners. Most of our work with other teams is asynchronous, so much of the job is a well-evidenced finding, proposal or design note that another team can act on without a meeting.

Desirable

 - Experience using AI agents in a SOC or other incident response workflows.

 - Sandboxed runtime experience with gVisor, Firecracker or Kata.

 - Offensive security or red-team experience in cloud and Kubernetes environments.

 - Policy engines such as OPA or Rego.

 - Supporting audits like SOC 2 with automated evidence collection.

 

Our stack

AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD with federated identity, an enterprise identity provider, observability and cloud security platforms, and AI agent tooling.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic, highly organized, and hands-on Program Manager - Corporate Events & Experience to help shape how Crusoe shows up for our employees, partners, and clients. This role will play a key part in bringing our internal culture and external market presence to life through thoughtfully designed, high-impact event experiences.



As Program Manager, you will develop and execute end-to-end event programming in partnership with Workplace and Organizational Development leadership. You will lead the planning and execution of a diverse portfolio of experiences, including multi-day development workshops, leadership summits, employee incentive trips, and enterprise-wide recognition programs, ensuring each experience reflects Crusoe’s mission and values.



This is a highly collaborative, execution-focused role requiring someone who can balance strategic program development with hands-on event management. You will bring strong project management, vendor negotiation, and budget management skills while seamlessly navigating everything from executive-level presentations and complex event logistics to flawless on-the-ground execution.



 

What You'll Be Working On:

 - Internal Events, Incentive Programming and Culture
   
   - Enterprise Event Structure: Build a scalable, annual internal events framework from the ground up, ensuring consistent, memorable experiences that reflect Crusoe's mission and values.
   
   - Incentive & Recognition Trips: Design and operationalize elite employee incentive programs, milestone celebrations, and high-performer reward trips from venue sourcing to final execution.
   
   - Leadership & Offsite Programming: Own the end-to-end execution of executive retreats, board meetings, and company-wide leadership summits, ensuring precise alignment on goals and scheduling.
   
   - Cross-Functional Workplace Engagement: Partner with People Operations and Workplace teams to align internal events with onboarding, employee engagement initiatives, and workplace culture spotlights.

 - Operational Excellence, Budget and Data
   
   - Fiscal Oversight: Manage the total corporate events budget across all internal and external portfolios, maximizing ROI and driving cost-efficiencies through strategic vendor contract negotiations.
   
   - Data-Driven Optimization: Establish KPIs for both internal employee satisfaction and external marketing ROI; leverage post-event data and metrics to continuously evolve event formats.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Patient Access & Fulfilment
jobs.description:
Healthcare is in crisis and the people behind the results deserve better. With more and more data coming from wearables, lab tests, and patient–doctor interactions, we’re entering an era where data is abundant.

Junction is building the infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare, making patient data accessible, actionable, and automated across labs and devices. Our mission is simple but ambitious: build the infrastructure that makes predictive, personalized care possible.

If you're passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in.

Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare personalized, proactive, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast.


Short on time? TL;DR

 - You: Experienced PM who's shipped complex B2B products where real people, and something in the physical world, have to show up for the product to work. The messier the problem space, the more at home you'll feel here

 - Us: Team of ~60 including a growing team of 14 engineers, lab volume 6x’d in the last year, powering millions of lab tests across all the US.

 - Salary: $190,000 - $240,000 + equity

 - Location: Remote EST ONLY



Why we need you

Junction sits at the center of labs, providers, and the developers building on top of us. We process 20M lab tests today and are on track for 60M next year, and every 300th outpatient test in the US already runs through our systems. The product decisions we make now will shape how we get there.

This role owns how every order on Junction turns into a sample at the lab, one of the most sensitive and error prone moments in laboratory testing. When a sample isn't collected, or isn't collected properly, the patient never gets their result. That is the leading cause of missing results in lab testing today. Between the order and the lab, a patient has to find a collection option, and show up. That might be at a patient service center, with a mobile phlebotomist at their home, or with a self collection kit through the mail. The sample then has to be collected correctly and reach the right lab within its stability window, often through partners we don't directly control. This is one of the few product roles where the product only works if something happens in the physical world.

Solving this is the biggest opportunity in lab testing, and it starts with the patient. A patient-centric experience is how we get more people lab results and get better care delivered faster, in more places, more reliably. That is becoming Junction's most differentiated value proposition, and this role will own it. You'll expand where and how patients can get tested, including in their own homes. You'll improve the experience so more people follow through and get collected correctly the first time. You'll also build the national network of collection sites, phlebotomists and couriers behind it, and keep it reliable as volume grows.

You'll report to our Head of Product, work closely with engineering from discovery to shipping, and help shape how we build product at Junction.



What you'll be doing day to day

 - Get more orders to a sample at the lab: from scheduling and reminders to where collection is available, you'll own the levers that get patients to follow through.

 - Own the physical path: kits and supplies, transport and routing each sample to the right lab, built alongside our Lab Operations team.

 - Expand where patients can get tested: launch new collection partners, including mobile phlebotomy and at-home kits, and decide where coverage and experience matters most.

 - Make calls with incomplete information: and flag the ones that need a wider conversation. Don't leave your team waiting on you.

 - Turn real-world signal into roadmap: customer pain, production issues, vendor behavior, support escalations. You're the person who sees the pattern and does something with it.

 - Partner with Product Ops on launches: so GTM, Success, Support and Operations are ready when the product is.

 - Help build the product function: how we plan, how we write, how we talk to customers, how we measure success.



Requirements

 - Consumer product experience with a physical component: you've worked on a consumer product, and it's a big plus if something physical had to ship or happen in the real world for it to work, like at-home testing, pharmacy or delivery.

 - Patient experience craft: you've designed experiences that get people to complete something that matters to them, and you know where funnels lose people and why.

 - Startup PM experience: you've owned an area end-to-end at an early-stage company (Series A–C or equivalent), ideally as a founding or early PM.

 - Understand healthcare deeply: You understand how incentives, economics, and relationships between providers, payers, and patients shape how healthcare actually works. You can navigate the gap between what should happen and what the system rewards—and build products that succeed within it.

 - Complex B2B2C product experience: you've built for both businesses and the people they serve, with heavy third-party dependencies and regulated constraints, and kept the product simple in the face of that complexity.

 - Comfortable with technical depth: you can write SQL, read an API doc, you don't need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.

 - Customer-obsessed: customer conversations are your lifeline, you thrive on calls with users and customers.

 - Strong judgment, clear communicator: you want to know why a rule exists before you accept it. You write clearly and can talk to anyone — engineers, customers, vendors.



What this role isn't

 - You only want to do strategy: you'll be in the weeds — specs, trade-offs, customer calls, launches. The details matter in this role as much as the bigger picture.

 - You want a polished process on day one: the product function is still forming. You'll help shape it as we scale.

 - You're looking for a people manager role: this is a senior builder role. You'll be hands-on.

 - You want fixed scope: you'll start with a clear area, and as a senior PM you'll also get pulled onto whatever the biggest opportunity is at the time.

 - You want to set your own roadmap: we run one roadmap for the company. You'll shape it a lot, and sometimes your best idea will lose to something more important.

Our benefits:

 - Your salary is dependent on your location and experience level

 - Equity (extended exercise post 2 years of employment) 

 - Company and team offsites

 - Monthly learning budget of $150 for personal development and productivity

 - $100 monthly wellness budget

 - Flexible, remote-first working, including $1K for home office equipment

 - Coworking budget

 - 36 days paid time off (including bank holidays)

 - Premium healthcare coverage 

 - 4% monthly contribution to pension/401k

 - Yearly blood test on us

 - Enhanced parental, foster, and adoption leave
   
   

Important details before applying:

 - We only hire folks physically based in GMT and EST timezones 

 - We do not sponsor visas right now given our stage

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a 50 State Licensed Per Diem On-Call Nurse, you will be the voice Daymark patients reach when they call overnight or on the weekend. Serving patients across the country, you will listen to what is going on, help them understand their options, and connect them to the right next step.

This is a remote, on-call role built around a rotating schedule. Your focus is making sure no patient feels alone with a question, and making sure every after-hours contact is handed off cleanly to the patient’s care team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Be the First Point of Contact After Hours. Answer inbound calls from patients and caregivers, bringing a warm, steady presence to people who may be anxious, uncomfortable, or unsure what to do next.

• Listen, Clarify, and Guide. Understand the patient’s concern through conversation, review the relevant context in their record, and use Daymark’s established pathways and protocols to help the patient understand what their concern may mean and what to do next. Help patients reach the appropriate resource at the moment, including guidance they can act on at home, contact with their treating oncology practice, or escalating care.

• Coordinate and Hand Off. Document each contact in the EHR and communicate open items through team channels.

• Follow Operational Standards. Adhere to Daymark’s policies, procedures, and documentation standards, including confidentiality of all patient health information in accordance with HIPAA.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Licensure: An active, unrestricted Registered Nurse license with multi-state (Nurse Licensure Compact) privileges is required. Current licensure in additional non-compact states (e.g., California, Michigan, New York, etc.) is preferred. Daymark may sponsor additional state licensure for this role.

• Experience: A minimum of 3 years of nursing experience, with oncology experience required. Experience on a nurse advice line, in telephone navigation or triage, or in remote patient support is strongly preferred.

• Sound Judgment & Communication: Ability to understand a patient’s concern through conversation and record review. A warm, clear telephone presence with patients and caregivers, and structured communication when coordinating with providers or handing off to the care team.

• Comfort Working Independently: Confident handling calls on your own, following clear protocols and escalation paths.

• Comfort with Technology: Proficiency with EHR systems and comfort with tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, and cloud-based phone platforms.

• Patient-Centric Approach: A deep commitment to Daymark’s mission to support cancer patients with dignity and compassion.

• Reliability: Dependable availability during scheduled on-call weeks and timely responsiveness to patient calls.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a per diem, fully remote role. Coverage follows a rotating on-call schedule that includes weeknight overnights as well as weekends. Holiday coverage may be requested. Specific scheduling expectations and compensation details will be discussed during the interview process, however the hours of coverage need are: Weeknights: 5pm-8:30am ET and Weekends: 8pm Friday - 8:30am Monday ET. Per diem employees are not eligible for benefits unless otherwise specified by organizational policy.

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

jobs.title: Product Consulting Manager
jobs.description:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

Are you ready to be a catalyst for transformation? As Product Consulting Manager within the broader AiDASH Customer Success team, you'll play a pivotal role in driving our vision forward. You'll own and drive our consultative engagements with customers, ensuring they realize exceptional business outcomes through our satellite-powered AI tech.

How you'll make an impact:

Our customers have climate resilience problems, AiDASH has a robust tech platform, and you will drive the outcome. Here's what your journey with us will look like:

• Strategic Consulting Partnership: You'll be the go-to person for our customers, developing solid working relationships from C-suite executives to front-line field staff (you get a pair of work boots on us!). You'll work closely with customers to dive deep into their business objectives, needs, and challenges, collaboratively identifying the critical problems you will solve with them. Imagine the customers’ situation as trying to find a few needles in a haystack, except the haystack spans thousands of miles, and they have nothing but a clipboard and truck to go find them. You’ll expertly lead them through complex analytics around their problem set with compelling communication skills. You'll serve as their trusted advisor, crafting tailored strategies to tackle this thorny problem using our satellite-powered AI technology.

• Product Value Maximization: You’ll lead dynamic cross-functional teams spanning analytics, data science, product, sales and delivery to craft the perfect solution and customer journey for the customer’s needs. This means more than just creating strategic outcomes for your customers – you’ll be the voice of the customer for our R&D, and your tailored customer solution today will drive new product development atop our incredible AI platform. As we expand our portfolio of products, you’ll workshop specific capabilities with our Data Science, Engineering, and Geospatial Analytics teams. Your knack for problem-solving and innovative thinking will drive value creation beyond expectations, reducing environmental risks once and for all.

• Change Enablement & End-to-end Ownership: You will take full ownership of the customer’s journey and collaborate with multiple AiDASH departments to implement & deploy crafted product solutions for them. You’ll lead critical change management efforts, guiding customers through the transition while painting a compelling narrative that underscores the necessity for change. Your leadership will be instrumental in ensuring that our products are seamlessly integrated into our customers’ workflows within time & budget constraints. The result? Customers are set up for successful long-term, impactful use of our products and realize value from AiDASH.

What we're looking for:

• Experience: You bring 3-6 years of experience that includes management consulting, digital product consulting, analytics or large-scale, complex B2B SaaS deployments with a proven track record of leading teams to deliver impactful projects for clients. Your work isn’t just the design or leave-behind recommendation: you have made measurable change happen with diverse stakeholders in an operational environment.

• Customer Empathy and Initiative: As a self-motivated individual, you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and immerse yourself in our customers’ field environments. Whether it's donning a hardhat and work boots to work with the front line, or engaging in management discussions, you approach every interaction with the strongest customer empathy, respect for a diversity of customers from communities all over the country (and increasingly, the world), and a passion for finding solutions to their pain points. Your intellectual curiosity and drive to learn new topics enables you to absorb information quickly and turn that into value for the customer, and your ability to build strategic relationships and manage diverse stakeholder interests are second to none.

• Communication and Problem-Solving: Your ability to communicate effectively and navigate ambiguity sets you apart. You thrive in challenging situations, leveraging your real-time problem-solving skills to drive meaningful outcomes. You can lead our customers on an ambiguous and technically complex journey with active listening and compelling storytelling.

• Team Leadership: Your leadership skills shine brightest in cross-functional environments. You thrive on collaboration, bringing together diverse teams to achieve common goals. You employ high colleague empathy across a globally distributed team to make things happen for your customers.

• Education: While a post-graduate degree in a business discipline from a Tier I institution would be advantageous, we value intellectual curiosity and a passion for tackling complex challenges.

What we can do for you:

• World-class Rewards: Competitive compensation along with comprehensive and premium benefits.

• Be the Disruptor: Make a positive impact on society & sustainability by leveraging the power of cutting-edge technology for industries ripe for innovation. Push the boundaries of what is possible by leading unique, atypical takes on long-standing problems.

• Multiply your Growth: Work in a dynamic environment where you can continuously learn, innovate, and thrive. We pride ourselves on our open and collaborative culture, where our founder team is approachable and eager to engage with innovative thinkers and creative problem-solvers. All our team members are encouraged to bring their concepts, perspectives, and creativity to the table and to the field, as that’s when the magic happens!

• Balance work, life, and the great outdoors: Our North America team is remote-first. With our mission-driven ethos we are making a major impact while working from home. But when it’s time to show off our amazing technology to customers, we hit the road and head to some incredible places. You may have the opportunity to travel across North America (and in some cases, globally), visiting customers, seeing breathtaking views, and experiencing diverse geographies. While travel frequency can vary, you can expect to be on the move for about 2-4 days each month (less than 30%).

If you're ready to embark on a career that merges AI, geospatial sensing, climate, and client service, then AiDASH is the place for you. Join us in driving positive change and solving some of the world's most pressing problems through innovation and collaboration.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and be part of our journey towards a sustainable future!

What you'll love:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children

• Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles

• 401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after three months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered

• Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers

• Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you!

• Winter Break: From December 25 through January 1, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends!

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We offer a competitive annual pay range of $190,000 to $230,000 for this full-time position, which includes a base salary and an annual performance-based bonus. This range reflects the anticipated annual salary for new hires. We strive to ensure our compensation packages are equitable and aligned with industry standards. Your recruiter can share more about compensation during the hiring process.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive
jobs.description:
