jobs.title: Health Partner
jobs.description:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care.

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Health Partners are core members of the Daymark care team, supporting integrated, whole-person care for our patients. In this role, you will coordinate social and logistical aspects of care, spending time connecting with patients and caregivers by phone, video, and occasionally in the home. You will help patients navigate community-based and social services, ensure follow-up appointments are scheduled, and support seamless coordination between Daymark and external providers.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment. Success requires strong prioritization, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality work at speed.

Note: This is a full time position required to be onsite 5 days a week in The Long Beach, CA office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Conduct structured social needs assessments (SDOH) and connect patients with community resources, which may include transportation, financial assistance, food, medical equipment, or emotional support programs.

• Support development of patients’ care plans and participate in case conferences to ensure quality care delivery.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for virtual visit readiness and basic technology troubleshooting.

• Coordinate and schedule care for patients, including scheduling follow-up visits and facilitating referrals.

• Own structured chart preparation to ensure providers are visit-ready, including accurate contact, insurance, and care team information.

• Track completion of our Symptom Survey, complete all appropriate follow ups, and escalate clinical concerns as needed.

• Document social interventions, tasks, and care coordination activities in the electronic health record in a timely and standardized format.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience. You have at least 3 years of experience in healthcare navigation or patient support, or related experience in a clinical or care coordination setting.

• Comfort with Technology. You’re comfortable using Slack, Zoom, the Google Suite, and EHR systems to ensure accurate appointment scheduling and management and support patients virtually.

• Bias to action: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do. You know how to identify and prioritize your initiative’s needs and you do what it takes to ensure that urgent and important needs are acted on immediately.

• Comfort with change and ambiguity: You may not always have direction in your work, and that’s OK, because you’re comfortable figuring out what needs to be done and a path forward.

• Strong relational skills. You have an uncanny ability to establish rapport and work effectively with diverse populations including health care providers, clinical staff, patients, and family members.

• Organized & Communicative. You are incredibly organized and sweat the details. You keep your team in the loop with what you’re working on and the challenges you’re facing and are proficient in collecting patient clinical and demographic data and documenting appropriately in a timely manner.

• Open to working from Daymark's local office: You're comfortable working out of our office in Providence, Rhode Island 5 days of the week, and occasionally, visiting patient's homes.

• Bilingual: is a plus but is not required.

Compensation Range: $55,000 - $60,000 USD
Location: Fully onsite (5 days a week) in Long Beach, CA; 8:30am - 5:00pm.

#LI-JG1

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Forward Deployed Engineer

Redwood City, CA

Suki builds AI for clinical documentation. Clinicians who use Suki spend over 70% less time on admin work, and our customers see a 9X return in their first year. Suki Platform gives other healthcare companies access to the same technology through APIs and SDKs, powering voice features in telehealth platforms, care delivery tools, and specialty EMRs.

We are hiring a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to lead technical delivery for our most important Platform customers. This is an individual contributor role.

About the role

Integrating AI into healthcare systems is hard. APIs behave differently in production, clinical workflows vary from site to site, and small edge cases decide whether clinicians keep using the product. You will own our most complex customer integrations from scoping to production. You will also turn what you learn into tools, patterns, and product feedback that help the rest of the team deliver faster.

What you will do

• Lead technical delivery for strategic Platform customers, working directly with their engineering, product, and clinical teams.

• Turn unclear customer requirements into solution designs using dictation, ambient, text generation, and summarization.

• Make architecture decisions on security, data handling, and edge cases.

• Build reference implementations and playbooks the team can reuse.

• Deploy distributed applications in on-premises and cloud environments, and own them after launch, including monitoring and incident response.

• Bring customer feedback to our Platform, ML, and Product teams and help shape the roadmap.

• Mentor other engineers on the team, review their work, and help with hiring.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or application development.

• Experience as the technical lead on complex customer projects, with influence beyond your own work.

• Strong skills in Python, Go, or Java, and working knowledge of TypeScript, JavaScript, and React.

• Experience shipping LLM features to production, including prompt design, evaluation, and trade-offs between latency, cost, and quality.

• Strong knowledge of OpenAPI 3.0, API design, and API security.

• Experience deploying and running distributed systems on-premises and in the cloud.

• Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, probability, and system design.

• Clear communication with engineers, clinicians, and executives, including onsite work with customer IT teams.

Nice to have

• Healthcare experience, such as HIPAA, EHR integrations, or HL7/FHIR.

• Experience with real-time or streaming systems, such as WebSockets, gRPC, or audio streaming.

You don't need to have done all of this. If you have done most of it and are ready to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

Our stack

GCP, Kubernetes, Vertex AI, Go, Python, C++, PyTorch, JAX, gRPC, JavaScript, and a range of open and commercial LLMs.

Why Suki

• Clinicians at health systems across the country use Suki every day.

• Our team includes former Google and Apple engineers, Stanford physicians, and healthcare veterans.

• We are going after a $30B+ market.

• We have raised $165M from investors including Venrock, First Round, Flare, and March Capital.

• We have been recognized by Fast Company, Google (Partner of the Year for AI/ML), Forbes (AI 50), and Frost & Sullivan.

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve.

The details

This role includes onsite customer work, with travel of about 15%

Under California pay transparency law, the base salary range for this role in California is $225,000 to $250,000. The range does not include bonus or equity. Final pay depends on skills, experience, scope, and market data.

jobs.title: Director, IT
jobs.description:
Shipfusion gives brands the best tools possible for building a successful eCommerce operation. We were founded by a team of long-time eCommerce and logistics professionals who believe retailers should be able to trust their fulfillment partners as much as their in-house team.

At Shipfusion, we pride ourselves on our commitment to entrepreneurship and innovation. We are always looking for individuals who share these values and who are looking to further their careers in a unique and rapidly growing organization!

The Opportunity:

Shipfusion is hiring a Director of IT & Infrastructure to lead the strategic direction of our IT, IoT, and Cloud Infrastructure functions across North America. Reporting to the Sr. VP, Technology, this is a senior leadership role for someone who treats IT as a strategic enabler of business growth and not a cost centre to be managed. This is the first dedicated leadership role of its kind at Shipfusion. You'll be defining the function as much as running it.

In this role you will...

Strategic Leadership

• Define and own the multi-year IT and infrastructure roadmap, covering endpoint management, network architecture, identity, SaaS portfolio, cloud footprint, and IoT, aligned to Shipfusion's growth and product strategy

• Partner with Product and Engineering as a technical consultant on how IT capabilities can enable new product features, integrations, and customer-facing infrastructure decisions

• Partner with Operations leadership on warehouse technology strategy how IoT, networking, and endpoint choices support fulfillment performance and new site launches

• Own SOC2 IT controls end-to-end, including audit readiness, evidence collection, control design, and remediation

• Define the IT security and compliance posture for the company's corporate and operational systems: Zero Trust principles, identity and access management, endpoint security, vendor risk

• Develop and steward the IT budget and vendor portfolio: strategic vendor selection, contract negotiation, renewal strategy, total cost of ownership analysis

• Build the IT levels framework, career ladders, and hiring plan for the IT organization in partnership with the SVP of Technology and People team

People Leadership

• Manage the IT Team Lead as a direct report, providing coaching, goal-setting, and growth support

• Through the Ops Manager, set direction for the broader IT team across Chicago, York, and Las Vegas

• Build a culture of proactive, platform-driven IT operations: moving the team from reactive ticket-handling to engineered reliability

• Partner with the SVP of Technology on hiring, performance, and succession planning for the IT organization

Hands on Architecture and Problem Solving

• Lead architectural decisions on novel infrastructure problems: new site launches, major platform migrations, security incidents requiring senior judgment, cross-functional integration questions

• Own the server compliance and corporate cloud footprint: Ubuntu server estate, AWS infrastructure used for IT and operational systems (distinct from product engineering infrastructure, which is owned by the TechOps function within Engineering)

• Define standards and reference architectures that the Ops Manager and L3 specialists implement: network design patterns, MDM policies, identity integrations, monitoring and alerting standards

• Step into hands-on work when the problem requires senior technical judgment, not as default mode, but when it's the right tool for the moment

Cross Functional Influence

• Represent IT at the technology leadership table; bring forward proposals that shape company-wide decisions on tooling, process, and infrastructure investment

• Build effective working relationships with Engineering's TechOps function, Operations, Finance, and People teams

• Be the senior IT voice on business continuity, incident response, and infrastructure risk for the executive team

Attractive Salary and Lucrative Compensation Plan: Earn what you deserve with our competitive and rewarding salary package.

Comprehensive Health and Dental Coverage: Enjoy peace of mind with health and dental benefits for you and your loved ones, starting from day one.

Generous Vacation Time: Recharge and explore with 15 days of paid vacation and 5 paid wellness days.

Vibrant Company Social Events: Connect and celebrate with exciting social events that bring our team together.

Exclusive Employee Discounts: Enjoy special savings with our employee discount program on your favorite products.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access to comprehensive support services that promote employee well-being and work-life balance.

Calm App Subscription: Receive 100% coverage for the Calm app, providing you with resources for meditation, sleep improvement, and stress management.

Positive Company Culture: Join a workplace known for its supportive, inclusive, and dynamic culture.

High Employee Retention Rates: Be part of a company where employees are valued and tend to stay, reflecting our commitment to employee satisfaction and growth.

Ready to take control of your financial future? At Horace Mann, we are here to support you in achieving your goals and making a meaningful difference in the lives of the educators who trust you. Join us and take the first step toward building a brighter, more prosperous future.

What We’re Looking For:

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

The EE System Manufacturing Engineer V/VI is a senior-level role that bridges electrical design and production. This position owns the manufacturability, testability, and production readiness of Zone 5's electrical systems - including circuit card assemblies, wire harnesses, and avionics subassemblies - and drives quality and yield improvements as programs ramp to rate production.

• Nonconformance Management: Disposition nonconforming material and support Material Review Board (MRB) activities.

• Supplier Support: Work with contract manufacturers and suppliers on process capability, first article inspections (AS9102), and quality issues.

• Process Improvement: Apply lean manufacturing principles to reduce cost, cycle time, and rework.

• Mentorship: Mentor engineers and technicians in manufacturing engineering and electrical workmanship best practices.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience: 10+ years of experience in electrical manufacturing or production engineering in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries.

• Strong working knowledge of IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship standards.

• Experience developing production test fixtures and automated test equipment.

• Proven experience leading RCCA investigations and closing nonconformances.

• Ability to read and interpret schematics, harness drawings, and assembly drawings.

• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

jobs.title: QA Inspector
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch accelerates the development of next-generation aerospace and defense technologies through reusable hypersonic flight testing. Our autonomous, air-launched Talon-A vehicles provide access to operationally realistic flight environments at speeds exceeding Mach 5, delivering critical data that helps customers validate system performance and advance technologies toward deployment. Our team brings together expertise in engineering, manufacturing, and flight operations to solve complex challenges and advance capabilities essential to national security.

To help achieve these efforts, Stratolaunch is seeking a Quality Assurance Inspector at our facility in Mojave, CA.  In this role, the individual operating in this capacity will support all quality aspects of the vehicle manufacturing assembly-line, to include evaluating the quality of Stratolaunch part manufacturing and assembly, with a focus on systems and components dimensional and electrical inspection.  You will contribute to the team responsible for inspecting Stratolaunch parts before they are integrated onto the flight vehicle and documenting non-conformances when they arise.  You will also participate in corrective or continuous improvement actions with the manufacturing team and contribute ideas to company processes that improve part quality.  This role will contribute to Stratolaunch’s Quality Management System, assisting Stratolaunch operations personnel, and instilling a culture where safety and quality are second nature.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform all Quality inspection functions on advanced aerospace vehicles, per specifications

• Use quality development knowledge and skills to develop and deploy effective and efficient methods for verifying and accepting processes and parts, including the use of quantitative and qualitative methods

• Work with Manufacturing, Engineering, and the Procurement team to evaluate the quality of Stratolaunch and supplier parts

• Identify, investigate, and document non-conformances and quality escapes in accordance with the Stratolaunch Quality Management System

• Assist in root cause corrective action analysis for non-conformances

• Maintain and properly fill out all quality-related documentation

• Assist technicians with problem solving on the floor, supporting key manufacturing, assembly, and final inspection processes

• Perform audits of systems, processes, products and documentation

• Perform acceptance and receiving inspections, as required

• Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity and fulfillment of commitments

• Perform other duties as assigned by Quality Management

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required Qualifications:

• Knowledge of, and experience with aircraft and/or launch quality assurance inspection techniques, quality management systems, and aerospace vehicle assembly

• Ability to implement and document quality inspection procedures

• Experience with reading, analyzing, or developing work instructions

• Excellent written & verbal communication

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy

• Ability to work on your own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals

• Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities

• Ability to obtain security clearance at the TS/SCI level

Preferred Qualifications:

• Knowledge and experience in quality management system requirements (such as ISO 9001, AS9100, or IATF 16949)

• Experience with non-destructive inspection methods for composites and metallics

• Experience with air launch systems or commercial space programs

• Experience with government agencies

• Active security clearance

• Experience with electrical/electronics inspection methods and IPC 620

• Experience with various dimensional inspection gauges and techniques, including CMM

• Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

Required Computer Skills:

• Quality Management System software tools

• MS Office (Word, Excel, PPT, Outlook)

Preferred Computer Skills

• Manufacturing Execution System (MES)

• Statistical analysis applications (Minitab or equivalent)

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• QA Inspector Level I ($27.00-$39.00): 1-5 years’ experience in manufacturing, quality assurance, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

• QA Inspector Level II ($36.50-$45.00): 5-10 years’ experience in aerospace manufacturing, quality assurance, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

• QA Inspector Level III ($46.25-$52.90): 10+ years’ experience in aerospace manufacturing, quality assurance, OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• Position requires significant interaction on the shop floor with the Materials and Processes, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Program Management teams

• Travel, as needed, to support the department. Travel estimated to be <5%

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the role

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without hidden fees or compounding interest. Our Direct to Consumer Products, Surfaces, and Growth programs are a fast-growing product set that operates with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader, delivering quality Consumer Experiences to our Consumers and Growth to the business alike.

You will be a pivotal strategic leader responsible for defining the next chapter of Affirm's Consumer & Card Growth programs. You will lead a portfolio of high-impact consumer journeys that directly influence conversion, engagement, and revenue. This is a role for a seasoned product leader obsessed with consumer experiences and quality, driving Consumer Product growth ie Cards, and disrupting the payments & credit landscape

What you'll do

• Strategic Leadership: Define and socialize a long-term Growth and App vision and strategy, and translate that vision into clear roadmaps and decisions that teams can execute against

• Portfolio Oversight: Manage and scale a portfolio of consumer-facing surfaces, and growth platforms, including Onboarding flows, App surfaces, and platforms like Segmentation & Targeting services, ensuring a simple and consistent experience across platforms

• Lead and grow a high-performing PM team. Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, including people managers. You'll set the bar for craft, create development paths, and cultivate a culture of ownership, rigor, and candor.

• Executive Communication: Proactively align senior leadership on strategy, execution risks, and mitigation plans, ensuring organizational clarity during complex initiatives

• Drive cross-functional alignment at scale: Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Revenue leaders to optimize the marketplace ecosystem, balancing merchant value with consumer experiences

• Operational Excellence: Establish frameworks for rigorous experimentation and funnel analysis to drive measurable gains in completion rates and customer retention

What we look for

• Experience: 10+ years of product management leadership, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale consumer products in fintech, e-commerce, or marketplace environments.

• Strategic Clarity: Demonstrated ability to bring "clarity when things feel messy," turning ambiguous problems into crisp narratives and structured execution plans.

• AI/LLM Fluency: Familiarity with AI-native product development, including agentic patterns and LLM-powered discovery experiences, to lead our highest-leverage bets in search

• Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to use data (including LTV/CAC and profitability assessments) to guide prioritization and quantify the impact of product features.

• People Leadership: Experience operating through layers of leadership, delegating ownership effectively, and scaling decision-making across diverse product lines.

• Consumer Empathy: A "consumer-first" mindset with a high bar for design polish and a commitment to delivering honest financial products

About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About the role

The Salesforce Developer and Digital Solutions Specialist develops, enhances, and supports Salesforce solutions that improve sales and customer service processes. The position emphasizes hands-on development using Apex, Salesforce Flow, Lightning configuration, and related platform capabilities across Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Working collaboratively with administrators, developers, business analysts, and business partners, this role translates requirements into secure, maintainable, and testable technical solutions. The position may independently build and support integrations between Salesforce and other systems, while strategic architecture decisions and enterprise platform direction remain with senior technical leadership. The role performs limited routine administration but maintains sufficient knowledge of Salesforce configuration, security, release, and support processes to deliver well-rounded solutions.

🏢💻Hybrid Framework - The best of both worlds! Work from home when you need focus and flexibility, and spend 2 days a week in the office for face-to-face collaboration, sharing ideas and catching up with the team. Because some things are simply better together!

What will you be doing?

• Salesforce Development: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch and queueable processes, invocable actions, REST services, callouts, and supporting unit tests.

• Digital Solutions and Automation: Build and enhance Salesforce Flow automation, validation logic, Lightning pages, and user experiences that support Sales Cloud and Service Cloud business processes.

• Solution Collaboration: Work with coworkers and business partners to understand requirements, evaluate options, and develop practical technical solutions within established platform standards and architectural direction.

• Code Quality: Write clean, documented, bulk-safe, and maintainable code that follows Salesforce development standards, governor-limit considerations, security requirements, and team design patterns.

• Integration Development: Independently design, build, test, monitor, and troubleshoot Salesforce integrations using Apex, REST or SOAP APIs, JSON, and approved authentication and integration patterns.

• Testing and Release Support: Create unit and integration tests, participate in peer reviews, support user acceptance testing, and assist with source control, deployment, and post-release validation activities.

• Platform Support: Troubleshoot Salesforce defects and production issues across custom code, automation, configuration, data, and integrations; document root cause and implement durable corrections.

• Platform Administration Awareness: Apply working knowledge of Salesforce objects, fields, permissions, sharing, validation rules, reports, dashboards, environments, and release processes while partnering with administrators for routine administration.

• Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Maintain technical documentation, share knowledge with team members, and stay current with Salesforce platform releases, development practices, and relevant capabilities in Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

What are we looking for?

• 3+ years of hands-on experience working with the Salesforce platform, including solution development, automation, configuration, or support.

• 2+ years of hands-on Apex development experience, including development, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting of custom Salesforce solutions.

• Salesforce certifications are not required at hire. Relevant Salesforce certifications, including Platform Developer I, Administrator, or Platform App Builder, are preferred and may qualify for certification incentives in accordance with applicable company programs.

Work Environment: Job is performed in a hybrid office environment, with two days currently expected in the office each week. The in-office schedule may be adjusted based on business needs and company policy.

• Vision; Clarity of vision at near or far distances.

What will make you stand out?

• Strong working knowledge of Apex, including classes, triggers, asynchronous processing, invocable methods, callouts, exception handling, and unit testing.

• Ability to write efficient SOQL and design solutions that respect Salesforce governor limits and large-data-volume considerations.

• Hands-on experience building Salesforce Flow automation and determining when Apex is appropriate to supplement declarative functionality.

• Experience configuring Lightning record pages, app pages, actions, and user experiences for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

• Working knowledge of Lightning Web Components and JavaScript sufficient to build or maintain targeted user-interface enhancements.

• Experience designing, building, testing, and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations, including JSON payloads, authentication concepts, and error handling.

• Understanding of Salesforce data modeling, data quality, security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, and access-control concepts.

• Familiarity with Salesforce administration processes, including environments, users, configuration, reports, dashboards, and release support.

• Experience with source control, preferably Git, and familiarity with Salesforce DX and CI/CD delivery practices.

• Ability to develop and execute unit, integration, regression, and deployment validation testing.

• Working knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud capabilities and business processes.

• Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into clear, maintainable technical solutions within established architecture.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to work independently on assigned solutions while collaborating effectively with administrators, developers, analysts, and business partners.

What do we offer?

The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Marketer, Neurology (West Region)
jobs.description:
Axsome Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company leading a new era in the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) conditions. We deliver scientific breakthroughs by identifying critical gaps in care and develop differentiated products with a focus on novel mechanisms of action that enable meaningful advancements in patient outcomes. Our industry-leading neuroscience portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for major depressive disorder, agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease, excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and migraine, as well as multiple novel product candidates addressing a broad range of serious neurological and psychiatric conditions that impact over 150 million people in the United States. Together, we are on a mission to solve some of the brain’s biggest problems so patients and their loved ones can flourish. For more information, please visit us at www.axsome.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

About This Role:

Axsome Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Regional Marketer (Thought Leader Liaison) to join our Neurology Marketing team. This field-based role will serve as a strategic connection between key thought leaders, regional markets, and the broader Axsome organization, helping translate customer and marketplace insights into meaningful commercial strategies and initiatives across our neurology portfolio.

The Senior Regional Marketer will develop and maintain relationships with regional, and local thought leaders across relevant neurology communities, gathering insights that help inform brand strategy, customer engagement, educational initiatives, and future marketing efforts. The role will also lead regional execution of key HCP marketing initiatives, including peer-to-peer education, speaker identification and development, advisory boards, congress engagement, and other thought leader programs aligned with brand and portfolio priorities.

Success in this role requires strong external relationship-building capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to connect insights from the field with opportunities for the business. The Senior Regional Marketer will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Field Medical, Training, Market Access, Market Research, and Medical Affairs in accordance with applicable policies and procedures. This position reports to the Senior Director, Regional Marketing for Neurology.

This is a field-based position supporting the West Region, including AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, LA, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, ND, NE, NM, NV, OK, OR, TX, UT, WA, WI, WY. Candidates must reside within the assigned geography.

Job Responsibilities and Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

Thought Leader Engagement & Insights

• Serve as a key commercial liaison to national, regional, and local thought leaders across relevant neurology communities, building trusted relationships and creating a strong bridge between external stakeholders and Axsome.

• Develop and execute strategic thought leader engagement plans based on regional dynamics, stakeholder needs, brand priorities, and business objectives.

• Develop and maintain thought leader mapping and engagement strategies to identify key relationships and opportunities across the region.

• Engage thought leaders at local, regional, and national congresses, professional meetings, and advocacy events to support appropriate commercial and brand initiatives.

• Gather and synthesize actionable insights from thought leaders and the regional marketplace to help inform brand strategy, messaging, educational needs, resources, and future marketing initiatives.

• Facilitate appropriate engagement opportunities between thought leaders and Axsome leadership in support of strategic marketing initiatives.

Regional & Brand Strategy

• Serve as a voice of the region to brand and commercial teams, communicating emerging customer needs, competitive dynamics, market trends, and opportunities across relevant neurology markets.

• Partner cross-functionally to translate regional and thought leader insights into actionable recommendations for commercial strategy and execution.

• Support the development and execution of regional HCP marketing initiatives aligned with brand and portfolio strategies and objectives.

• Provide insight into local marketplace dynamics, including customer education needs, clinical messaging, access considerations, and other factors influencing the treatment landscape.

• Partner with Marketing and other stakeholders to evaluate existing programs and identify opportunities to strengthen future customer engagement.

Peer-to-Peer Education & Speaker Engagement

• Identify potential HCP speakers consistent with approved criteria and business needs.

• Lead the development, training, engagement, and ongoing support of promotional speakers to enable high-quality peer-to-peer education.

• Partner with Marketing and other internal stakeholders to support compliant execution of speaker programs.

• Attend and monitor speaker programs, providing appropriate coaching and feedback to support effective program delivery.

• Gather and synthesize speaker feedback to help inform current and future content, resources, and educational initiatives.

Advisory Boards & Congress Engagement

• Support the planning and execution of commercial advisory boards and other approved thought leader engagements.

• Identify potential HCP consultants consistent with approved consultant engagement criteria.

• Support and, where appropriate, facilitate advisory boards designed to gather meaningful customer and market insights.

• Represent Regional Marketing at relevant local, regional, and national congresses and professional meetings.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to maximize appropriate thought leader engagement opportunities surrounding major congresses and events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build strong partnerships with field-based and corporate colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Field Medical, Training, Market Access, Market Research, and Medical Affairs.

• Share relevant marketplace and thought leader insights with internal stakeholders to support coordinated decision-making and execution.

• Partner effectively across multiple brands and therapeutic priorities as the neurology portfolio evolves.

Requirements / Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• 8+ years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or relevant healthcare industry experience.

• At least 2 years of relevant cross-functional experience across two or more areas, such as Regional or HCP Marketing; Thought Leader/KOL Engagement; Product or Brand Marketing; Field Sales; Field Sales Leadership; Key Account Management; or Professional healthcare organization engagement.

• Demonstrated experience developing relationships with thought leaders/KOLs and other influential healthcare stakeholders.

• Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50–75%, including air and automobile travel.

Experience, Knowledge and Skills

• Demonstrated success in thought leader engagement, KOL relationship management, advisory boards, and/or speaker bureau programs.

• Experience in regional marketing, brand/product marketing, sales leadership, or pharmaceutical product launches strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to manage a large geographic territory and engage effectively with stakeholders across academic and community-based healthcare settings.

• Strong understanding of how customer and marketplace insights can inform commercial and brand strategy.

• Demonstrated ability to build credible, productive relationships with senior external stakeholders and cross-functional internal partners.

• Strong clinical and marketplace aptitude within complex and competitive therapeutic areas; neurology, neuroscience, or other CNS experience preferred.

• Strategic thinker with the ability to identify themes across customer interactions and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

• Strong executive presence and verbal and written communication skills.

• Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence across functions and operate effectively in a matrixed environment.

• Strong organizational and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives across a large geography.

• Self-directed and comfortable making sound decisions within established strategies, policies, and available resources.

• Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuously learning, adapting, and responding to evolving market dynamics.

Salary and Benefits:

The anticipated salary range for this role is $190,000 - $210,000. The salary offer will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, qualifications, internal equity and location. Axsome offers a competitive employment package that includes an annual bonus, significant equity and a generous benefits package.

Axsome is committed to equal employment opportunity and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Axsome Therapeutics does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or third-party recruitment agencies and will not pay placement fees for unsolicited candidates that are sent to hiring managers, the HR team or other Axsome team members. Only approved vendors who have been explicitly asked to support a specific search will receive access to our Applicant Tracking System to submit candidates for consideration.

jobs.description:
Why Join Us?

Be a hero for our rare disease patients

At Ultragenyx, we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to do. To achieve this goal, our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us, this means going where other biopharma companies won’t go – challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science, applying a novel rapid development approach, making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices, and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.

Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people, so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ultragenyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth – so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives, in and outside of work. Ultimately, we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family, friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact, do the best work of your career, and grow a lot, both professionally and personally, come join our team.

Position Summary:

ultradedicated – Your biggest challenges yield rare possibilities

We are looking for experienced UltraCare Liaisons (UCLs) that will represent Ultragenyx in the Rare Disease Community, responsible for the promotion of Dojolvi for the treatment of long chain fatty oxidation disorders (LC-FAOD).  Ultragenyx is also preparing for the potential commercialization of two investigational novel gene therapies in MPSIIIA and GSD1a.  We are seeking driven individuals with the desire to run their own business within a specified geography. jobs.title: Startup & VC Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team

What you'll do

As a Startup & VC Partnerships Manager, you'll be the face of Brex in the startup ecosystem. You'll build trusted relationships with top-tier VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and high-growth founders, and turn those relationships into a steady stream of new customers.

The role has two sides that reinforce each other. On the community side, you'll represent Brex in the market by hosting events, driving engagement, and creating meaningful connections that bring real value to founders. On the partnerships side, you'll identify and cultivate partners from the ground up, build tailored go-to-market plans for each one, onboard them into the Brex ecosystem, and manage the relationship over time.

Success will be measured by your ability to bring in new startups, grow Brex's market share among top venture networks, develop new channel relationships, and deliver high-quality experiences that strengthen Brex's position in the startup space. If you have a track record of exceeding targets and a passion for building mutually beneficial relationships, this is a chance to make a significant impact in a fast-growing environment.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Sales and pipeline

• Drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition for newly incorporated, Pre-seed through Series B companies through direct sales, strategic partnerships, relationship building, and high-impact community events

• Consistently hit targets by converting partner relationships into a steady stream of client referrals

• Serve as a product expert, articulating Brex's value proposition to partners and founders

Partnerships

• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and other ecosystem partners

• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner

• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams, and be the connective tissue between partners and the Brex ecosystem

• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners and use the data to optimize each relationship

Community and brand

• Expand your existing network of top-tier founders and VCs who are eager to support your efforts

• Launch initiatives that bring founders and VCs together in meaningful and differentiated ways

• Be the respected brand and face of Brex for Startups. You are the flag bearer for Brex and everyone should know you in the market

Value add to founders

• Leverage your network, your colleagues' networks, and your skills to help founders on several fronts: accessing capital (debt and equity), sourcing talent for key roles, and connecting them with potential customers

Cross-functional and operations

• Work closely with marketing, growth, direct sales, underwriting, operations, finance, revenue operations, and product & engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform the product roadmap

• Maintain strong data hygiene in Salesforce and leverage tools such as Hex, Retool, Scratchpad, Botdog, Rings, Harmonic, Pitchbook and Nooks

• Use AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, etc.) to work more efficiently

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in venture capital, at a startup, or in a partnerships or closing sales role

• Established network within the startup ecosystem and proven experience working directly with VCs and founders

• Strong understanding of the venture community and how to drive partnerships within it

• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas

• Experience building communities both virtually and in person, with a passion for events and activations with partners

• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partners' needs and business goals

• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions

• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders

• Self-starter with strong leadership skills, intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, high EQ, and a positive, winning attitude

• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is USD $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Location: Denver, CO / Remote

Reports To: Sales Director

Salary Range: $140,000-$160,000

Position Summary:

As a Sales Professional for IEM, you will be responsible for the sale of IEM power distribution products (MV/LV Switchgear, Switchboards, Panelboards) through direct channels. This includes developing and maintaining medium and large Electrical Contractor accounts and developing contacts and sales with key end user accounts.

Candidate should be skilled in assembling large project package quotations to include IEM and non-IEM products as necessary to furnish a complete bill of material to the customer.

The general territory will be regional. Your office base will be remote.

Key Responsibilities:

• Work with Sales Director to establish, own, execute and continuously develop an agreed & sponsored Account plan.

• Identify & build positive relations with all account decision & influencers who impact current or future business.

• Deeply understand and be able to articulate the client buying process.

• Identify & engage in revenue opportunities within defined accounts.

• Understand & capture the clients challenges & requirements.

• Use personal & internal resources to develop proposals that meet/exceed client requirements.

• Follow the client buying journey / process so as to commercially respond & offer proposal.

• Oversee the effective handover to Platform Execution team.

• Maintain an ongoing oversight into all commercial related engagements for customer success/satisfaction and our performance as vendor.

• Be highly knowledgeable of the client’s business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations and challenges to articulate this in terms of opportunity, growth and risk.

• Be highly knowledgeable on IEM products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations to articulate this in terms of value to client’s business.

• Be an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits in supporting the account within IEM.

• Be an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits in supporting IEM within client organization.

• Provide all internal stakeholder and functional departments the account specific guidance and insights required so that they can execute their role and add value to the client.

• Be responsible for managing forecasting and providing information to Sales Director for capacity planning.

Qualifications:

• A Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.

• A minimum of 5 - 10 years’ experience in the sale of power distribution equipment (MV/LV switchgear/switchboards. Data Center market experience a plus.

• A strong track record of negotiating medium and large project orders, successfully developing new contacts, maintaining current relationships with major contractors throughout the sales cycle and maximizing client potential is a must.

• Experience generating accurate project proposals utilizing MV/LV switchgear plus non-IEM products to present a complete bid package is required.

• A self-motivated individual with a high level of professionalism, excellent communication, presentation and negotiating skills are also required.

• Experience utilizing Salesforce is a plus

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Non-Discrimination Statement

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

Privacy

jobs.title: Senior Physical Engineer - Data Centers
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

About the Position

The Senior Physical Engineer - Data Centers leads the technical execution of physical engineering design, analysis, and technical documentation activities for data centers and mission-critical infrastructure projects. Responsibilities may include site layouts, equipment arrangements, grounding systems, conduit systems, cable routing systems, engineering calculations, technical studies, construction support, and project coordination. In this role, an employee will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in the essential functions below.

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead physical engineering assignments for data centers projects using established engineering standards and practices.

• Prepare and review engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications, studies, and project documentation.

• Develop and coordinate physical engineering deliverables including site layouts, equipment arrangements, grounding plans, conduit plans, cable routing plans, bills of material, and construction documents.

• Perform and review engineering analyses related to grounding systems, conduit systems, equipment layouts, bus ampacity, conduit fill requirements, and other physical design activities.

• Review project requirements, vendor information, client specifications, submittals, and applicable standards to support project execution.

• Lead planning, coordination, and execution of assigned project phases, work packages, and engineering deliverables to support successful project delivery.

• Act as a technical lead for assigned project scopes, ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established engineering standards and practices.

• Lead technical reviews and QA/QC activities to maintain technical quality within assigned scope and ensure deliverables meet company, client, and industry standards.

• Contribute to engineering standards, technical consistency, and application of design practices across assigned projects.

• Provide field support, troubleshooting, site observations, and construction support activities as required.

• Support client communication, technical discussions, project coordination, and project deliverables through effective collaboration with project teams and stakeholders.

• Conduct engineering research related to applicable codes, standards, technologies, and industry practices.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Proficiency with AutoCAD, MathCAD, Microsoft Office, and related engineering software applications.

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Commitment to quality, continuous improvement, safety, and professional development.

• Experience preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, technical reports, design documentation, technical studies, and project deliverables.

• Experience performing physical design and engineering analysis for infrastructure or power-related projects.

• Experience leading assigned project phases, technical work packages, or engineering deliverables and coordinating multidisciplinary project activities.

• Experience coordinating with engineers, designers, project managers, clients, and project stakeholders.

• Experience supporting project delivery, troubleshooting, or construction support activities.

Additional Position Details

• Frequently communicates and collaborates with clients, engineers, designers, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.

Cultural Fit

• Dependable

• Natural Communicator

• Flexible

• Client Focused

jobs.title: Due Diligence Analyst - Americas
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

Alpaca is looking for a collaborative and detail-oriented Due Diligence Analyst - Americas (ET hours) to join our Risk team. In this role, you will support the onboarding of new partners, including international fintechs and financial institutions, by helping ensure that required due diligence, risk, compliance, and AML standards are met before launch.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing role that sits at the intersection of risk management, third-party due diligence, compliance, operations, and project execution. You will help evaluate prospective partners, review key documentation, coordinate internal requirements, and guide partners through the onboarding process.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, comfortable communicating with external stakeholders, and able to manage multiple onboarding workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Support due diligence reviews for new and existing partners, including fintech companies, financial institutions, vendors, and other third-party service providers.

• Communicate regularly with prospective and onboarding partners globally to help them understand requirements, timelines, and outstanding documentation needs.

• Conduct and support third-party risk management processes, including KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, policy and procedure reviews, customer onboarding flow reviews, and risk assessments.

• Review partner-provided documentation for completeness, consistency, and potential risk indicators.

• Track partner onboarding progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help ensure required documents are submitted ahead of launch deadlines.

• Respond to partner questions related to the onboarding and due diligence process, escalating requests or issues as appropriate.

• Work closely with internal teams, including Operations, Compliance, AML, Legal, Product, and Project Management, to ensure partner integrations meet internal requirements.

• Identify process gaps, recurring partner questions, or documentation issues, and contribute to improvements in the partner onboarding and diligence process.

• Maintain accurate records of diligence reviews, decisions, approvals, and supporting documentation.

What You’ll Need:

• Experience: 2–3+ years of experience in risk management, operational risk, third-party risk, compliance, AML, financial crime, or related functions within financial services, fintech, brokerage, or another regulated industry.

• International Mindset: Comfort working with international partners and reviewing diligence materials across different jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

• Analytical Skills: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, gaps, and potential risk indicators in documentation, data, and partner responses.

• Organizational Skills: Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple partner onboarding processes simultaneously.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requirements clearly to external partners and internal stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across Risk, Compliance, AML, Operations, Legal, Product, and Project Management teams.

• Proactive Ownership: A self-starter mindset with strong accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a rapidly evolving environment.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations, or a related field.

Nice to Haves:

• Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations, including BSA/AML, KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, and third-party risk management practices.

• Experience supporting partner, vendor, or third-party onboarding in a fintech, brokerage, payments, banking, or financial services environment.

• Understanding of operational resilience, business continuity, cybersecurity, data protection, or outsourcing risk frameworks.

• Experience reviewing policies and procedures related to AML, sanctions, customer onboarding, fraud, compliance, or operational controls.

• Familiarity with broker-dealer, introducing broker, or embedded finance models.

• Experience using case management, GRC, CRM, or project tracking tools.

How We Take Care of You:

• Competitive Salary & Stock Options

• Health Benefits

• New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500

• Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform - Prism
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

As a Senior Software Engineer (IC3) on SoFi’s Prism team, you’ll help build Prism, SoFi’s internal AI platform for knowledge work. Prism connects employees with the AI models, business context, and tools they need to solve important problems more effectively. It also creates a continuous learning loop by capturing what works—and what doesn’t—so our workflows improve over time and employees can deliver better results faster.

In this role, you will pair hands-on software development with systems thinking. You will take technical ownership over feature delivery and key service components—translating partially defined technical problems into production-grade, highly available microservices. You will collaborate closely with partner teams (such as Autonomous Coding, CI/CD, and product squads), practice operational rigor, and use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to raise quality and delivery velocity across our engineering community.

What you’ll do:

• Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate foundational components of Prism and contribute to the underlying components.

• Build and maintain telemetry, usage instrumentation, and reporting pipelines to provide clear visibility into Prism and the learning feedback loop.

• Lead technical feature execution for assigned platform work streams, breaking down complex tasks to parallelize implementation with teammates and aligning dependencies with product and engineering managers.

• Participate actively in technical design reviews, reasoning through architectural trade-offs (such as latency, fault tolerance, concurrency, and security) and documenting clear technical specifications.

• Contribute to team engineering quality by following and refining coding conventions, automated testing patterns, and reusable service templates.

• Drive operational excellence by automating test and deployment workflows, participating in on-call service ownership, acting as an incident resolver, and implementing post-incident remediations to prevent recurrence.

• Engage directly with internal customers to understand their day-to-day workflows, support adoption of Prism, and incorporate feedback into iterative system improvements.

• Mentor early-career engineers through thoughtful code reviews, constructive design feedback, and pair programming to foster continuous team growth.

What you’ll need:

• Education & Minimum Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree + 2–3 Years of Experience OR Master’s Degree + 2 Years of programming experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related field.

• Proven programming proficiency in at least one modern backend language (such as Java, Kotlin, Python, Go, or Scala).

• Solid experience building and operating distributed backend services in a microservices or cloud environment, with an understanding of concurrency, fault tolerance, idempotence, and API design.

• Practical experience working with relational databases, persistent data stores, and data modeling concepts.

• Practical understanding of operational excellence: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, automated unit/integration testing, and safe production deployment practices (canarying, feature flags).

• Hands-on experience developing with or integrating AI-assisted developer tools, LLM APIs, prompt engineering patterns, or tool-execution frameworks.

• Collaborative approach with clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write structured technical design documents and share constructive code review feedback.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations:

• Use AI tools responsibly to prototype solutions, navigate codebases, and accelerate implementation velocity while upholding high security and safety standards.

• Critically inspect and validate AI-generated code, backing all implementations with comprehensive automated tests to ensure long-term maintainability.

• Maintain rigorous compliance with data governance and security policies, ensuring sensitive member data and proprietary assets are never exposed to unapproved tools.

• Elevate team productivity by sharing effective harnesses, prompt templates, and operational guardrails.

Nice to have:

• Experience engineering internal developer platforms (IDP), developer tooling, or CLI workflows.

• Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern CI/CD pipeline automation.

• Experience in fintech or within another highly regulated industry environment.

• Deep understanding of LLM integration, context retrieval architectures (RAG), and AI evaluation frameworks.

Requisition ID:  300508

Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects:

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.

Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report .

Project Overview:

Bechtel is designing, constructing and commissioning the world's largest radioactive waste treatment plant for the U.S. Department of Energy at the Hanford Site in southeastern Washington state. The Hanford Tank Waste Treatment and Immobilization Plant will use vitrification technology to process and solidify 56 million gallons (210 million liters) of radioactive and chemical waste stored at the Hanford site, which is a byproduct of plutonium production during World War II and the Cold War era.

The project is the largest undertaking of its kind and one of DOE's most technically challenging cleanup projects. Its construction spans 65 acres (26 hectares) with four major nuclear facilities - Pretreatment, Low-Activity Waste Vitrification, High-Level Waste Vitrification and Analytical Laboratory - as well as operations and maintenance buildings, utilities, other support facilities

Job Summary:

Plans and conducts work requiring judgment in the evaluation, selection, application, adaptation, and modification of standard techniques, guidelines, procedures, and criteria. Devises new approaches to startup or testing. Plans and coordinates independent work requiring judgment and experience in the application and substantial adaptation of startup techniques. Devises new approaches to startup problems. Provides startup or testing direction to subordinate startup engineers, engineers, technicians, crafts or others as assigned for specific projects or tasks. Requires experience and demonstrated skill in handling work at grade level and a broad knowledge of precedents in the industry. Principle responsibilities include but are not limited to the following: Develops and evaluates plans and criteria within a discipline or specialty for a variety of project activities.
