jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

Rippling is transforming how businesses operate, and as we continue to grow, we're scaling our demand generation engine to reach new audiences, create demand, and drive meaningful business impact.

That's where you come in.

As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you'll help shape and execute high-impact field marketing programs that build relationships, create demand, generate net-new pipeline, and accelerate existing opportunities. Working closely with Sales leadership and cross-functional marketing teams, you'll be a key partner in translating business priorities into creative, scalable programs that connect Rippling with the right audiences and drive measurable revenue impact.

We're looking for someone who brings strategic thinking, strong execution, and a passion for building meaningful experiences. You're relentlessly focused on results, constantly looking for ways to optimize performance, improve conversion, and maximize impact. You'll challenge traditional B2B marketing playbooks, experiment with new approaches, and help evolve how Rippling brings its brand to life in the field.

What you will do

• Help shape and execute field marketing plans. Partner with field marketing leadership to develop plans aligned with business priorities, sales objectives, and pipeline goals. Own programs from planning through execution and optimization.
• Drive net-new pipeline and accelerate opportunities. Build high-impact programs that generate qualified pipeline, engage target accounts, and accelerate opportunities, with a relentless focus on improving results.
• Be a strategic partner to Sales. Build strong relationships with Sales leadership and go-to-market teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and drive effective engagement and follow-up.
• Create differentiated field experiences. Develop innovative programs across owned events, third-party conferences, executive experiences, and other field marketing initiatives.
• Own program budgets and execution. Manage event calendars, budgets, vendors, and execution while maximizing efficiency and ROI.
• Share learnings and performance metrics. Ensure the right metrics are tracked, keep leadership and cross-functional partners informed, and identify opportunities to optimize performance.
• Build for scale and innovation. Develop repeatable playbooks, streamline processes, and experiment with new approaches to drive greater impact.

What you will need

• Proven expertise in field marketing. You understand how to reach target audiences through the right mix of events, partnerships, and experiences that generate pipeline and maximize ROI.
• A hacker's mentality. You obsess over finding creative ways to improve performance, maximize efficiency, and scale successful programs.
• 6+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, or event marketing, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
• Salesforce and Outreach knowledge is strongly preferred.
• Ability to navigate ambiguity. You adapt quickly, take ownership, and find a path forward even when the roadmap isn't clear.
• Strong attention to detail. You manage multiple programs, budgets, and priorities while delivering exceptional experiences.
• A hands-on mentality. You're willing to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to get the job done.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You're comfortable engaging directly with executives, Sales leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Bias for speed. You thrive in fast-moving environments, make decisions quickly, and maintain momentum while driving measurable results.

About the team

The Field Marketing team sits within Rippling's Events organization and plays a key role in driving growth by partnering closely with Sales to generate net-new pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and drive measurable revenue impact. Through creative, high-impact experiences and programs, we bring Rippling closer to our customers and prospects.

We're a team of five spread across the US, working closely with Sales and cross-functional Marketing teams to develop innovative, scalable programs that drive results.

Even if you don’t meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply. Skills can be used in lots of different ways and your life and professional experience may be relevant beyond what a list of requirements will capture.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

jobs.title: Product and Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Blossom Health exists to solve the mental health epidemic in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access to affordable, timely, clinically-effective mental healthcare. Our AI-native care platform is loved by hundreds of clinicians and thousands of patients.

We’re a Series A company with $20M+ raised from Headline, Village Global, and the founders of General Catalyst, Flatiron Health, Sword Health, Grow Therapy, Fay, Elemy, Zip, Blank Street, Assured, Bridge, Birches Health, and Enzo Health.


THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance & Business Operations Lead to own the financial and analytical work behind some of Blossom’s most important business decisions.

This is not a generalist BizOps role. You’ll spend a significant amount of your time digging into the economics of the business: understanding our revenue structure, building financial models, evaluating new opportunities, and turning complex financial and operational data into decisions.

You’ll report directly to our Founder and work closely with leaders across the company as we scale.


WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

 - 🚀 Be early in a hyper-growth startup: Join the foundational team of a rapidly scaling company and help build the financial and operational infrastructure behind our next stage of growth

 - 📈 Work on decisions that matter: Your analysis won’t live in a deck. You’ll help answer questions that directly influence how we grow, where we invest, and how we build the business

 - 🤝 High trust and autonomy: Own meaningful work from day one, with the freedom to shape how problems are approached and solved

 - 🧠 Talent-dense team: Work alongside a top-percentile team with high standards, intellectual curiosity, and a shared ambition to build something consequential

 - 🏃 We move with speed and purpose: We value people who can move quickly, get deep into the details, and turn analysis into action


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own financial analysis and modeling across revenue, growth, unit economics, and strategic initiatives

 - Develop a deep understanding of Blossom’s revenue structure and identify opportunities to improve the economics of the business

 - Build models and analyses that inform company-level decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, and new opportunities

 - Partner with the Founder and business leaders on high-priority strategic and operational projects

 - Translate complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations and actionable decisions

 - Build reporting, forecasting, and analytical processes as the company scales

 - Evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, markets, and strategic initiatives from both a financial and operational perspective

 - Move beyond the analysis when needed and help execute on the opportunities you identify


YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 2–6 years of professional experience, with a strong foundation in finance and financial analysis

 - You have experience in investment banking, equity research, private equity, hedge funds, or another rigorous investing/financial environment

 - You’re exceptionally strong in financial modeling and comfortable getting deep into revenue structures, unit economics, and business performance

 - You have a track record of outperforming in highly selective, demanding environments

 - You can take a complicated or ambiguous question, structure it quickly, and arrive at a thoughtful answer

 - You’re commercially minded. You care about what the numbers actually mean for the business, not just producing the analysis

 - You have a strong bias for action and are excited to operate beyond the traditional boundaries of a finance role

 - You communicate clearly and can turn detailed analysis into a compelling recommendation

 - You’re excited by the opportunity to work directly with a Founder and take on increasingly broad ownership as the company grows

 - You’re authorized to work in the United States

 - You’re excited to be in-person in New York City 5 days a week

Bonus: You’ve spent several years in investment banking or another rigorous finance environment and have since moved into strategic finance, business operations, or a similar role at a high-growth startup.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable - you want to tackle large, meaningful problems and hold yourself to a high bar

 - Ownership mindset - you think long-term and put the business and our customers first

 - High velocity and high excellence - you move with urgency without sacrificing the quality of your work

 - Analytically rigorous - you’re comfortable going several layers deeper than the obvious answer

 - Commercially curious - you want to understand how and why a business works, not just report what happened

 - An explorer - you’re comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and questions that don’t have an existing playbook

 - Humble - you use your strengths in service of the team and understand that success is an output, not an input


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $120,000–$180,000 base salary

 - Meaningful equity ownership

 - Significant growth opportunities as the company scales

 - Beautiful, sunshine and snack-filled office in the heart of Flatiron, Manhattan

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - A focus on outcomes, not hours

 - Team outings, offsites, and unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supporting a dynamic legal team and enhancing client experience?

Can you manage multiple priorities with precision and professionalism?

Do you thrive in a team environment that values flexibility and initiative?

Are you ready to make a significant impact at a leading homeowner representation law firm?

Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?

** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

If you have any questions, please email recruit@crisp.co only.

• Please do not reach out through our website's contact information (telephone, email, or web chat) or via direct messaging on any social media platform.

To Apply: Submit your application by clicking the "Apply" button and applying on the Crisp Recruit page that opens.

**RECRUITERS DO NOT CONTACT**

LS Carlson Law, PC, established in 2006, is a leading law firm dedicated to championing the rights of homeowners across California and Florida. With a focus on HOA disputes, business litigation, and real estate issues, we have carved out a reputation for fierce advocacy and exceptional client service. Our founder, Luke Carlson, authored the bestseller 'Bad HOA,' underscoring our commitment to homeowner rights.

We prioritize a client-centered approach, emphasizing clarity, strategic advantage, and precision in execution. Our diverse practice areas include HOA disputes, business litigation, employer defense, real estate disputes, and more. We are proud to have received 553 five-star reviews, reflecting our unwavering dedication to client satisfaction and community impact. Our mission extends beyond legal victories as we actively engage in community reform and empowerment.

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of LS Carlson Law by supporting various administrative functions. Your expertise in organization and communication will help elevate client and team interactions, directly contributing to our mission of empowering homeowners and providing top-tier legal services. This position is pivotal in maintaining the efficiency and effectiveness of our administrative operations, allowing our legal teams to focus on advocacy and client success.

Role Scope: This is a cross-trained administrative floater position designed to support multiple functions across the California office. You will step in where needed, provide coverage across administrative responsibilities, and assist with changing priorities and special projects. This role reports to the Director of Administration and works collaboratively with attorneys, leadership, and administrative team members.

What you’ll do:

• General Support: Provide comprehensive daily administrative support across the California office.

• Mail and Phone Coverage: Assist with incoming and outgoing mail processes and provide backup telephone support.

• Document Management: Organize and manage electronic and physical files, ensuring accuracy and accessibility.

• Calendars and Scheduling: Help manage calendars, coordinate appointments, and maintain organized schedules.

• Client Interaction: Occasionally serve as a first point of contact for clients and visitors, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented experience.

• Office Organization: Maintain a clean and organized office environment, supporting special projects as needed.

• Work Arrangement: This is a full-time, onsite position based in Aliso Viejo, CA. Standard hours are approximately 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with some flexibility around start and end times based on team coverage.

What we’re looking for:

• Experience: 2–3 years of administrative experience preferred, ideally within a legal or office setting.

• Customer Service & Composure: Strong customer service skills with the ability to remain calm, empathetic, and professional when interacting with upset or emotional callers and to de-escalate difficult conversations appropriately.

• Role Alignment: Genuinely enjoys administrative support work and is motivated by skill development, teamwork, and broader responsibilities rather than rapid title progression.

• Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with the ability to learn new technologies efficiently.

• Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills, with an eye for detail and accuracy in document review.

• Initiative & Dependability: Self-motivated, reliable, and willing to take ownership of responsibilities, stay productive, and step in wherever support is needed.

• Teamwork: Collaborative mindset, willing to cross-train and support various administrative functions.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; professional demeanor.

Why you should work here:

• Professional Development: Build your skills through cross-training, regular coaching, mentorship, and exposure to multiple administrative functions in a collaborative, relatively flat organization.

• Cross-Functional Growth: Build skills across administrative functions, with the potential to be cross-trained on Retention Team responsibilities such as fee agreements and client file activation as business needs evolve. This is a potential future opportunity, not a guaranteed promotion or transfer.

• Collaborative Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment where teamwork and communication are paramount.

• Leadership Access: Work closely with leadership, gaining insights and mentoring opportunities.

• Meaningful Impact: Contribute to our mission of empowering homeowners and effecting meaningful legal reform.

• Compensation: $26 to $29 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Additional perks:

• Benefits: Health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), and paid time off are offered. Additional benefit details will be shared during the interview process.

• Office Environment: Experience a professional, dynamic, and supportive workplace.

Join LS Carlson Law as an Administrative Assistant and be part of a team that stands for advocacy, empowerment, and positive change. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about contributing to our mission, we invite you to apply and make a difference in the lives of homeowners we represent.

jobs.title: Staff, Strategic Programs and Customer Success
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, https://www.permitflow.com/blog/permitflow-series-b from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7401703305569275904/, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Role Overview

Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will be second in command for the CS org, building the programs, processes, and initiatives that help the team scale with the customer base. You will partner with the Implementation and Customer Success leaders to prioritize and land programs across their teams. You will also work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, and Marketing on cross-functional initiatives.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, based in NYC with a hybrid schedule (in office Monday, Wednesday, Friday).



What You'll Do

 - Own the CS strategic program portfolio and drive the initiatives that improve time to value, retention, expansion, and support efficiency. Examples of programs on the roadmap: a customer health model and review cadence, and a scaled CS motion to complement our white glove approach.

 - Build and maintain the CS operating cadence: planning cycles, weekly reviews, OKR tracking, and executive reporting.

 - Design and land process and tooling changes across Implementation, Support, and CS, including the change management plan, training, and adoption tracking.

 - Act as the CS point of contact for cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Sales, and RevOps; represent CS priorities and bring back commitments.

 - Optimize renewals forecasting and CS capacity planning: the forecast model, risk cadence, book sizing, CSM and IM ratios, and the hiring recommendations that follow, in partnership with Finance and RevOps.

 - Step in for the VP of Customer Success in meetings, escalations, and decisions as needed.

 - Diagnose problems with data: pull your own numbers, build the business case, and define success before work starts.



What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years in post-sales roles (customer success, implementation, professional services, support, or CS operations) at a B2B SaaS company, including 2+ years leading cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling startup.

 - Change management experience. You have rolled out new processes or systems to teams that did not ask for them, and the change stuck.

 - Forecasting and capacity modeling experience. You have owned a renewals forecast or built a coverage model and explained it to Finance.

 - Strong with data and AI tools. You can pull your own numbers from a BI tool, build a model in a spreadsheet, and use AI to sharpen your analysis and communicate your conclusions clearly.

 - Clear writer and effective operator. Your project briefs, status updates, and decision docs are short enough to read and specific enough to act on, and you are as comfortable building a tracker as presenting to the exec team.



What We Offer (Full-Time Roles Only)

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Flexible PTO and paid family leave

 - Home office & equipment stipend

 - Hybrid NYC office culture (3 days in-office/week) with direct access to leadership

jobs.description:
The opportunity

This role exists to win the first wave of flagship AI cloud and inference customers for k0rdent AI. You will be the person in the room when a provider decides how to build, operate and monetize its GPU fleet.

We are looking for a hunter who already knows the founders, CTOs, heads of infrastructure and product leaders at NCPs, neoclouds and inference platforms. You will use those relationships to open doors quickly, shape deals early and build a repeatable go-to-market motion in a market that is moving fast.

What you'll do

• Prospect, open and close new logos among AI cloud providers, NCPs, neoclouds, GPU-as-a-service providers and inference service providers, with a focus on the Bay Area.
• Use your existing executive network to secure meetings with CEOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure, heads of platform engineering and product leaders.

• Build and manage a qualified pipeline with accurate forecasting in Salesforce, using a disciplined methodology such as MEDDPICC.
• Position k0rdent AI around the provider's business outcomes: faster time to revenue on new GPU capacity, higher utilization, multi-tenancy, and new services such as managed inference.
• Partner with solutions architects and product management to run technical evaluations and proofs of concept, and bring customer feedback back into the roadmap.
• Work with NVIDIA, OEM, hardware and channel partners to co-sell, source opportunities and shape joint offerings.
• Represent Mirantis at AI and cloud infrastructure events and in local ecosystem communities.
• Help define the playbook for this segment, including ideal customer profile, pricing input and reference stories.

• 15+ years of enterprise or strategic software and infrastructure sales, selling into the cloud provider ecosystem: hyperscalers, service providers, managed service providers or neoclouds.
• Existing, active relationships with decision-makers at AI cloud providers, NCPs and inference service providers that you can engage from day one.
• A proven hunter track record: consistent quota attainment on new-logo deals, including multiple complex, seven-figure transactions.
• Deep understanding of AI infrastructure and applications, including GPU clusters, model training versus inference workloads, LLM serving, and how providers price and package GPU capacity.
• Working fluency in cloud-native technology: Kubernetes, containers, open source, multi-tenancy and infrastructure automation.
• Ability to build a CFO-level business case around utilization, time to revenue and operating cost.
• Executive presence and the credibility to sell to both technical founders and business leaders.
• Based on the west coast of the US (San Francisco Bay Area highly preferred) and able to travel as needed.

Nice to have

• Prior sales experience at NVIDIA, a GPU cloud, a server OEM, or an AI infrastructure software company.
• Familiarity with the NVIDIA Cloud Partner program and reference architectures.
• Experience selling open-source-based or platform software to service providers.
• Exposure to sovereign AI, telco or regional cloud initiatives.
• Experience as an early seller in a new product line or startup-style business unit.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
• Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
• Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist - Urgent Care
jobs.location: West Lebanon, New Hampshire, United States
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, you will be the first face a patient or visitor sees when they walk into one of our clinics. Working alongside the clinical team, you will be responsible for greeting patients and visitors, completing patient registration, updating new and existing patient records, collecting payment, and ensuring patients with or without pre-existing reservations are seen in a timely manner.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who's looking to get their foot in the door at a growing medical company or someone looking to kickstart their career in customer service or the medical field. If you enjoy working with people, staying organized, and are a pro at multi-tasking, we encourage you to apply!

Your Impact

• Patient Interaction: Engage with patients in a welcoming and professional manner, addressing inquiries and providing assistance both in person and over the phone. Welcome and greet patients to the clinic with a friendly and professional demeanor. Register patients efficiently, ensuring completion of all required forms with accurate information. Handle insurance and billing inquiries, providing clear and concise information to patients. Aid ill or distraught patients as necessary and with available resources.

• Payment Collection: Collect payments, insurance co-pays, and prescription charges following clinic financial policies. Proactively and confidently request a card on file, follow-up on patient balances, and ensure timely patient payments.

• Clinic Coordination & Collaboration: Collaborate with the healthcare team to ensure seamless patient flow and efficient clinic operations, contributing to a positive and organized environment. Manage patient reservations (online and walk-in) and registration, optimizing patient satisfaction and provider schedules. Assist in scheduling specialist referrals as needed for patient follow-up. Work with attention to detail in all tasks, navigating between multiple software systems to follow protocols established by our occupational health partners in support of our Employer Services team.

• Front Desk Management: Answer and direct phone calls in a professional and timely manner. Keep the reception area organized and tidy, creating a welcoming environment for patients. Perform various administrative duties, including photocopying, filing, and maintaining daily activity logs.

• CMD Technology & Offerings Expert: Become familiar with scope of services provided at CMD and costs affiliated with all services. Navigate and utilize various software systems for reservation scheduling and electronic medical records.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days: For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• When needed, must be able to work at a minimum of three (3) other ConvenientMD locations within a one (1) hour travel distance from your primary clinic.

• Required to travel for training shifts which will occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills: Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and handle a fast-paced work environment.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

• Effective communicator and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with patients, team members, and stakeholders across the organization.

• Excellent team player: You enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Driven and self-motivated: Capable of working independently, possess a level of initiative and enthusiasm to help drive results. Actively identifying better ways of working. Uses resourced to achieve the best outcomes for patients, the team, and the organization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Able to comprehend, interpret, and apply the appropriate sections of applicable laws, guidelines, regulations, ordinances, and policies.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Bonus Qualifications

• Medical Receptionist certification

• Previous experience in a medical receptionist role or similar customer service position

• Familiarity with medical terminology and basic knowledge of insurance processes

• Experience using electronic records management software and other related programs used for medical registration and collection of HIPAA documentation

• Experience working with insurance billing and coding information

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process is designed to prevent discrimination against applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, disability status, or any other aspect which makes you unique. If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a ServiceNow Platform Engineer to own a new ServiceNow environment for a federal program. This position offers the opportunity to build an environment from the ground up (provisioning, configuration, security hardening, integration enablement, and readiness validation) within a secure federal enclave, and to serve as the platform owner supporting module implementation (including CMDB), platform upgrades, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform expert who is comfortable taking an environment from zero to production and staying with it as it grows.

Major responsibilities include standing up, configuring, securing, and maintaining the ServiceNow platform, establishing the design and administration standards that keep the environment stable, and collaborating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to deliver a compliant, production-ready platform.

• Location: Hybrid in Washington, D.C. 20036

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $180,000–$200,000 annually, based on experience level.

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements. Top Secret clearance is required. Candidates holding an active Secret clearance are encouraged to apply, and LightFeather sponsors an upgrade to Top Secret for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

• Stand up and configure a new ServiceNow environment within a secure federal enclave, establishing the instance architecture, baseline configurations, and administration standards

• Install, configure, and maintain MID Servers and establish secure connectivity within the environment

• Configure authentication, authorization, and access management (LDAP/Active Directory, SSO/SAML, role-based access controls)

• Harden the platform in accordance with federal security and operational standards, including NIST and FISMA requirements and applicable DISA STIGs, and support Assessment and Authorization (ATO) activities

• Establish and maintain platform administration baselines, including system properties, plugin activation, instance security settings, and upgrade and patch management processes

• Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise systems using REST/SOAP web services and IntegrationHub, as permitted within the environment

• Support ongoing implementation and optimization of platform modules, including ITSM and CMDB, in collaboration with the broader team

• Maintain update sets, environment documentation, build procedures, and technical design records

• Utilize an Agile/Scrum methodology to manage platform and development work

• Participate in client calls and technical discussions, coordinating with security, infrastructure, and program stakeholders to resolve dependencies and design gaps early

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, and engineering on the ServiceNow platform

• Demonstrated experience standing up new ServiceNow instances or leading instance-level builds and migrations

• Strong scripting ability (server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes)

• Experience with MID Server installation and configuration, and with platform integrations using REST/SOAP web services

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks (NIST, FISMA, STIGs)

• Experience working on project teams that leverage Agile/Scrum

• Demonstrable ability to communicate and listen well with business and technical people, regardless of title, with good self-awareness

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in federal or defense contracting environments, particularly in classified, air-gapped, or otherwise isolated networks.

• ServiceNow CAD (Certified Application Developer) or a CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist) certification.

• Hands-on experience with CMDB, ITOM, or Discovery.

• Experience with release coordination, version control, environment management, and automated testing strategies, including the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).

• Experience supporting Windows Server implementation, upgrades, and integrations as required by the environment.

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description:
CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

CentralReach is seeking a motivated, customer-focused IT Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This role is part of a collaborative team responsible for providing exceptional technical support to employees, managing corporate technology systems, and continuously improving IT operations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded IT professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, supporting employees, and working with modern cloud-based technologies. This position combines hands-on employee support with endpoint management, identity and access administration, SaaS application support, security, and IT process improvements.

As an IT Engineer, you will work closely with fellow IT Engineers to ensure employees have reliable, secure, and efficient access to the tools and technology they need to succeed. You will share responsibility for daily IT operations while contributing to projects that enhance the organization's technology environment and employee experience.

Key Accountabilities:

Employee Technical Support

• Provide timely, professional, and effective L2/L3 technical support to employees (onsite & remote) across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, and enterprise applications.

• Collaborate with fellow IT Engineers to manage and resolve incoming support requests, incidents, and service tickets.

• Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, authentication, and application-related issues.

• Participate in employee onboarding, offboarding, and internal transfers, including equipment preparation, account provisioning, and access management.

• Take ownership of assigned technical issues from initial investigation through resolution, escalating or collaborating when appropriate.

• Maintain clear communication with employees regarding issue status, troubleshooting steps, and resolution.

• Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal IT documentation.

Endpoint & Device Management

• Administer and maintain Windows and macOS endpoints using management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Iru, or equivalent solutions.

• Configure, deploy, and troubleshoot corporate laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices.

• Support automated device provisioning, application deployment, operating system updates, and patch management.

• Monitor and maintain endpoint security, compliance, and configuration standards.

• Assist with hardware inventory, asset tracking, procurement, and device lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with the IT team to improve device deployment processes and endpoint management practices.

Identity, Access & SaaS Administration

• Administer and support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and other enterprise SaaS applications.

• Manage user accounts, security groups, permissions, licenses, and application access.

• Support Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity lifecycle management.

• Troubleshoot authentication, application access, and user provisioning issues.

• Assist with SaaS application configuration, integrations, and administration.

• Ensure access management processes follow established security policies and least-privilege principles.

IT Operations & Security

• Collaborate with fellow IT Engineers to maintain the reliability, security, and availability of corporate IT services.

• Implement and maintain IT security controls, including endpoint protection, device encryption, patching, and access management.

• Partner with Legal, Security and other internal teams to address vulnerabilities, security concerns, and compliance requirements.

• Assist with IT audits, security reviews, and evidence collection for applicable compliance frameworks.

• Maintain accurate documentation of IT systems, configurations, procedures, and operational processes.

• Coordinate with external vendors and service providers to troubleshoot issues and support IT services.

Automation, Projects & Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve IT workflows, reduce repetitive tasks, and enhance the employee technology experience.

• Collaborate on IT projects, application deployments, system improvements, and technology initiatives.

• Help streamline onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and device management processes.

• Recommend improvements to existing tools, procedures, and support practices.

• Share technical knowledge and best practices with fellow IT Engineers to improve overall team effectiveness.

Desired Skills and Experience:

• 3–5 years of professional experience in IT support, IT engineering, systems administration, or a related technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting experience with Windows and macOS operating systems.

• Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, or similar enterprise identity platforms.

• Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Iru, or equivalent solutions.

• Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications, SSO, MFA, and identity and access management.

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and wireless connectivity.

• Experience supporting employees in remote, hybrid, or distributed work environments.

• Familiarity with IT ticketing systems, incident management processes, and Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical issues.

• Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively within a small IT team and share responsibility for daily operations.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize support requests and project assignments.

• Willingness to learn new technologies, share knowledge, and contribute to continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Familiarity with scripting and automation using PowerShell or equivalent.

• Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, NIST, HIPAA or ISO 27001.

• Experience administering email protection platforms such as Proofpoint.

• Experience with IT asset management, patch management, hardware procurement, and device lifecycle management.

• Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft 365, or other security-related certifications.

What Success Looks Like:

• Employees receive timely, knowledgeable, and professional IT support.

• Support tickets and technical issues are resolved efficiently with clear communication and accountability.

• Corporate devices and applications remain secure, reliable, and properly managed.

jobs.title: Director, Measurement & Attribution
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (United States), NY metro preferred; requires ability to work east coast hours

About Consumer Edge

Consumer Edge is redefining consumer and healthcare data analytics for the world’s leading investment firms and global brands. We deliver privacy-compliant, real-time intelligence on consumer spending across markets, helping clients make faster, smarter decisions with confidence. Our merchant-level benchmarks and differentiated datasets provide a true edge.

About the role

We’re hiring a Director, Measurement & Attribution to be the senior measurement leader for our media business. You will own how we measure the sales impact of campaigns, using closed-loop attribution on card, bank or SKU-level transaction data. You will build our incrementality measurement methodology and set the standards brands and agencies trust. You will work closely with the Director, Audience Solutions and Activation, so that campaign results feed back into better audiences.

What you’ll do

• Own sales measurement. Own closed-loop sales attribution and sales lift measurement on card, bank or SKU-level transaction data, and improve its coverage, rigor and speed of delivery. Define the offering: sales attribution, new-to-brand, and reach and frequency.

• Build incrementality measurement. Design and launch incremental sales lift measurement with clear confidence standards, and quantify campaign impact across digital, CTV, social, retail media and other channels, including purchases that happen outside the platform where the ad ran.

• Productize client reporting. Turn campaign results into a standard set of client deliverables, from post-campaign reports to benchmarks that show how CE audiences stack up against alternatives. Build templates and norms that hold up as campaign volume grows, so every client gets the same quality of answer.

• Be our senior measurement voice with clients. Present results to CPG, agency and retailer leaders and turn findings into actionable recommendations on audience selection, media allocation, channel mix, campaign frequency and future test design. Set realistic expectations, run feasibility reviews before we commit, and flag setup gaps early so we never over-promise. Support pitches, proposals and proof points that help win new business and grow client relationships.

• Set the standard and own the roadmap. Set the measurement standards brands and agencies trust, define requirements for privacy-safe exposure-to-purchase matching, and prioritize new methodologies and client-ready offerings.

• Build with Product and Engineering. Work with Product and Engineering, and with partners and platforms (for example DSPs, clean rooms and retailers), to turn exposure data into a repeatable, automated measurement pipeline.

• Lead and develop the team. Partner with and develop a senior data analyst as the key analyst on the measurement team, and grow the team as the business scales.

• Automate for scale. Use AI to automate routine analysis, QA and reporting so measurement delivery stays fast as campaign volume grows.

What you’ll bring

• 10+ years in advertising measurement and analytics, including experience in retail media, commerce media or purchase-based measurement

• Experience developing and commercializing measurement solutions that demonstrate advertising effectiveness and support client acquisition, retention and growth

• Hands-on experience with closed-loop sales attribution and sales lift measurement using card, bank, SKU-level or comparable purchase transaction data

• Deep expertise in incrementality and causal inference

• Strong understanding of the advertising ecosystem, including DSPs, retail media networks, programmatic advertising, clean rooms and campaign exposure data, and experience integrating measurement with partners and platforms

• Strong SQL and Python (or R); you can build and check models yourself

• Credibility with senior CPG, agency and retailer clients, and the ability to explain complex results simply and set realistic expectations

• Sound judgment about what a measurement design can and cannot prove

• Experience leading or developing analysts

• Comfort using AI tools as an everyday part of your work

• A well-formed point of view on measurement best practices, and the conviction to defend it with clients and internally

Nice to have

• Familiarity with IAB and MRC retail media measurement guidelines, and experience setting up an MRC-accredited or audited measurement process

• Familiarity with marketing mix modeling (MMM) and how it fits alongside closed-loop measurement

• Background at a CPG purchase-data company, a retail media network, or a measurement provider

Why Consumer Edge

At Consumer Edge, you’ll join a high-performance team at the forefront of data-driven decision-making for the world’s leading investors and brands. You’ll be building measurement for a media business that’s still early, using transaction data that most measurement teams don’t have access to. The methodology and the standards are yours to shape.

We offer competitive compensation, company equity, 401(k) matching, work-from-home flexibility, and subsidized health benefits.

Compensation and Benefits

The annual base salary for this role is $170,000 - $200,000, depending on experience, with the opportunity for a performance-based bonus, company equity, 401(k) matching, paid parental leave, flexible and generous time off, work-from-home flexibility, and subsidized health benefits.

jobs.title: Principal Statistical Programmer Consultant – Oncology (Solid Tumors)-Remote
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….

ClinChoice is searching for a Principal Statistical Programmer Consultant to join one of our clients.

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO with a strong focus on quality, professional development, and supportive culture. As a client-facing role, we are looking for confident candidates with the ability to work independently whilst establishing a high-trust environment with the client’s counterparts.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Principal Statistical Programmer to provide programming expertise and leadership in support of clinical development programs, primarily focused on solid tumor oncology studies.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in clinical trial statistical programming, strong SAS programming skills, and in-depth knowledge of oncology endpoints, CDISC standards, and regulatory submission requirements. This individual will contribute to the development and execution of clinical programming deliverables across Phase I–III clinical trials.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and oversee statistical programming activities for oncology clinical trials, with a primary focus on solid tumor indications.

• Develop, validate, and maintain SDTM and ADaM datasets in compliance with CDISC standards.

• Program and review complex TFLs (Tables, Figures, and Listings) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions.

• Support oncology efficacy and safety analyses, including Overall Survival (OS), Progression-Free Survival (PFS), Objective Response Rate (ORR), Duration of Response (DoR), and Disease Control Rate (DCR).

• Demonstrate expertise in Kaplan-Meier analysis, Cox proportional hazards models, and other time-to-event analyses.

• Work closely with biostatisticians, data management, clinical teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely and high-quality deliverables.

• Provide technical leadership, programming oversight, and mentorship to junior and senior statistical programmers.

• Review programming specifications, analysis datasets, and statistical outputs for accuracy and consistency.

• Support regulatory submissions and respond to health authority requests, as needed.

• Identify opportunities to improve programming standards, processes, and efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in clinical statistical programming within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong hands-on experience with SAS programming, including SAS Base, SAS Macro, and SAS/STAT.

• Significant experience supporting solid tumor oncology clinical trials, preferably across Phase I, II, and III studies.

• Strong knowledge of oncology efficacy endpoints, including OS, PFS, ORR, and DoR.

• Expertise in CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards.

• Experience developing and validating complex TFLs for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions.

• Knowledge of ICH-GCP and regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

• Excellent communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with immuno-oncology and targeted cancer therapies.

• Exposure to clinical trials involving head and neck, lung, colorectal, breast, or other solid tumor indications.

• Experience with FDA or EMA regulatory submissions.

• Prior experience providing technical leadership and mentoring statistical programming teams.

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.  Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.

Who will you be working for?

About ClinChoice

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our Company Ethos

Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization helps customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products and platform.

The GTM Strategy & Planning team sits within Revenue Operations and works at the intersection of GTM Leadership, Strategic Finance, and the broader business. We shape how OpenAI invests, organizes, and scales its revenue organization, translating company ambitions into actionable growth strategies, financial targets, capacity plans, and investment decisions.

Our work spans OpenAI’s global GTM organization, including Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and emerging businesses. We partner closely with senior leadership to ensure our resources support the highest-impact opportunities as the business grows.

About the role

We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic operator to help shape OpenAI’s GTM growth strategy and operating plan.

In this role, you’ll tackle some of the most important questions facing our revenue organization: Where should we invest to accelerate growth? How should we allocate resources across markets, segments, and customer motions? What level of productivity can we expect as we scale? How do we translate ambitious financial goals into executable plans?

You’ll own planning and analytical workstreams spanning revenue targets, investment strategy, capacity and productivity modeling, and GTM organizational design. Working closely with Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, and cross-functional partners, you’ll develop rigorous, data-backed recommendations that inform executive decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with strategic judgment, thrives in ambiguity, and can move between detailed modeling and executive-level decision-making.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with GTM Leadership and Strategic Finance to translate company financial objectives into growth strategies, resource allocation decisions, and operating plans across regions, segments, and functions.

 - Build headcount, capacity, and productivity models to inform where and how OpenAI invests across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM functions.

 - Develop regional, segment, and team-level revenue targets, translating company financial goals into executable plans with clear accountability.

 - Build scenario analyses to evaluate how hiring, productivity, product launches, partner distribution, and other growth levers affect revenue performance and investment requirements.

 - Develop data-driven recommendations on segmentation, coverage models, organizational structure, and resource allocation to support growth and operational efficiency.

 - Lead annual and midyear planning cycles, aligning Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, Field Operations, Data Science, and other stakeholders around a cohesive operating plan.

 - Analyze revenue attainment, capacity, productivity, and other key performance indicators to surface risks, challenge assumptions, and inform strategic decisions.

 - Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership, balancing analytical rigor with business judgment and a company-wide perspective.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, management consulting, or a similarly analytical and strategic role.

 - Have exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience building complex models that inform strategic, financial, and operational decisions.

 - Understand GTM strategy, revenue planning, capacity models, and the drivers of growth and productivity in high-growth technology businesses.

 - Have experience with SaaS, consumption-based, or usage-based business models and understand how different GTM motions influence revenue growth.

 - Have led complex, cross-functional initiatives, navigated ambiguity, and aligned senior stakeholders with competing priorities.

 - Bring strong strategic judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, translating complex analyses into executive narratives that influence leadership decisions.

 - Demonstrate ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

You may also bring:

 - Experience in AI, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or other technical product businesses.

jobs.title: Multi-State ABA Operations Manager
jobs.description:
MULTI-STATE ABA OPERATIONS MANAGER




ABOUT US

Finni Health is a rapidly growing healthcare technology company transforming the way ABA practices are built, operated, and scaled. We partner with independent ABA practice owners to help them build thriving, sustainable businesses while delivering exceptional care to the families they serve.

We've grown 400% and are approaching profitability, with the backing of General Catalyst and Y Combinator. As we continue expanding our footprint, we're looking for experienced ABA operators who understand what it takes to build and scale successful practices across multiple states.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Multi-State ABA Operations Manager, you'll work directly with independent ABA practice owners across multiple states, helping them build, operate, and grow successful, sustainable practices. You'll serve as a trusted operational and strategic partner, developing a deep understanding of each practice's business, identifying opportunities to improve performance, and helping owners navigate the operational, financial, and strategic challenges of running an ABA practice.

This is a highly collaborative, provider-facing role that combines hands-on healthcare operations, business strategy, and relationship management. You'll support a diverse portfolio of practices across different states, bringing an understanding of the operational considerations, payer environments, regulatory requirements, and market dynamics that can vary by location.

You'll work alongside practice owners to improve financial and operational performance, solve complex business challenges, and identify opportunities for sustainable growth. You'll also collaborate closely with Finni's internal teams to address provider needs, improve operational processes, and ensure our partners have the resources and infrastructure to run successful practices.

The ideal candidate has firsthand experience operating or supporting ABA practices across multiple states and understands that successful practice operations require more than a one-size-fits-all approach. You're comfortable building trusted relationships with independent practice owners, analyzing business performance, navigating state-specific operational complexities, and translating challenges into practical solutions.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Multi-State ABA Operations Experience

 - 5+ years of experience in ABA or behavioral health, with significant experience operating, managing, or supporting ABA practices.

 - Experience supporting practices, clinics, or healthcare operations across multiple states is strongly preferred.

 - Familiarity with state-specific ABA regulations, payer requirements, Medicaid programs, credentialing processes, and reimbursement environments is highly valued.

 - Strong understanding of the operational realities of running an ABA practice, including clinical operations, staffing, utilization, scheduling, patient growth, retention, compliance, RCM, payer relationships, and reimbursement.

 - Experience partnering directly with BCBAs, clinical leaders, practice owners, or other healthcare providers.

 - Understanding of the relationship between clinical quality, provider capacity, operational performance, and financial outcomes.

Business & Financial Acumen

 - Strong understanding of the financial drivers of an ABA practice and what it takes to build a healthy, sustainable business.

 - Comfortable analyzing financial statements, budgets, revenue, expenses, staffing costs, utilization, margins, and other key business drivers.

 - Experience owning or contributing to the financial performance, P&L, or budget of a practice, multiple practices, or a region preferred.

 - Ability to translate financial and operational data into clear, actionable recommendations.

 - Understanding of how payer mix, reimbursement, patient volume, staffing, utilization, and retention impact practice profitability.

Operational Execution & Growth

 - Proven ability to identify operational challenges, determine root causes, and develop practical solutions.

 - Experience supporting new practice launches, entering new markets, and preparing operations for sustainable growth.

 - Experience developing or optimizing staffing models, operational workflows, and accountability structures.

 - Strong understanding of operational KPIs and how to use data to improve practice performance.

 - Experience setting and managing performance targets related to growth, retention, utilization, patient access, provider productivity, and profitability.

 - Comfortable balancing immediate operational needs with longer-term growth and expansion priorities.

Strategic Problem Solving

 - Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to navigate complex, ambiguous problems.

 - Able to look beyond immediate challenges to identify underlying operational and business drivers.

 - Comfortable developing actionable growth plans and working alongside stakeholders to execute them.

 - Experience building operational processes, systems, and infrastructure in growing or evolving organizations.

 - Highly resourceful, adaptable, and willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

Provider Partnership & Communication

 - Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.

 - Ability to build trust with independent practice owners and become a credible thought partner on operational, financial, and business decisions.

 - Comfortable influencing and collaborating with providers without direct authority.

 - Able to communicate complex operational and financial concepts clearly and make recommendations without being overly prescriptive.

 - Genuine interest in helping independent healthcare business owners build successful practices.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Partner With ABA Practice Owners

 - Build strong, trusted relationships with independent ABA practice owners across multiple states.

 - Develop a deep understanding of each practice's business model, goals, operational challenges, financial performance, and growth opportunities.

 - Act as a strategic thought partner on operational, financial, and expansion decisions.

 - Proactively identify opportunities to improve practice performance and address challenges before they become larger issues.

 - Translate provider goals into actionable business and operational plans, working alongside owners to execute them.

Drive Multi-State Practice Growth & Expansion

 - Support the launch of new ABA practices and expansion into additional states and markets.

 - Help providers navigate the operational requirements and complexities of establishing and scaling practices across different states.

 - Identify potential roadblocks to expansion and coordinate with internal Finni teams to resolve them.

 - Develop scalable operational approaches that allow practices to grow sustainably across multiple locations and markets.

 - Continue supporting providers throughout the lifecycle of their partnership with Finni, beyond the initial launch.

Improve Practice Performance

 - Analyze practice-level financial and operational performance to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and profitability.

 - Partner with providers on strategies to improve patient volume, provider utilization, staffing, retention, revenue, and margins.

 - Develop and track KPIs that provide visibility into practice health and progress.

 - Create regular business reviews and presentation decks that communicate performance, opportunities, and recommended actions.

 - Help providers understand the financial and operational implications of key business decisions.

Drive Operational Excellence

 - Identify recurring operational challenges and work cross-functionally to develop scalable solutions.

 - Improve workflows, processes, tools, and systems that make it easier for providers to operate and grow their practices.

 - Use data to identify trends, diagnose issues, and measure the impact of operational improvements.

 - Help establish clear SLAs, KPIs, and accountability structures across the provider experience.

 - Identify opportunities to improve how Finni supports practices as they expand across markets.

Work Cross-Functionally

 - Collaborate closely with Finni teams across RCM, credentialing, product, operations, and leadership.

 - Serve as the bridge between provider needs and internal teams, ensuring operational challenges are understood and addressed.

 - Help prioritize and resolve issues requiring cross-functional coordination.

 - Partner with Finni leadership on strategic initiatives that improve the provider experience and strengthen our operating model.

Build a Best-in-Class Provider Experience

 - Become an expert on Finni's products, services, and operating model.

 - Ensure providers have the information, resources, and support they need to operate successful practices.

 - Help improve provider-facing resources, training, documentation, and self-service tools.

 - Identify opportunities to make the provider experience more proactive, scalable, and effective.


BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation

 - 401(k)

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexible work schedule

 - Paid time off

 - Paid holidays

 - Opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the growth of a rapidly scaling healthcare company

 - Work directly with ABA practice owners and Finni leadership to shape the future of the provider experience

• Experience building Service Catalog items, workflows, and integrations
