jobs.title: Agentic Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Gradial is building the AI-native system of work for enterprise marketing. Our agents turn ideas into live campaigns by executing across the tools, teams, and workflows enterprises already use—from content authoring and campaign assembly to quality assurance and brand compliance. We give marketers and creatives more time to shape brands, understand customers, and create work that moves people.

We’re tackling some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building agent harnesses, sandboxed execution environments, and orchestration that enable agents to plan, act, and verify their work reliably at enterprise scale. We’re growing rapidly, winning Fortune 500 and enterprise customers including AWS, T-Mobile, and Prudential. Our $65 million Series C led by Insight Partners is accelerating that momentum.

Join us to help define how people and AI agents work together. We move with urgency, reason from first principles, and take ownership from idea to customer impact. You’ll shape the product, own consequential problems, and build systems that some of the world’s leading brands depend on every day.

The Role

Gradial is looking for an Agentic Transformation Manager to help some of the world's largest enterprises rethink how marketing work gets done in the age of AI agents. You'll lead strategic customer engagements that move beyond deploying technology to fundamentally redesigning workflows, operating models and how organizations measure value.

You'll own transformation engagements across two strategic enterprise customers, working closely with Account Directors, Forward Deployed Product Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers. While those teams own the ongoing customer relationship and technical delivery, you'll focus on how people, processes and AI agents come together to create meaningful business outcomes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between executive conversations, collaborative workshops, detailed process design and financial modeling. You'll work directly with customer teams to understand how they operate today, design how they should operate tomorrow and build the business case to make that transformation real.

This role is based in our Seattle HQ, with up to 30% travel for customer engagements and workshops.

What You'll Own

• Lead enterprise transformation engagements across two strategic customers, owning discovery, operating model design, value measurement and executive recommendations from start to finish.

• Redesign how marketing organizations operate by identifying opportunities for AI agents to take on work, eliminate manual handoffs and fundamentally improve how teams execute.

• Facilitate collaborative workshops with executives, functional leaders and practitioners to map existing processes, challenge assumptions and co-design future-state workflows.

• Define new operating models that clarify how people and AI agents work together, including responsibilities, decision rights, governance and processes.

• Build financial models and business cases that quantify the impact of transformation through reduced cycle times, improved productivity, automation rates and measurable cost savings.

• Establish clear success metrics and baselines that connect customer transformation initiatives to tangible business outcomes and support ongoing measurement of realized value.

• Present transformation strategies and value assessments to senior customer stakeholders, translating complex operational changes into clear recommendations and investment decisions.

• Partner with Account Directors and delivery teams to align transformation roadmaps with customer priorities, commercial commitments and technical implementation plans.

• Lead discovery and transformation workshops for prospective customers alongside Sales and Solutions Engineering, helping enterprise buyers understand the operational and financial opportunity of agentic AI.

• Develop repeatable methodologies and frameworks that improve how Gradial delivers transformation engagements and scales successful approaches across enterprise customers.

What We Need

• 7+ years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, operating model design or related disciplines, with a track record of leading complex enterprise engagements.

• Demonstrated experience redesigning business processes and operating models, turning ambiguous operational challenges into practical, implementable solutions.

• Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to build credible business cases, quantify ROI and communicate financial impact to executive stakeholders.

• Experience leading stakeholder interviews, collaborative workshops and cross-functional working sessions to build alignment and drive meaningful organizational change.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge established ways of working and present compelling recommendations.

• Ability to translate strategic objectives into detailed process flows, governance structures, implementation roadmaps and measurable success criteria.

• Experience working alongside commercial, customer success, product or technical delivery teams in complex enterprise environments.

• A hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the judgment to move between high-level strategy and detailed execution without relying on large project teams.

• Curiosity about AI and its potential to fundamentally reshape enterprise operations, with the ability to think beyond incremental automation toward new ways of working.

• Willingness to work in person from our Seattle HQ and travel up to 30% for customer engagements.

Nice to Have

• Experience in marketing operations, digital transformation, content supply chains or enterprise marketing technology environments.

• Familiarity with platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Sitecore, Salesforce, Contentful or Workfront.

• Experience applying human-centered design, journey mapping or participatory design methodologies to enterprise transformation initiatives.

What we offer

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Meaningful equity awards

• Medical, dental & vision (fully covered for employees with 75% for dependents)

• Fertility & family-planning support

• 401k plan

• Unlimited PTO

• A beautiful Seattle office with a gym, sauna, and bike parking

• Free lunch three days a week in our HQ

• A front-row seat to building category-defining AI infrastructure

You'll thrive here if you

• Learn quickly, actively seek out new challenges, and regularly reconsider “how it’s always been done.”

• Want to have real impact with zero bureaucracy.

• Have an innate drive for being 1% better than the day before, building towards greatness.

• Embrace AI as a core tool for problem-solving, innovation, and scale.

• Show customer-obsession (internal or external), high ownership/accountability, and bias for action.

• Communicate clearly, directly, with curiosity, and assuming good intentions.

• Thrive in fast-paced, hyper-growth environments where building better > maintaining status quo.

AI Literacy & Interviewing Tools

As an AI-first company, we prioritize AI literacy as a core competency in our hiring decisions. We’re excited by candidates who thoughtfully apply AI tools in their work, but during interviews we’re focused on you. This is your opportunity to show how you think, communicate, and solve problems. Over-reliance on AI-generated responses during the interview process (especially when it obscures your own voice) will result in disqualification. We want to understand your unique perspective and how you approach challenges, both with and without AI.

Gradial is dedicated to creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and all team members can grow. We offer competitive compensation, equity, flexible work hours, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative culture focused on learning and impact.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Business Analyst
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead the requirements gathering and process design for our federal agency clients. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between federal business stakeholders and our technical development teams. You will be responsible for translating complex mission requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions, ensuring compliance with federal standards, and maintaining the highest quality of data in our backlog.. This is a Full Time, Remote Position.

• Location: Fully Remote (EST hours)

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $110,000–$130,000 annually, based on experience

• Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance

Responsibilities

• Lead client workshops and focus groups to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with agency mission goals.

• Translate high-level business needs into comprehensive user stories, acceptance criteria (AC), and functional specifications within Agile/Scrum frameworks.

• Conduct gap analysis to identify the delta between current legacy processes and ServiceNow "Out of the Box" (OOTB) functionality.

• Collaborate directly with the Agile Coach to design, document, and distribute new Agile processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that support all ServiceNow delivery teams. Ensure these processes drive consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the broader program.

• Review all user stories and requirements for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity. Ensure every story meets the team's "Definition of Ready" before it is approved for sprint planning.

• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers and junior analysts. Help them understand business context, federal domain constraints, and ServiceNow best practices to foster their professional growth.

• Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain high standards of quality control across the delivery team.

• Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and data models to visualize end-to-end service delivery.

• Advise government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices, steering them away from excessive customization that creates technical debt.

• Collaborate with System Architects to ensure functional designs are technically feasible.

• Ensure all solution designs adhere to federal IT standards, including Section 508 compliance (accessibility) and FISMA/NIST security controls.

• Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, creating test scripts and coordinating testing sessions with government personnel.

• Create federal-grade deliverables, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), User Guides, and Training Decks.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

• U.S. Citizenship

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level security clearance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years dedicated to the ServiceNow platform.

• Proven experience working in the federal contracting space (DoD, DHS, or Civilian agencies).

• Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

• Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and at least one other major workflow (e.g., ITOM, HRSD, SPM, ITAM, Custom Applications).

• Strong experience with Jira, ServiceNow Agile, or Azure DevOps for backlog management.

• Proficiency in Visio, LucidChart, or similar tools for process mapping.

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - REQUIRED

Preferred:

• ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher).

• Project Management Professional (PMP) or Agile certifications (CSM, SAFe PO/PM).

Why Join LightFeather?
At LightFeather, you're not just taking a job—you're joining a purpose-driven team that delivers innovative, mission-critical solutions to make a real difference. You'll work on diverse, meaningful projects that challenge and inspire you, alongside some of the best minds in the industry.

LightFeather is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here. We're looking for a relationship-driven, proactive Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Sourcer to help build and strengthen our talent pipelines.

This role goes beyond filling open positions. You'll partner closely with hiring managers to understand their teams, business priorities, and talent needs, while proactively identifying and engaging exceptional talent for current and future opportunities.

You'll play an important role in developing a forward-looking recruiting strategy, building meaningful candidate relationships, and ensuring our recruiters and hiring teams have access to strong talent when opportunities arise.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain qualified talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs

• Proactively source, identify, and engage talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels

• Develop strong relationships with hiring managers and gain a deep understanding of their teams, roles, technical requirements, and business priorities

• Partner with hiring managers to translate talent needs into effective sourcing strategies

• Conduct talent mapping and market research to identify relevant talent pools and competitive insights

• Build relationships with prospective candidates and maintain engagement beyond immediate openings

• Partner with recruiters to deliver qualified, well-aligned candidates for active searches

• Maintain accurate candidate information, sourcing activity, and pipeline data in our ATS

• Share regular updates on pipeline health, market insights, and sourcing progress

What You'll Bring

• 3+ years of recruiting or talent sourcing experience

• Demonstrated success building proactive talent pipelines, particularly for specialized or hard-to-fill roles

• Strong experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and applicant tracking systems

• Ability to quickly understand technical roles, team structures, and hiring priorities

• Strong relationship-building and hiring manager partnership skills

• Excellent communication and candidate engagement abilities

• Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing competing priorities

• A curious, resourceful, and collaborative approach to recruiting

What Makes You Successful

You're someone who enjoys connecting people, understanding businesses, and finding talent others might overlook. You don't just source against a job description; you take the time to understand the teams you're supporting and become a trusted partner to the hiring managers and recruiters you work with.

You're proactive, thoughtful, and relationship-oriented, with a passion for building talent pipelines that create a lasting impact.

This is a part-time opportunity with the ability to make a meaningful contribution to our growing Talent Acquisition team.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst, Private Credit
jobs.description:
A Career with Point72's Risk and Quantitative Research (RQR) Team

The RQR team plays a vital role in the firm’s investment process, building a deeply rooted culture of efficient risk management and factful performance attribution. Quantitative risk analysts perform research to identify opportunities for improved risk management, investment behavior, and portfolio construction, with the goal of helping the firm deliver superior risk-adjusted performance. The paramount mission of the team is to protect the firm from improper levels of exposure and ensure that risk-taking is always efficient and deliberate.

What you'll do

• Analyze private credit portfolios to identify key drivers of risk, return, concentration, liquidity, and downside exposure

• Partner with investment teams to review private credit transactions, including deal structure, borrower fundamentals, covenants, downside risks, and key diligence findings

• Evaluate borrower fundamentals, capital structures, covenants, and deal terms to assess potential vulnerabilities across private credit investments

• Monitor the private credit portfolio, including performance, exposures, concentrations, risk limits, and emerging company or sector-level issues

• Ensure accurate tracking of portfolio activity, key terms, risk metrics, and performance trends

• Prepare weekly and ad hoc reporting for senior risk management, business leadership, and the broader firm management team

• Provide clear, practical risk commentary on portfolio performance, investment activity, and notable developments across the private credit book

• Produce concise risk reporting that translates complex analytics into actionable observations for investment professionals and senior stakeholders

• Partner with risk managers to monitor limits, investigate emerging exposures, and escalate material changes in portfolio risk profiles

• Conduct research on credit market trends, portfolio behavior, and risk measurement techniques to strengthen the team’s analytical capabilities

• Collaborate with technologists to improve data quality, automate recurring analysis, and strengthen risk infrastructure for private credit portfolios

What's required

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, or another related discipline

• 1-2 years of experience in quantitative research, trading, portfolio analytics, or risk management focused on credit markets

• Strong understanding of private credit instruments and how they behave across changing markets and borrower-specific conditions

• Strong corporate credit analysis skills, including evaluating financial statements, borrower fundamentals, leverage, and repayment capacity

• Strong understanding of capital structures, covenants, and how deal terms influence risk outcomes in private credit portfolios

• Experience with portfolio-level risk measurement, including concentration, sensitivity, scenario, and downside risk analysis

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to investment professionals, risk managers, technologists, and senior stakeholders

• Demonstrated attention to detail, accountability, and ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to work full time in New York

• Commitment to the highest ethical standards

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer, SEO/AEO and Experimentation
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview:

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor's website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You'll join Cresta's Growth Marketing team, reporting to Devan Tremblay, Head of SEO, and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel, not a content calendar. Our priorities are clear: win the comparison and evaluation queries buyers use to build their shortlists, build authority in our core industries (financial services, travel and hospitality, telecom and home services, and insurance), and turn AEO into a measurable new source of pipeline.

Youwill own day-to-day execution of Cresta's Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta's organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

• Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.

• Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.

• Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.

• Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.

• Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.

• Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.

• Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.

• Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

• Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.

• Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

• Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.

• Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.

• Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.

• Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.

• First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.

• First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

• 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.

• A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.

• Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.

• Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.

• Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.

• Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.

• Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.

• A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

• In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.

• Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.

• Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.

• Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.

• SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.

• Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.

• Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

jobs.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
LightFeather is seeking a skilled Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support the U.S. Department of State in modernizing and maintaining secure, scalable cloud environments. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize OCI solutions while ensuring compliance with federal security requirements. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise across OCI compute, networking, storage, databases, security, and automation, with the ability to support mission-critical federal systems. This is a Full-Time, Hybrid Position requiring four days onsite and one remote day per week.

• Location: Hybrid, On-site 4 days/week in Washington, D.C. 20036 and 1 day Telework

• Job Type: Full-time

• Salary: $160,000–$180,000 annually, based on experience level.

• Clearance Requirement: Candidates must possess an active Secret clearance and be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, and manage Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services, including compute, networking, storage, and database solutions.

• Configure and maintain Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs), subnets, gateways, and load balancers supporting mission-critical applications.

• Implement cloud security best practices aligned with federal compliance frameworks, including NIST, FISMA, and FedRAMP.

• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scripts using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.

• Monitor system performance, optimize cloud costs, and ensure high availability across OCI environments.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex OCI-related issues, providing escalation support when needed.

• Collaborate with security, development, and operations teams on cloud migrations and enterprise modernization initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• Active Secret clearance with eligibility to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5+ years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, including at least two years of experience working specifically with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

• Strong knowledge of OCI compute, storage, Identity and Access Management (IAM), networking, and database services.

• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform and Ansible.

• Experience with cloud security, compliance, and monitoring solutions.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to support mission-critical federal systems.

• Familiarity with Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE) and Docker.

Preferred Qualifications

• Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect certification or related OCI certifications.

• Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud environments integrating OCI with on-premises systems.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automation frameworks.

• Hands-on experience supporting the Department of State or other federal civilian agencies.

jobs.title: Lead Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced compensation professional to help build and manage SimplePractice’s compensation programs across job architecture, market pricing, salary ranges, and annual compensation planning for our US and Mexico teams.

This is a hands-on role on a small team, with the opportunity to shape how we work and accelerate our capabilities through AI. You’ll partner closely with the Senior Director, lead projects, advise business leaders on compensation decisions, and pioneer the adoption of AI tooling to automate and enhance our Total Rewards operations. Some work will involve improving established processes; other projects will require you to navigate incomplete or conflicting information, apply sound judgment, and recommend a path forward.

Responsibilities

Job Architecture and Market Pricing

• Lead job architecture reviews with business leaders, evaluating role responsibilities, recommending job families and levels, selecting market matches, and documenting decisions.

• Price jobs using Aon/Radford and other compensation surveys, assess market competitiveness, and communicate recommendations, including where judgment is required.

• Develop and maintain salary ranges for the US and Mexico, analyzing geographic differences, internal equity and employee pay, and modeling the cost of proposed changes.

Annual Compensation and Programs

• Lead key components of annual merit, promotion, and bonus planning, from preparing employee data and guidelines through testing, manager support, and final validation.

• Partner with Finance, People Technology, and Payroll to reconcile budgets, validate calculations, and ensure approved compensation changes are implemented accurately.

• Advise People and Culture partners, Talent Acquisition, and managers on offers, promotions, job changes, and pay adjustments, including requests outside established guidelines.

• Support incentive, recognition, and long-term compensation projects in partnership with the Senior Director and Finance.

Systems, Data, AI, and Process Improvement

• Partner with People Technology to define requirements, test system changes, and investigate discrepancies in job and compensation data to improve Workday reporting.

• Design, develop, and deploy internal AI tooling and automated workflows to accelerate job matching, survey submissions, and complex compensation data analysis.

• Manage compensation survey submissions and maintain accurate market matches, documentation, and supporting records.

• Develop tools, AI-assisted resources, and manager guidance that promote consistent pay decisions. Improve recurring processes through better templates, data hygiene, and applied automation.

• Manage projects from start to finish, preparing materials for review, tracking decisions, coordinating follow-through, and raising issues early.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Typically six or more years of compensation experience, including ownership of complex analyses and projects.

• Experience evaluating jobs, pricing roles, developing salary ranges, and managing annual compensation planning.

• Sound judgment when job descriptions, market data, or stakeholder feedback present conflicting information or no obvious answer.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including data reconciliation, financial modeling, and rigorous validation of calculations.

• Applied experience with, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools (e.g., LLMs, internal AI agents) to improve workflows, automate data processing, or generate insights.

• Experience partnering directly with business leaders, asking thoughtful questions, challenging assumptions, and explaining recommendations clearly.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and follow through on commitments.

• Strong attention to detail and discretion in handling confidential information.

• A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points

• Experience with Aon/Radford surveys and job architecture in a software or technology company.

• Experience contributing to AI transformation initiatives or developing custom AI tooling for HR/Total Rewards.

• Experience with Workday compensation planning, reporting, and testing.

• Experience supporting international compensation, particularly in Mexico.

• Experience building or improving compensation programs on a small team.

• Familiarity with incentive plans, private-company equity, or cash-based long-term incentives.

• Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) certification or progress toward certification.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), wellbeing days, paid holidays, and summer Fridays

• Mental health resources

• Paid parental leave & Backup Care

• Tuition reimbursement

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

California Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Thank you for your interest in opportunities at SimplePractice LLC (“SimplePractice” or “us” or “we” or “our”). Please note that when you submit your resume or application materials to us for employment purposes, you are subject to the SimplePractice California Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

For more information about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@simplepractice.com.

Notice to Candidates

SimplePractice has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team. We do not have any affiliation or connection to these situations and only post open roles on our official Careers page (simplepractice.com/careers) and reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages.

All official SimplePractice recruitment emails will be sent from the domains @simplepractice.com, no-reply@greenhouse.io or no‑reply@linkedin.com email addresses.

Examples of fraudulent domains include careers-simplepractice.com, simplepractices.com, and simplepractice.careers.

Please note that SimplePractice will never ask candidates or new hires for money or payment of any kind at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process.

Base salary is one component of total compensation. Employees may also be eligible for an annual bonus or commission. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay.

The amount below represents the expected annual base compensation range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider many factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

$120,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Project/Program Manager
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and the innovation we drive

• Our values of share, care and dare

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Senior Project / Program Manager, Client Engagement, you will lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from planning through delivery. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical projects and multi-stream programs, bringing together business, product, engineering, IT, data, vendors, and implementation partners to ensure teams remain aligned and focused on outcomes.

You will also support portfolio management across the Client Engagement domain, providing leadership with a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, capacity, and business value. Working within an Agile delivery environment, you will combine strong project governance with the flexibility needed to support Scrum teams and scaled Agile practices.

This role requires a proactive leader who is comfortable taking ownership, navigating technical conversations, anticipating risks, and communicating clearly with senior stakeholders. You do not need to be a developer, but you should understand how modern software platforms are built, integrated, released, and operated.

Role responsibilities

• Own complex, business-critical projects and programs from initiation through completion, defining scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, resourcing, and success criteria.

• Lead multi-stream programs involving several teams and workstreams, managing sequencing, dependencies, integration points, and delivery timelines.

• Proactively drive initiatives forward, remove blockers, follow up with stakeholders, and ensure teams remain aligned around priorities and decisions.

• Identify and manage risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies, establishing clear ownership and escalating issues appropriately.

• Coordinate across business, product, engineering, IT, data, vendors, and system integrators.

• Work effectively within Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, Agile at Scale, and PI Planning, while maintaining appropriate project governance.

• Maintain a consolidated view of the Client Engagement portfolio, including project status, priorities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and value delivered.

• Prepare and facilitate portfolio reviews with domain leadership and provide clear executive-level reporting on progress, decisions, risks, and escalations.

• Partner effectively with Agile Coaches while maintaining clear accountability for project and program management.

• Apply established PMO methodologies, playbooks, and best practices across projects and programs.

• Develop and improve project and portfolio management tools, templates, dashboards, reporting, and governance artifacts.

• Contribute lessons learned and best practices to the broader project management community.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

• 8+ years of project and program management experience, including significant experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in technology-driven environments.

• Proven ability to take end-to-end ownership of large projects and multi-stream programs and drive them through successful delivery.

• Strong technical understanding of how software is developed, integrated, tested, released, and operated, with the ability to follow technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and anticipate delivery risks.

• Experience delivering initiatives involving CRM platforms, particularly Salesforce, including familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem and configuration versus customization considerations.

• Experience working with mobile applications, ideally business-critical or internally distributed applications.

• Working knowledge of REST APIs, middleware, system integrations, SaaS platforms, data flows, and dependency management.

• Understanding of software development practices including SDLC, backlog management, environments, CI/CD, testing, QA, and production releases.

• Practical experience working within Agile environments, including Scrum, SAFe or comparable scaled frameworks, and PI Planning.

• Experience with Jira, Confluence, or comparable project, portfolio, reporting, and collaboration tools.

• Experience managing risks, issues, dependencies, governance, and executive-level reporting.

• Previous exposure to portfolio management, including portfolio tracking and leadership reviews.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business implications for senior stakeholders.

• Excellent organizational skills, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through influence across teams without direct reporting relationships.

• Full professional fluency in English.

Nice to have qualifications

• Previous experience within retail, luxury, or consumer brands

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The benefits

This is a FTE osition based in NEW YORK / USA . The offered salary range is 130K annually and up  depending on experience and location.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.title: Senior Curriculum Engineer
jobs.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

MinIO is looking for a hands-on technologist who likes building things and explaining how they work. You don't need a curriculum background; we'll teach you that. You will'll turn AIStor, across objects, tables, files, and agent memory, into labs, videos, and self-paced courses for a wide range of technical audiences: data engineers, developers building agents, AI infrastructure engineers accelerating performance with MemKV, storage administrators, and the partner and internal solution architects who support them. Most of your teaching will be recorded, with live sessions about once a month.

This role has real variety. On any given week, you might be building a hands-on lab, standing up an agent memory demo, recording a training video, turning engineering documentation into a teachable module for partners, or adapting a core course for a specific customer deployment. You enjoy that variety. You're as comfortable in front of a camera as you are at a command line.

You will collaborate closely with engineering and product marketing. You welcome the freedom and opportunity of being part of a startup and have the self-discipline to identify needs and get things done without waiting to be asked. You will be encouraged to help shape the strategy that the MinIO team executes.

Experience in a solutions architect or other customer-facing technical role is a strong plus — it helps you understand how customers deploy and operate storage in production and how to make training land in that context. Experience with competitive software-defined storage platforms is also a plus. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain courses for AIStor administrators and operators, covering installation, configuration, management, and troubleshooting, and keep them current as the product changes

• Build curriculum for AIStor Memory and agentic AI use cases, turning orchestration and memory concepts (context assembly, agent state, retrieval) into practical, hands-on training

• Turn engineering documentation and demos into training modules for partners

• Adapt core courses for specific customer deployments and industries

• Build hands-on lab environments with Terraform, Ansible, and Docker, and test them end to end before release

• Write course content as code: Markdown in git and GitHub, with branches and pull request review

• Record and edit short demo and training videos for MinIO Academy, YouTube, and LinkedIn

• Deliver live and recorded training sessions for internal teams and partners

• Use approved AI tools such as Claude Code to speed up authoring, testing, and review

Your Skills and Experience

• Working proficiency in Linux

• Demonstrated ability to turn engineering material (documentation, specs, demos) into teachable content

• 5+ years in a solutions architect or equivalent customer-facing technical role

• 3+ years of experience with software-defined storage, cloud storage, or Kubernetes; hands-on experience with MinIO or competitive platforms (Vast, Cloudian, Weka) is a plus

• 1+ years of experience with agentic AI infrastructure (e.g., agent memory/orchestration platforms such as LangChain/LangGraph, Mem0, Letta, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Memory Bank) or memory/vector infrastructure (Pinecone, Weaviate, Redis)

• Experience teaching live and on camera

• Comfort with Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Python, and related tooling

• 1+ years building and maintaining workflows in git and GitHub

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code

• Previous experience with curriculum development or formal training delivery

What We Offer

• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

• 401K with 3% Contribution

• Pre-IPO Stock Options

• At least 12 Public Holidays

• Flexible Time Off

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Web Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US



At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.






ABOUT THE ROLE

LangChain's web presence is both a product and a growth engine. Developers visit our site to evaluate our tools, learn what we build, and decide whether to go deeper. We're looking for a Web Lead to own the strategy, quality, and evolution of LangChain's web properties across marketing, product, and education.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thinks in systems and cares about craft. You'll set the strategic direction for how LangChain presents itself on the web, establishing the processes that keep the site accurate and high-performing, leading conversion and SEO initiatives, and partnering closely with content, design, growth engineering, and demand gen to bring it all together.

What You'll Do

Web Ownership

 - Lead the web roadmap. Maintain a clear, prioritized view of what needs to be built, fixed, or improved across LangChain's web properties, balancing strategic initiatives with ongoing maintenance, quality, and reliability. Translate business priorities into web plans and drive them to completion.

 - Coordinate cross-functional web work. Serve as the central point of contact for web across marketing, education, product marketing, design, and growth engineering. Run the intake, review, and launch process so teams can ship web changes with speed and confidence.

 - Own the site's structural health. Establish and enforce processes for keeping the site accurate, up-to-date, and free of technical debt. This includes governance for page creation and deprecation, content hygiene, and cross-functional intake so nothing slips through the cracks.

 - Manage the CMS and tooling stack. Own the relationship with our CMS and web tooling vendors. Ensure the right systems are in place for the team to operate efficiently, and evaluate new tools as the site's needs evolve.

Conversion & Performance

 - Own conversion rate optimization. Develop and execute a CRO program across key pages, including homepage, product pages, pricing, and landing pages. Design and run experiments, analyze results, and translate findings into durable improvements to the site's ability to drive signups, product adoption, and pipeline.

 - Define and track web performance metrics. Establish the reporting framework for how we measure web effectiveness across traffic, engagement, conversion, and downstream impact on product metrics. Own a regular reporting cadence that gives stakeholders a clear view of what's working and where to invest.

 - Partner with demand gen on landing pages. Work closely with marketing to design, build, and optimize campaign landing pages that convert. Bring a disciplined, test-and-learn mindset to paid and organic landing page performance.

SEO

 - Build the bridge between SEO and content. jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

BasePowerCompany.com http://BasePowerCompany.com is one of our most important tools. It's where homeowners learn about Base, decide whether they trust us, and ultimately become members.

We're looking for a Web Designer to own and evolve that experience. You'll design and build web experiences that look great, communicate clearly, and drive growth. You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing, and Engineering while bringing your own point of view on how the site should look, feel, and perform.

We're a small team that moves quickly. You don't need to be a traditional frontend engineer, but you should be comfortable using AI-assisted tools to independently turn ideas into live experiences.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and ongoing evolution of basepowercompany.com http://basepowercompany.com, from landing pages and product launches to improvements across the existing site.

 - Design and build web experiences that balance exceptional visual craft, clear storytelling, and conversion.

 - Use AI-assisted development tools to independently implement designs, prototype ideas, and ship improvements.

 - Maintain and evolve our web design system, creating reusable components that help us move faster without sacrificing quality.

 - Work with Growth and Marketing to shape content, test ideas, and iterate based on performance and user feedback.

 - Ensure a high-quality experience across devices, considering accessibility, SEO, and performance.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in web or digital design, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft.

 - Strong fundamentals in typography, layout, interaction, and responsive design, with an understanding of how design influences usability and conversion.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to turn designs into working experiences. You don't need to write everything from scratch, but you should be able to build and ship independently.

 - Experience working with design systems and creating reusable components.

 - Strong proficiency in Figma, good writing instincts, and a willingness to learn new tools.

 - A high degree of ownership and resourcefulness. You can take an idea from concept to launch without constant direction.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth team is responsible for turning interest in Base into action. basepowercompany.com http://basepowercompany.com is our most important acquisition surface, the place where a homeowner decides whether to trust us with their power. Our challenges are concrete: we’re explaining a new category of product in a market full of noise, and every word and interaction on the site either earns that trust or loses it. The decisions you make here will show up directly in sign-ups, cost-per-acquisition, and the quality of members we bring on.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Job Role: Principal Architect
Location: United States (Remote/Hybrid, client-facing travel as needed)
Experience: 11+ years minimum, 8+ years in Solution/Technical Architecture
Role Summary:
The Principal Architect is the senior-most technical authority and executive-facing owner of the overall solution architecture for the account. This is a client-facing, decision-making role accountable for technical credibility with the client's executive and engineering leadership, and for the integrity of the architecture across every workstream. Delivery on this account uses an agent-orchestrated development model — the Principal Architect is expected to direct AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) directly for spikes and validation, not only delegate to human engineers. The final technology stack is not yet finalized (it may or may not end up being Python + React), so this role is intentionally technology-agnostic rather than tied to a specific platform.
Key Responsibilities:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the account, ensuring alignment with business goals and enterprise architecture standards, independent of whichever technology stack is ultimately selected.
Define and defend the target-state architecture and roadmap directly to client executive stakeholders and governance/Change Board forums.
Drive technical design decisions across application architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security, reliability).
Set coding standards, design patterns, and technology choices across workstreams once the stack is confirmed, and keep design options open and unbiased until that decision is made.
Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs) before implementation begins; hold final sign-off authority on architecture decisions and technical design changes, including authority to block releases that violate architectural standards.
Evaluate and integrate new tools, frameworks, and AI/agentic development capabilities into the delivery model.
Direct and prompt AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) directly for architecture-level proofs of concept, technical spikes, and feasibility validation.
Partner with the Tech Product Manager and Delivery Lead to align architecture with delivery timelines and prioritization.
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to the India-based Principal Architect and Solution Architect, ensuring one coherent architecture across delivery locations.
Escalate cross-cutting architectural risks and represent the account technically to the client's engineering leadership.
Required Qualifications
11+ years in enterprise technology roles with 8+ years owning solution architecture on client-facing, multi-workstream programs.
Proven experience as the client-facing architecture owner, comfortable defending design decisions to VP/C-level stakeholders and formal governance bodies.
Deep, current fluency in modern application architecture, API/integration design, cloud infrastructure, and non-functional requirements — technology-agnostic, with the ability to architect confidently on whichever stack is ultimately chosen.
Hands-on experience directing or prompting AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or an equivalent agentic development tool) as part of an agent-orchestrated delivery model — required, as this engagement is delivered using AI-assisted development.
Track record of resolving ambiguous, evolving requirements into a defensible, phased architecture.
Good To Have
Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF) or a cloud/platform architect certification relevant to the eventual stack.
Experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare distribution or another regulated industry.
Prior experience architecting within an AI-agent-orchestrated or "generative" development delivery model.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Digital Merchandising Site Experience Strategy & Discoverability
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

About the Role

At Zoro, our competitive advantage is how we help customers discover what they need—and what they didn’t know they needed.

As the Sr. Manager of Site Experience Strategy & Discoverability, you will lead a team responsible for defining and scaling the merchandising capabilities that power product discovery across the site. You will own the Digital Merchandising roadmaps for discovery (homepage, Collections), search, navigation, filtering, product relationships, and personalization—identifying the customer and business opportunities that matter most and defining the merchandising capabilities needed to address them.

This is a highly strategic leadership role focused on identifying the frameworks and capabilities that elevate the customer journey. You will partner closely with Product and Marketing teams to vet, sequence, and integrate Digital Merchandising priorities into roadmaps. While your team defines the customer problems, strategic priorities, and merchandising use cases, you will work with Product and other partners to determine the right solutions, technical approach, and delivery plans.

What You’ll Do

• Set the strategic direction for the Digital Merchandising Site Experience Strategy & Discoverability team, spanning search, navigation, filtering, product relationships, personalization, homepage, and other sitewide merchandising experiences.

• Own the Digital Merchandising roadmap across these focus areas, prioritizing the highest-impact customer and business opportunities and balancing near-term improvements with foundational capabilities.

• Build alignment with Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional leaders to vet, sequence, and integrate Digital Merchandising priorities into shared roadmaps and delivery plans.

• Ensure Digital Merchandising is engaged early in Product discovery—clearly defining customer problems, desired outcomes, and merchandising use cases before solutions are scoped.

• Lead, coach, and develop the team members who own the day-to-day strategy, analysis, and execution within their respective focus areas.

• Establish and maintain scalable frameworks, standards, and defaults that improve how customers search, navigate, evaluate, and discover products across the site.

• Use customer insight, performance data, and experimentation to refine priorities, measure impact, and continuously improve the experience.

• Partner with Digital Merchandising Category Experience Strategy, Data Science, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to connect merchandising strategy to broader customer and business priorities.

What You Bring

• 7–10+ years of experience in ecommerce strategy, digital merchandising, product strategy, or related roles

• Proven experience building and leading high-performing teams

• Strong experience designing and scaling sitewide customer experiences and supporting processes

• Experience developing strategic roadmaps and prioritizing complex work across customer, business, and technical needs.

• Deep understanding of search, navigation, filtering, product relationships, and personalization in ecommerce

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a focus on measurable business impact

• Experience in B2B or large-catalog ecommerce environments is a plus

• Familiarity with AI/ML applications in ecommerce (search, recommendations, personalization)

• Excellent communication and leadership skills

Total Rewards

Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment

• Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program

• 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing

• At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year

• 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required

• Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools

• Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations

• Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. jobs.title: Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) | Supervision Provided
jobs.description:
BOARD CERTIFIED ASSISTANT BEHAVIOR ANALYST (BCABA) | BCBA SUPERVISION PROVIDED | SUMMERVILLE, SC



Location: Summerville, SC | Primarily in person, with up to 25% remote flexibility for eligible activities

Job Type: Part-time, with opportunities to grow your caseload

Employment Options: W-2 Employee or 1099 Independent Contractor




GROW YOUR CLINICAL CAREER WITH THE SUPPORT BUILT IN

Are you a BCaBA who wants meaningful clinical work without having to find and pay for your own supervision?

At Tellos ABA Therapy, we believe great outcomes for kids start with providers who feel supported, mentored, and set up to grow.

We're looking for BCaBAs in the Summerville, South Carolina area who want to develop their clinical skills, work closely with an experienced BCBA, and build a caseload that fits their professional goals.




HOW IT WORKS

You deliver high-quality ABA services in person, primarily in clients' homes, with some services in school and community settings.

We provide the qualified BCBA supervision you need to maintain your certification, along with an operations team that handles the administrative work behind the scenes.




YOU FOCUS ON:

 - Delivering quality care and building strong relationships with families.

 - Supporting assessments and individualized treatment planning under the guidance of your supervising BCBA.

 - Supervising and supporting RBTs on your cases, depending on caseload and applicable requirements.

 - Growing your clinical skills through ongoing mentorship and collaboration.




WE HANDLE:

 - BCBA Supervision: Tellos provides a qualified, South Carolina-based BCBA supervisor at no cost to you to meet your ongoing BACB supervision requirements.

 - The Paperwork: Credentialing, authorizations, billing, and claims submissions.

 - Client Acquisition: We manage referrals and intake and connect you with local families seeking services.

 - RBT Staffing: We handle sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and payroll for RBTs supporting your cases.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Assessments: Conduct and assist with functional behavior assessments (FBAs) and skill-based assessments under the direction and oversight of your supervising BCBA.

 - Treatment Planning: Develop, implement, and support individualized, evidence-based treatment plans and behavior intervention plans (BIPs) in collaboration with your supervising BCBA.

 - Data-Based Decision Making: Collect and analyze data, monitor client progress, and recommend or implement program adjustments within your authorized scope and under BCBA supervision.

 - RBT Support: Provide supervision, training, and feedback to RBTs to support treatment fidelity, depending on caseload and applicable supervision requirements.

 - Caregiver Partnership: Provide parent and caregiver training to help families reinforce skills across home and community settings.

 - Documentation: Complete accurate and timely session notes, progress reports, and clinical documentation that meet medical necessity and payer requirements.

 - Supervision & Ethics: Participate in regular supervision meetings, observations, and clinical collaboration while practicing in accordance with the BACB Ethics Code for Behavior Analysts.




WHY JOIN TELLOS?

BCBA Supervision Included

No searching for a supervisor or paying out of pocket. We match you with a qualified, South Carolina-based BCBA who provides in-person supervision and ongoing clinical guidance.

Flexible Employment Options

We offer both W-2 employment and 1099 independent contractor opportunities, depending on the position and applicable requirements.

Start part-time and explore opportunities to grow your caseload as additional clients become available.

Eligible clinical and administrative activities may be completed remotely, with up to 25% remote flexibility depending on payer, supervision, and client needs.

Less Administrative Work

Our operations team handles credentialing, authorizations, billing, claims, and administrative coordination so you can spend more time focusing on clinical care.

A Path Toward BCBA Certification

Interested in becoming a BCBA? We support BCaBAs who are continuing their education and working toward the next step in their clinical careers.

We're not tied to specific graduate programs, and we welcome clinicians pursuing their education through different universities.

Support for BCBA certification fieldwork can be discussed based on your individual goals and supervision arrangements.

Professional Development

We invest in your continued growth through:

 - CEU stipends.

 - Certification assistance.

 - Ongoing BCBA mentorship and clinical collaboration.

 - Opportunities to expand your clinical experience and responsibilities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Active Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) certification in good standing with the BACB.

 - Bachelor's degree or higher, with BACB-approved behavior analytic coursework.

 - Ability to meet applicable South Carolina practice and payer requirements.

 - Based in or near Summerville, SC, with availability to provide in-person services.

 - At least 2 years of ABA experience.

 - Experience implementing individualized ABA treatment plans and working collaboratively with supervising BCBAs.

 - Strong clinical judgment, communication, and organizational skills.

 - Reliable transportation for travel between client locations.

 - Comfortable using digital data collection, clinical documentation, and telehealth tools.

 - Bilingual English/Spanish or proficiency in another language is a plus, but not required.




READY TO GROW WITH US?

Joining Tellos is straightforward.

Step 1: Connect with our team to discuss your experience, professional goals, and preferred employment arrangement.

Step 2: We guide you through credentialing and connect you with a qualified supervising BCBA.

Step 3: We introduce you to available families and help coordinate your clinical team.

Step 4: Begin providing services once all applicable onboarding and payer requirements are met, with ongoing support behind you.

Whether you're looking to develop your clinical skills, pursue BCBA certification, or build a larger caseload over time, we'd love to learn more about your goals.

Apply today and grow your ABA career with a team that has your back.

We believe in hiring people, not resumes. If you’re excited by Tellos’s mission but unsure if you meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply, we’d love to learn what you’d bring to the team.
