jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role:

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to join a small, high-leverage marketing team as a true generalist. You'll run product launches end-to-end, own positioning and messaging for parts of our product suite, and support the rest of the PMM engine — sales enablement, competitive intelligence, customer proof, website copy, and campaigns.

AssemblyAI ships fast: new models, new products, and new capabilities land every quarter, and each one needs a story, a launch, and the enablement to sell it. You'll partner closely with product, research, sales, growth, and brand to make sure every release lands with the right buyers — developers and product teams building voice agents, medical scribes, AI note takers, and customer-call intelligence.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the copy, build the deck, ship the landing page, and run the launch yourself, using modern AI tools to move at the pace the market demands.

What You’ll Do:

Product Launches

• Run product and model launches end-to-end using our launch playbook — landing pages, announcement blog, email, social, Product Hunt, in-product modules, and handoffs to paid and influencer partners

• Own the launch plan: timeline, tiering, stakeholder alignment, asset production, and the internal and external communications that go with it

• Align on success metrics with product and marketing leads before each launch, then report honestly on what worked and what didn't

• Build evergreen campaigns that keep shipped products growing between launches — refreshing assets, retargeting stalled signups, and cultivating verticals long after launch day

Positioning & Messaging

• Own positioning and messaging for assigned products across our suite — speech-to-text, streaming, text-to-speech, and new product lines as they ship

• Translate technical capabilities (accuracy, latency, model improvements) into positioning that ties to business outcomes for developers and enterprise buyers

• Develop strategic narratives for our top use cases — voice agents, medical scribes and dictation, AI note takers, and customer calls — including the buyers, competitors, and market dynamics in each

• Keep the website accurate and consistent as the product and positioning evolve — product pages, solution pages, and landing pages — owning narrative and copy while partnering with brand and web on build and publish

Sales Enablement

• Build and maintain the core enablement library: pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, FAQs, demo scripts, and objection handling

• Run enablement sessions for sales and CS on new launches, positioning changes, and competitive updates

• Gather feedback from reps on what's landing and what's missing, and close the loop with product and marketing

Competitive Intelligence

• Track competitor moves — model releases, pricing changes, positioning, and campaigns — and keep internal teams informed

• Maintain competitive benchmarks, battlecards, and comparison pages, and turn competitive shifts into messaging and campaign responses

• Partner with research and product on benchmark claims so our comparisons are accurate, defensible, and current

Customer Marketing

• Source and produce customer proof points — case studies, quotes, logos, and video — from identifying the customer to shipping the asset

• Partner with growth and CS on expansion and upsell campaigns

• Feed customer insight back into positioning: what buyers actually say, why they chose us, and where they struggle

Growth & Market Insight

• Collaborate with lifecycle, demand gen, and paid partners on campaigns — email nurtures, onboarding flows, audience building, and targeting based on signup behavior

• Spot emerging use cases and verticals from customer feedback, signup trends, and market signals — and flag where we should lean in next

What You’ll Need:

• 3–5 years in B2B product marketing, ideally with experience owning launches and positioning at a developer-focused, API-first, or AI company. We value non-traditional paths (former sales engineers, content or growth backgrounds) as much as classic PMM résumés.

• Proven experience running product launches end-to-end — you've owned the plan, the assets, the cross-functional coordination, and the results

• Ability to translate technical capabilities into positioning that ties to business outcomes for developers and enterprise buyers

• Experience building enablement materials sales actually uses, and a point of view on how to tell whether it's working

• Strong writing: you can produce clear, specific copy for a landing page, a launch email, a battlecard, and an exec deck — and know how each should differ

• A hands-on builder: comfortable shipping website edits, landing pages, and emails yourself with modern AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor) rather than only briefing others

• Comfort with ambiguity and speed — our campaigns ship in weeks, not quarters, and priorities shift as the market does

• Excellent cross-functional project management and communication skills

• Fluent with AI and LLMs in your daily workflow — you use them to move faster on research, drafting, analysis, and iteration, and have a stance on where they help vs. where they get in the way

• Deeply curious about Voice AI and excited to market infrastructure that helps developers build the next generation of voice-powered products

Nice to Have:

• Experience in AI/ML, speech, conversation intelligence, or voice tech

• Background marketing to developers and product teams

• Experience running competitive intelligence programs or maintaining benchmarks

• Experience with growth or activation metrics — you've owned a number, not just a content calendar

• Familiarity with developer tooling ecosystems and modern GTM strategies

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level, qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

The provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range which will be communicated to candidates throughout the interview process.

Salary range: $130,000 - $160,000

Using AI in your interview
If you’re selected for an interview, please read our Candidate AI Guidance. It explains how you can use AI at each stage of our process, from your application and take-home to the interviews themselves.

GDPR privacy notice

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role:

We're hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to run paid programs aimed at our target accounts. That means account-based marketing through paid channels, for new logos and for existing customers we want to expand. Target-account programs are the core of this job, but you will own the entire paid budget line-item and decide how to divide it.

AssemblyAI sells Voice AI APIs to engineering teams: Pre-recorded and Realtime Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech with instant voice cloning, LLM Gateway, Speech Understanding, and the Dictation API, with more launches on the way. Our buyers pick an API on features and benchmarks, so we primarily market specific products with concrete proof. Your job is to get that proof in front of the right engineers at the accounts our sales team most wants to win, and to show what it produced in those accounts.

Day to day, you'll build cross-platform retargeting for target accounts. You'll use paid to boost our account-based programs: direct mail, Vibe, webinars and launches. You'll own geo-targeted paid for our events and field activations, and test new channels and formats quickly. You'll work with Sales, Revenue Operations and Events on ABM. You'll also run the paid side of our expansion work with the marketer who owns cross-sell and lifecycle programs.

You'll also own the full paid budget and our conversion channels: Google Ads, paid social, YouTube and others. Google search needs to keep running well, and you'll need real hands-on skill to do that. But keeping it healthy is the foundation of this job, not the center of it. Your closest partners are Product Marketing on launches, Brand Studio on creative, and our analytics team on measurement.

Why This Role Exists:

Paid is one of our largest marketing investments, and we want to ensure that investment is working on the accounts we most want to win. That means getting engineers at those accounts to see our launches, attend our webinars and events, and hear one story alongside Sales.

Retargeting, LinkedIn, Vibe, connected TV, direct mail and event promotion are account channels. They're measured on reach and new engagement inside our target accounts, and judging them on cost per click gets them wrong. Search and some paid social are conversion channels, measured on cost per activation, and they still need an owner who keeps them efficient. This role leans firmly toward account channels.

We've run tests and understand generally what works: geo-targeted around recent in-person events and field activations have brought registrations from target accounts that had never engaged with us. We want someone to turn these tests into a repeatable program they own.

In Your First 90 Days

Here's where we expect your time to go:

• Cross-platform retargeting: retargeting is live across LinkedIn, Meta, Vibe and display, so engineers at target accounts who visit the site, read the docs or watch a launch video keep seeing relevant proof

• A geo-targeted event playbook: you've run geo-targeted paid for at least two events or activations and written the playbook (audiences, timing, creative, budget and how registrations from target accounts are tracked), so anyone on the team can run it again

• Paid behind ABM programs: our direct mail, Vibe, webinar and launch programs each have paid support aimed at target accounts, planned with Sales so each account hears one story

• Quick channel tests: you're testing new channels and formats every week and making clear calls on what to scale or cut

• Google Ads in good shape, not in focus: you've audited the account, fixed what matters, and set it up to run without taking over your week

If your instinct for your first 90 days is a deep restructure of our Google campaigns, this probably isn't the right role.

What You’ll Do:

Cross-Platform Retargeting to Target Accounts

• Build and run retargeting across LinkedIn, Meta, Vibe, YouTube, display and connected TV for engineers at target accounts who have visited the site, read the docs, watched a launch video or attended an event

• Build person- and company-level audiences from Salesforce and enrichment tools like Clay. Tailor the message by buying committee (engineering leaders, ML and voice engineers, product owners) and by account tier

• Keep target accounts out of mass campaigns where Sales owns the first touch

Paid Amplification for ABM Programs

• Own paid ABM for target accounts, both new logos and existing customers we want to expand. This is the core of the role

• Put paid behind our account-based programs: direct mail (run with Sales and BDRs), Vibe audiences, webinar promotion and launch promotion. Each account should hear one story across paid, events, mail and outbound

• Track account-level signals such as ad engagement, site visits, docs activity, sign-ups and API usage, and get warm accounts to the right AE or BDR quickly

Events & Geo-Targeting

• Own geo-targeted paid for our in-person events and field activations, aimed at people at target accounts who haven't engaged with us yet

• Turn our early wins into a repeatable playbook covering audiences, radius and timing, creative, budget, registration tracking and follow-up with Sales

• Report each event's results by account: who registered, who attended, and which accounts were new to us

Channel Experimentation

• Run experiments every week across LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, connected TV, Meta, X and emerging channels such as AI assistant and agent ad placements

• Take the creative we already have (launch videos, customer stories, benchmark charts, lo-fi creator-style clips) and find where each one performs

• Write and test many ad variations quickly, and tell Brand Studio and content creators what to make next based on what works

• Decide what to scale, what to cut, and when a channel has had a fair test, and say why

• Set and pace the monthly budget across channels and report spend against plan

Google Ads & Paid Search

• Own our Google Ads account: brand and non-brand search, YouTube, and Performance Max where it fits, and keep it running efficiently without letting it take over your week

• Structure campaigns by product line, with feature-led copy that names the product and the proof (benchmarks, latency, language coverage, price), and optimize toward API activation, not clicks or sign-ups alone

• Test how much brand search we need to buy, and move savings into programs that reach target accounts

• Keep conversion tracking accurate with our data team, including offline conversions sent from our warehouse

Measurement & AI-Native Workflow

• Own one view of paid and ABM performance, led by account-level results: new engagement in target accounts, event and webinar registrations from those accounts, and pipeline in the target list. Also track spend and cost per activation by channel, campaign and product

• Work with analytics to build that view in Looker and our warehouse so anyone on the team can see it

• Write a short weekly update: results against goals, what's working, what isn't, and what changes next

• Report on the pipeline and revenue your programs source and influence

• Use AI tools and agents for the work that slows paid teams down, such as ad copy variations, audience builds, search-term reviews, budget pacing, anomaly alerts, and reporting, and share the automations you build with the team

What You’ll Need:

• 4+ years in B2B paid acquisition or demand generation, personally managing six-figure monthly budgets

• A track record in both ABM and conversion marketing. That includes LinkedIn and connected TV awareness programs that measurably moved engagement or pipeline in a named target account list. You've also optimized search and paid social to cost per acquisition, but conversion optimization alone isn't the profile we're after

• Experience running account-based programs on paid channels: cross-platform retargeting, ABM platforms, and paid support for direct mail

• Experience using paid to drive attendance at events, webinars and launches, including geo-targeted campaigns aimed at specific accounts

• Deep, hands-on Google Ads skills: account structure, bidding strategies, conversion setup and search-term management. We treat this as foundational: you'll need it, but it isn't the main job

• Experience at a startup or on a fast-paced, scrappy team where you built campaigns yourself rather than managing an agency

• Experience testing new paid channels and formats, and making clear calls to scale or cut backed by data

• Experience marketing technical, developer-facing products. You can learn an API product quickly and write ads an engineer would click

• Comfort with conversion tracking, attribution and audience syncing (Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, a CDP such as RudderStack or Segment, and enrichment tools such as Clay)

• Data fluency: you can pull and analyze your own numbers with SQL, Looker or similar tools

• Strong copywriting and a sharp eye for creative that performs

• Comfortable with AI-assisted bidding (Smart Bidding, Performance Max, predictive audiences) and AI-enabled workflows. You use AI tools to work faster and smarter, not as a crutch

Nice to Have:

• Experience at a usage-based, API, or developer-focused company

• Experience in AI/ML, voice, speech, or infrastructure products

• Experience with CTV platforms, Reddit Ads, YouTube, or other emerging B2B channels

• Experience with intent data and ABM platforms (Vibe, 6sense, Demandbase, or similar)

• Experience running direct mail programs for target accounts (Sendoso, Reachdesk, or similar)

• Experience running ads for product launches at a high-growth startup with a fast release cadence

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide.

jobs.title: Director - Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Director, Software Engineering

Position Summary

The Director of Software Engineering is responsible for leading multiple software engineering teams in the design, development, delivery, and ongoing evolution of scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise software solutions.

This role combines people leadership, technical depth, Agile execution, and strategic thinking. The Director will lead and develop engineering managers and software engineers while partnering closely with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, Security, and business leaders to translate business priorities into effective technical solutions.

The ideal candidate has experience leading engineering organizations in an Agile/Scrum environment and a strong understanding of modern cloud-based application and data architectures. Experience leading teams that develop solutions utilizing Snowflake, cloud technologies, APIs, data integration, and modern software engineering practices is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Strategy

• Lead, develop, and mentor engineering managers, technical leads, and software engineers across multiple teams.

• Establish and execute engineering strategies that align technology investments with product and business objectives.

• Provide technical leadership across complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and technology domains.

• Maintain sufficient technical depth to effectively participate in architecture, application design, data architecture, security, scalability, and engineering discussions.

• Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Data Engineering, Security, and business stakeholders to define technical priorities and delivery roadmaps.

• Drive technical decision-making while balancing scalability, maintainability, performance, security, cost, and speed to market.

• Establish meaningful engineering metrics and use them to improve delivery predictability, software quality, team effectiveness, and operational performance.

Agile Software Development

• Lead engineering teams operating within an Agile/Scrum product development environment.

• Promote effective Agile practices, including sprint planning, refinement, estimation, daily collaboration, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.

• Partner with Product leaders and Product Owners to maintain alignment between product priorities, technical requirements, engineering capacity, and delivery commitments.

• Create accountability around commitments and the definition of done while encouraging teams to continuously improve development practices.

• Identify and remove organizational or technical barriers that impact engineering velocity and delivery.

• Use Agile and engineering metrics to identify trends, improve predictability, and support data-driven decision-making.

Software Architecture & Development

• Provide technical oversight for the design and development of scalable enterprise and SaaS applications.

• Champion modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, source control, CI/CD, observability, DevOps, and secure software development.

• Partner with architects and senior engineers to establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical best practices.

• Guide teams in addressing technical debt and balancing short-term product needs with long-term platform sustainability.

• Ensure solutions meet appropriate standards for availability, performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Cloud, Data & Snowflake

• Lead software engineering teams building applications and services that integrate with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms.

• Provide leadership around the integration of application, data, API, and analytics architectures.

• Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams on data accessibility, application integration, data quality, performance, and governance.

• Develop teams capable of effectively working with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Azure Data Factory, APIs, and cloud-native services.

• Understand the architectural considerations involved in building software applications that consume, process, and interact with large-scale cloud data platforms.

• Promote effective performance, security, access-control, and cost-management practices across cloud and data solutions.

People & Organizational Leadership

• Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing engineering talent.

• Build leadership capability among engineering managers, technical leads, and senior individual contributors.

• Establish clear expectations and accountability for technical quality, execution, collaboration, and professional development.

• Conduct regular performance and development discussions and create opportunities for career growth.

• Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

• Help design engineering team structures that support current business priorities while positioning the organization for future growth.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 10+ years of progressive software engineering or technology experience, including significant experience developing enterprise or SaaS applications.

• 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering managers and/or multiple software development teams.

• Demonstrated experience leading teams in an Agile/Scrum software development environment.

• Experience leading teams responsible for the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and support of production software applications.

• Experience with modern cloud-based software and data architectures.

• Experience leading teams developing applications or data solutions utilizing Snowflake.

• Strong understanding of APIs, databases, data integration, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.

• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira and Git-based source control.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical strategies and execution plans.

• Proven ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Microsoft Azure and technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, API Management, Service Bus, or Azure Data Lake.

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, and modern data engineering/data integration architectures.

• Experience leading engineering organizations within healthcare technology, healthcare revenue cycle, finance, analytics, or other highly regulated environments.

• Experience developing cloud-based SaaS products at enterprise scale.

• Understanding of healthcare security, privacy, interoperability, or compliance requirements, including HIPAA and healthcare data standards.

Research design and methodology

jobs.title: Water Strategy, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility.  Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end-to-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future.   



Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager.  

 

Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery.  

 

Role Summary

Rowan Digital Infrastructure is looking for a Manager of Water and Wastewater Infrastructure to spearhead wet utility infrastructure development across Rowan’s data center portfolio. The Infrastructure Manager will also execute Rowan’s water and wastewater sustainability initiatives consistent with Rowan’s corporate goals. This role will entail collaboratively working with multi-functional project teams to create strategies to secure wet utilities for projects, negotiate supply agreements with service providers and support the deployment of water and wastewater infrastructure through permitting and construction.

The Infrastructure Manager will be involved in other development activities as necessary including project evaluations, due diligence reviews, agency consultations, permitting, entitlements, and budgeting alongside the project teams.

The Infrastructure Manager is a critical part of the Energy and Water team, working closely with the project origination and development teams, leadership, and other internal stakeholders to ensure efficient execution of Rowan’s Development Projects. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully managing multiple projects concurrently and negotiating successful service agreements with utilities, preferably in the data center industry. The successful candidate will have excellent organizational and communication skills, strong project management skills, comfort with ambiguity, comfort with having direct conversations, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

 

Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% for company gatherings or for site visits.

Location:  Denver, CO or Seattle, WA (3-day hybrid in-office role)

Compensation: $150k-$180K (Offers Bonus)

 

Essential Responsibilities

 - Prepare and implement strategy for water assessment, commercial certainty, and compliance across a portfolio of data center projects

 - Develop customer and external-facing water narrative for Rowan to support sustainability and high-quality digital infrastructure goals

 - Monitor external factors that could affect water (i.e., tracking local and state water policy, water quality issues, legal rights/issues) and develop strategy and position to address risks

 - Assess water risk and delivery feasibility for portfolio of potential data center sites from site selection through construction

 - Manage external relationships with local water authorities and partners in prospective data center locations to ensure sufficient supply, rights, and to conduct necessary diligence

 - Partner with the Directors of Development and project teams to prepare for and conduct commercial negotiations and conversations to secure necessary water rights and infrastructure for all data center sites

 - Facilitate and drive communication and cross-team coordination between internal and external water stakeholders including Development, Engineering, Design, Construction, and Operations

 - Oversee compliance with water withdrawals and discharge and ensure compliance with end-user agreements (flow rate, installation of monitoring and operational equipment where required)

 - Organize, review and evaluate water and wastewater monitoring data to compare against agreements, identify anomalies, and establish best practices. · Implement Rowan’s water stewardship program in collaboration with Rowan’s Sustainability lead and project teams

 

Education, Skills, and Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in civil or environmental engineering or similar

 - 7+ years professional experience in water and wastewater infrastructure projects

 - Technical expertise related to industrial water use and wastewater discharge, water efficiency techniques, as well as water policy and permitting

 - Experience with water and wastewater infrastructure construction and operations for data centers strongly preferred

 - Preferred experience with NPDES permits, industrial pre-treatment permits, and decentralized wastewater systems

 - Experience working with water and wastewater utilities in the United States

 - Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders and consultants

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, and highly cross-functional environment

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills
   
   

Fueled by Excellence & Collaboration

At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S.



Here to support you

At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best.

 - Hybrid working environment

 - Team building and educational opportunities

 - Generous benefits package including robust health benefits and a 401(k)-company contribution

 - Unlimited PTO

 - RTD ECO pass or parking reimbursement

 - Competitive compensation, bonus, and an incentive plan

 - Relocating for this role? We offer relocation assistance on a case-by-case basis to help make your transition smooth

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Payroll Tax Manager
jobs.description:
THE POSITION
Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a Payroll Tax for our US and Canadian entities. You will play a key role on the Payroll team, with full ownership over employee/employer tax, and will collaborate with multiple departments within FanDuel including, but not limited to HR Operations, Total Rewards, Finance and Accounting. This is an exciting opportunity to help transform Payroll tax initiatives at a premier gaming company.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Major Responsibilities

• Oversight of tax compliance requirements, regulations, and confidentiality provisions for the Payroll team

• Partner with third party OSV to ensure all Federal, State, and Local payroll tax liabilities and associated regulatory tax filings are completed 100% accurate and on time

• Oversight of each quarterly tax close, as well as the annual W-2/W-2c process

• Overall maintenance and development of procedures and policies related to the payroll tax department, with understanding of their correlation to other cross-department impacts

• Oversight and collaborative relationship management with third-party payroll tax system providers to ensure long-term stability of the solution as it relates to our business

• Develop policies, processes, and procedures to ensure payroll tax compliance in a multi-state environment

• Maintain payroll data integrity in the systems by running queries, analyzing data, and creating and running various audits'

• Ensure regulatory compliance and prepare EEOC, Bureau of Labor Statistics, multi-state reporting, and other statutory compliance as required

• Stay educated on the latest laws and legislation at the local, state, and federal levels

• Partner with Legal to address employee compliance in accordance with federal, state, and local laws

• Review and analyze current payroll and tax procedures to recommend and implement changes leading to best-practice operations

• Resolve accounting and reporting discrepancies and irregularities in a timely manner related to payroll, including those within the payroll system, general ledger, or payroll-related tax reporting

• Drive the development and coaching of payroll team members and ensure team members are cross-trained within the department

• Ensure system compliance with SOX and internal controls

• Demonstrate strong customer service and problem-solving skills when addressing payroll tax questions and issues

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively at both detail and big-picture levels and drive projects forward

• Partner effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization

THE STATS
What we're looking for in our next teammate

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline plus 6+ years’ experience in the Payroll Tax field, or the equivalent of 10+ years’ experience in the Payroll Tax field. (Required)

• 6+ years’ experience with payroll taxes in at least 30+ states. (Required)

• 5+ years’ experience in payroll tax leadership. (Required)

• 5+ years’ Workday software experience. (Required)

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with an ability to communicate information clearly and effectively throughout all levels of the organization

• Demonstrated ability to work well with cross-functional groups

• Demonstrated interpersonal, collaborative, and relationship-building skills; ability to interact positively with teammates at all levels of the company

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

We treat our team right

We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, DC Buying
jobs.location: Remote in the U.S., San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the Role

As Senior Engineering Manager for DC Buying, you'll lead engineering for Afresh's AI-powered fresh buying product. Buyers at grocery distribution centers use it to decide what to buy, how much, and when. Every order a DC buyer places determines what lands in the stores it serves. Get it right and shelves stay full and less food goes to waste across the whole network.

DC Buying is live with enterprise customers and scaling fast. Your job is to make it the tool DC buyers can't work without. You'll own engineering end to end and partner with product, design, data engineering and applied science on one roadmap. You'll also work directly with customers to make sure what we build supports buyers' daily work.

We're looking for someone who has demonstrated excellence as an engineering manager, thinks beyond their own team, and wants to own the outcome, not just the delivery.

What You'll Do

Lead engineering

• Hire, develop and retain a senior team of product engineers. Set clear expectations, invest in their careers, and address performance directly and on time.

• Set the technical bar. Review architecture, push back on unnecessary complexity, and be deliberate about where we take on and pay down tech debt.

• Build strong relationships with peer engineering leaders across platform, data and AI, so DC benefits from shared tooling instead of reinventing it.

Build the roadmap

• Own the DC Buying roadmap with product, design and science leads. Balance customer asks, technical investment and business goals.

• Know the business deeply. Understand what matters to users, moves key metrics and how to delight customers.

Execute effectively

• Make clean commitments, internally and with customers, then hit them. Tell people early when something is going to slip.

• Turn broad goals into scoped plans with a sequence, a cost and a date.

• Keep leadership and partner teams aware of what's happening, and drive decisions to clarity.

• Own reliability, on-call health and data quality for a product buyers rely on every day.

Be a great example

• Build a culture where engineers and scientists own problems, not tickets. Bring them in early with customers, product and design rather than handing them a predetermined solution.

• Be creative in your problem solving.

• Build innovative product that delights DC buyers and drives massive customer impact.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We encourage all highly qualified candidates to apply, even if they don't meet every listed qualification.

• 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineering teams.

• You have experience developing, scaling and supporting mission critical products in production.

• You have strong technical range. You have experience leading across multiple functional domains (front-end, back-end, data pipelines and applied science). You have enough depth to engage, and are excited to learn.

• You use AI-native development practices day to day and want your team on the leading edge of them.

Nice to Have

• Supply chain, retail or grocery experience, especially demand forecasting, replenishment or inventory optimization.

• You've shipped forecasting, optimization or recommendation products that operators act on every day.

• You've taken a product from early design partners to production at enterprise customers.

• Familiarity with our stack: Python, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Databricks, Azure.

This position is not eligible for company sponsorship.

Salary Band in U.S. (USD): $203,745 - $275,655 + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.

• Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.

• Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.

*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. jobs.title: Customer Support Billing Specialist l
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Customer Support Billing Specialist I

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Customer Support Billing Specialist I - Bilingual in English/Spanish is required, at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO, we are open to remote if you are not local to the Columbia MO area. We’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

The primary responsibility of the Customer Support Billing Specialist I is to consistently provide exceptional service and support to EquipmentShare’s internal and external customers in a multi-channel environment. Work cross-functionally with Accounts Receivable, Collections, and Rental Operations in servicing internal and external customers as it relates to billing and payment processes and inquiries. Establish and maintain excellent working relationships with rental markets and help facilitate support requests throughout EquipmentShare. As a primary customer-facing role, the ability to provide professional, exceptional, timely and accurate service to internal and external customers is critical to the success of this position.

Primary Responsibilities

• Perform job duties in accordance with EquipmentShare’s vision, mission, and values.

• Provide excellent customer service for EquipmentShare customers with clear answers to billing and payment inquiries and appropriate referrals as needed.

• Respond to customer inquiries via telephone, chat, and email in an accurate, timely, and professional manner and within established quality and service standards.

• Show empathy towards customers, understanding their concerns, and offering them reassurance while providing assistance.

• Complete Voice of Customer (VOC) reports to capture customer concerns.

• Establish and maintain professional working relationships with internal and external customers and co-workers.

• Manage time effectively to ensure productivity levels and turnaround times are within established service standards.

• Establish and maintain adequate knowledge of EquipmentShare products, service offerings, and core systems, and respond effectively and efficiently to customer and co-worker inquiries.

• Establish and maintain an understanding of all EquipmentShare subsidiaries, guaranteeing current knowledge of their payment stipulations and designated points of contact.

• Perform administrative functions within core systems across all customer platforms (phone, email, and Intercom), including but not limited to:

• Setting up new users and profiles in ES Admin, including sending T3 Customer password re-sets.

• Update and accurately maintain customer account billing configurations, including user access rights, billing contact information, electronic billing preferences, customer billing receipt requests, and rental billing cycle parameters.

• Issue customer credit notes, invoices, and statement copies upon customer request.

• Ensure customer interactions are documented accurately and promptly for reference in ES Admin.

• Develop and maintain billing and payment systems knowledge and exhibit the ability to comprehend and communicate basic accounting and billing system practices in a manner that is easily understood by internal and external customers.

• Possess sufficient expertise regarding the various bank accounts to accurately provide and verify information to both internal and external clientele.

• Maintain familiarity with multiple remittance addresses and demonstrate the ability to appropriately direct customer inquiries.

• Ability to troubleshoot, comprehend, and fully reconcile billing and payment information to identify and resolve discrepancies.

• Proficiency in generating customized customer reports and statements beyond those automatically produced by Admin or T3 systems.

• Process customer credit card and ACH payments in the appropriate system (ES Admin, SlimCD, or Stripe) with high attention to detail to ensure accuracy, data integrity, and compliance with state and federal payment industry guidelines.

• Partner with Accounts Receivable in the creation of credit request documents and application of such as requested by the customer.

• Engage with new customers throughout the onboarding process to educate them on specific areas of doing business with EquipmentShare, such as self-service options, billing and payment features, rental agreements and contracts, and insurance requirements.

• Comprehend and articulate the rental and invoicing procedures. This encompasses the complete rental lifecycle and the methodology of invoice generation, including various billing cycle types and invoice classifications.

• Maintains the Help-Billing support channel, delivering resolutions when feasible or collaborating with relevant teams to guarantee the requestor receives a resolution.

• Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the various invoice types, including Cycle, Final, Service, Retail, Lost/Stolen/Damage, Telematics, Warranty, etc.

• Deliver customer support and training regarding the utilization of our electronic bill payment systems, specifically T3 and the Direct Pay Portal.

• Utilize diverse platform resources to verify, synthesize, and instigate invoice disputes. Convey customer grievances to branch and sales teams to collaboratively rectify disputes. Ensure dispute resolutions are communicated to the customer, encompassing follow-ups and/or credit issuances. Conclude the dispute within the system.

• Engage in communication with customers, Territory Account Managers (TAMs), and branch personnel to resolve purchase order inquiries and discrepancies that impede invoice processing and customer payment.

• Possess foundational knowledge to effectively manage and direct inquiries regarding liens and waivers. This encompasses Notice to Owner (NTO) inquiries, as well as all certified correspondence issued to clients, including Preliminary Notices of Lien Rights and Notices of Furnishing.

• Collaborate with Territory Account Managers to finalize project closure documentation, encompassing the reconciliation of orders, invoices, and payments for extensive customer accounts. These engagements frequently span multiple months and involve a substantial quantity of equipment.

• Facilitate communication between branch teams, Territory Account Managers (TAMs), and customers by addressing disputes, inquiries regarding balances, and updates to payments to support collections activities.

• Facilitate collaboration with the credit team and Territory Account Managers (TAMs) concerning correspondence pertaining to credit application inquiries, billing term inquiries and modification requests, and requests for account name alterations.

• Facilitate and properly route credit reference inquiries and requests.

• Act as a liaison between internal and external clients and the tax department to manage communications concerning tax exemption certificates, tax rate inquiries, and discrepancies.

• Facilitate and properly route Accounts Payable inquiries and invoice submissions.

• Utilize appropriate resources to ensure work is completed efficiently and within established service standards.

• Comply with EquipmentShare’s departmental and corporate policies and procedures as well as mandated state and federal laws and requirements at all times.

• Enhance construction industry, technical, and functional job knowledge through actively participating in learning and growth opportunities.

• Work collaboratively with co-workers to achieve departmental and company goals and standards.

• Provide second-level support to the Rental Operations team as necessary.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Ability to read and comprehend basic/complex communication in written or verbal sources. Bilingual in English/Spanish is required Ability to communicate effectively in English and in written or verbal form, using correct grammar, punctuation, spelling, and sentence structure. A passion for helping others and a willingness to go the extra mile in providing nothing less than exceptional customer service and a positive customer experience. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to multi-task and maneuver through various programs and applications while providing timely and superior service to customers. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Working knowledge of G-Suite, including Gmail, Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive Ability to acquire new skills in a proficient manner. Accept responsibility for actions when necessary and learn from mistakes. Ability to be flexible - adapt to change in a positive manner. Ability to work quickly and think logically, especially under pressure. Ability to reason with difficult and/or upset customers in a courteous and professional manner. Self-starter and highly motivated with a strong, positive work ethic that contributes to the success of the department and company as a whole. Must possess a professional yet enthusiastic and friendly demeanor. Excellent phone handling, negotiating and active listening skills. Education and Experience: High school diploma required, College degree desired. At least one year experience in a customer service role, preferably in a contact center or multi-channel communication environment. Physical Requirements: Must be able to lift 20 lbs Must be able to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician III
jobs.description:
At Hawthorne Residential Partners, we’re looking for dependable, motivated, and hands on maintenance professionals who take pride in creating clean, well-maintained, and welcoming communities.

We offer more than just a job, we offer a path to grow your skills, learn new trades, and build a career. You’ll work alongside a team who will support you, challenge you, and cheer you on every step of the way.

Join a company where your work matters and your future is full of opportunity!

Maintenance Technician III | Job Overview

Maintenance professionals play a vital role in creating an exceptional apartment community. As Maintenance Technician III, you will be responsible for handling complex work orders, mentoring junior techs, and helping lead preventative maintenance efforts.  You are expected to have your certification in HVAC, and experience in electrical, plumbing, appliance repair, and team leadership.

Maintenance Technician III | Education, Experience, and License Qualifications

Education:

Experience:

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in apartment maintenance or a skilled trade such as HVAC, plumbing, or electrical. Prior supervisory or lead technician experience strongly preferred.

Licenses & Certifications:

• Valid Driver's License

• EPA/ HVAC Certification

• CPO Certification

Maintenance Technician III | Job Functions

Repair & Preventative Maintenance

• Diagnose and perform maintenance and repairs in a timely and professional manner.

• Assure all service requests are completed by Hawthorne standards.

• Repair and restore vacant apartments to make ready status in preparation for the next move-in and per company standard.

• Assist with pool maintenance and cleaning.

Maintaining Building & Grounds

• Perform building and common area upkeep daily. Assist in keeping ground neat and free of litter, debris, and pet waste.

Team & Leadership Responsibilities

Maintenance Technicians work Monday through Friday, with standard office hours from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. This role will require participation in an on-call rotation for after-hours emergencies and occasional support for resident events, as needed.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Power Generation
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to design and integrate on-site power-generation systems for large AI data center campuses. You will work across generation, substations, medium-voltage distribution, protection, auxiliary systems, grid interfaces, and data center loads. This role will establish technical requirements, evaluate technology and vendor solutions, and carry electrical designs from concept through commissioning and validated operation.

Travel: 50%

Responsibilities

 - Develop electrical architectures, one-lines, design criteria, specifications, and studies for generation plants and campus interconnections.

 - Design and review generator or alternator interfaces, transformers, MV and HV switchgear, protection, synchronization, grounding, station service, DC systems, and black-start capability.

 - Perform or review load flow, short circuit, arc flash, protection coordination, transient, motor-starting, grounding, and reliability studies.

 - Coordinate generation controls, microgrid or islanding behavior, utility interconnection, data center load characteristics, and operating modes.

 - Evaluate OEM and EPC proposals, equipment ratings, test plans, failure modes, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle tradeoffs.

 - Support procurement, factory acceptance testing, construction, energization, commissioning, performance testing, and root-cause investigations.

 - Resolve cross-discipline interfaces with mechanical, controls, CSA, fuel, utility, and data center electrical teams.

 - Create repeatable electrical reference designs and standards for future generation deployments.

Qualifications

 - 8+ years of electrical engineering experience on power generation, utility, industrial, microgrid, or mission-critical projects.

 - Deep knowledge of generators, transformers, switchgear, protection and controls, grounding, auxiliary power, and electrical system studies.

 - Experience with grid-connected and islanded generation, synchronization, load sharing, and black-start or restoration concepts.

 - Ability to interpret OEM data, operating scenarios, failure modes, and data center load requirements.

 - Experience carrying designs through construction, commissioning, and operational validation.

 - Knowledge of applicable NEC, NFPA, IEEE, NERC, and utility requirements.

 - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.

Preferred Skills

 - Professional Engineer license.

 - Experience with gas turbines, reciprocating engines, battery systems, microgrids, or hybrid generation plants.

 - Proficiency with ETAP, PSCAD, PSS/E, SKM, EasyPower, or equivalent analysis tools.

 - Experience supporting high-density data center loads and fast-changing AI compute demand.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Service
jobs.description:
Advantage Point Solutions (APS), part of The Lockwood Group, is a unique pharmaceutical consulting agency working with Pharmaceutical Manufacturers and Payers, delivering results for both. Our team of knowledgeable professionals has defined groundbreaking formulary, contracting and outcomes strategies for over 20 years. The core of these strategies has always been valued for both payers and manufacturers.

Position Overview:

The Senior Director - Vice President of Clinical Services will be an integral member of the APS team with day-to-day responsibilities for supporting APS staff and its clients with drug information, pharmacotherapy and disease state and payer experience and expertise across a broad range of orphan, ultra-orphan, specialty and traditional drugs and conditions. The position will require expert level drug information skills combined with a comprehensive understanding of the PBM and health plan payer landscape. This should include knowledge of payer behaviors and practices around formulary and coverage management in the Commercial and Medicare marketplaces, as well as a good working knowledge of drug distribution channels and the different entities in these spaces. The Senior Director - Vice President will use their clinical and payer landscape expertise to inform internal strategic insight generation, develop clinical perspectives, and augment client-facing engagements. The position will also require prior leadership and management experience to oversee the clinical aspects of APS workstreams and client deliverables.

Job Responsibilities:

•    Provide expert opinions to APS staff and its clients regarding the clinical value of drugs and drug classes to payers and how these drugs will be perceived and managed by payers
•    Support APS staff and its clients with broad-based drug information expertise in all therapeutic areas, including ultra-orphan, orphan, and non-orphan disease states
•    Conduct drug information research and other clinical and non-clinical research activities needed to gain an understanding of how various payer lines of business will perceive and manage new drugs and new indications being pursued by APS’ clients
•    Serve as a resource to all APS staff and its clients regarding the rationales and approaches that payers use when developing Prior Authorizations, step-therapy edits and other drug coverage rules
•    Prepare Word documents, PowerPoint slides or other formats describing the commercial viability, Pros and Cons, relevant competition and likely payer coverage management practices for new business development assets being considered by APS’ clients
•    Plan, conduct and concisely summarize payer research involving products being pursued by APS’ clients
•    Help to plan, develop and facilitate virtual and in-person payer advisory boards involving assets and issues of interest to APS’ clients.
•    Review and improve client value proposition presentations, including preapproval information exchange (PIE) presentations, to better address payer needs and perspectives
•    Interact with APS’ current and prospective clients and demonstrate that APS is  an organization with deep understanding and knowledge of drugs and drug therapy
•    Assist in the preparation and augmenting of statements of work (SOW) that APS prepares for new business and participate in client presentations to win new business
•    Keeping current with marketplace trends related to clinical use of drugs and payer formulary and coverage management practices
•    Collaborates with the APS Chief Clinical Officer and VP of Clinical Services to achieve APS’ and its clients’ goals and objectives
•    Works as a critical member of the entire APS team to achieve APS, Nexus and affiliated Lockwood company objectives.
•    Manage other clinical team members as well as freelance consultants, as needed.
•    Assist in the planning and execution of APS annual seminars
•    Perform other related duties, as needed

Qualifications:

•    Pharm. D degree or equivalent e.g., BS pharmacy with advanced degrees
•    At least 10-years of experience in a managerial/supervisory drug information position with a payer, i.e., health plan or PBM, in the areas of formulary development, coverage management, and benefit design
•    Comprehensive understanding of current payer organizations and payer regulatory landscape in Commercial and Medicare
•    Drug information experience with payers in developing drug monographs, class reviews, drug formularies, coverage criteria, appeals criteria, clinical policies, etc.
•    Experience managing individuals and teams.
•    Experience with the Commercial and Medicare lines of business, experience in Medicaid is also desirable, but not required
•    Experience in benefit design, coverage determination, benefit allocation, coverage review and appeal processes, etc.
•    Experience in P&T committee processes
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills
•    Dedication to life-long learning and development
•    Ability to facilitate/moderate virtual or in person payer advisory boards and payer advisory panels
•    Ability to collaborate and support other clinical and non-clinical experts within APS and other Lockwood companies to jointly achieve company and client objectives
•    Excellent time management skills and ability to meet agreed upon deadlines

jobs.title: Principal Research Scientist I - Biologics Analytical Research and Development, CMC Biologics Development
jobs.description:
AbbVie Biologics Analytical Research & Development (Biologics Analytical R&D) is a global analytical sciences organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative therapeutic biologic medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules through the transition of analytical methods and testing to commercial labs to support product launch.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Biologics Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.

The biologics characterization group develops state-of-the-art analytical techniques for in-depth characterization of therapeutic proteins and other novel biologic molecules using advanced, combined analytical techniques. We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific and leadership experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.

Responsibilities:

• Act as a subject matter expert in BioARD, lead phase-appropriate analytical development strategies for biologics characterization including ADC, PDC, AOC, fusion proteins, multi-specific antibodies, and other novel modalities.
• Design and execute the buildout of biotherapeutics extended characterization methods, to facilitate in-process analytics, batch release/stability, RS qualification, and comparability study.
• Make lab-based, data-driven, and phase-appropriate contributions to project team and deliver results in a team-oriented setting and will work across scientific disciplines to drive programs through critical milestones.
• Represent key area function in cross-functional project teams, provide hands-on analytical support, technical oversight to portfolios.
• Collaborate and integrate scientific objectives associated with development of new/improved products or technology; contribute to scientific exchange and publications.
• Author, review lab notebook, analytical report, and analytical sections of regulatory filings. Primary author of external publications, presentations, and patents. Present at leading scientific conferences.
• May mentor/supervise a team of one or more, guide and evaluate the performance of those individuals; is accountable for the effective performance of the team/individuals.

• BS or equivalent education with 14+ years of experience; MS or equivalent education with 12+ years of experience; PhD in scientific discipline (e.g., Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Biology) with typically 6+ years of industry experience, is required.
• Demonstrated proficiency and substantial hands-on experience in mass spectrometry-based characterization of biologics, including intact/subunit analysis, peptide mapping, disulfide bond mapping, etc., as well as hands-on experience in mass spec data processing and interpretation using various MS software platforms.
• Strong working knowledge and familiarity with separation-based analytical techniques, including SEC, HIC, HILIC, RPLC, IEX, CE, icIEF, etc.
• Knowledge in key analytical CMC areas, such as risk-based analytical development and method validation, CQAs assessment, reference standard qualification, comparability study.
• Familiarity with biophysical assays, or binding and functional assays are plus.
• Working knowledge of lab automation, good written and oral communication skills, time management skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Automotive
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Project Accountant Analyst
jobs.description:
Project Accountant Analyst 
Position summary
The Project Accountant Analyst owns the flow of revenue from engagement to recognition. Working directly with departmental leaders and their project teams, this person makes sure work performed is billed accurately and on time, that revenue is recognized in the correct period, and that unbilled and deferred balances are understood and current. The role also supports the Director of Finance through month-end and year-end close.
This is a hands-on position in a small finance function. The Project Accountant Analyst will spend meaningful time on detailed invoices, project schedules, reconciliations — while also serving as the finance point of contact that operating leaders come to with questions about their projects. Alongside the revenue focus, this person contributes through general accounting operations and provides coverage for the billing team during absences, which builds broad exposure to the full accounting cycle. It is a role with room to grow in scope and responsibility for the right person.
 Core responsibilities
Revenue recognition & project accounting
Own the monthly revenue recognition process for projects and service engagements, ensuring revenue is recorded in the correct period and in accordance with company policy and contract terms.
Prepare and reconcile deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and work-in-progress balances; investigate and resolve variances.
Review new and amended contracts for billing terms, milestones, and revenue implications, and flag anything unusual to the Director of Finance.                                                   
Partnership with departmental leaders
Meet regularly with departmental leaders and project teams to understand where each project stands — milestones reached, work delivered, and what is ready to be billed.
Drive timely billing by identifying stalled, unbilled, or under-billed work and following it through to resolution with the responsible team.
Convert project milestone and completion information into accurate, timely billing of work in progress.
Serve as the finance point of contact for project-related billing and revenue questions, translating accounting requirements into terms operating leaders can act on.
Billing operations
Prepare and review complex, milestone-based, and non-standard invoices; support the billing team on routine invoice volume.
Review billing output for accuracy and completeness before release and resolve billing disputes and customer inquiries in coordination with the billing team.
Identify and implement improvements to billing workflow, documentation, and controls.
Month-end and year-end close
Prepare assigned journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules within the close calendar.
Support the Director of Finance with close deliverables, financial reporting packages, and variance analysis.
Assist with year-end close and prepare requested schedules and documentation for external auditors.
Maintain written documentation of revenue and billing procedures.
General accounting & team support
Review and approve accounts payable transactions within assigned authority, verifying coding, documentation, and appropriate approval before release.
Review employee expense reports and corporate card activity for policy compliance, accurate coding, and proper project allocation.
Perform general ledger account reconciliations and general accounting tasks as assigned by the Director of Finance.
Provide coverage for billing and accounts payable functions during planned time off and periods of high volume, keeping cycles on schedule.
Contribute to process documentation, internal controls, and cross-training so the finance function is not dependent on any single person.
Support ad hoc analysis and special projects for the Director of Finance and departmental leadership.
 Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Three to five years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue, or general accounting.
Working knowledge of accrual accounting and the ability to reason through revenue timing questions.
Strong Excel skills, including the ability to build and maintain reconciliation and project schedules.
Demonstrated accuracy and follow-through in detail-heavy work, with the judgment to know when something needs to be escalated.
Comfort working directly with non-finance colleagues and holding them to deadlines diplomatically.
Willingness to move between focused revenue work and broader accounting tasks, including stepping in to cover teammates during absences.
Preferred
Direct exposure to revenue recognition under ASC 606, particularly for services or project-based work.
Experience in professional services, engineering, construction, or project-driven environment.
Experience with ERP or project accounting systems and with improving a billing process rather than only executing it.
Progress toward CPA or CMA, or interest in pursuing it. The company supports exam and continuing education costs.
 What success looks like
 First 90 days: Fluent in how revenue moves through the business. Billing cycle running on time with the billing team. Relationships established with each departmental leader. Cross-trained well enough to provide coverage during a teammate's absence.
 First year: Full ownership of the monthly revenue recognition process. Unbilled and deferred balances clean, current, and explainable. Close deliverables consistently on schedule, and AP approval and expense review running without prompting.
 Beyond: Broadening scope within the finance function based on demonstrated capability and interest.
 Why this role
This position works alongside our Director of Finance daily, with direct exposure to the full accounting cycle and to every department in the company, a level of visibility and breadth that is unusual for a role at this level.
 We are looking for someone who wants to grow. This is a small team where capability is noticed quickly, scope expands as it is earned, and the person in this seat has genuine influence over how revenue processes work.
 About K Group Companies
K Group Companies is a locally owned technology services provider headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, with a proud history dating back to 1980. While rooted in West Michigan, we support customers across the United States by delivering innovative, high-quality technology solutions across managed IT, physical security, and integrated services.
As a third-generation, family-owned business, we’ve built our reputation on long-term relationships, trusted expertise, and a commitment to doing things the right way—for our customers and for each other.
We believe great work happens when people feel connected to their purpose, their team, and their growth.
Why K Group Companies?
At K Group Companies, culture is built on long-standing relationships, both with our customers and with each other.
Our team is made up of people who take pride in solving problems, supporting one another, and delivering work that reflects the standards we’ve built our reputation on. Whether it’s designing secure environments for customers, supporting critical IT infrastructure, or collaborating across teams, we operate as one organization working toward shared success.
We also believe work should be fulfilling and enjoyable. From friendly gaming competitions in our Team Zone arcade to grabbing lunch together in the community, we value connection and teamwork just as much as technical excellence.

A family-owned company with deep roots in West Michigan
A trusted advisor culture built over 40+ years of relationships

We believe we are better together, and that belief shows up in everything we do.
Compensation & Benefits
At K Group Companies, we invest in our people because we believe great work starts with feeling supported and secure.
