jobs.title: Lead Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
About Equip 

Equip is the leading virtual, evidence-based eating disorder treatment program on a mission to ensure that everyone with an eating disorder can access treatment that works. Created by clinical experts in the field and people with lived experience, Equip builds upon evidence-based treatments to empower individuals to reach lasting recovery. All Equip patients receive a dedicated care team, including a therapist, dietitian, physician, and peer and family mentor. The company operates in all 50 states and is partnered with most major health insurance plans. Learn more about our strong outcomes https://equip.health/outcomes and treatment approach at www.equip.health. http://www.equip.health

Founded in 2019, Equip has been a fully virtual company since its inception and is proud of the highly-engaged, passionate, and diverse Equipsters that have created Equip’s culture.  Recognized by Time https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2023/6285207/equip/ as one of the most influential companies of 2023, along with awards from Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2022-50-us-companies-rise-linkedin-news/ and Lattice https://lattice.com/blog/announcing-the-2023-finalists-for-lattices-people-success-awards, we are grateful to Equipsters for building a sustainable treatment program that has served thousands of patients and families.

About the role

The Lead Medical Assistant will oversee and mentor the Medical Assistant Team, ensuring clinical service excellence, operational efficiency, and superior patient experience from the Med Team. Balancing direct patient care with leadership responsibilities, this position supports established workflows, quality standards, and team development. This leader will collaborate with other Care Delivery leads at Equip to ensure streamlined workflows and clear understanding and communication between teams.

Responsibilities

 - Effectively manage a team of Medical Assistants, including setting performance expectations and monitoring KPIs, providing continuous feedback, writing and delivering performance reviews, and initiating performance improvement plans when necessary.

 - Maintain a caseload of patients, coordinating care across a multidisciplinary treatment team of physicians, dietitians, patient mentors, and family mentors, along with outside providers in accordance with Equip’s policies and procedures.

 - Manage MA schedules and create coverage plans for supervisee responsibilities when they are out of office to ensure seamless completion of work and patient safety.

 - Use data insights to guide feedback and support leadership decisions.

 - Identify training needs. Schedule and oversee any training sessions.

 - Collaborate with Senior Medical Service Manager to lead the Monthly MA huddle as well as assist in planning for the monthly Med Support Team meeting.

 - Provide administrative oversight, logistical support, and coverage, as needed, for the patients assigned to direct reports.

 - Review and approve time off requests.

 - Assist with hiring and onboarding of new hires for the MA Team. Develop an onboarding plan for training and coaching.

 - Develop and support growth plans for supervisees.

 - Review and approve expense requests in Ramp.

 - Complete tasks for medical staff, including data entry, faxing, scheduling, and collection of outside priority records.

 - Maintain and update patient medical records; for example entering vital signs and uploading documents.

 - Monitor messaging on the medical team chat channels to answer questions and pull in appropriate medical staff as needed to address the needs of patients and families.

 - Follow up on requested testing to ensure that patients are following provider recommendations.

 - Work with multiple providers and staff to coordinate care with outside providers, including primary care providers and student health centers.

 - Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

 - CCMA (Certified Clinical Medical Assistant) or equivalent certification is highly desirable.

 - 4+ years experience working in a Med Support role; previous direct people management or mentoring experience preferred

 - Experience in behavioral/Eating disorders for a minimum of 1 year

 - Preferred virtual care experience

 - Highly organized, skilled administrator.

 - Strong communicator with a high level of confidentiality.

 - Skilled at navigating electronic medical records

 - Ability and willingness to pivot to other potential tasks

 - Enthusiastic, strong team player a must

Compensation & Benefits Package

Compensation:

 - Earning Potential Range: $56,000 to $70,000 Base Pay + 15% Annual Performance-Based Bonus Potential

Time Off:

 - Flex PTO policy (3-5 wks/year recommended) + 11 paid company holidays.

 - Generous Parental Leave Benefits.

Core Benefits:

 - Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance.
   
   - Equip pays for a significant percentage of benefits premiums for individuals and families.

 - Spring Health, a 100% employer-paid mental health benefit through Guardian.
   
   - You can receive 5 free therapy sessions and 5 free coaching sessions per year for you and each of your dependents.

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more!

 - HealthJoy, a 100% employer-paid platform connecting you to a healthcare concierge who can help you navigate your benefits.

 - 401K Option!

Other Benefits

Student Loan Repayment:

 - $500/quarter for employees under a year of tenure.

 - $1,000/quarter for employees over a year of tenure.

Continuing Education:

 - Robust training in evidence-based treatments for eating disorders, including Family-Based Treatment, Enhanced Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for ARFID. Comparable training workshops and supervision in these modalities are valued over at $3,000 per training.

 - For therapists and medical providers, unlimited online courses through NetCE.

 - Up to $1,000/year stipend for continuing education.

Work From Home Additional Perks:

 - $50/month stipend added directly to an employee’s paycheck to cover home internet expenses.

 - Initial work-from-home stipend of up to $500.
   
   - Reload of $200 on the home office stipend at the 3-year mark and then every other year after that (year 5, year 7, etc.).

 - Company Laptop.

Physical Demands 

Work is performed 100% from home with no requirement to travel. This is a stationary position that requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards as well as to talk or hear by telephone. Sit or stand as needed.

 - Accurately document procedural data in real time

 - Maintain logs, equipment records, and supply inventory

 - Support quality improvement initiatives and survey readiness

 - Maintain Compliance and Standards

 - Adhere to AAAHC, CMS, and applicable state regulatory requirements

 - Follow infection prevention and radiation safety protocols

 - Maintain patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA

What You’ll Bring

 - Associate’s degree in Cardiovascular Technology, Radiologic Technology, or related field preferred

 - 1–2 years of experience in a cardiac catheterization lab and interventional radiology preferred

 - Florida radiologic technologist license

 - Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required

 - RCIS or ARRT certification preferred

 - Strong knowledge of cardiac anatomy, coronary circulation, and hemodynamics

 - Proficiency with Cath lab equipment and monitoring systems

 - Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-acuity environment

 - Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and communication skills

What We Offer:

 - No nights, weekends, holidays, or call

 - Competitive salary and benefits package

 - Health, 401(k), and PTO

 - Supportive, collaborative, and growing environment

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Octus

Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Since 2013, tens of thousands of professionals across hedge fund, investment banking, management consulting, and law firm verticals have come to rely on Octus to make better, faster, and more confident decisions in pace with the fast-moving credit markets.
For more information, visit: https://octus.com/

Working at Octus

Octus hires growth-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Our core values – Action Oriented, Customer First Mindset, Effective Team Players, and Driven to Excel – define an organizational ethos that’s as high-performing as it is human. Among other perks, Octus employees enjoy competitive health benefits, matched 401k and pension plans, PTO, generous parental leave, gym subsidies, educational reimbursements for career development, recognition programs, and much more.

Role

We're hiring a hands-on Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to own the security technology that protects Octus employees, endpoints, and enterprise systems. You'll keep our security stack healthy and well tuned, and you'll harden the security settings in the business systems people use every day.

Our security team is small, so this role is broad. Your main focus is IT and enterprise security. You'll also work on cloud security, application security, incident response, vendor risk, and audits. Anyone who joins gets real exposure across the whole program.

You'll also help us secure AI tools. Octus uses AI heavily, and we want someone who can make tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT safe to use at scale.

Responsibilities

Primary focus: IT and enterprise security

• Own the care and feeding of our security tools. Tune policies, manage upgrades, fix integrations, and retire what we no longer need.

• Manage endpoint security across Mac and Windows with Microsoft Defender, Intune, and Jamf Pro.

• Manage Netskope policies for web, SaaS, and data loss prevention.

• Harden identity in Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. This covers SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and admin access reviews.

• Set and enforce security configuration in enterprise systems like Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other SaaS apps.

• Manage email security with Abnormal Security and Google Workspace controls.

• Support secrets and credential management in 1Password.

• Harden AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT. Configure admin settings, connector and MCP controls, audit logging, and data protections.

Also in scope: the broader program

• Build and tune detections in Google SecOps with our managed SOC partner.

• Respond to incidents and lead post-incident reviews. Join the team on-call rotation. Calls are rare.

• Track and drive remediation of cloud and code findings from Wiz and Snyk.

• Partner with Engineering on AWS security and secure development practices.

• Automate security work with Python, APIs, and workflow tools.

• Collect evidence for SOC 2 and support client security reviews.

• Assess security risk in new vendors and tools.

• Mentor teammates and share what you learn across Technology.

Requirements

• 6+ years in cybersecurity or security-focused IT engineering.

• Hands-on experience running EDR and MDM tools across Mac and Windows fleets.

• Strong working knowledge of identity platforms like Okta or Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, and conditional access.

• Experience hardening SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.

• Experience with SSE or secure web gateway tools, and with DLP.

• Experience tuning a SIEM and responding to security incidents.

• Working knowledge of SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR, and how technical controls support them.

• Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Comfort working with REST APIs.

• Clear writing and speaking with both technical and non-technical people.

• Comfort working across many areas at once on a small team.

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with our stack, including Okta, Microsoft Defender, Intune, Jamf Pro, Netskope, Google SecOps, or Wiz.

• Experience hardening enterprise AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT, including MCP servers and connectors.

• Experience building security automation or workflows that cut manual work.

• Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, Security+, or a cloud security cert.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Octus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse work environment where all individuals are valued, respected, and treated fairly. We believe that diversity enriches our workplace and enhances our ability to innovate and succeed.

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager (SMB)
jobs.description:
Vendelux https://vendelux.com/ is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including FirstMark. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Forter and beyond.

________________

We're looking for a Partnerships Manager to grow and deepen our event organizer partner program. This is a strategic, hands-on individual contributor role: you'll personally own relationships with key event organizer partners and the operational excellence that keeps them successful.

You'll drive retention and expansion across your book of strategic accounts—owning the health metrics, playbooks, and outcomes that keep organizers engaged—while partnering with product, data, and commercial teams as Vendelux scales. You've built and grown partner, channel, or customer success relationships at a Series A/B/C tech company and thrive in commercial, operational work.

This role is hybrid, 4 days a week in our NYC office.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own strategic partnerships

 - Lead and grow relationships with key event organizer partners, serving as the senior point of contact for your strategic accounts.

 - Own partner onboarding end-to-end, from pre-call research to live sessions and follow-up education.

 - Build and customize data reports and dashboards to meet partner-specific needs, and surface partner feedback to improve reporting workflows and product capabilities.

 - Represent Vendelux externally at industry events, and stay close to market trends to influence product and positioning.

Drive retention and expansion

 - Own retention, expansion, and account health across your accounts; hit your targets and prioritize your time and resources to deliver predictable outcomes.

 - Identify and drive expansion—additional events, renewals, webinars, case studies, and media partnerships—partnering with Sales, Product, Data, and Marketing on go-to-market and upsell.

 - Deliver compelling business outcomes for your partners across onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion.

 - Contribute to the playbooks, segmentation, and health-scoring approaches that make the account management function scalable.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 2-4+ years in account management, partnerships, or customer success—ideally in B2B SaaS.

 - Proven success hitting retention and expansion targets; comfortable owning your number.

 - Strong operational mindset: building playbooks, KPIs, and repeatable processes for your accounts.

 - Comfortable with data and customer usage/adoption metrics; a strong communicator who builds trust and navigates complex stakeholder conversations.

 - Highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, scaling environments and prioritizes competing demands.

 - Nice to have: experience with data, analytics, media, or marketing intelligence platforms.

 - Nice to have: familiarity with events, experiential, or brand marketing ecosystems.

 - Nice to have: experience with international clients or expanding into new markets.


BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary and bonus

 - Equity

 - Healthcare covering medical, dental and vision

 - 401(k)

 - Catered lunch every day in our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO plus two company-wide shutdowns during the July 4th week and the Christmas – New Year's week

Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.



Vendelux is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Account Executive (Mid Market-Enterprise) | $75K-$85K Base + Uncapped Commission | Exciting SaaS Hospitality & Franchise Startup
jobs.description:
WE’RE LOOKING FOR A HUNTER WHO WILL OPEN DOORS, BUILD RELATIONSHIPS, AND WIN NEW BUSINESS.

This role calls for a hunter who wants sales ownership of a mature, category-defining product. You enjoy opening doors, asking difficult questions, following up consistently, building relationships that add value to our prospects, and converting interest into decisions.

Our client already has amazing credibility and understanding of their customers’ business like no other competing SaaS out there. Marketing support is in place, and you will walk into a role offering high-quality leads and opportunities on day 1.

You will own the full new business sales cycle for mid-market and enterprise accounts, from prospecting through close. Average deals are $20,000+ ARR, with sales cycles of approximately 3-6 months.

Working directly with the CEO, growth marketing, and Customer Success, you will help shape the sales approach and bring new customers onto the platform.

Travel includes 6-8 conferences annually, typically 2-3 days per event, with potential international travel.

Responsibilities

• Own the full new business sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and closing.
• Generate pipeline through outbound calls, targeted outreach, referrals, existing customer relationships, and industry events.
• Understand each prospect’s operational challenges, buying process, and stakeholders, then deliver tailored demonstrations and a clear business case.
• Navigate complex deals involving corporate leaders, operators, franchisors, franchisees, and property teams, maintaining clear next steps and consistent follow up.
• Partner with marketing to improve campaigns and sales materials, and with Customer Success to support a smooth transition into onboarding.
• Represent our client at approximately 6-8 conferences annually, typically requiring 2-3 days away per event, with potential international travel.

• 5-7+ years of relevant B2B sales experience, with a background in SaaS and familiarity with hospitality, franchising, or organizations operating multiple locations.
• A demonstrated record of closing SaaS deals worth $20,000+ in ARR (sales cycles of approximately 3-6 months)
• Proven ability to create your own pipeline through cold calling, outbound prospecting, and relationship building, with the urgency and discipline to keep deals moving.
• Strong consultative selling, discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills, including experience navigating purchasing decisions involving multiple stakeholders.
• Experience selling to hotel groups, franchisors, franchisees, or selling operations and workflow software is particularly valuable.
• Based within approximately one hour of Wayne, Pennsylvania, or willing to relocate, with availability to work in the office 3 days per week and travel domestically and internationally.

About SaaS Talent

SaaS Talent is more than just a recruiting company. We're your hiring, business development and growth partner with 20+ years of experience in SaaS and Hi-Tech that helps you scale and transform your business. We've worked with 100+ companies and helped them achieve their goals. From streamlining sales, marketing, and operations to hiring ideal talent and getting funding, if you're struggling to grow, we're an ideal choice.

Reach out to us at www.saas-talent.com to learn more about how we can help you.

SMS Communication Consent Disclaimer

By applying for this position, you agree to receive text message updates from SaaS Talent related to job opportunities. Standard message and data rates may apply, and messaging frequency varies. Text HELP for help and STOP to cancel. Learn more about our opt-in SMS Communication consent policy here: https://www.saas-talent.com/opt-in-sms-communication-consent

jobs.title: Professional Services, Program Manager
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Professional Services Program Manager at GitLab, you will lead the delivery of complex, multi-workstream services engagements for some of our largest and most strategic customers. You will help customers turn transformation goals into clear execution plans by bringing structure, visibility, and accountability across interconnected projects. Working closely with customer stakeholders and GitLab team members, you will guide programs from planning through delivery while building trusted relationships across executive, technical, and delivery teams. In this role, you will define and apply a strong delivery methodology grounded in agile and project management best practices, communicate that approach clearly, and keep teams aligned on milestones, dependencies, and outcomes. This is a strong opportunity to shape how customers adopt GitLab at scale and help them realize meaningful business value through effective program leadership.

What you'll do

• Lead delivery of multi-workstream professional services engagements for large and strategic customers

• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive leaders, program and project managers, engineering, development, and security teams

• Develop and apply a delivery methodology that uses agile and project management best practices, and communicate how the methodology will be used throughout the program

• Create and continuously communicate program roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across connected projects

• Manage stakeholder expectations and secure approval on major milestones, decisions, and delivery plans

• Define program strategy, including business justification, expected benefits, in-scope and out-of-scope work, timelines, schedules, resources, stakeholders, and success criteria

• Establish core program structures such as RACI charts, work breakdown structures, communication plans, and escalation paths

• Work closely with Engagement Managers and Regional Delivery Managers to support program scoping, review delivery assumptions, and help improve project management processes through quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)

What you'll bring

• Experience leading complex programs with multiple interdependent projects, stakeholders, and timelines

• Strong skill in program planning, forecasting, reporting, and communicating delivery metrics clearly to internal and external stakeholders

• Ability to organize, monitor, and manage long-term project budgets, schedules, risks, and dependencies

• Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with customers and partner effectively with Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery teams

• Working knowledge of agile and other project management approaches, with the judgment to apply the right structure to different customer needs

• Ability to develop long-term plans that support customer adoption, transformation, and successful delivery outcomes

• Comfort leading program-level meetings and driving progress across multiple workstreams

• Willingness to complete GitLab Project Management certification within 2 months of starting in the role

About the team

On our Professional Services team, we help customers adopt GitLab effectively by turning strategy into structured delivery. As Program Managers on our team, we bring clarity to large, complex engagements by coordinating people, plans, and processes across multiple workstreams. We work closely with customers, Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery leaders to create practical plans, manage risk, and keep programs moving toward agreed outcomes. Because we operate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, we value clear communication, strong documentation, and ownership. This role is well suited for you if you enjoy building order in complex environments, guiding stakeholders through change, and helping customers make progress on meaningful transformation efforts.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, SME & Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex is building toward 10B ARR by 2030, and the SME & Growth business is one of our biggest opportunities because the market remains largely untapped. As Sales Manager, you’ll lead and scale a team of full-cycle Account Executives acquiring and closing customers with 1–500 employees across segments such as travel, ecommerce, and SaaS.

 - Own revenue delivery, pipeline health, deal quality, and execution velocity across the team.

 - Coach Account Executives on discovery, deal strategy, negotiation, objection handling, and closing.

 - Build the processes, metrics, and operating cadence needed to scale a high-performing outbound sales motion.

 - Use data, AI, and sales tools to improve account research, deal strategy, pipeline visibility, and forecasting accuracy.

 - Partner with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to refine our ideal customer profile, test new SMB verticals, and turn win/loss insights and revenue outcomes into better execution.

 - Recruit and develop your team, strengthen our sales motion, and raise the bar on how we serve ambitious businesses.



This role is fully remote.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 


ESSENTIALS

 - At least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, including experience managing and coaching Account Executives.

 - A proven track record of closing deals and managing complex SMB pipelines end to end.

 - Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to prioritise leads, assess deal quality, and forecast accurately.

 - Deep experience coaching Account Executives on closing, negotiation, objection handling, and pipeline management.

 - Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles, including with business owners and finance teams.

 - Excellent communication skills — structured, persuasive, and credible in commercial negotiations.

 - Experience operating in a high-growth environment with high accountability.

 - Experience leading outbound sales motions, including prospecting and cold calling.

 - A builder mindset, with examples of creating or improving sales processes, enablement, or operating rhythms without relying on an established framework.

 


PREFERRED

 - Experience leading SMB sales teams in fintech, payments, or trade-related platforms.

 - Strong intuition for mapping customer payment flows and identifying expansion or revenue opportunities.

 - A demonstrated ability to improve close rates, deal velocity, and win consistency.

 - Experience using AI and sales tools to improve deal strategy, pipeline visibility, and forecasting accuracy.

 - A relationship-first leadership style with a strong coaching and talent-development mindset.

 - Experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups.

 


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

 - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

 


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Technical Service Manager
jobs.description:

Due to an promotion we are looking for our next star employee to join the Precoat Metals team as a Technical Services Manager. jobs.title: Propulsion Engineer, Components Manufacturing (Raptor)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROPULSION ENGINEER, COMPONENTS MANUFACTURING (RAPTOR)

The Raptor Components team develops the most advanced engine control components in the world. Our engineers are hardware experts for flow control devices that enable the Raptor engine, integrating pneumatics, mechanical, electrical, and software into integrated packages that enable streamlined manufacturing and engine operation. We design, analyze, build, test, and fly components for simplicity, manufacturability, and reliability in extreme thermal, pressure, and vibe environments. You will use and expand your knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions at the cutting edge of space technology. You will own the relationship between your hardware and suppliers, customers, and test teams while spearheading your own projects. You will provide input into vehicle architecture trades and take a lead role in design and flight readiness on Starship, the vehicle that will make humanity multi-planetary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop manufacturing & integration processes for components & assemblies in the Raptor engine family.Question requirements, delete parts and processes, simplify/optimize, accelerate, and automate component deliveries

• Conceptualize, demonstrate, and drive to completion innovative manufacturing processes to support high rate production targets

• Regularly challenge each process, part, and operation while working closely with design/development engineers to create the most manufacturable and reliable engine hardware possible

• Oversee introduction and implementation of new products and product revisions, frequently multiple at a given time

• Maintain a sense of holistic ownership over the production line, including process consistency, quality, tooling, capital equipment, ergonomics, and safety

• Spearhead root cause investigations that arise in development, production, test, integration and launch, implementing corrective actions, proactively seeking out hardware issues and implementing solutions early

• Coordinate team of peers through informal leadership and self-directed program organization to achieve goals. Assign clear responsibilities, motivating and holding teammates accountable for execution

• Interface with internal fabrication shops as well as vendors to meet production goals

• Work with production teams to ensure the hardware you are responsible for is delivered on time or ahead of schedule

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience with engine, fluid, or system design, development, fabrication, assembly, or test (internship or project team experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, enthusiasm for problem solving, and desire to optimize modern rocket production and launch processes

• Strong leadership project management skills and experience, and effective communication of technical concepts across multi-disciplinary teams

• Experience working with liquid rocket engines, spacecraft systems, and/or pressurized fluid systems

• Expertise in design for manufacturability (DFM), with demonstrable success at taking products through development, testing, and production

• Understanding of fundamental principals in fluid systems, solid mechanics, and/or electrical systems

• Highly detail oriented with excellent organizational skills

• Track record of success in a rapidly growing, changing and highly technical environment

• Ability and desire to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, team environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This is a hands-on position that will require standing for long durations of your day and working directly with hardware on the floor

• Must be comfortable stooping, bending, and standing

• Position may require occasional travel, long hours, or weekend work

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Veo, our mission is to end car dependency by making clean transportation accessible to all. A leading shared micromobility provider in North America, Veo provides millions of bike and scooter rides annually in over 60 cities and universities from Los Angeles to New York City.

Veo offers the most diverse and accessible vehicle fleet in the country built to expand who can ride and what trips are possible. We design and manufacture our vehicles, hardware, and software systems in-house and operate our local markets directly to ensure safe and reliable service. As the first profitable micromobility company in North America, Veo is built for long-term growth and partnership with cities.

Veo has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies and a Top GreenTech Company by TIME. As we continue to scale, we are looking for exceptionally talented individuals who are excited to help shape the next era of micromobility.

Job Summary

As Veo's Director, Supply Chain, you will lead Veo's end-to-end supply chain function, including central warehouse operations, supplier management, supply planning, international logistics, hardware quality coordination, and supply chain financial performance. You will be responsible for ensuring vehicles, batteries, and parts are sourced, produced, transported, and delivered on time, at the required quality, and at a competitive cost.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will partner closely with Operations, Hardware, R&D, Finance, and Veo's suppliers to strengthen supply chain performance, reduce unit costs, optimize working capital, and develop strategies that protect the business from global supply chain risks.

This role is ideal for an experienced, supply chain leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on operating approach and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Responsibilities:

• Supply Chain Leadership - Own Veo's end-to-end supply chain strategy and execution across vehicles, batteries, replacement parts, international sourcing, and domestic distribution.

• Central Warehouse Management - Oversee multiple central warehouse supply chain operations, including receiving, shipping, inventory accuracy, inventory controls, order fulfillment, and shipping vendor performance.

• Supplier Management - Lead supplier sourcing, selection, negotiation, and performance management across pricing, production capacity, delivery timelines, product quality, and commercial terms.

• Supply Chain Planning - Develop and maintain vehicle, battery, and parts-ordering plans based on fleet needs, consumption trends, demand forecasts, lead times, and operational priorities.

• International Logistics - Manage cross-border shipments, including tariff strategy, customs coordination, vessel booking, freight forwarding, port management, and delivery to U.S. warehouses and operating markets.

• Cost Optimization- Lead initiatives to optimize vehicle, battery, parts, freight, and total landed costs while maintaining Veo's quality, safety, and operational standards.

• Financial Performance - Own the financial performance of the supply chain function, including budget management, cost-reduction targets, inventory investment, working capital optimization, and supply chain forecasting.

• Cross-Functional Partnership - Lead alignment between Supply Chain, Operations, Hardware, R&D, Finance, and other stakeholders to support new vehicle launches, ensure parts availability, identify and resolve in-market product issues, improve product reliability, and coordinate timely corrective actions.

• Leadership - Lead, mentor, and develop domestic and international supply chain and warehouse teams while fostering a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Requirements:

• Experience - 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, sourcing, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, or related functions, including leadership experience. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field required.

• Supply Chain Expertise - Deep knowledge of strategic sourcing, supplier and production management, inventory planning, warehousing, international logistics, tariffs, and supply chain risk management.

• Financial Acumen - Demonstrated success reducing unit and landed costs, managing budgets, improving inventory efficiency, and optimizing working capital.

• Hardware and Quality - Experience managing suppliers and quality issues involving vehicles, batteries, electronics, or other manufactured hardware, including partnering with Engineering or R&D on corrective actions.

• Leadership - Proven ability to lead domestic and international teams, manage complex supplier relationships, and build scalable supply chain processes in a fast-paced environment.

• Technical Skills - Experience with ERP, inventory, warehouse, procurement, and supply-planning systems. Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets required.

• Communication - Strong executive communication, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills.

• Language - Full professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is required.

• Hybrid Role - Must reside within or relocate to a commutable distance from our Santa Monica headquarters. This role requires a minimum of four days per week in the office.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Total Cash Compensation: $175,000–$250,000 annually, including a base salary and annual performance bonus opportunity.

• Base Salary: $175,000–$230,000

• Annual Performance Bonus: Additional earning potential based on performance

• Equity: Stock options

• Unlimited PTO

• Competitive Benefits Package: Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, and more

• 401(k) with company match

• Opportunity to work in a fast-paced technology company

Below is the expected salary range for this position. The listed range is a good faith estimate, and exact compensation and total package may vary depending on market conditions and candidate qualifications.

Pay Range

$175,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.description:
As Information Systems Security Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets and sensitive information. The ideal candidate is a dedicated professional with a strong background in cybersecurity, a deep understanding of current threats and vulnerabilities, and can implement robust security measures. You’ll contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of our cybersecurity infrastructure while staying abreast of emerging trends in the field.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

What you’ll do:

• Design, implement, and manage security solutions, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection, and encryption mechanisms to ensure the organization's networks and systems remain secure.

• Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses in systems, networks, and applications.

• Develop and implement incident response plans to effectively address security breaches, incidents, and breaches.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures.

• Monitor network traffic, system logs, and security alerts to detect and respond to potential security incidents.

jobs.title: Army Launched Effects Software Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
501756 U.S. Army Launched Effects Product Office – Software Safety Engineer

Work Location: Huntsville, AL

Schedule: Full Time; 40 hours per week remote work not authorized

Relocation: Negotiable

IronMountain Solutions is seeking an Army Launched Effects Software Safety Engineer for the Army Launched Effects (LE) Product Office to develop and field cutting-edge Launched Effects systems to enhance lethality, survivability, and situational awareness for Soldiers.  This will support a dynamic team dedicated to rapid innovation and delivering transformative capabilities to the warfighter. IronMountain Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Software System Safety Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development, assessment, and rapid fielding of Army Uncrewed LE platforms. As a Software System Safety Engineer in the LE Product Office, you will leverage your experience and abilities in formulating, standardizing, and guiding software system safety practices across multiple platform variants throughout the entire acquisition lifecycle.

Job Summary:
The Software System Safety Engineer will serve as a key technical authority within the engineering team, responsible for establishing, standardizing, and guiding the software safety framework across multiple Launched Effects Assistant Product Manager (APM) teams. This role requires an agile, proactive systems thinker who can bridge traditional system safety principles with the operational demands of rapid, iterative defense acquisition. The engineer will collaborate closely with APM teams to guide and support them through execution, while actively engaging external stakeholders, airworthiness authorities, and safety review boards to tailor processes that fit the unique characteristics of Launched Effects. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment where strategies and technical approaches adapt dynamically to warfighter priorities.

Responsibilities:

• Formulate, standardize, and maintain a tailored software safety framework and clear guidance that LE APM teams can systematically apply across diverse product lines and vendor architectures.

• Partner directly with LE APM product teams, project engineers, and contractors to provide hands-on technical guidance, risk assessments, and reviews during the planning and execution of software safety activities.

• Interface with external safety organizations, review boards, and airworthiness authorities to negotiate and establish tailored software safety requirements aligned with Launched Effects operational profiles.

• Serve as an active voice within the broader Army aviation and safety communities, clearly communicating the unique technical, cost, and operational nuances of LE platforms compared to conventional aviation platforms.

• Prepare technical positions, executive white papers, and risk-trade briefings to drive consensus and facilitate process modernization across multiple echelons of Army leadership.

• Guide and support the development of safety documentation, risk mitigations, and hazard analyses required for safety releases, Airworthiness Releases (AWR), Materiel Releases, and discrete Soldier test and operational fielding events.

• Evaluate vendor software system safety analyses, safety architectures, and hazard logs to identify core system hazards and ensure safety integrity without levying unnecessary programmatic burden.

• Rapidly adjust software safety priorities, approaches, and risk mitigation strategies in response to shifting program timelines, emerging threat demands, and iterative fielding cycles.

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use tools or controls; normal physical activity (reach with hands and arms; climb stairs): and communicate effectively with all levels of employees and leadership. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds.

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Software, Systems, Computer Engineering, Electrical, Aerospace, or related technical field).

• Demonstrated experience in system safety engineering, software hazard analysis, or systems engineering on software-intensive systems.

• Proven track record of formulating, tailoring, and standardizing technical processes within complex project environments or defense acquisition programs.

• Strong negotiation, consensus-building, and communication skills, with the demonstrated ability to effectively advocate technical positions to external regulatory bodies and senior decision-makers.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across multi-disciplinary teams and support diverse product offices in executing technical standards.

• Proactive, self-starter mindset with the ability to thrive and pivot quickly in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving program environment.

Qualifications Desired:

• A Secret Security Clearance (or the ability to obtain one).

• Familiarity with DoD and Army safety, airworthiness, and materiel release policies and standards (e.g., MIL-STD-882E, AR 70-62, AMCOM Reg 385-17).

• Experience with Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (Group 1–3 UAS), loitering munitions, or missile platforms.

• Experience working within rapid acquisition frameworks (e.g., Other Transaction Authority (OTA), Middle Tier of Acquisition (MTA), rapid prototyping/fielding initiatives).

• Understanding of modern software architectures, safety-critical software partitions, and Modular Open Systems Approaches (MOSA).

Security Clearance

Candidates must have an active Secret clearance or have the ability to obtain and maintain an active Secret level security clearance.

IronMountain Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
Icarus was founded on the belief that the Stratosphere is the Forgotten Frontier and that reclaiming it will define the next era of aerospace and what is possible from the sky. We build solar-powered aircraft that fly at 60,000 ft for weeks at a time, delivering persistent, affordable, and scalable presence from this layer of the atmosphere. You will help build the supply chain that makes this possible.

Mission

Re-establish and maintain dominance in the Stratosphere.

The role

You will own buying and supply planning for mechanical, propulsion, composite, and raw-material commodities. Your scope includes machined and build-to-print parts, hardware, motors, servos, actuators, carbon materials, resins, adhesives, foam, and core. You will work with the Head of Supply Chain and the engineering and manufacturing teams to make material availability match the build plan.

What you’ll own

• Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP and spreadsheet-based material analysis.

• Strong follow-through with suppliers and internal customers in a changing build environment.

• Attention to material traceability, accurate transactions, and clear communication of shortages.

Bonus

• Experience with precision machining, electromechanical actuators, carbon composites, adhesives, or controlled-shelf-life materials.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Workplace Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



About the Role

As Suno grows its teams and real estate footprint across Cambridge, New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco, the company is looking for a senior lead to own all workplace experience initiatives that make our offices feel unmistakably Suno, while helping us efficiently scale. You're the one who notices what's not landing, figures out why, and fixes it before anyone has to ask.



Our Senior Manager, Workplace Experience sits at the center of a lot of moving parts: you'll build and iterate on in-office operations and programming, stand up systems that let workplace experience scale across four sites while keeping our human, music-centered touch, plan and run the operational and financial aspects of major office-based events and company offsites, and act as the cross-functional partner between Workplace and IT, Security, Finance, Communications, Music, Brand, and Executive Assistants, to name but a few.



This is a builder's role for someone who is equally comfortable running the operations of a 300-person offsite and sitting in a room helping shape what Suno's culture should feel like as the company doubles in size. You'll report to the VP of People and partner closely with her as a strategic thought partner, not just an executor.



What You’ll Do

 - Own the workplace experience strategy, roadmap and budget across all four offices: forecast spend, track it against plan, negotiate with vendors, and make sure every dollar goes toward experiences people actually value.

 - Manage our office managers and coordinators in Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles as they design and run in-office programming, share playbooks, vendors, and what’s working so every office feels genuinely Suno.

 - Lead operations for office events, company offsites or celebrations, and any recruiting events, from budgets, to venue hire, to run-of-show and day-of execution, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Keep the Workplace team’s roadmap on track by chasing down commitments and dependencies, setting up workplace operations ahead of new office openings, and flagging risks before they become last-minute fires.

 - Partner with Physical Security to ensure that all offices are operating according to required codes and protocols, ensuring employee health and safety is a top priority.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 8–10 years in workplace operations and experience, including owning a multi-site program.

 - 3–5 years managing people, including hiring, onboarding, and developing a team spread across multiple locations.

 - Experience owning a large workplace budget end to end: forecasting, tracking spend against plan, and making tradeoffs on where money goes.

 - A track record of planning and running large events and offsites (hundreds of attendees), from budget and venue to run-of-show and day-of execution.

 - Experience sourcing and negotiating with vendors and managing those relationships over time.

 - Strong cross-functional influence, comfortable working with executives and partners like IT, Security, Finance, and Brand, and shaping strategy rather than only executing it.

 - Strong project management: you keep a roadmap moving, follow up on dependencies, and raise risks early.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools to speed up workflows like vendor research, event planning, budget tracking, or creating playbooks.

 - A hospitality mindset, with a habit of noticing what isn’t working for people and fixing it before anyone asks.

Nice-to-Haves

 - Experience at a high-growth tech company, ideally during a period of rapid headcount growth.

Work Location Policy

This role is expected to work from Suno's NYC office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.



Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 25%) to lead team members and support offices across Suno locations.



Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - Creative Education Stipend

Are you looking for a meaningful role in behavioral health and have the desire to work with an organization that puts people first? If you have a passion for helping others along their recovery journey, then we invite you to join our Crestwood family!

For more than 50+ years Crestwood has been committed to creating innovative recovery programs and developing compassionate communities that support each client in their journey.  Our model of care focuses on a personal and self-directed process that empowers the people we serve and helps them to develop the skills to thrive!

Title: Mobile Crisis Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) | Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT)

Job Duties: The Mobile Crisis Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) ensures we are providing safe, effective, and compassionate responses to individuals during a mental crisis. The Mobile Crisis Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) will respond to calls from dispatch involving a mental health crisis in various settings. They will be required to travel to the location of the caller and provide crisis intervention services, including assessing and documenting holds. The Mobile Crisis Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Psychiatric Technician (LPT) will also be responsible for the supervision of the Peer Specialist as part of the Mobile Response Team (MRT).

About the Mobile Response Team: The Crestwood Behavioral Health Mobile Response Team (MRT) provides community-based interventions for those experiencing a mental health crisis. Our team is available to deploy into the community to provide crisis intervention, de-escalation, and stabilization. The MRT is staffed by Licensed/Registered Mental Health Counselors and Peer Specialists who can provide services throughout Napa County including residences, parks, shelters, schools, and hospitals. The goal of MRT is to de-escalate the crisis and safely connect individuals with mental health care and resources.

jobs.title: Strategy and Program Manager
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

The Role

We’re looking for a Strategy & Program Manager to help shape the future of Adyen’s Global Operations. You’ll sit within the Strategy & Execution team and work across our core operational domains: Support, Professional Services, and Merchant Operations.

This role is for a strategic operator who connects commercial ambition, technical innovation, and operational delivery. You won’t be tracking tasks. You’ll be taking on the hardest, least-defined problems in the organization and turning them into structures that work at scale. Your focus will shift as priorities shift, so expect a broad scope and an environment that keeps changing. Your mission is to make sure that as Adyen grows, our operational engine becomes more powerful, effective, and agile.

What you’ll do

• Solve high-complexity, systemic challenges: Take on high-stakes, ambiguous projects where no playbook exists. You’ll create the structure, define the “why,” and drive the “how,” taking undefined concepts from zero to scalable reality.

• Design for the end-to-end customer lifecycle: Make sure a commercial idea translates into seamless Merchant Ops onboarding, a smooth Professional Services implementation, and world-class Support. You design for the customer experience and for the effectiveness of our internal teams.

• Unblock the organization: Identify process debt and technical roadblocks that slow us down, and replace them with scalable, automated, or simplified workflows.

• Connect global pillars: Act as the link between Adyen’s global product pillars and our operational domains, so our operations are ready before new products launch.

• Steer with data: Use performance metrics as a roadmap for action. Spot friction early and use data-led diagnostics to guide the organization toward better ways of working.

• Build AI into how we work: Go beyond adopting third-party tools. Re-engineer our processes, tooling, and ways of working so we scale through intelligence rather than complexity.

Who you are

• A strategic operator with 5+ years of experience in strategy consulting, tech strategy, business operations, program management, or operations in a high-growth environment. You’ve taken complex, messy programs from concept to delivery without letting the ball drop.

• A systems thinker who looks beyond the immediate task to platform dependencies and technical trade-offs, and who sees how a decision in one area ripples across the customer journey.

• A problem solver who doesn’t rely on “how it’s always been done.” You break problems down to their fundamentals and build solutions that are tech-driven, friction-free, and customer-centric.

• A strategic influencer who can navigate high-stakes discussions with senior stakeholders, bring clarity to ambiguity, and drive alignment across teams and regions.

• Technically fluent, comfortable in a tech-first environment, and able to talk with engineers and commercial leads alike.

• Agile and resilient: You’re comfortable in the unknown, adapt quickly when priorities change, and keep up your execution power when there’s no playbook.

What success looks like:

• Complexity is simplified: You’ve replaced manual workarounds and technical roadblocks with simple and scalable workflows.

• Operational agility: The organization can absorb new products, commercial growth and technical shifts seamlessly because the operational groundwork was laid months in advance.

• Impact over activity: You are recognized as the person who unblocks the biggest hurdles, allowing our global teams to be more powerful and effective in their core roles.

Total rewards & compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $180,000. Compensation is based on factors including qualifications, experience, and location. Total compensation package includes equity (RSUs), 401(k), health, dental, vision, and more.

In-office expectations

This role will either be based in our New York or San Francisco office. We're an office-first company and expect employees to work in-office at least 3 days a week on average. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while also supporting flexibility.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen

We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen.

If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. If you have specific time constraints, please communicate them with your recruiter, and we’ll do our best to accommodate them where possible.

EEO statement

Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work Eligibility

The role requires an experienced senior commercial manager capable of operating within a complex, multi-contractor environment while protecting the client's commercial interests and supporting effective project delivery. The Senior Commercial Manager will work closely with project controls, procurement, risk management, engineering, and construction teams to ensure sound commercial governance and decision-making.

The ideal candidate has proven and demonstrable commercial management experience across major construction projects across the delivery life cycle.

**Houston, Texas based and travel to client sites required (frequency to be determined)

• Lead day-to-day commercial management activities for major projects and workstreams within the program.

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years of purchasing, material planning, or related supply chain experience supporting hardware manufacturing.

• Experience procuring electrical or electronic components and working with technical suppliers.

• Comfort reading BOMs, comparing specifications, and asking engineering the right questions.

• Practical ERP/MRP experience and strong spreadsheet skills.

• Ability to manage changing demand, long lead times, and multiple open orders without losing commitments.

• Strong supplier communication, attention to detail, and personal ownership of delivery outcomes.

Bonus

• Experience with avionics, RF, batteries, solar components, PCBAs, or cable and harness suppliers.

• Worked in aerospace, defense, robotics, or a hardware startup.

• Experience with ION, electronics lifecycle management, or alternate-source qualification.

jobs.title: Senior Space Electronics Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Overview

SEAKR is seeking an accomplished Space Electronics Systems Engineer to spearhead the design, development, testing, and qualification of mission‑critical electronic subsystems for our next‑generation products. You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, mechanical, power, and software teams to deliver highly reliable, radiation‑tolerant electronics that meet stringent requirements.

Core Responsibilities

• Subsystem Architecture & Design – Define and validate the architecture for avionics, payload electronics, power‑distribution units, and environmental control systems. Produce derived specifications, system‑level block diagrams and test plans.
• Component Selection & Qualification – Evaluate and select commercial or radiation‑hardened components (COTS, rad‑hard) against mission specifications.
• Hardware Development & Production – Oversee prototype build, assembly, and production‑grade manufacturing.
• Test & Validation – Design and execute system‑level test plans (electrical, functional, EMI/EMC, vibration, thermal). Analyze test data, generate reports, and drive verification efforts.
• Systems Integration & Interface Management – Define and maintain electronic interface control documents (ICDs, EID). Coordinate with hardware, power, software, and mechanical teams to resolve cross‑disciplinary interface issues.
• Documentation & Knowledge Management – Produce design specifications, test procedures, and operational manuals. Maintain a living knowledge base for future teams.
• Communication Skills – Ability to understand mission, translate customer asks into technological solutions, and represent SEAKR in unit sell off and delivery
• Team Leadership & Collaboration – Mentor junior engineers, conduct design reviews, and foster cross‑functional teamwork.

Required Qualifications

• Education – Bachelor’s (or Master’s) in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Experience – 10+ years of systems engineering experience in the space industry, or 4+ years in a senior/lead role.
• Technical Expertise – Deep knowledge of digital and analog electronics design (mixed‑signal, high‑speed). Proficiency with Requirements Management Environment (RME) tools. Experience with radiation testing (TID, SEE) and mitigation techniques. Skilled in firmware/software integration for embedded microcontrollers/FPGA.
• Testing & Validation – Proven track record designing and executing electrical, EMI/EMC, thermal vacuum, vibration, and functional test plans. Ability to interpret and apply test data to design improvement.
• Soft Skills – Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication abilities. Team leadership and mentorship.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with RF processing system architecture and design including testing.
• Experience with space‑qualified microprocessors or FPGA families.
• Knowledge of system power calculations throughout a design cycle for space.
• Prior work with space‑qualifying standards: NASA SP‑3008, ECSS‑E‑ST‑20C, MIL‑STD‑1553, SpaceWire, etc.

Compensation: Base salary range is $130,000- $180,000, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

SEAKR is an Equal Opportunity Employer - All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US Citizenship Required

Applications will be accepted until 11/20/26.

With one procedure room, the center will provide high-quality, cost-effective outpatient cardiovascular care, including diagnostic heart catheterization, coronary interventions, peripheral interventions, and pacemaker and implantable cardiac device procedures.

Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Compass Surgical Partners (an ASC management organization), the center will combine advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient outpatient setting.

Anticipated hire date February 8th, ahead of center opening later in February 2027.

The Registered Nurse (RN) supports patients undergoing cardiac catheterization and interventional cardiovascular procedures. This position is responsible for assessing patients before and after procedures, delivering individualized nursing care, monitoring patient status during recovery, and collaborating with cardiologists and the Cath lab team to ensure safe, efficient procedures and optimal outcomes.

 - Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care in the cardiac catheterization lab and recovery settings

 - Assist physicians during diagnostic and interventional Cath lab procedures

 - Administer medications, monitor cardiac rhythms, and respond to changes in patient condition

 - Document accurately and communicate effectively with team members, physicians, and patients

 - Maintain sterile environments and adhere to safety and infection prevention protocols

 - Support patient education regarding procedures, recovery, and discharge instructions

 - Graduate of an accredited RN program

 - Current RN license (unencumbered)

 - At least 1 year of Cath Lab, ICU, ER, telemetry, or critical care nursing experience (within last 3–5 years)

 - Current BLS certification required

 - ACLS certification required (or obtained within 6 months of hire)

 - Preferred: Prior experience with cardiac monitoring, moderate sedation, or interventional procedures

 - Strong clinical judgment, communication, and teamwork skills

 - Ability to remain calm and respond effectively in high-acuity situations

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

 - Frequent standing, walking, lifting, and manual dexterity

 - Exposure to procedural environments, radiation, medical equipment, and patient care areas

 - Ability to respond quickly in emergency situations

 - Full-time, on-site position (Monday–Friday with possible call rotation)

Compensation & Benefits

 - Competitive pay with medical, dental, and vision insurance
