jobs.title: Capital Markets Manager
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

This person leads execution of Hadrian’s capital markets activity, with a primary emphasis on debt capital markets. They will translate Hadrian’s operational and financial needs (new factories, machine capex, working capital, and growth) into well-structured, executable financing transactions across both corporate and asset-backed contexts, and drive those transactions from structuring through diligence, negotiation, and close. They will own relationships with banks, private credit funds, and other debt capital providers, and partner closely with the CFO, SVP of Capital Markets, Treasury, FP&A, and Legal to align financing strategy with liquidity planning, capital allocation, and long-term planning. The role is explicitly outward-facing and execution-focused, operates comfortably in non-standard situations where Hadrian’s model does not fit traditional corporate lending frameworks, and will grow into building out the capital markets function as Hadrian’s financing cadence scales.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead end-to-end execution of debt transactions (credit facilities, term loans, private credit, equipment and facility financing, and structured debt) from initial structuring through diligence, negotiation, and closing.

 - Structure financing solutions across corporate and asset-backed contexts, tailored to Hadrian’s operating model, including equipment finance, receivables facilities, sale-leasebacks, project-level debt, and government-backed loans.

 - Own lender engagement and process management: build and manage relationships with banks, private credit funds, and institutional lenders; run competitive financing processes and coordinate diligence.

 - Lead term sheet negotiation, documentation, and closing in partnership with Legal, outside counsel, and finance leadership, with a clear point of view on pricing, covenants, security, and flexibility trade-offs.

 - Drive speed, certainty, and flexibility in capital access by proactively developing financing capacity and options ahead of need.

 - Partner with the CFO, SVP of Capital Markets, Treasury, and FP&A to align financing strategy with liquidity planning, cash forecasting, capital allocation priorities, and the operating plan.

 - Own the capital structure, debt capacity, and credit / downside models that underpin financing decisions, and set the standard for the team’s analytical work.

 - Present financing strategy and recommendations to the CFO, SVP of Capital Markets, Exec team, and Board; prepare lender and investor materials for live processes.

 - Oversee lender reporting and credit agreement compliance (compliance certificates, borrowing base and covenant calculations), and manage ongoing amendments, waivers, and upsizes.

 - Monitor debt and equity capital markets across A&D, industrials, and defense tech to benchmark Hadrian’s terms and identify windows of opportunity.

 - Mentor and develop analysts and associates on the team, and help build out the capital markets function as it scales, including future rating agency engagement and public-market readiness.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6–8+ years of experience in leveraged finance, debt capital markets, private credit, project finance, investment banking or structured finance, or in a corporate-side capital markets role.

 - Significant experience executing debt transactions end to end, including structuring, diligence, documentation, and closing.

 - Strong understanding of credit analysis, capital structures, and lender dynamics, including pricing, covenants, security packages, and key credit agreement terms.

 - Experience working directly with banks, direct lenders, and private credit funds, and the ability to independently drive complex, external-facing processes under tight timelines.

 - Advanced financial modeling skills with a focus on credit and downside analysis.

 - Strong judgment in structuring and negotiating complex transactions, with the presence to represent Hadrian in front of lenders, investors, and the Board.

 - High ownership and accountability for external execution, a bias toward action, and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving situations.

 - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience in structured or asset-backed financing (e.g., equipment finance, receivables facilities, project-based debt, sale-leasebacks).

 - Experience in capital-intensive or operationally complex industries (e.g., aerospace, defense, manufacturing, infrastructure).

 - Familiarity with government contracting environments (FAR, CAS, DCAA, contract types) and how they shape cash flow and credit profile.

 - Familiarity with government financing programs (e.g., DoD Office of Strategic Capital, DPA Title III, state and local incentives) and how they fit into a capital stack.

 - Experience with equity, convertible, and hybrid instruments, and evaluating debt vs. dilution trade-offs.

 - Experience building or scaling a capital markets or treasury function at a high-growth company.

 - An established network across the bank, private credit, and defense / space / manufacturing investor ecosystem.


COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $200,000 - $230,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. jobs.title: Senior Services Sales Executive, Strategic Accounts — Americas West
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

At Elastic, we believe that search is more than just a box—it's a way to solve the world's most complex data challenges. As a Senior Services Sales Executive for our Strategic Accounts segment, you will be the primary driver of professional services growth across our highest-value relationships in the Americas West. This is a quota-carrying sales role: you own the full services sales cycle—from pipeline origination through commercial close—across a portfolio of Global 500 and industry-leading accounts.

You are not just a trusted advisor; you are a closer. You arrive with an established network of senior relationships in the strategic segment—and you know how to activate them. You translate executive credibility and long-standing trust into pipeline, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and convert ambitious customer goals into scoped, commercially sound multi-million dollar engagement programs. You partner closely with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to embed services as a strategic pillar of every account plan, and you work hand-in-hand with our delivery leaders to ensure what you sell lands with exceptional outcomes.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own Your Number: Carry and consistently achieve a services bookings quota across a named portfolio of Strategic accounts. Build and maintain a healthy, stage-accurate pipeline with strong forecast discipline in Salesforce.

• Drive New Business: Proactively identify and originate services opportunities within existing accounts and new-to-services logos. You don't wait for the phone to ring—you map whitespace, uncover initiatives, and create demand.

• Lead the Full Services Sales Cycle: Run discovery, lead solutioning sessions, develop Statements of Work, structure creative commercial arrangements (T&M, fixed-fee, milestone-based), negotiate terms, and close. You own this process end-to-end.

• Sell Complex, Multi-Year Engagements: Architect and sell multi-phase, multi-million dollar programs tied to customers' largest transformation bets—modernization initiatives, platform migrations, security programs, and AI/analytics buildouts.

• Activate and Expand Your Network: You bring an established book of executive relationships in the strategic segment—and you put them to work. From day one, you leverage existing trust with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, and SVPs of Engineering to open doors, accelerate pipeline, and land early wins. Over time, you deepen those relationships and expand your reach into new stakeholders within the accounts you own.

• Partner with the Field: Work side-by-side with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to co-develop account plans, align on services investment strategies, and present a unified value story to customers. You amplify—not duplicate—the field team. We are not order takers, but rather help shape the larger Elastic strategy with our customers.

• Develop Compelling Business Cases: Lead ROI conversations and construct value frameworks that link Elastic's services investments to measurable customer outcomes—reduced time-to-value, improved MTTD/MTTR, lower operational costs, faster platform adoption.

• Shape Engagements for Delivery Success: Collaborate with Services Delivery leadership to scope engagements that are both winnable and deliverable. You set your customers and delivery teams up to succeed from day one.

• Contribute to Practice Growth: Share field intelligence on buyer patterns, competitive dynamics, and packaging gaps to help Elastic continuously sharpen its services offerings for the Strategic market.

What You Bring

• A Proven Services Sales Track Record: 10+ years of quota-carrying professional services sales experience, with consistent attainment selling into enterprise or strategic/global accounts. You have personally originated and closed multi-million dollar services engagements.

• An Established Network You Can Activate: You bring pre-existing executive relationships in the Global 500 / strategic segment—and a track record of converting those relationships into revenue. You don't need to spend your first year earning introductions; you arrive ready to open conversations and move deals.

• Strategic Account Depth: Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of complex, high-stakes accounts—not just renewing, but growing. You know what it takes to be trusted at the executive level over the long term, and you've done it.

• Commercial Sophistication: You are fluent in services deal structures—T&M, fixed-fee, managed services, subscription-based delivery models. You've negotiated Master Services Agreements, SOWs, and custom commercial terms with procurement and legal teams.

• Solutioning Credibility: You can lead technical scoping conversations. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you can translate customer architecture goals into realistic, well-scoped engagement plans that earn buy-in from both the buyer and the delivery team.

• Executive Presence: You are comfortable and effective in C-suite conversations. You ask sharp discovery questions, listen actively, and earn a seat at the table—not just a slot on the agenda.

• Pipeline Discipline: You build pipeline with intention and manage it rigorously. You forecast accurately, move deals with urgency, and never let momentum die on the customer's side.

• Field Collaboration: You thrive in a co-selling model. You know how to align with AEs, SEs, CSMs, and delivery leaders to drive the right outcome for the account—without ego or turf.

• Curiosity for the Technology: You don't need to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about how the technology works—and you invest in understanding it. You'll take the time to learn Elastic's platform, speak credibly about search, observability, and security use cases, and hold your own in conversations with technical buyers to earn you a seat at the table.

• Domain Relevance: Experience selling services in the search, observability, security, data analytics, or broader enterprise software space strongly preferred. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern data architectures is a plus.

• Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field. MBA or similar advanced degree is a plus.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 80/20 pay mix (base salary / target variable).

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

Different people approach problems differently. We need that.
